import fs from 'fs';

const staffPath = 'src/StaffApp.jsx';
let staffCode = fs.readFileSync(staffPath, 'utf8');

// 1. Add Legacy Colors
const colorsDef = `
const VELOX_DARK = {
  bg: "#0B111A", card: "#161F2F", cardAlt: "#1E293B", ink: "#FFFFFF",
  gray: "#8B9BB4", light: "#0B111A", line: "#273449",
  red: "#EF4444", redLight: "#451A1A", green: "#10B981", greenLight: "#0A2A20",
  amber: "#F59E0B", amberLight: "#3A2510", blue: "#3B82F6", blueLight: "#152A4A",
  gold: "#FF5A1F", goldDark: "#E04814", goldLight: "#2A1A15", goldText: "#FF8C5A",
};
const ORIGINAL_LIGHT = {
  bg: "#FAF7EF", card: "#FFFFFF", cardAlt: "#F4EEDD", ink: "#1C1608",
  gray: "#7A7058", light: "#FAF7EF", line: "#E9E0C9",
  red: "#DC2626", redLight: "#FEF2F2", green: "#16A34A", greenLight: "#F0FDF4",
  amber: "#F59E0B", amberLight: "#FFFBEB", blue: "#2563EB", blueLight: "#EFF6FF",
  gold: "#B8860B", goldDark: "#7A5806", goldLight: "#FBF3D9", goldText: "#8A6200",
};
`;
staffCode = staffCode.replace(/const LIGHT = \{[\s\S]*?\};\s*const DARK = LIGHT;/, colorsDef.trim());

// 2. Inject legacyUI State
staffCode = staffCode.replace(
  /const \[darkMode, setDarkMode\] = useState\(\(\) => safeStorageGet\("staff_dark", "0"\) === "1"\);/,
  `const [darkMode, setDarkMode] = useState(() => safeStorageGet("staff_dark", "0") === "1");
   const [legacyUI, setLegacyUI] = useState(false);`
);

// 3. Use legacyUI for Colors
staffCode = staffCode.replace(
  /const C = darkMode \? DARK : LIGHT;/,
  `const C = legacyUI ? ORIGINAL_LIGHT : VELOX_DARK;`
);

// 4. Conditionally Render Sidebar
staffCode = staffCode.replace(
  /\{\!isMobile && \(\s*<div style=\{\{ width: 260, background: C\.card, borderRight:/,
  `{!isMobile && !legacyUI && (\n        <div style={{ width: 260, background: C.card, borderRight:`
);

// 5. Add Toggle Button in Sidebar
staffCode = staffCode.replace(
  /<button onClick=\{handleLogout\} style=\{\{ width: "100%", padding: 8, background: "transparent", border: \`1px solid \$\{C\.line\}\`, color: C\.red, borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 12 \}\}>Logout<\/button>/,
  `<button onClick={() => setLegacyUI(true)} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 8, background: "transparent", border: \`1px solid \${C.line}\`, color: C.gold, borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 8 }}>Switch to Legacy UI</button>
            <button onClick={handleLogout} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 8, background: "transparent", border: \`1px solid \${C.line}\`, color: C.red, borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 12 }}>Logout</button>`
);

// 6. Conditionally Render Old Header
staffCode = staffCode.replace(
  /display: isMobile \? "flex" : "none", background: `linear-gradient/,
  `display: (isMobile || legacyUI) ? "flex" : "none", background: \`linear-gradient`
);

// 7. Conditionally Render Old Tabs
staffCode = staffCode.replace(
  /display: isMobile \? "flex" : "none", background: C\.card, borderBottom:/,
  `display: (isMobile || legacyUI) ? "flex" : "none", background: C.card, borderBottom:`
);

// 8. Add Switch back to New UI button in Old Header
staffCode = staffCode.replace(
  /<button onClick=\{handleLogout\} style=\{\{ background: "rgba\(255,255,255,0\.18\)", border: "none", color: "#fff", padding: isMobile \? "9px 10px" : "9px 16px", borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer" \}\}>Logout<\/button>/,
  `<button onClick={() => setLegacyUI(false)} style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)", border: "none", color: "#fff", padding: isMobile ? "9px 10px" : "9px 16px", borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", marginRight: 8 }}>âœ¨ New UI</button>
          <button onClick={handleLogout} style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)", border: "none", color: "#fff", padding: isMobile ? "9px 10px" : "9px 16px", borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer" }}>Logout</button>`
);

fs.writeFileSync(staffPath, staffCode);

# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the Oxlint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the [TS template](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts) for information on how to integrate TypeScript and Oxlint's TypeScript related rules in your project.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Patch 3 (pehle apply_fav_patch.py aur apply_fav_pin_patch.py lag chuke hone chahiye)

Features (BillingView / New Order screen):
  A1  Search me category naam se bhi item milega ("chinese" likho -> poori category)
  A2  Search box me  X  (clear) button
  B   Cart header me "Clear" button (sirf naye order me, confirm ke saath)
  C1  Favourites panel me owner ke pin kiye items ğŸ“Œ, auto wale â­
  C2  Favourites panel khula/band state yaad rahe (localStorage)

Har feature alag group hai: kisi group ka text match na ho to sirf wahi skip hota hai, baaki lag jate hain.

Use:   python3 apply_fav_pro_patch.py src/StaffApp.jsx
Undo:  cp src/StaffApp.jsx.bak_pro src/StaffApp.jsx
"""
import os
import shutil
import sys

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "src/StaffApp.jsx"

if not os.path.exists(path):
    print("ERROR: file nahi mili: " + path)
    sys.exit(1)

with open(path, encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    src = f.read()

if "pinnedIds" not in src or "showFav" not in src:
    print("ERROR: pehle apply_fav_patch.py aur apply_fav_pin_patch.py chalao. File change NAHI hui.")
    sys.exit(1)

groups = []

# A1: category se search
groups.append({
    "name": "A1 category search",
    "marker": 'String(m.category || "").toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch',
    "edits": [(
        r'''m.name.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch.toLowerCase())''',
        r'''(m.name.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch.toLowerCase()) || String(m.category || "").toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch.toLowerCase()))''',
    )],
})

# A2: search clear button
groups.append({
    "name": "A2 search clear (X)",
    "marker": 'aria-label="Search clear"',
    "edits": [(
        r'''<input placeholder="Search..." value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} style={{ padding: "10px 14px", border: `1px solid ${C.line}`, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 14, outline: "none", background: C.card, color: C.ink }} />''',
        r'''<div style={{ position: "relative", flexShrink: 0 }}><input placeholder="Search..." value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", padding: "10px 38px 10px 14px", border: `1px solid ${C.line}`, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 14, outline: "none", background: C.card, color: C.ink }} />{search && <button aria-label="Search clear" onClick={() => setSearch("")} style={{ position: "absolute", top: 6, right: 6, width: 28, height: 28, border: "none", borderRadius: 14, background: C.cardAlt, color: C.gray, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", padding: 0 }}>âœ•</button>}</div>''',
    )],
})

# B: clear cart (sirf naye order me)
groups.append({
    "name": "B clear cart",
    "marker": "Poora cart khaali",
    "edits": [(
        r'''+ Menu</button>}</div>''',
        r'''+ Menu</button>}{!existingOrder && cartItems.length > 0 && <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm("Poora cart khaali karein?")) { setCart({}); try { localStorage.removeItem("staff_draft_" + table); } catch (e) {} } }} style={{ float: "right", margin: "-3px 8px -3px 0", padding: "5px 12px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.red, borderRadius: 6, background: "transparent", color: C.red, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Clear</button>}</div>''',
    )],
})

# C1: pinned = ğŸ“Œ, auto = â­
groups.append({
    "name": "C1 pin marker",
    "marker": '"ğŸ“Œ" : "â­"',
    "edits": [(
        r'''â­ {m.name}{cart[m.id]''',
        r'''{pinnedIds.includes(m.id) ? "ğŸ“Œ" : "â­"} {m.name}{cart[m.id]''',
    )],
})

# C2: favourites panel state yaad rakho
groups.append({
    "name": "C2 remember panel state",
    "marker": "staff_fav_open",
    "edits": [
        (
            r'''const [showFav, setShowFav] = useState(false);''',
            r'''const [showFav, setShowFav] = useState(() => { try { return localStorage.getItem("staff_fav_open") === "1"; } catch (e) { return false; } });''',
        ),
        (
            r'''setShowFav((v) => !v)''',
            r'''setShowFav((v) => { const n = !v; try { localStorage.setItem("staff_fav_open", n ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {} return n; })''',
        ),
    ],
})

applied, skipped = [], []
for g in groups:
    if g["marker"] in src:
        skipped.append(g["name"] + " (pehle se laga hai)")
        continue
    bad = [(i + 1, src.count(f)) for i, (f, _) in enumerate(g["edits"]) if src.count(f) != 1]
    if bad:
        skipped.append(g["name"] + " (text match nahi hua: " + ", ".join("edit#%d=%d baar" % b for b in bad) + ")")
        continue
    for find, repl in g["edits"]:
        src = src.replace(find, repl, 1)
    applied.append(g["name"])

if not applied:
    print("Kuch apply nahi hua. File change NAHI hui.")
    for s in skipped:
        print("  skip: " + s)
    sys.exit(0)

bak = path + ".bak_pro"
shutil.copyfile(path, bak)
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(src)

print("Done. Backup: " + bak)
for a in applied:
    print("  OK:   " + a)
for s in skipped:
    print("  skip: " + s)
print("Undo: cp " + bak + " " + path)

import os, re, shutil, datetime

def backup(path):
    bak = path + ".bak_final." + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%H%M%S")
    shutil.copy2(path, bak)
    print(f"ğŸ’¾ Backup created: {bak}")

def main():
    path = "src/StaffApp.jsx"
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print("âŒ File nahi mili.")
        return

    backup(path)
    with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        src = f.read()

    print("ğŸ”§ Fixing transaction errors and duplicate items...")

    # 1. Fix "Order kisi aur ne badal diya" error (Transaction error handling)
    # Hum 'kisi aur ne badal diya' wale error ko catch karke warning show karenge
    error_text = "Order kisi aur ne badal diya"
    if error_text in src:
        # Agar exact error text milta hai, toh us throw statement ko replace karo
        src = src.replace('throw new Error("' + error_text + ' - screen band karke dobara kholo");', 'throw new Error("REFRESH_NEEDED");')
        src = src.replace('throw new Error("' + error_text + '");', 'throw new Error("REFRESH_NEEDED");')
        print("âœ… 1. Conflict error text handled.")
    
    # Catch block me REFRESH_NEEDED handle karo (taaki crash na ho)
    # Hum try-catch block me jaakar ek chota sa fix daalenge
    old_catch = "catch (e) { toast(e.message, \"error\"); } finally { lockRef.current = false; setPlacing(false); }"
    new_catch = """catch (e) {
        if (e.message === "REFRESH_NEEDED" || e.message.includes("badal diya")) {
          toast("Order update ho gaya tha, please wapas table par click karein.", "warning");
          onBack();
        } else {
          toast(e.message, "error");
        }
      } finally { lockRef.current = false; setPlacing(false); }"""
    
    count_catch = src.count(old_catch)
    if count_catch > 0:
        src = src.replace(old_catch, new_catch)
        print(f"âœ… 2. Catch block handled ({count_catch} places).")

    # 2. Fix duplicate item merge in running orders
    # Search for the array append logic in transaction
    old_items_append = "items: [...(live.items || []), ...newItems],"
    new_items_merge = """items: (() => {
              const merged = [...(live.items || [])];
              newItems.forEach(newItem => {
                const existing = merged.find(i => i.itemId === newItem.itemId);
                if (existing) existing.qty += newItem.qty;
                else merged.push(newItem);
              });
              return merged;
            })(),"""
    
    count_merge = src.count(old_items_append)
    if count_merge > 0:
        src = src.replace(old_items_append, new_items_merge)
        print(f"âœ… 3. Duplicate item merge fixed ({count_merge} places).")
    else:
        print("âš ï¸ Duplicate item merge logic not found (shayad pehle se fix hai).")

    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print("\nğŸ’¾ File saved successfully!")
    print("ğŸš€ Ab aap 'npm run build' chala kar deploy kar sakte hain.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

SEP = "// ==========================================================================="


def die(msg):
    print("âŒ " + msg)
    print("File me koi badlav NAHI hua.")
    sys.exit(1)


def find_file():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        return sys.argv[1]
    cands = [p for p in glob.glob("**/*.jsx", recursive=True) + glob.glob("**/*.js", recursive=True)
             if "node_modules" not in p and "EP-EST-v1" in open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()]
    if len(cands) == 1:
        return cands[0]
    die("Staff file nahi mili ya ek se zyada hain: %s\nPath do: python3 apply_estimate_v2.py src/StaffApp.jsx" % cands)


def main():
    path = find_file()
    src = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    print("ğŸ“„ File:", path)

    if "ESTIMATE PANEL v2" in src:
        die("Estimate v2 pehle se lagi hui hai.")

    # ---- Edit 1: purana estimate block -> naya
    i_est = src.find("// ğŸ“‹ ESTIMATE PANEL")
    i_main = src.find("// MAIN APP")
    if i_est < 0 or i_main < 0 or i_main < i_est:
        die("Edit 1: ESTIMATE PANEL / MAIN APP banner nahi mile.")
    start = src.rfind(SEP, 0, i_est)
    end = src.rfind(SEP, 0, i_main)
    if start < 0 or end < 0 or end <= start:
        die("Edit 1: banner lines nahi mili.")

    # ---- Edit 2
    a2 = "const [showEstimate, setShowEstimate] = useState(false);"
    if src.count(a2) != 1:
        die("Edit 2: showEstimate state line nahi mili.")

    # ---- Edit 3
    a3 = ">ğŸ“‹ Estimate</button>"
    if src.count(a3) != 1:
        die("Edit 3: Estimate tab button nahi mila.")

    # ---- Edit 4
    u_start = src.find("{showEstimate && (")
    u_end = src.find("{feedbackOrder && <FeedbackModal")
    if u_start < 0 or u_end < 0 or u_end < u_start:
        die("Edit 4: <EstimatePanel> usage block nahi mila.")

    # ---- Edit 5
    a5 = "setCart({}); setSelectedTable(null); setBillOrder(null); setAddMoreMode(false);\n    await signOut(auth);"
    has5 = src.count(a5) == 1

    # ---- Apply (peeche se aage, taaki index na bigde)
    out = src
    out = out[:u_start] + USAGE + out[u_end:]                       # 4
    out = out.replace(a3, ">ğŸ“‹ Estimate{estItems.length ? ` (${estItems.length})` : \"\"}</button>")  # 3
    out = out.replace(a2, a2 + STATE_ADD)                            # 2
    out = out[:start] + NEW_PANEL + out[end:]                        # 1 (usage/state ke baad, par index start<end pehle ke hain)
    if has5:                                                         # 5
        out = out.replace(a5, "setCart({}); setSelectedTable(null); setBillOrder(null); setAddMoreMode(false);\n    setEstItems([]); try { localStorage.removeItem(\"staff_estimate_items\"); } catch (e) {}\n    await signOut(auth);")

    shutil.copyfile(path, path + ".bak")
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(out)
    print("âœ… Edit 1-4 lag gaye" + (" + Edit 5" if has5 else " (Edit 5 skip: logout line match nahi hui, optional hai)"))
    print("ğŸ’¾ Backup:", path + ".bak")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

const ESTIMATE_COMPONENT = `
// ===========================================================================
// ğŸ“‹ ESTIMATE PANEL â€” persons + items (manual ya auto) + one-click cart
// ===========================================================================

const SUGGEST_RULES = [
  { re: /starter|snack|tandoor|appetizer|momos|roll/i, perPerson: 0.5, pick: 2 },
  { re: /main|curry|sabzi|gravy|paneer|chicken|mutton|fish|egg/i, perPerson: 0.7, pick: 3 },
  { re: /bread|roti|naan|paratha/i, perPerson: 2, pick: 2 },
  { re: /rice|biryani|pulao/i, perPerson: 0.5, pick: 1 },
  { re: /dessert|sweet|ice/i, perPerson: 0.5, pick: 1 },
  { re: /drink|beverage|juice|shake|cold|coffee/i, perPerson: 1, pick: 2 },
  { re: /thali/i, perPerson: 1, pick: 1 },
];

function buildSuggestion(menu, persons) {
  const used = new Set();
  const out = [];
  SUGGEST_RULES.forEach((rule) => {
    const pool = menu
      .filter((m) => rule.re.test(m.category || "") && !used.has(m.id) && m.available !== false)
      .sort((a, b) => (b.isBestseller ? 1 : 0) - (a.isBestseller ? 1 : 0))
      .slice(0, rule.pick);
    if (!pool.length) return;
    const totalQty = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(persons * rule.perPerson));
    const each = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalQty / pool.length));
    pool.forEach((m) => {
      used.add(m.id);
      out.push({ id: m.id, name: m.name, price: Number(m.price) || 0, qty: each });
    });
  });
  return out;
}

function EstimatePanel({ C, menu, isMobile, onClose, onMoveToCart }) {
  const [persons, setPersons] = React.useState(2);
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState("manual");
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = React.useState("");
  const [catFilter, setCatFilter] = React.useState("All");
  const toast = useToast();

  const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);

  const addItem = (m) =>
    setItems((prev) => {
      const ex = prev.find((p) => p.id === m.id);
      if (ex) return prev.map((p) => (p.id === m.id ? { ...p, qty: p.qty + 1 } : p));
      return [...prev, { id: m.id, name: m.name, price: Number(m.price) || 0, qty: 1 }];
    });

  const changeQty = (id, d) =>
    setItems((prev) =>
      prev.map((p) => (p.id === id ? { ...p, qty: p.qty + d } : p)).filter((p) => p.qty > 0)
    );

  const runAuto = () => {
    const s = buildSuggestion(menu, Number(persons) || 1);
    if (!s.length) { toast("Auto suggest ke liye menu me category match nahi mili", "warning"); return; }
    setItems(s);
  };

  const categories = React.useMemo(
    () => ["All", ...Array.from(new Set(menu.map((m) => m.category).filter(Boolean)))],
    [menu]
  );

    () => menu.filter((m) =>
      m.available !== false &&

    ).slice(0, 60),

  );

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# apply_menu_fix.py â€” Ek button jo sab theek karta hai (Auto-finds App.js)
import os, sys, re, shutil
from datetime import datetime

# â”€â”€ 1. App.js dhundho (recursively) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
found_files = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
    # Ignore useless folders
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ["node_modules", ".git", "dist", "build", ".next", "out"]]
    for file in files:
        if file in ["App.js", "App.jsx"]:
            found_files.append(os.path.join(root, file))

if not found_files:
    print("âŒ App.js ya App.jsx project me kahin nahi mila.")
    sys.exit(1)

if len(found_files) == 1:
    path = found_files[0]
    print(f"âœ… Target mil gaya: {path}")
else:
    print("âš ï¸ Ek se zyada App.js mile:")
    for i, p in enumerate(found_files):
        print(f"  [{i+1}] {p}")
    choice = input("Kaunsa edit karna hai? (number daalo, e.g. 1): ")
    try:
        path = found_files[int(choice)-1]
    except:
        print("âŒ Galat choice.")
        sys.exit(1)

content = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()

if "ONE-SHOT MENU FIX" in content:
    print("âš ï¸  Fix pehle se laga hai. Kuch nahi kiya.")
    sys.exit(0)

# â”€â”€ 2. STATE + HELPERS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
STATE_CODE = r'''
  // ğŸ©¹ ONE-SHOT MENU FIX â€” duplicates + naam + desc + photos (Wikipediaâ†’Cloudinary)
  const [fixState, setFixState] = useState(null);
  const [fixReport, setFixReport] = useState(null);
  const [fixProgress, setFixProgress] = useState({ done: 0, total: 0, msg: "" });
  const CLOUD_NAME = "nnddxvcn";
  const UPLOAD_PRESET = "eatpark_uploads";
  const isOwnImage = (u) => /cloudinary\.com|pexels\.com/.test(u || "");
  const normalizeDishName = (s) => {
    let n = String(s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    n = n.replace(/\bchilly\b/gi, "Chilli").replace(/\bchily\b/gi, "Chilli").replace(/\bchili\b/gi, "Chilli").replace(/\bmutter\b/gi, "Mutton");
    return n.split(" ").map(w => w ? w[0].toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase() : "").join(" ");
  };
  const normalizeDesc = (s, name) => {
    let d = String(s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (!d || d.length < 6) return `${name || "Fresh dish"} â€” freshly prepared with quality ingredients.`;
    if (!/[.!?]$/.test(d)) d += ".";
    return d[0].toUpperCase() + d.slice(1);
  };
  const wikiImage = async (dishName) => {
    const clean = String(dishName || "").replace(/\(.*?\)/g, "").replace(/\b\d+\s*(pc|pcs|piece|pieces|kg|gm|ml|ltr|plate|eggs?)\b/gi, "").replace(/\b(half|full|quarter|regular|special|small|large|medium|dry|gravy|steam|fry|tandoori)\b/gi, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (!clean) return "";
    try {
      const url = `https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&generator=search&gsrsearch=${encodeURIComponent(clean + " food")}&gsrlimit=1&prop=pageimages&piprop=thumbnail|original&pithumbsize=600&format=json&origin=*`;
      const r = await fetch(url);
      if (!r.ok) return "";
      const d = await r.json();
      const first = Object.values(d?.query?.pages || {})[0];
      const img = first?.thumbnail?.source || first?.original?.source;
      if (img && /\.(jpe?g|png|webp)/i.test(img)) return img;
    } catch (e) {}
    return "";
  };
  const cloudinaryUpload = async (remoteUrl) => {
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("file", remoteUrl);
      fd.append("upload_preset", UPLOAD_PRESET);
      fd.append("folder", "eatpark_auto");
      const r = await fetch(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload`, { method: "POST", body: fd });
      if (r.ok) { const d = await r.json(); if (d.secure_url) return d.secure_url; }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      const ir = await fetch(remoteUrl, { mode: "cors" });
      if (!ir.ok) return "";
      const blob = await ir.blob();
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("file", blob, "auto.jpg");
      fd.append("upload_preset", UPLOAD_PRESET);
      fd.append("folder", "eatpark_auto");
      const r = await fetch(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload`, { method: "POST", body: fd });
      if (r.ok) { const d = await r.json(); return d.secure_url || ""; }
    } catch (e) {}
    return "";
  };
  const scanFix = () => {
    setFixState("scanning");
    try {
      const norm = (s) => String(s || "").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      const richness = (m) => (isOwnImage(m.image) ? 20 : 0) + (m.image ? 5 : 0) + (m.desc ? 3 : 0) + (m.isBestseller ? 2 : 0) + ((m.alsoIn || []).length);
      const seen = {}, dupDeleteIds = new Set(), dupPairs = [];
      [...menu].sort((a, b) => richness(b) - richness(a)).forEach((m) => {
        const key = [norm(m.name), norm(m.portion), norm(m.category), Math.round(Number(m.price) || 0)].join("|");
        if (seen[key]) { dupDeleteIds.add(m.id); dupPairs.push({ keep: seen[key].name, del: m.name, price: m.price }); }
        else seen[key] = m;
      });
      const surviving = menu.filter(m => !dupDeleteIds.has(m.id));
      const nameFixes = [], descFixes = [];
      surviving.forEach(m => {
        const newName = normalizeDishName(m.name);
        if (newName && newName !== m.name) nameFixes.push({ id: m.id, from: m.name, to: newName });
        const newDesc = normalizeDesc(m.desc, newName || m.name);
        if (newDesc !== (m.desc || "")) descFixes.push({ id: m.id, from: m.desc || "(empty)", to: newDesc });
      });
      const imgTargets = surviving.filter(m => !isOwnImage(m.image)).map(m => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name, category: m.category }));
      setFixReport({ dupPairs, dupDeleteIds: [...dupDeleteIds], nameFixes, descFixes, imgTargets });
      setFixState("report");
    } catch (e) { alert("âŒ Scan fail: " + e.message); setFixState(null); }
  };
  const applyFix = async () => {
    if (!fixReport) return;
    const { dupDeleteIds, nameFixes, descFixes, imgTargets } = fixReport;
    const totalSteps = dupDeleteIds.length + nameFixes.length + descFixes.length + imgTargets.length;
    if (!window.confirm(`Final fix:\nâ€¢ ${dupDeleteIds.length} duplicates delete\nâ€¢ ${nameFixes.length} naam fix\nâ€¢ ${descFixes.length} description fix\nâ€¢ ${imgTargets.length} photo fetch\n\nBackup pehle save hoga. Continue?`)) return;
    setFixState("applying");
    setFixProgress({ done: 0, total: totalSteps, msg: "Backup save..." });
    try {
      try { localStorage.setItem("menu_backup_" + Date.now(), JSON.stringify({ at: Date.now(), menu })); } catch (e) {}
      try { const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify({ at: Date.now(), menu }, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" })); a.download = `menu-backup-${Date.now()}.json`; a.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 3000); } catch (e) {}
      const delSet = new Set(dupDeleteIds);
      const nameMap = Object.fromEntries(nameFixes.map(n => [n.id, n.to]));
      const descMap = Object.fromEntries(descFixes.map(n => [n.id, n.to]));
      let working = menu.filter(m => !delSet.has(m.id)).map(m => { let o = { ...m }; if (nameMap[m.id]) o.name = nameMap[m.id]; if (descMap[m.id]) o.desc = descMap[m.id]; return o; });
      let done = dupDeleteIds.length + nameFixes.length + descFixes.length;
      setFixProgress({ done, total: totalSteps, msg: "Photos fetch..." });
      for (let i = 0; i < imgTargets.length; i++) {
        const t = imgTargets[i];
        setFixProgress({ done: done + i, total: totalSteps, msg: `ğŸ–¼ï¸ ${i + 1}/${imgTargets.length}: ${t.name}` });
        try {
          const wikiUrl = await wikiImage(t.name);
          if (wikiUrl) { const cdnUrl = await cloudinaryUpload(wikiUrl); if (cdnUrl) working = working.map(m => m.id === t.id ? { ...m, image: cdnUrl } : m); }
        } catch (e) { console.warn("skip:", t.name); }
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
      }
      setFixProgress({ done: totalSteps, total: totalSteps, msg: "Firestore save..." });
      await setDoc(doc(db, "settings", "menu"), { items: working });
      setMenuState(working);
      setFixState("done");
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); alert("âŒ Apply fail: " + e.message); setFixState("report"); }
  };
  const closeFix = () => { setFixState(null); setFixReport(null); setFixProgress({ done: 0, total: 0, msg: "" }); };
'''

let fixed = false;

// Hum line 2575 se 2585 ke aas-paas check karenge jahan error aaya hai
for (let i = 2575; i < 2590; i++) {
  // Agar line mein </div> hai aur uske theek baad ModalShell aa raha hai

    break;
  }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const filePath = process.argv[2] || "src/StaffApp.jsx";

  console.error("âŒ File nahi mili:", filePath);
  process.exit(1);
}

let code = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
let edits = 0;

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// FIX 1: Menu Listener Limit (Crash fix)
// ---------------------------------------------------------
const menuListenerOld = `const unsubMenu = onSnapshot(doc(db, "settings", "menu"), (snap) => {
  if (snap.exists() && Array.isArray(snap.data().items) && snap.data().items.length > 0) {
    setMenu(snap.data().items);
  } else {
    console.warn("âš ï¸ Menu khali hai. Customer app se pehli baar khulne pe seed hoga.");
    setMenu([]);
  }
}, (err) => { console.error("menu listener:", err); });`;

const menuListenerNew = `const unsubMenu = onSnapshot(doc(db, "settings", "menu"), (snap) => {
  if (snap.exists() && Array.isArray(snap.data().items) && snap.data().items.length > 0) {
    // ğŸš€ FIX: 3900 items se crash hone se bachane ke liye sirf 150 items load karo
    setMenu(snap.data().items.slice(0, 150));
  } else {
    console.warn("âš ï¸ Menu khali hai. Customer app se pehli baar khulne pe seed hoga.");
    setMenu([]);
  }
}, (err) => { console.error("menu listener:", err); });`;

if (code.includes(menuListenerOld)) {
  code = code.replace(menuListenerOld, menuListenerNew);
  edits++;
  console.log("âœ… Fix 1 apply hua: Menu Listener par 150 items ki limit lag gayi.");
} else {
  console.log("âš ï¸ Fix 1 SKIP: Listener code bilkul match nahi hua. File manual check karein.");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// FIX 2: Filtered Items Limit (Render freeze fix)
// ---------------------------------------------------------
const filterOld = `const filtered = useMemo(() => menu.filter(m => m.available !== false && (category === "All" || m.category === category) && (!debouncedSearch.trim() || (m.name.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch.toLowerCase()) || String(m.category || "").toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch.toLowerCase())))), [menu, category, debouncedSearch]);`;

const filterNew = `const filtered = useMemo(() => menu.filter(m => m.available !== false && (category === "All" || m.category === category) && (!debouncedSearch.trim() || (m.name.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch.toLowerCase()) || String(m.category || "").toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch.toLowerCase())))).slice(0, 150), [menu, category, debouncedSearch]);`;

if (code.includes(filterOld)) {

  edits++;
  console.log("âœ… Fix 2 apply hua: Screen render par bhi 150 items ki limit lag gayi.");
} else {
  console.log("âš ï¸ Fix 2 SKIP: Filter code match nahi hua. File manual check karein.");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// FIX 3: Estimate List Limit (Agar wahan bhi crash ho raha ho)

      m.available !== false &&
      (catFilter === "All" || m.category === catFilter) &&

const brokenEstimate = `<span style={{ minWidth: 30, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 14, color: C.ink, fontFamily: "monospace" }}><input type="number" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQty(id, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)} style={{ width: 36, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 13, color: C.ink, border: "none", background: "transparent", outline: "none", fontFamily: "monospace" }} />`;
const fixedEstimate = `<span style={{ minWidth: 30, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 14, color: C.ink, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{q}</span>`;

if (code.includes(brokenEstimate)) {
  code = code.replace(brokenEstimate, fixedEstimate);
  console.log("âœ… Fix 1: Estimate Panel repair ho gaya (Build Error khatam).");
} else {
  // Agar line break ki wajah se nahi mila, toh regex se dhoondhenge
  const regex = /<span style={{ minWidth: 30, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 14, color: C.ink, fontFamily: "monospace" }}><input type="number" value={q}[\s\S]*?\/>/g;
  if (regex.test(code)) {
    code = code.replace(regex, `<span style={{ minWidth: 30, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 14, color: C.ink, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{q}</span>`);
    console.log("âœ… Fix 1: Estimate Panel repair ho gaya (Regex se).");
  } else {
    console.log("âš ï¸ Fix 1: Estimate panel pehle se theek hai.");
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// FIX 2: BILLING CART MEIN QTY INPUT ADD KARNA (Smart way)
// ---------------------------------------------------------
let edits = 0;
const lines = code.split('\n');
for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
  // Hum exact billing wali line dhoondh rahe hain jahan {q} akela ho
  if (lines[i].includes('{q}</span>') && lines[i].includes('fontSize: 13')) {
    lines[i] = lines[i].replace(/\{q\}<\/span>/, `<input type="number" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQty(id, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)} style={{ flex: 1, width: "100%", minWidth: 30, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 13, color: C.ink, border: "none", background: "transparent", outline: "none", fontFamily: "monospace" }} />`);
    edits++;
    break;
  }
}

if (edits > 0) {
  code = lines.join('\n');
  console.log("âœ… Fix 2: Billing Cart mein Qty editable input ban gaya.");
} else {
  console.log("âš ï¸ Fix 2: Billing Qty ka code nahi mila (Shayad pehle se input hai).");

def locate(arg):
    if arg:
        p = Path(arg)
        if p.exists():
            return p
        sys.exit(f"âŒ File nahi mili: {arg}")
    for c in ("src/App.jsx", "src/App.js"):
        if Path(c).exists():
            return Path(c)
    sys.exit("âŒ App file nahi mili. Path do: python3 apply_hardening.py src/App.jsx")


def balance(t):
    return (t.count("{") - t.count("}"), t.count("(") - t.count(")"), t.count("[") - t.count("]"))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("file", nargs="?")
    ap.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="Tier-2 patches bhi lagao")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    target = locate(a.file)
    dest = target.parent / "hardening.js"
    if not dest.exists():
        for src in (Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "hardening.js", Path.cwd() / "hardening.js"):
            if src.exists():
                if not a.dry_run:
                    shutil.copy(src, dest)
                print(f"ğŸ“„ hardening.js -> {dest}")
                break
        else:
            sys.exit("âŒ hardening.js nahi mili. Isse script ke saath rakho ya src/ me daalo.")

    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    before = balance(text)
    applied, already, failed, skipped = [], [], [], []

    for p in PATCHES:
        if p["tier"] == 2 and not a.all:
            skipped.append(p["name"])
            continue
        if p["new"] in text:
            already.append(p["name"])
            continue
        n = text.count(p["old"])
        if n != p["count"]:
            failed.append(f'{p["name"]}  (mila {n}, chahiye {p["count"]})')
            continue
        text = text.replace(p["old"], p["new"])
        applied.append(p["name"])

    if IMPORT_LINE not in text:
        sys.exit("âŒ Import patch fail hua â€” kuch bhi write nahi kiya. File me QRCodeSVG import line check karo.")

    after = balance(text)
    if after != before:
        sys.exit(f"âŒ Bracket balance badal gaya {before} -> {after}. Kuch write nahi kiya.")

    print("\nâœ… Applied:")
    for x in applied: print("   +", x)
    if already:
        print("\nâ†º Already applied:")
        for x in already: print("   =", x)
    if skipped:
        print("\nâ­  Skipped (Tier-2, --all se lagenge):")
        for x in skipped: print("   -", x)
    if failed:
        print("\nâš ï¸  Match nahi hua (file ka text alag hai â€” manual dekho):")
        for x in failed: print("   !", x)

    if a.dry_run:
        print("\n(dry-run: kuch write nahi hua)")
        return
    if not applied:
        print("\nKuch naya apply nahi hua.")
        return

    bak = target.with_name(f"{target.name}.bak.{int(time.time())}")
    shutil.copy(target, bak)
    target.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    print(f"\nğŸ’¾ Saved: {target}   (backup: {bak.name})")
    print("Ab chalao:  npm start   (ya)  npm run build   â€” aur  git diff  se review karo.")
    print("Undo:       git checkout -- " + str(target))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

function getErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message) return error.message;
  if (typeof error === "string") return error;
  if (error && typeof error === "object" && "message" in error) {
    return String(error.message);
  }
  return "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.";
}
function isRefreshNeeded(error) {
  const msg = getErrorMessage(error);
  return msg === "REFRESH_NEEDED" || msg.includes("badal diya");
}
function safeStorageGet(key, fallback = null) {
  try {
    const v = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    return v === null ? fallback : v;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}
function safeStorageSet(key, value) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, String(value));
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
function safeStorageRemove(key) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function getRangeBounds(range, customDate) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (range === "today") { const d = new Date(); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now }; }
  if (range === "yesterday") { const s = new Date(); s.setDate(s.getDate()-1); s.setHours(0,0,0,0); const e = new Date(); e.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: s.getTime(), end: e.getTime() }; }
  if (range === "7days") { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate()-6); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now }; }
  if (range === "30days") { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate()-29); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now }; }
  if (range === "month") { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(1); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now }; }
  if (range === "custom" && customDate) { const start = new Date(customDate + "T00:00:00").getTime(); return { start, end: start + 86400000 }; }
  const d = new Date(); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now };
}

function useHaptic() {
  return useCallback((ms = 10) => { try { if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(ms); } catch (e) {} }, []);
}
function useDebounce(value, delay = 150) {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delay);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, delay]);
  return debounced;
}
function useOnline() {
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.onLine : true);
  useEffect(() => {
    const up = () => setOnline(true), down = () => setOnline(false);
    window.addEventListener("online", up);
    window.addEventListener("offline", down);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("online", up); window.removeEventListener("offline", down); };
  }, []);
  return online;
}

function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const toast = useCallback((msg, type = "info", opts = {}) => {
    const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    setToasts(t => [...t, { id, msg, type, ...opts }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts(t => t.filter(x => x.id !== id)), opts.duration || 2800);
  }, []);
  return (
    <ToastCtx.Provider value={{ toast }}>
      {children}
      <div style={{ position: "fixed", top: 70, left: "50%", transform: "translateX(-50%)", zIndex: 9999, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 8, pointerEvents: "none", width: "calc(100% - 32px)", maxWidth: 420 }}>
        {toasts.map(t => {
          const bg = t.type === "success" ? "#16A34A" : t.type === "error" ? "#DC2626" : t.type === "warning" ? "#F59E0B" : "#111827";
          const icon = t.type === "success" ? "âœ…" : t.type === "error" ? "âš ï¸" : t.type === "warning" ? "â±ï¸" : "â„¹ï¸";
          return (
            <div key={t.id} style={{ background: bg, color: "#fff", padding: "12px 18px", borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, boxShadow: "0 10px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.22)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, animation: "slideInTop 0.22s ease-out", pointerEvents: "auto" }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>{icon}</span>
              <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{t.msg}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </ToastCtx.Provider>
  );
}

function AnimatedNumber({ value, duration = 600, format = true }) {
  const [display, setDisplay] = useState(0);
  const prevRef = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const from = prevRef.current;
    const to = Number(value) || 0;
    const start = Date.now();
    let raf;
    const tick = () => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (Date.now() - start) / duration);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      setDisplay(Math.round(from + (to - from) * eased));
      if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else prevRef.current = to;
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [value, duration]);
  return <>{format ? inr(display) : display}</>;
}

function Confetti({ show, duration = 1500 }) {

    size: 6 + Math.random() * 8,
  })));
  if (!show) return null;
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, pointerEvents: "none", zIndex: 9999, overflow: "hidden" }}>
      {items.map(p => (
        <div key={p.id} style={{
          position: "absolute", left: p.left + "%", top: -20,

      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function estKind(m) {
  const n = String(m.name || "").toLowerCase();
  const t = n + " " + String(m.category || "").toLowerCase();
  if (/thali|combo/.test(n)) return "thali";
  if (/roti|naan|paratha|parotta|parantha|kulcha|phulka|chapati/.test(n)) return "roti";
  if (/biryani|biriyani/.test(n)) return "biryani";
  if (/\brice\b|pulao|pulav/.test(n)) return "rice";
  if (/\bdal\b|daal|dhal/.test(n)) return "dal";
  if (/\bwater\b|mineral|bisleri/.test(n)) return "water";
  if (/pizza/.test(n)) return "pizza";
  if (/momo|dumpling|dim ?sum|spring roll/.test(n)) return "momo";
  if (/roll|burger|sandwich|wrap|maggi/.test(n)) return "snack";
  if (/soup|shorba/.test(n)) return "soup";
  if (/shake|lassi|juice|mojito|coffee|\btea\b|chai|cold drink|coke|pepsi|sprite|thums|soda|lemonade|mocktail|smoothie|buttermilk|chaas|sharbat/.test(n)) return "drink";
  if (/ice ?cream|kulfi|falooda|brownie|halwa|jalebi|gulab|rasgulla|rasmalai|kheer|sundae|dessert|sweet(?! corn)|cake|pastry|rabri/.test(n)) return "dessert";
  if (/noodle|chowmein|chow mein|chaumin|hakka|pasta|macaroni/.test(n)) return "noodle";
  if (/fries|wedges|finger chips/.test(n)) return "fries";
  if (/raita|salad|chutney|achar|pickle/.test(n)) return "side";
  if (/papad/.test(n)) return "papad";
  if (/tikka|kabab|kebab|seekh|tandoori|tangdi|reshmi|malai chaap|lollipop|\b65\b|crispy|nugget|wings|afghani|achari|hariyali|bbq|barbeque|pakora|pakoda|cutlet|tikki|\bfry\b/.test(n)
      && !/masala|gravy|kadai|kadhai|handi|korma|curry|makhani|butter|lababdar|bhuna|rogan|do pyaza/.test(n)) return "starter";
  if (/paneer|mushroom|chicken|mutton|fish|egg|manchurian|chilly|chilli|kadai|kadhai|masala|curry|soya|chaap|veg|gobi|aloo|sabzi|handi|korma|butter|dum|bhurji|kofta|palak|matar|tadka|lababdar|bhuna|rogan|starter|main|gravy|dry|chinese/.test(t)) return "pc";
  return "other";
}
function estPcPerPlate(name, def) {
  const mm = String(name || "").match(/(\d+)\s*(pc|pcs|piece|pieces)\b/i);
  return mm && Number(mm[1]) > 0 ? Number(mm[1]) : def;
}
const estFmt = (n) => String(Math.round(n * 100) / 100);
const estCeil = (x) => Math.max(1, Math.ceil(x - 0.05));
function estTag(m) {
  const r = EST_RULES[estKind(m)];
  if (!r) return "manual qty";
  return r.label + (r.pieces ? " Â· " + estPcPerPlate(m.name, r.plate) + " pc" : "");
}
function estLegend(lv) {
  const g = (k) => estFmt(EST_RULES[k].per[lv.i]);
  return "Per log: sabzi " + g("pc") + " pc Â· starter " + g("starter") + " pc Â· roti " + g("roti") + " Â· rice " + g("rice") + " Â· biryani " + g("biryani") + " Â· dal " + g("dal") + " plate";
}

// items: [{id,name,price,qty}], menuById: {id: menuItem}, pax: number, lv: EST_LEVELS entry
// return: { [id]: { qty, note } }  (sirf wahi items jinka rule hai)
function estCompute(items, menuById, pax, lv) {
  const groups = {};
  items.forEach((i) => {
    const k = estKind(menuById[i.id] || i);
    if (EST_RULES[k]) (groups[k] = groups[k] || []).push(i);
  });
  const out = {};
  Object.keys(groups).forEach((k) => {
    const r = EST_RULES[k], arr = groups[k], n = arr.length;
    if (r.pieces) {
      const pool = r.per[lv.i] + r.extra * (n - 1); // per log total piece (is type ki sab dish mila ke)
      const share = pool / n;                         // per log, is dish ke piece
      arr.forEach((it) => {
        const per = estPcPerPlate(it.name, r.plate);
        const pieces = share * pax;
        const qty = estCeil(pieces / per);
        out[it.id] = { qty, note: pax + " log x " + estFmt(share) + " pc = " + Math.round(pieces) + " pc / " + per + " pc plate = " + qty + " plate" };
      });
    } else {
      const each = r.per[lv.i];
      const total = (pax * each) / n;
      arr.forEach((it) => {
        const qty = estCeil(total);
        out[it.id] = { qty, note: pax + " log x " + estFmt(each) + " " + r.unit + (n > 1 ? " / " + n + " item" : "") + " = " + qty };
      });
    }
  });
  return out;
}
//LOGIC-END

function EstStepper({ C, q, onChange, size = 32 }) {
  const b = { width: size, height: size, border: "none", fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 900, cursor: "pointer", padding: 0, fontFamily: "inherit" };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", border: "1.5px solid " + C.gold, borderRadius: 10, overflow: "hidden", flexShrink: 0, background: C.card }}>
      <button onClick={() => onChange(q - 1)} style={{ ...b, background: C.cardAlt, color: C.ink }}>âˆ’</button>
      <span style={{ minWidth: 30, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 14, color: C.ink, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{q}</span>
      <button onClick={() => onChange(q + 1)} style={{ ...b, background: C.gold, color: "#fff" }}>+</button>
    </div>
  );
}

  const lv = EST_LEVELS.find((l) => l.id === level) || EST_LEVELS[1];
  const pax = Math.max(1, Number(persons) || 1);

  const count = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty, 0);

  const menuById = React.useMemo(() => { const o = {}; menu.forEach((m) => { o[m.id] = m; }); return o; }, [menu]);

  const popular = React.useMemo(() => {
    const cnt = {};
    (orders || []).forEach((o) => {

    const seen = new Set();

function ParcelView({ C, isMobile, orders, onNew, onBill, onAdd }) {
  const [, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => { const iv = setInterval(() => setTick(x => x + 1), 30000); return () => clearInterval(iv); }, []);
  const list = orders.filter(isOpenParcel).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
  const total = list.reduce((s, o) => s + (Number(o.finalTotal) || 0), 0);
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 14, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10 }}>
        <div>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: isMobile ? 18 : 22, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>Parcel ({list.length})</h2>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 2 }}>Baaki payment: {inr(total)}</div>
        </div>
        <button onClick={onNew} style={{ padding: "11px 18px", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${C.gold} 0%, ${C.goldDark} 100%)`, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>+ New Parcel</button>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr" : "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr))", gap: 12 }}>
        {list.map(o => {
          const st = STATUS[o.status] || STATUS.new;
          const stColor = C[st.color] || C.gray;
          const stBg = C[st.color + "Light"] || C.light;
          const cname = o.customer?.name && o.customer.name !== "Walk-in" ? o.customer.name : "";
          const cphone = o.customer?.phone || "";
          return (
            <div key={o.id} style={{ background: C.card, border: `2px solid ${stColor}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: isMobile ? 12 : 14 }}>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 6, gap: 8 }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 15, color: C.ink }}>ğŸ›ï¸ #{o.id?.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}</div>
                <span style={{ background: stBg, color: stColor, padding: "3px 10px", borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800 }}>{st.label}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                {timeAgo(o.createdAt)} ago{cname ? " - " + cname : ""}{cphone ? " - " + cphone : ""}{o.waiter ? " - " + o.waiter : ""}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.ink, lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {(o.items || []).map((it, i) => (
                  <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 8 }}>
                    <span>{it.qty}x {it.name}{it.portion ? ` (${it.portion})` : ""}</span>
                    <span style={{ color: C.gray, fontFamily: "monospace", flexShrink: 0 }}>{inr(it.price * it.qty)}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${C.line}`, paddingTop: 8, marginBottom: 10, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 600 }}>Total</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 900, color: C.goldText, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{inr(o.finalTotal || 0)}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 6 }}>
                <button onClick={() => onBill(o)} style={{ padding: 9, border: "none", borderRadius: 8, background: C.red, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Bill / Paid</button>
                <button onClick={() => onAdd(o)} style={{ padding: 9, border: "none", borderRadius: 8, background: C.green, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>+ Add Items</button>
                <button onClick={() => printKOT(o)} style={{ padding: 9, border: `1.5px solid ${C.blue}`, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.blue, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>KOT</button>
                <button onClick={() => whatsappBill(o)} style={{ padding: 9, border: `1.5px solid ${C.green}`, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.green, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>WhatsApp</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {list.length === 0 && <div style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1", textAlign: "center", padding: 60, color: C.gray }}><div style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 8 }}>ğŸ›ï¸</div><div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>Koi chalu parcel nahi</div></div>}
      </div>

}

function TablesView({ C, isMobile, orders, onTableClick, onEditBill, onAddMore, onMerge, onSplit, onMove, onFeedback, search, setSearch, todayRevenue, activeOrders }) {
  const [, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => { const iv = setInterval(() => setTick((x) => x + 1), 30000); return () => clearInterval(iv); }, []);
  const tableData = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    for (let i = 1; i <= TABLE_COUNT; i++) map[i] = { table: i, order: null };
    orders.filter(isOpenDineIn).forEach(o => {
      const t = Number(o.table);
      if (map[t]) map[t].order = o;
    });
    return Object.values(map);
  }, [orders]);

  const filteredTables = search.trim() ? tableData.filter(t => String(t.table).includes(search.trim())) : tableData;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr 1fr" : "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr))", gap: 10, marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${C.green}11 0%, ${C.green}05 100%)`, border: `1px solid ${C.green}33`, borderRadius: 12, padding: isMobile ? 12 : 16 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 800, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>Revenue</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: isMobile ? 16 : 22, fontWeight: 900, color: C.green, marginTop: 4, fontFamily: "monospace", whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}><AnimatedNumber value={todayRevenue} /></div>
        </div>

        <input value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search table..." style={{ padding: "9px 14px", border: `1px solid ${C.line}`, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 13, outline: "none", width: isMobile ? "100%" : 180, background: C.card, color: C.ink }} />

                <button onClick={() => onSplit(t.order)} style={{ padding: isMobile ?                 <button onClick={() => onMove(t.order)} style={{ padding: isMobile ? // ===========================================================================
// ORDERS VIEW (with optimistic update + toast)
// ===========================================================================
function OrdersView({ C, isMobile, orders, menu, waiterName, isOwner, filter, setFilter, rangeStart, rangeEnd, setOrders, onPaidSuccess, onAddMore, onEditBill }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const haptic = useHaptic();
  const defaultStart = useMemo(() => { const d = new Date(); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return d.getTime(); }, []);
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState(null);
  const payLockRef = useRef(false);
  const [payFor, setPayFor] = useState(null);
  const [cancellingId, setCancellingId] = useState(null);
  const start = rangeStart ?? defaultStart;
  const end = rangeEnd ?? Date.now();
  const rangeAll = orders.filter(o => {
    if (o.createdAt < start || o.createdAt >= end) return false;
    if (filter === "cancelled") return o.status === "cancelled";
    return o.status !== "cancelled";
  });
  const filtered =
    filter === "all" ? rangeAll
    : filter === "active" ? rangeAll.filter(isActiveOrder)
    : filter === "paid" ? rangeAll.filter(o => o.paid)
    : filter === "served" ? rangeAll.filter(o => o.status === "served")
    : filter === "cancelled" ? rangeAll
    : rangeAll.filter(o => o.status === filter);

  const advanceOrder = async (order) => {
    const idx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(order.status);
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= STATUS_FLOW.length - 1) return;
    const next = STATUS_FLOW[idx + 1];
    haptic(12);
    setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, status: next } : o));
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", order.id), { status: next }); toast("Order â†’ " + STATUS[next].label, "success"); }
    catch (e) {
      setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, status: order.status } : o));
      toast(e.message, "error");
    }
  };

  const voidOrder = async (o) => {
    if (!isOwner) { toast("Sirf owner delete kar sakta hai", "warning"); return; }
    const label = o.orderType === "parcel" ? "Parcel" : "Table " + o.table;
    if (!window.confirm(label + " - " + inr(o.finalTotal || 0) + (o.paid ? " (PAID)" : "") + "\nDelete karein? Revenue se hat jayega.")) return;
    const reason = window.prompt("Cancel karne ka reason? (zaroori)", "");
    if (reason === null) return;
    if (!reason.trim()) { toast("Reason likhna zaroori hai", "warning"); return; }
    setCancellingId(o.id);
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", o.id), {
        status: "cancelled", cancelledAt: Date.now(),
        cancelledBy: waiterName || "Staff",
        cancelledReason: reason.trim(),
        voidedWasPaid: !!o.paid,
      });
      logAudit("void_order", { orderId: o.id, total: o.finalTotal || 0, wasPaid: !!o.paid, reason: reason.trim() });
      toast("Order delete ho gaya", "success");
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
    finally { setCancellingId(null); }
  };

  const restoreOrder = async (o) => {
    if (!isOwner) { toast("Sirf owner restore kar sakta hai", "warning"); return; }
    if (!window.confirm("Is cancelled order ko restore karein?")) return;
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", o.id), {
        status: o.voidedWasPaid ? "served" : "new",
        cancelledAt: null, cancelledBy: null, cancelledReason: null, voidedWasPaid: null,
        restoredAt: Date.now(), restoredBy: waiterName || "Staff",
      });
      logAudit("restore_order", { orderId: o.id, wasPaid: !!o.voidedWasPaid });
      toast("Order restore ho gaya", "success");
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
  };

  const undoPaid = async (o) => {
    if (!isOwner) { toast("Sirf owner undo kar sakta hai", "warning"); return; }
    if (!window.confirm("Is order ka payment undo karein? (paid -> pending)")) return;
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", o.id), {
        paid: false, paymentStatus: "pending",
        paidAt: null, paidBy: null, payment: "cash",
        undonePaidAt: Date.now(), undonePaidBy: waiterName || "Staff",
      });
      logAudit("undo_paid", { orderId: o.id, total: o.finalTotal || 0 });
      toast("Payment undo ho gaya", "success");
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
  };

  const markPaidWith = async (order, mode) => {
    if (payLockRef.current) return;
    payLockRef.current = true;
    haptic(30);
    const patch = buildPaidPatch(order, mode, waiterName);
    // status "served" ka rule: buildPaidPatch (orderRules.js) - orders tab
    setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, ...patch } : o));
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", order.id), patch);
      logAudit("paid", { orderId: order.id, total: order.finalTotal || 0, mode }); toast("Payment received!", "success");
      if (onPaidSuccess) onPaidSuccess();
    } catch (e) {
      setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? order : o));
      toast(e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      payLockRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  const filterLabel = filter === "cancelled" ? "Cancelled" : filter.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + filter.slice(1);

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 16, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 12 }}>
        <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: isMobile ? 18 : 22, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>{filterLabel} Orders ({filtered.length})</h2>
        {payFor && (
          <ModalShell C={C} open onClose={() => setPayFor(null)} isMobile={isMobile} title="Payment mode" icon="ğŸ’°" maxWidth={340}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: C.gray, marginBottom: 14 }}>{payFor.orderType === "parcel" ? "Parcel" : "Table " + payFor.table} - {inr(payFor.finalTotal || 0)}</div>
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr 1fr", gap: 8 }}>
              {[["cash", "Cash", C.green], ["upi", "UPI", C.blue], ["card", "Card", C.amber]].map(([m, l, c]) => (
                <button key={m} onClick={() => { const o = payFor; setPayFor(null); markPaidWith(o, m); }} style={{ padding: "14px 4px", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, background: c, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{l}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </ModalShell>
        )}
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          {["all", "active", ...STATUS_FLOW, "paid", "cancelled"].map(f => (
            <button key={f} onClick={() => { haptic(); setFilter(f); }} style={{ padding: isMobile ? "6px 10px" : "7px 14px", borderRadius: 20, border: "1px solid " + (filter === f ? C.gold : C.line), background: filter === f ? C.gold : C.card, color: filter === f ? "#fff" : C.gray, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: isMobile ? 11 : 12, cursor: "pointer", textTransform: "capitalize", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{f}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile || filter === "all" ? "1fr" : "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(340px, 1fr))", gap: filter === "all" ? 8 : 12 }}>
        {filtered.map(o => {
          const st = STATUS[o.status] || STATUS.new;
          const stColor = C[st.color] || C.gray;
          const stBg = C[st.color + "Light"] || C.light;
          const isCancelled = o.status === "cancelled";
          const isOpen = filter !== "all" || openId === o.id;
          if (!isOpen && !isCancelled) return (
            <button key={o.id} onClick={() => { haptic(); setOpenId(o.id); }} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, width: "100%", padding: isMobile ? "9px 10px" : "10px 14px", background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 10, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", textAlign: "left", color: C.ink }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{o.orderType === "parcel" ? "Parcel" : "T" + o.table}</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>#{o.id?.slice(1,5).toUpperCase()} - {timeAgo(o.createdAt)}</span>
              <span style={{ background: stBg, color: stColor, padding: "2px 8px", borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{st.label}</span>
              {o.paid && <span style={{ background: C.greenLight, color: C.green, padding: "2px 8px", borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800 }}>PAID</span>}
              <span style={{ marginLeft: "auto", fontWeight: 900, color: C.goldText, fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: 13, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{inr(o.finalTotal || 0)}</span>
              <span style={{ color: C.gray, fontSize: 10 }}>â–¼</span>
            </button>
          );
          return (
            <div key={o.id} style={{ background: isCancelled ? C.redLight : C.card, border: "1px solid " + (isCancelled ? C.red : C.line), borderRadius: 12, padding: isMobile ? 12 : 16, boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)", animation: "fadeIn 0.25s", opacity: isCancelled ? 0.9 : 1 }}>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 10, gap: 8 }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: isMobile ? 14 : 15, color: C.ink }}>{o.orderType === "parcel" ? "Parcel" : "Table " + o.table}</div>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}>
                  <span style={{ background: stBg, color: stColor, padding: "4px 10px", borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{st.label}</span>
                  {filter === "all" && !isCancelled && <button onClick={() => setOpenId(null)} style={{ border: "1px solid " + C.line, background: C.cardAlt, color: C.gray, borderRadius: 8, padding: "3px 9px", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>â–²</button>}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, marginBottom: 10, display: "flex", gap: 12, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                <span>#{o.id?.slice(1,5).toUpperCase()}</span><span>{timeAgo(o.createdAt)} ago</span>{o.waiter && <span>{o.waiter}</span>}
              </div>
              {isCancelled && (
                <div style={{ background: C.amberLight, color: C.amber, padding: "8px 10px", borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 10 }}>
                  Cancelled by {o.cancelledBy || "?"} - {o.cancelledReason || "-"}{o.voidedWasPaid ? " (was PAID)" : ""}
                </div>
              )}
              <div style={{ fontSize: isMobile ? 12 : 13, color: C.ink, lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: 10 }}>
                {(o.items || []).map((it, i) => <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "2px 0", gap: 8 }}><span>{it.qty}x {it.name}</span><span style={{ color: C.gray, fontFamily: "monospace", flexShrink: 0 }}>{inr(it.price * it.qty)}</span></div>)}
              </div>
              <div style={{ borderTop: "1px solid " + C.line, paddingTop: 10, marginBottom: 12, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 600 }}>Total</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: isMobile ? 16 : 18, fontWeight: 900, color: C.goldText, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{inr(o.finalTotal || 0)}</span>
              </div>
              {o.paid && <div style={{ background: C.greenLight, color: C.green, padding: "6px 10px", borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, marginBottom: 10, textAlign: "center" }}>PAID {o.payment ? "(" + o.payment.toUpperCase() + ")" : ""}</div>}
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 6 }}>
                {isCancelled && isOwner && (
                  <button onClick={() => restoreOrder(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, background: C.green, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", gridColumn: "span 2" }}>Restore Order</button>
                )}
                {!isCancelled && o.status !== "served" && <button onClick={() => advanceOrder(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, background: stColor, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{o.status === "new" ? "Start" : o.status === "preparing" ? "Ready" : "Serve"}</button>}
                {!isCancelled && !o.paid && <button onClick={() => setPayFor(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.green, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.green, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Paid</button>}
                {!isCancelled && o.paid && isOwner && <button onClick={() => undoPaid(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.amber, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.amber, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Undo Paid</button>}
                {!isCancelled && !o.paid && <button onClick={() => onAddMore && onAddMore(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, background: C.green, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>+ Add Items</button>}
                {!isCancelled && !o.paid && <button onClick={() => onEditBill && onEditBill(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, background: C.red, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Edit Bill</button>}
                {!isCancelled && <button onClick={() => printKOT(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.blue, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.blue, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>KOT</button>}
                {!isCancelled && <button onClick={() => printBill(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.red, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.red, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Bill</button>}
                {!isCancelled && <button onClick={() => whatsappBill(o)} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.green, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.green, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>WhatsApp</button>}
                {!isCancelled && (
                  <button onClick={() => voidOrder(o)} disabled={cancellingId === o.id} style={{ padding: "9px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.gray, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.gray, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: cancellingId === o.id ? "not-allowed" : "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", gridColumn: "span 2" }}>{cancellingId === o.id ? "Deleting..." : "Delete Order"}</button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {filtered.length === 0 && <div style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1", textAlign: "center", padding: 60, color: C.gray }}><div style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 8 }}>ğŸ˜Œ</div><div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>Koi order nahi</div></div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// KITCHEN VIEW (with aging bar)
// ===========================================================================
/*P5*/ function kotDisplayItems(o) {
  const kots = o.kots || [];
  const last = kots[kots.length - 1];
  if (kots.length < 2 || !last) return o.items || [];
  const fresh = (last.items || []).map((i) => ({ ...i }));
  const gone = (last.removedItems || []).map((i) => ({ ...i, _cancel: true }));
  const prev = kots.slice(0, -1).flatMap((k) => k.items || []).map((i) => ({ ...i, _old: true }));
  return [...fresh, ...gone, ...prev];
}
function KOTView({ C, isMobile, orders, setOrders }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const haptic = useHaptic();
  const [, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => { const iv = setInterval(() => setTick(x => x + 1), 15000); return () => clearInterval(iv); }, []);
  const kotOrders = orders.filter(o => (o.status === "new" || o.status === "preparing") && Date.now() - (o.createdAt || 0) < OPEN_WINDOW_MS);
  const advanceOrder = async (order) => {
    const idx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(order.status);
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= STATUS_FLOW.length - 1) return;
    const next = STATUS_FLOW[idx + 1];
    haptic(12);
    setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, status: next } : o));
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", order.id), { status: next }); toast(STATUS[next].label, "success"); }
    catch (e) { setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, status: order.status } : o)); toast(e.message, "error"); }
  };
  return (
    <div>
      <h2 style={{ margin: "0 0 16px", fontSize: isMobile ? 18 : 22, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>Kitchen ({kotOrders.length})</h2>
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr" : "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr))", gap: 12 }}>
        {kotOrders.map(o => {
          const isNew = o.status === "new";
          const mins = Math.floor((Date.now() - (o.lastKotAt || o.createdAt)) / 60000);
          const late = mins >= 15;
          const aging = Math.min(100, (mins / 20) * 100);
          return (
            <div key={o.id} style={{ background: isNew ? C.redLight : C.amberLight, border: `2px solid ${late ? C.red : isNew ? C.red : C.amber}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: isMobile ? 12 : 16, animation: late ? "lateBlink 1.2s infinite" : "none", overflow: "hidden", position: "relative" }}>
              <div style={{ height: 4, background: C.line, borderRadius: 2, marginBottom: 12, overflow: "hidden" }}>
                <div style={{ width: `${aging}%`, height: "100%", background: mins < 10 ? C.green : mins < 15 ? C.amber : C.red, transition: "width 0.5s" }} />
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: isMobile ? 15 : 17, color: C.ink }}>{o.orderType === "parcel" ? "Parcel" : `Table ${o.table}`}</div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: late ? C.red : C.gray, fontWeight: 800 }}>{mins}m</span>
              </div>
              {kotDisplayItems(o).map((it, i) => <div key={i} style={{ opacity: it._old ? 0.45 : 1, textDecoration: it._cancel ? "line-through" : "none", fontSize: isMobile ? 13 : 15, fontWeight: 700, padding: "6px 0", borderBottom: `1px dashed ${C.line}`, color: C.ink }}>{it.qty}x {it.name}{it.portion ? <span style={{ color: C.gray, fontWeight: 500 }}> ({it.portion})</span> : ""}</div>)}
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, marginTop: 12 }}>
                <button onClick={() => advanceOrder(o)} style={{ flex: 1, padding: "10px", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, background: isNew ? C.red : C.amber, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{isNew ? "Start Cooking" : "Mark Ready"}</button>
                <button onClick={() => printKOT(o)} style={{ padding: "10px 14px", border: `1.5px solid ${C.line}`, borderRadius: 8, background: "transparent", color: C.ink, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Print</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {kotOrders.length === 0 && <div style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1", textAlign: "center", padding: 60, color: C.gray }}><div style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 8 }}>ğŸ˜Œ</div><div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>Kitchen khaali hai</div></div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ===========================================================================
// DASHBOARD VIEW (with animated numbers)
// ===========================================================================
function DashboardView({ C, isMobile, orders, dueOrders, menu, onStatusClick, onOrderClick }) {
  const todayStr = invDateKey();
  const [range, setRange] = useState("today");
  const [customDate, setCustomDate] = useState(todayStr);
  const haptic = useHaptic();

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (range === "today") { const s = new Date(); s.setHours(0,0,0,0); return orders.filter(o => o.createdAt >= s.getTime()); }
    if (range === "yesterday") { const s = new Date(); s.setDate(s.getDate()-1); s.setHours(0,0,0,0); const e = new Date(); e.setHours(0,0,0,0); return orders.filter(o => o.createdAt >= s.getTime() && o.createdAt < e.getTime()); }
    if (range === "7days") { const s = new Date(); s.setDate(s.getDate()-6); s.setHours(0,0,0,0); return orders.filter(o => o.createdAt >= s.getTime()); }
    if (range === "30days") { const s = new Date(); s.setDate(s.getDate()-29); s.setHours(0,0,0,0); return orders.filter(o => o.createdAt >= s.getTime()); }
    if (range === "month") { const s = new Date(); s.setDate(1); s.setHours(0,0,0,0); return orders.filter(o => o.createdAt >= s.getTime()); }
    if (range === "custom" && customDate) { const s = new Date(customDate + "T00:00:00").getTime(); const e = s + 86400000; return orders.filter(o => o.createdAt >= s && o.createdAt < e); }
    return orders;
  }, [orders, range, customDate]);

  const todayRevenue = paidRevenue(filtered);
  const todayTotal = filtered.filter(o => o.status !== "cancelled").length;
  const paidCount = paidOrders(filtered).length;
  const activeOrders = filtered.filter(isActiveOrder).length;
  const avgOrder = paidCount ? Math.round(todayRevenue / paidCount) : 0;
  const statusCounts = { new: 0, preparing: 0, ready: 0, served: 0 };
  filtered.forEach(o => { if (statusCounts[o.status] !== undefined) statusCounts[o.status]++; });
  const recentOrders = [...filtered].filter(o => o.status !== "cancelled").sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt).slice(0, 20);
  const hourCounts = Array.from({ length: 24 }, () => 0);
  filtered.forEach(o => { if (o.status !== "cancelled") hourCounts[new Date(o.createdAt).getHours()]++; });
  const rangeLabel = { today: "Today", yesterday: "Yesterday", "7days": "Last 7 Days", "30days": "Last 30 Days", month: "This Month", custom: `Date: ${customDate}` }[range] || "Today";

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 16, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 12 }}>
        <div>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: isMobile ? 18 : 22, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>Dashboard</h2>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, marginTop: 2, fontWeight: 700 }}>{rangeLabel} - {todayTotal} orders</div>
        </div>
        <input type="date" value={customDate} onChange={e => { setCustomDate(e.target.value); setRange("custom"); }} style={{ padding: "8px 12px", border: `1px solid ${C.line}`, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 13, background: C.card, color: C.ink, fontWeight: 700, outline: "none" }} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, marginBottom: 20, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        {[{ id: "today", label: "Today" }, { id: "yesterday", label: "Yesterday" }, { id: "7days", label: "7 Days" }, { id: "30days", label: "30 Days" }, { id: "month", label: "Month" }].map(r => (
          <button key={r.id} onClick={() => { haptic(); setRange(r.id); }} style={{ padding: isMobile ? "6px 10px" : "7px 14px", borderRadius: 20, border: `1px solid ${range === r.id ? C.gold : C.line}`, background: range === r.id ? C.gold : C.card, color: range === r.id ? "#fff" : C.gray, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: isMobile ? 11 : 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{r.label}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr 1fr" : "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))", gap: isMobile ? 10 : 14, marginBottom: 24 }}>
        {[
          { label: "Revenue", val: todayRevenue, color: C.green, icon: "ğŸ’°", click: null, fmt: true },
          { label: "Orders", val: todayTotal, color: C.red, icon: "ğŸ“‹", click: () => onStatusClick("all", getRangeBounds(range, customDate)), fmt: false },
          { label: "Paid", val: paidCount, color: C.green, icon: "âœ…", click: () => onStatusClick("paid", getRangeBounds(range, customDate)), fmt: false },
          { label: "Active", val: activeOrders, color: C.amber, icon: "ğŸ”¥", click: () => onStatusClick("active", getRangeBounds(range, customDate)), fmt: false },
          { label: "Avg", val: avgOrder, color: C.blue, icon: "ğŸ“ˆ", click: null, fmt: true },
        ].map((s, i) => (
          <div key={i} onClick={s.click || undefined} style={{ background: C.card, border: `1px solid ${C.line}`, borderRadius: 14, padding: isMobile ? 12 : 20, boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)", cursor: s.click ? "pointer" : "default", transition: "all 0.2s" }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, color: C.gray, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>{s.label}</div>
              <span style={{ fontSize: isMobile ? 18 : 26 }}>{s.icon}</span>
            </div>

                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>#{o.id.slice(1,5).toUpperCase()} - {timeAgo(o.createdAt)} ago - {(o.items || []).length} items</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign: "right", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: isMobile ? 14 : 16, fontWeight: 900, color: C.goldText, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{inr(o.finalTotal || 0)}</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
