          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 16 }}>
            {actBtn("â¬‡ Excel", downloadExcel, true)}
            {actBtn("ğŸ–¨ PDF / Print", printPnl, false)}
            {actBtn("WhatsApp", shareWhatsapp, false)}
          </div>

          <div style={box}>
            <div style={boxTitle}>Payment Split</div>
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr 1fr" : "repeat(4, 1fr)", gap: 10 }}>
              {[["Cash", s.pay.cash, C.green], ["UPI", s.pay.upi, C.blue], ["Card", s.pay.card, C.amber], ["Discount diya", s.discount, C.gray]].map(([l, v, c]) => (
                <div key={l} style={{ background: C.cardAlt, borderRadius: 10, padding: 12 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 800 }}>{l}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: isMobile ? 15 : 18, fontWeight: 900, color: c, fontFamily: "monospace", marginTop: 4 }}>{inr(v)}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={box}>
            <div style={boxTitle}>Kharcha Category-wise</div>
            {s.catRows.length === 0 && <div style={{ color: C.gray, fontSize: 13, textAlign: "center", padding: 10 }}>Kharcha tab me entry karo</div>}
            {s.catRows.map(([c, v]) => (
              <div key={c} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 3 }}>
                  <span>{c}</span><span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: C.gray }}>{inr(v)} ({s.expTotal ? Math.round((v / s.expTotal) * 100) : 0}%)</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ height: 6, background: C.line, borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden" }}><div style={{ width: (s.expTotal ? (v / s.expTotal) * 100 : 0) + "%", height: "100%", background: G }} /></div>
              </div>
            ))}
            {s.revenue > 0 && s.saman > 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 8 }}>Saman / kaccha maal = bikri ka <b style={{ color: GT }}>{Math.round((s.saman / s.revenue) * 100)}%</b> (food cost)</div>}
          </div>

          <div style={box}>
            <div style={boxTitle}>Daily Revenue vs Kharcha <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700 }}>(hara = bikri, laal = kharcha)</span></div>
            {s.daily.length === 0 && <div style={{ color: C.gray, fontSize: 13, textAlign: "center", padding: 10 }}>Koi data nahi</div>}
            {s.daily.map((d) => (
              <div key={d.date} style={{ marginBottom: 11 }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 3 }}>
                  <span>{d.date.slice(5)} <span style={{ color: C.gray }}>({d.orders})</span></span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: d.profit >= 0 ? C.green : C.red }}>{d.profit >= 0 ? "+" : "-"}{inr(Math.abs(d.profit))}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ height: 6, background: C.line, borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden", marginBottom: 2 }}><div style={{ width: (d.revenue / maxDay) * 100 + "%", height: "100%", background: C.green }} /></div>
                <div style={{ height: 6, background: C.line, borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden" }}><div style={{ width: (d.expense / maxDay) * 100 + "%", height: "100%", background: C.red }} /></div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div style={box}>
            <div style={boxTitle}>Top Items (amount se)</div>
            {s.items.length === 0 && <div style={{ color: C.gray, fontSize: 13, textAlign: "center", padding: 10 }}>Koi paid sale nahi</div>}
            {s.items.slice(0, 10).map((it, i) => (
              <div key={it.name} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 8, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 3 }}>
                  <span style={{ overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap", minWidth: 0 }}>#{i + 1} {it.name}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: C.gray, flexShrink: 0 }}>{it.qty} - {inr(it.amt)}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ height: 6, background: C.line, borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden" }}><div style={{ width: (it.amt / maxItem) * 100 + "%", height: "100%", background: G }} /></div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {s.waiters.length > 0 && (
            <div style={box}>
              <div style={boxTitle}>Waiter-wise Sale</div>
              {s.waiters.map((w) => (
                <div key={w.name} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "8px 0", borderBottom: "1px dashed " + C.line, fontSize: 13, color: C.ink, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  <span>{w.name} <span style={{ color: C.gray, fontWeight: 600 }}>({w.orders} orders)</span></span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", color: GT }}>{inr(w.amt)}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ ...box, border: "1.5px solid " + G }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 10 }}>
              <div style={{ ...boxTitle, marginBottom: 0 }}>ğŸ”’ Din Band (Day Close)</div>
              <button onClick={closeDay} style={{ padding: "10px 16px", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, background: isTodayOnly ? G : C.line, color: isTodayOnly ? "#fff" : C.gray, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Aaj ka din band karo</button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, marginBottom: 10 }}>{isTodayOnly ? "Opening cash aur gina hua cash daalo - system cash ka fark bata dega." : "Day Close ke liye upar 'Aaj' chuno."}</div>
            {closes.length === 0 && <div style={{ color: C.gray, fontSize: 12, textAlign: "center", padding: 8 }}>Abhi koi din band nahi hua</div>}
            {closes.map((c) => (
              <div key={c.id} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, padding: "9px 0", borderTop: "1px dashed " + C.line, fontSize: 12, color: C.ink, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <div>{c.date} <span style={{ color: C.gray, fontWeight: 600 }}>- Bikri {inr(c.revenue)} - Kharcha {inr(c.expenses)}</span></div>
                  <div style={{ color: (c.profit || 0) >= 0 ? C.green : C.red, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{(c.profit || 0) >= 0 ? "Profit " : "Loss "}{inr(Math.abs(c.profit || 0))}</div>
                </div>
                <span style={{ background: (c.cashDiff || 0) === 0 ? C.greenLight : C.amberLight, color: (c.cashDiff || 0) === 0 ? C.green : C.amber, padding: "3px 9px", borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, flexShrink: 0 }}>{(c.cashDiff || 0) === 0 ? "Cash sahi" : "Fark " + ((c.cashDiff || 0) > 0 ? "+" : "-") + inr(Math.abs(c.cashDiff || 0))}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      </>)}
    </div>
  );
}



// ===========================================================================
// VENDOR DUE TRACKING (patch 5)
// collections: vendors/{id}, vendorPayments/{id}
// Expense mode="credit" => due create, cash out NAHI, P&L expense HAAN
// vendorPayments       => due kam, P&L expense NAHI, cash out HAAN
// ===========================================================================

const modeLabel = (m) => ({ cash: "Cash", upi: "UPI", bank: "Bank", credit: "Udhaar" }[m] || m);

async function loadVendorDues() {
  const [vSnap, eSnap, pSnap] = await Promise.all([
    getDocs(collection(db, "vendors")),
    getDocs(query(collection(db, "expenses"), where("mode", "==", "credit"))),
    getDocs(collection(db, "vendorPayments")),
  ]);
  const map = {};
  vSnap.docs.forEach((d) => {
    const v = { id: d.id, ...d.data() };
    map[v.id] = { ...v, purchases: 0, paid: 0, due: Number(v.openingDue) || 0 };
  });
  eSnap.docs.forEach((d) => {
    const e = d.data();
    if (e.vendorId && map[e.vendorId]) map[e.vendorId].purchases += Number(e.amount) || 0;
  });
  pSnap.docs.forEach((d) => {
    const p = d.data();
    if (p.vendorId && map[p.vendorId]) map[p.vendorId].paid += Number(p.amount) || 0;
  });
  return Object.values(map)
    .map((v) => ({ ...v, due: (Number(v.openingDue) || 0) + v.purchases - v.paid }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.due - a.due);
}

async function loadCustomCats() {
  try {
    const s = await getDoc(doc(db, "settings", "expenseCats"));
    if (s.exists() && Array.isArray(s.data().list) && s.data().list.length) return s.data().list;
  } catch (e) {}
  return EXP_CATS;
}
async function saveCustomCats(list) {
  await setDoc(doc(db, "settings", "expenseCats"), { list, updatedAt: Date.now() });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// VENDOR LEDGER / PAYMENT VIEW
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function VendorView({ C, isMobile, isOwner, waiterName, onDuesChange }) {
  const toast = useToast(); const haptic = useHaptic();
  const G = goldOf(C); const GT = goldTextOf(C);
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState([]);
  const [payments, setPayments] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
  const [newPhone, setNewPhone] = useState("");
  const [newOpen, setNewOpen] = useState("");
  const [payVendor, setPayVendor] = useState("");
  const [payAmount, setPayAmount] = useState("");
  const [payMode, setPayMode] = useState("cash");
  const [payNote, setPayNote] = useState("");
  const [payDate, setPayDate] = useState(invDateKey());
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const dues = await loadVendorDues();
      setVendors(dues.filter((x) => x.active !== false));
      const ps = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "vendorPayments"), orderBy("createdAt", "desc"), limit(50)));
      setPayments(ps.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })));
      if (onDuesChange) onDuesChange(dues.reduce((s, v) => s + Math.max(0, v.due), 0));
    } catch (e) { toast("Vendor load nahi hua: " + e.message, "error"); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { refresh(); }, [refresh]);

  const addVendor = async () => {
    const n = newName.trim();
    if (!n) { toast("Vendor ka naam likho", "warning"); return; }
    if (saving) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await addDoc(collection(db, "vendors"), {
        name: n, phone: newPhone.trim(),
        openingDue: Number(newOpen) || 0,
        active: true, createdAt: Date.now(),
      });
      logAudit("vendor_added", { reason: n });
      toast("Vendor add ho gaya", "success"); haptic(20);
      setNewName(""); setNewPhone(""); setNewOpen("");
      refresh();
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const payNow = async () => {
    const amt = Number(payAmount);
    if (!payVendor) { toast("Vendor chuno", "warning"); return; }
    if (!(amt > 0)) { toast("Sahi amount likho", "warning"); return; }
    if (saving) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await addDoc(collection(db, "vendorPayments"), {
        vendorId: payVendor, amount: amt, mode: payMode,
        note: payNote.trim(), date: payDate,
        by: waiterName || "Staff", createdAt: Date.now(),
      });
      logAudit("vendor_paid", { total: amt, reason: "Vendor " + payVendor + " - " + payMode });
      toast("Payment save ho gayi: " + inr(amt), "success"); haptic(25);
      setPayAmount(""); setPayNote("");
      refresh();
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const deleteVendor = async (v) => {
    if (!isOwner) return;
    if (!window.confirm(v.name + " ko delete karein? (payments/purchases history rahegi)")) return;
    try {
      if (Math.abs(Number(v.due) || 0) > 0) { toast("Pehle due clear karo (baaki " + inr(v.due) + ")", "warning"); return; }
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "vendors", v.id), { active: false, deletedAt: Date.now() });
      toast("Vendor delete ho gaya", "success");
      refresh();
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
  };

  const field = { width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", padding: "11px 12px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 15, background: C.card, color: C.ink, outline: "none", fontFamily: "inherit" };
  const lbl = { fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, color: C.gray, marginBottom: 5, textTransform: "uppercase" };
  const box = { background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 14, padding: isMobile ? 14 : 18, marginBottom: 16 };

  const totalDue = vendors.reduce((s, v) => s + Math.max(0, v.due), 0);

  if (!isOwner) {
    return (
      <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 50, color: C.gray }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>ğŸ”’</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, marginTop: 8 }}>Vendor sirf owner dekh sakta hai</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 style={{ margin: "0 0 4px", fontSize: isMobile ? 18 : 22, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>Vendor Due</h2>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 14 }}>
        Vendor ka udhaar aur payment - ye kharcha NAHI hai, alag track hota hai
      </div>

      <div style={{ background: C.amberLight || C.cardAlt, border: "1px solid " + (C.amber || G), borderRadius: 14, padding: 14, marginBottom: 16, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, color: C.gray, textTransform: "uppercase" }}>Kul Vendor Due</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 900, color: C.amber || GT, fontFamily: "monospace", marginTop: 4 }}>{inr(totalDue)}</div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, textAlign: "right" }}>{vendors.filter((v) => v.due > 0).length} vendor<br/>due wale</div>
      </div>

      <div style={box}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 12 }}>â• Naya Vendor</div>
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr" : "2fr 1fr 1fr", gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <input value={newName} onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Vendor name" style={field} />
          <input value={newPhone} onChange={(e) => setNewPhone(e.target.value)} placeholder="Phone" style={field} />
          <input value={newOpen} onChange={(e) => setNewOpen(e.target.value)} type="number" placeholder="Purana due" style={field} />
        </div>
        <button onClick={addVendor} disabled={saving} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 12, border: "none", borderRadius: 10, background: G, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: saving ? "not-allowed" : "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{saving ? "Saving..." : "Vendor Add Karo"}</button>
      </div>

      {vendors.length > 0 && (
        <div style={box}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 12 }}>ğŸ’µ Vendor ko Paisa Do (Payment)</div>
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr" : "1fr 1fr", gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <select value={payVendor} onChange={(e) => setPayVendor(e.target.value)} style={field}>
              <option value="">-- Vendor chuno --</option>
              {vendors.map((v) => <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name} (due {inr(Math.max(0, v.due))})</option>)}
            </select>
            <input type="number" value={payAmount} onChange={(e) => setPayAmount(e.target.value)} placeholder="Amount Rs" style={field} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 10 }}>
            {[["cash", "Cash"], ["upi", "UPI"], ["bank", "Bank"]].map(([id, l]) => (
              <button key={id} onClick={() => setPayMode(id)} style={{ padding: "7px 13px", borderRadius: 20, border: "1px solid " + (payMode === id ? G : C.line), background: payMode === id ? G : C.card, color: payMode === id ? "#fff" : C.gray, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{l}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr" : "2fr 1fr", gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <input value={payNote} onChange={(e) => setPayNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="Note (optional)" style={field} />
            <input type="date" value={payDate} max={invDateKey()} onChange={(e) => e.target.value && setPayDate(e.target.value)} style={field} />
          </div>
          <button onClick={payNow} disabled={saving} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 14, border: "none", borderRadius: 10, background: "linear-gradient(135deg, " + G + " 0%, " + (C.goldDark || G) + " 100%)", color: "#fff", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 15, cursor: saving ? "not-allowed" : "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{saving ? "Saving..." : "Payment Save Karo"}</button>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, marginTop: 8, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 700 }}>âš ï¸ Ye P&L expense nahi hai - sirf due kam karega</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {loading && <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 20 }}><Spinner color={G} /></div>}

      {!loading && vendors.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 40, color: C.gray, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700 }}>Abhi koi vendor nahi - upar se add karo</div>
      )}

      {!loading && vendors.map((v) => (
        <div key={v.id} style={{ background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 12, padding: 14, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14, color: C.ink }}>
                {v.name}
                {v.phone && <span style={{ color: C.gray, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12 }}> Â· {v.phone}</span>}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, marginTop: 2 }}>
                Opening {inr(v.openingDue || 0)} Â· Purchase {inr(v.purchases)} Â· Paid {inr(v.paid)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ textAlign: "right", flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700 }}>DUE</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 900, color: v.due > 0 ? C.red : C.green, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{inr(Math.max(0, v.due))}</div>
            </div>
            {isOwner && <button onClick={() => deleteVendor(v)} style={{ border: "none", background: "transparent", color: C.gray, fontSize: 16, cursor: "pointer", padding: 4 }} title="Delete">x</button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}

      {payments.length > 0 && (
        <div style={box}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 10 }}>ğŸ• Recent Payments</div>
          {payments.slice(0, 20).map((p) => {
            const v = vendors.find((x) => x.id === p.vendorId);
            return (
              <div key={p.id} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "8px 0", borderTop: "1px dashed " + C.line, fontSize: 12 }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: C.ink }}>{v ? v.name : p.vendorId}</div>
                  <div style={{ color: C.gray, fontSize: 11 }}>{p.date} Â· {modeLabel(p.mode)}{p.note ? " Â· " + p.note : ""}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, color: C.green, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{inr(p.amount)}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// ===========================================================================
// BULK IMPORT (patch 6)
// Gemini se nikala hua JSON import karke vendors + expenses auto-create
// ===========================================================================

function ImportView({ C, isMobile, isOwner, waiterName, onDone }) {
  const toast = useToast(); const haptic = useHaptic();
  const G = goldOf(C); const GT = goldTextOf(C);
  const [rawJson, setRawJson] = useState("");
  const [parsed, setParsed] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [existingVendors, setExistingVendors] = useState([]);
  const [modeOverride, setModeOverride] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    getDocs(collection(db, "vendors"))
      .then((s) => setExistingVendors(s.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }))))
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const parseJson = (text, overrideArg) => {
    const override = overrideArg === undefined ? modeOverride : overrideArg;
    setError(""); setResult(null);
    if (!text.trim()) { setParsed(null); return; }
    try {
      const clean = text.replace(/^```json\s*/i, "").replace(/^```\s*/i, "").replace(/```\s*$/i, "").trim();
      const obj = JSON.parse(clean);
      const bills = Array.isArray(obj) ? obj : (obj.bills || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(bills)) throw new Error("JSON mein 'bills' array nahi mila");
      const normalized = bills.map((b, i) => ({
        _idx: i,
        vendorName: String(b.vendorName || "").trim(),
        vendorPhone: b.vendorPhone ? String(b.vendorPhone).trim() : "",
        date: b.date || invDateKey(),
        amount: Number(b.amount) || 0,
        category: b.category || "Anya",
        mode: override || b.mode || "credit",
        note: b.note || "",
        confidence: Number(b.confidence) || 1,
        _valid: !!b.vendorName && Number(b.amount) > 0,
        _skip: false,
        _existingVendorId: "",
      }));
      normalized.forEach((n) => {
        const match = existingVendors.find((v) => v.name.toLowerCase() === n.vendorName.toLowerCase());
        if (match) n._existingVendorId = match.id;
      });
      setParsed(normalized);
    } catch (e) {
      setParsed(null);
      setError("JSON galat hai: " + e.message);
    }
  };

  const handleFile = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.name.endsWith(".json")) { toast("Sirf .json file daalo", "warning"); return; }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
      const txt = String(ev.target.result || "");
      setRawJson(txt);
      parseJson(txt);
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  const toggleSkip = (idx) => {
    setParsed((prev) => prev.map((p) => p._idx === idx ? { ...p, _skip: !p._skip } : p));
  };
  const editField = (idx, field, value) => {
    setParsed((prev) => prev.map((p) => {
      if (p._idx !== idx) return p;
      const upd = { ...p, [field]: value };
      if (field === "vendorName") { const mv = existingVendors.find((v) => v.name.trim().toLowerCase() === String(value).trim().toLowerCase()); upd._existingVendorId = mv ? mv.id : ""; }
      upd._valid = !!upd.vendorName && Number(upd.amount) > 0;
      return upd;
    }));
  };

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (!parsed) return null;
    const active = parsed.filter((p) => !p._skip && p._valid);
    const newVendors = new Set();
    active.forEach((p) => { if (!p._existingVendorId) newVendors.add(p.vendorName.toLowerCase()); });
    return {
      total: parsed.length,
      importing: active.length,
      skipped: parsed.filter((p) => p._skip).length,
      invalid: parsed.filter((p) => !p._skip && !p._valid).length,
      newVendors: newVendors.size,
      totalAmount: active.reduce((s, p) => s + Number(p.amount || 0), 0),
    };
  }, [parsed]);

  const runImport = async () => {
    if (!parsed || !stats || stats.importing === 0) { toast("Kuch import karne layak nahi", "warning"); return; }
    if (!window.confirm(stats.importing + " bills import honge. " + stats.newVendors + " naye vendor banenge. Confirm?")) return;
    setImporting(true);
    const imported = { expenses: 0, vendors: 0, errors: [] };
    try {
      const nameToId = {};
      const freshVendors = await getDocs(collection(db, "vendors"));
      freshVendors.docs.forEach((d) => { nameToId[String(d.data().name || "").trim().toLowerCase()] = d.id; });

      const newVendorNames = new Set();
      const seenNew = new Set();
      parsed.filter((p) => !p._skip && p._valid).forEach((p) => { const k = p.vendorName.trim().toLowerCase(); if (!nameToId[k] && !seenNew.has(k)) { seenNew.add(k); newVendorNames.add(p.vendorName.trim()); } });
      for (const vName of newVendorNames) {
        try {
          const ref = await addDoc(collection(db, "vendors"), {
            name: vName, phone: "", openingDue: 0, active: true, createdAt: Date.now(),
          });
          nameToId[vName.toLowerCase()] = ref.id;
          imported.vendors++;
        } catch (e) {
          imported.errors.push("Vendor '" + vName + "': " + e.message);
        }
      }

      const active = parsed.filter((p) => !p._skip && p._valid);
      /*P12*/ const seenKeys = new Set();
      try {
        const exSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "expenses"), where("importedFrom", "==", "gemini")));
        exSnap.docs.forEach((d) => { const x = d.data(); seenKeys.add([x.date, Number(x.amount), x.vendorId || "", x.note || ""].join("|")); });
      } catch (e) {}
      const toImport = active.filter((p) => !seenKeys.has([p.date, Number(p.amount), resolveVendorId(p.vendorName, nameToId) || "", (p.note || "") + (p.vendorPhone ? " | " + p.vendorPhone : "")].join("|")));
      imported.skipped = active.length - toImport.length;
      for (let i = 0; i < toImport.length; i += 20) {
        const chunk = toImport.slice(i, i + 20);
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        chunk.forEach((p) => {
          const vId = resolveVendorId(p.vendorName, nameToId);
          const ref = doc(collection(db, "expenses"));
          batch.set(ref, {
            date: p.date,
            amount: Number(p.amount),
            category: p.category,
            mode: p.mode,
            vendorId: vId,
            note: (p.note || "") + (p.vendorPhone ? " | " + p.vendorPhone : ""),
            by: waiterName || "Staff",
            createdAt: Date.now(),
            importedFrom: "gemini",
          });
          imported.expenses++;
        });
        await batch.commit();
      }

      try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, "auditLogs"), {
          action: "bulk_import",
          amount: stats.totalAmount,
          count: imported.expenses,
          by: waiterName || "Staff",
          at: Date.now(),
          detail: imported.vendors + " new vendors, " + imported.expenses + " expenses",
        });
      } catch (e) {}

      haptic(50);
      setResult({ ok: true, ...imported, totalAmount: stats.totalAmount });
      toast("Import ho gaya: " + imported.expenses + " expenses, " + imported.vendors + " naye vendor" + (imported.skipped ? ", " + imported.skipped + " duplicate skip" : ""), "success");
      if (onDone) onDone();
    } catch (e) {
      setResult({ ok: false, error: e.message });
      toast("Import fail: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
    }
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setRawJson(""); setParsed(null); setError(""); setResult(null);
  };

  const box = { background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 14, padding: isMobile ? 14 : 18, marginBottom: 16 };
  const field = { width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", padding: "11px 12px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 14, background: C.card, color: C.ink, outline: "none", fontFamily: "inherit" };

  if (!isOwner) {
    return (
      <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 50, color: C.gray }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>ğŸ”’</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, marginTop: 8 }}>Bulk import sirf owner kar sakta hai</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 style={{ margin: "0 0 4px", fontSize: isMobile ? 18 : 22, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>ğŸ“¥ Bulk Import</h2>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 14 }}>
        Gemini se nikala hua JSON file yahan daalo - vendors aur expenses auto-create ho jayenge
      </div>

      {!parsed && !result && (
        <>
          <div style={box}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 10 }}>ğŸ“¸ Step 1: Bills ki photo Gemini ko bhejo</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              Gemini ko bill photo + niche wala prompt bhejo. Wo aapko JSON dega. Us JSON ko <b>.json</b> file mein save karo.
            </div>
            <details style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
              <summary style={{ cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800, color: GT, padding: "8px 0" }}>ğŸ“‹ Gemini Prompt dekho / copy karo</summary>
              <pre style={{ background: C.cardAlt, padding: 12, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 10, overflowX: "auto", color: C.ink, lineHeight: 1.5, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{`Tum ek restaurant accounting assistant ho. Main tumhe purane bill/invoice ki photo bhej raha hoon. Tumhe isse structured JSON nikaalna hai.

RULES:
1. Sirf valid JSON return karo, koi explanation nahi.
2. Agar koi field samajh nahi aaye toh null daalo.
3. Amount number mein.
4. Date YYYY-MM-DD format mein.
5. Category choose karo: ["Saman / Kaccha maal", "Salary", "Kiraya", "Gas / Coyla", "Bijli / Pani", "Repair", "Packing", "Marketing", "Anya"]
6. "paid" likha ho toh mode="cash", warna mode="credit".
7. Multiple bills ho toh array.

OUTPUT:
{
  "bills": [
    {
      "vendorName": "Ramesh Vegetables",
      "vendorPhone": "9876543210",
      "date": "2026-10-15",
      "amount": 10000,
      "category": "Saman / Kaccha maal",
      "mode": "credit",
      "note": "Paneer 5kg",
      "confidence": 0.95
    }
  ]
}`}</pre>
            </details>
          </div>

          <div style={box}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 10 }}>ğŸ“ Step 2: JSON file upload karo</div>
            <input type="file" accept=".json,application/json" onChange={handleFile} style={{ ...field, padding: 10, cursor: "pointer" }} />
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, marginTop: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>Ya niche seedha paste karo:</div>
            <textarea
              value={rawJson}
              onChange={(e) => { setRawJson(e.target.value); parseJson(e.target.value); }}
              placeholder='{"bills": [{"vendorName": "...", "amount": 1000, ...}]}'
              style={{ ...field, minHeight: 160, marginTop: 8, fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: 12 }}
            />
            {error && <div style={{ color: C.red, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 8 }}>âŒ {error}</div>}
          </div>

          <div style={box}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 10 }}>âš™ï¸ Mode override (optional)</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, marginBottom: 8 }}>Agar Gemini galat mode de raha ho toh yahan sabke liye fix karo:</div>
            <select value={modeOverride} onChange={(e) => { const v = e.target.value; setModeOverride(v); if (parsed) parseJson(rawJson, v); }} style={field}>
              <option value="">-- Gemini ka mode use karo --</option>
              <option value="cash">Sab Cash</option>
              <option value="credit">Sab Udhaar</option>
              <option value="upi">Sab UPI</option>
              <option value="bank">Sab Bank</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {parsed && !result && (
        <>
          <div style={{ ...box, background: C.goldLight || C.cardAlt, border: "1.5px solid " + G }}>
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr 1fr" : "repeat(4, 1fr)", gap: 10 }}>
              <div><div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 800 }}>TOTAL</div><div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 900, color: C.ink, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{stats.total}</div></div>
              <div><div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 800 }}>IMPORT</div><div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 900, color: C.green, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{stats.importing}</div></div>
              <div><div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 800 }}>NEW VENDORS</div><div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 900, color: GT, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{stats.newVendors}</div></div>
              <div><div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 800 }}>AMOUNT</div><div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 900, color: C.red, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{inr(stats.totalAmount)}</div></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <button onClick={runImport} disabled={importing || stats.importing === 0} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 140, padding: 14, border: "none", borderRadius: 10, background: importing ? C.line : "linear-gradient(135deg, " + G + " 0%, " + (C.goldDark || G) + " 100%)", color: importing ? C.gray : "#fff", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 15, cursor: importing ? "not-allowed" : "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{importing ? "Import ho raha hai..." : "âœ… " + stats.importing + " Bills Import Karo"}</button>
            <button onClick={reset} disabled={importing} style={{ padding: "14px 20px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 10, background: "transparent", color: C.gray, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Cancel</button>
          </div>

          <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 8 }}>Preview ({parsed.length} bills)</div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6 }}>
            {parsed.map((p) => (
              <div key={p._idx} style={{ background: p._skip ? C.cardAlt : C.card, border: "1px solid " + (p._valid ? C.line : C.red), borderRadius: 10, padding: 10, opacity: p._skip ? 0.5 : 1 }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center", flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={!p._skip} onChange={() => toggleSkip(p._idx)} style={{ cursor: "pointer" }} />
                    <input
                      value={p.vendorName}
                      onChange={(e) => editField(p._idx, "vendorName", e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Vendor name"
                      style={{ ...field, padding: "6px 8px", fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800 }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <input
                    value={p.amount}
                    onChange={(e) => editField(p._idx, "amount", e.target.value)}
                    type="number"
                    placeholder="Amount"
                    style={{ ...field, padding: "6px 8px", fontSize: 13, width: 100, fontFamily: "monospace", fontWeight: 900 }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? "1fr 1fr" : "1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr", gap: 6, fontSize: 11 }}>
                  <input value={p.date} onChange={(e) => editField(p._idx, "date", e.target.value)} type="date" style={{ ...field, padding: "5px 7px", fontSize: 11 }} />
                  <select value={p.category} onChange={(e) => editField(p._idx, "category", e.target.value)} style={{ ...field, padding: "5px 7px", fontSize: 11 }}>
                    {EXP_CATS.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
                  </select>
                  <select value={p.mode} onChange={(e) => editField(p._idx, "mode", e.target.value)} style={{ ...field, padding: "5px 7px", fontSize: 11 }}>
                    <option value="cash">Cash</option>
                    <option value="upi">UPI</option>
                    <option value="bank">Bank</option>
                    <option value="credit">Udhaar</option>
                  </select>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, color: p._existingVendorId ? C.green : GT, padding: "5px 7px", background: C.cardAlt, borderRadius: 6 }}>
                    {p._existingVendorId ? "âœ“ existing" : "â˜… naya"}
                    <span style={{ color: C.gray, marginLeft: "auto" }}>{Math.round(p.confidence * 100)}%</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {p.note && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, marginTop: 6, fontStyle: "italic" }}>{p.note}</div>}
                {!p._valid && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.red, marginTop: 4, fontWeight: 700 }}>âš ï¸ Vendor name ya amount missing</div>}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {result && (
        <div style={{ ...box, border: "2px solid " + (result.ok ? C.green : C.red), textAlign: "center" }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>{result.ok ? "âœ…" : "âŒ"}</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 900, color: result.ok ? C.green : C.red, marginTop: 8 }}>{result.ok ? "Import Successful" : "Import Failed"}</div>
          {result.ok ? (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 12, fontSize: 13, color: C.ink, fontWeight: 700 }}>
              <div>{result.expenses} expenses add huye</div>
              <div>{result.vendors} naye vendors bane</div>
              <div>Total: {inr(result.totalAmount)}</div>
              {result.errors && result.errors.length > 0 && <div style={{ color: C.amber, marginTop: 8, fontSize: 11 }}>{result.errors.length} errors - check console</div>}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 12, fontSize: 12, color: C.red }}>{result.error}</div>
          )}
          <button onClick={reset} style={{ marginTop: 16, padding: "12px 24px", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, background: G, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Naya Import Karo</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) { super(props); this.state = { err: null }; }
  static getDerivedStateFromError(err) { return { err }; }
  componentDidCatch(err, info) { console.error("Staff app crash:", err, info); }
  render() {
    if (!this.state.err) return this.props.children;
    return (
      <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", padding: 20, fontFamily: "system-ui, sans-serif", background: "#F9FAFB" }}>
        <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1px solid #E5E7EB", borderRadius: 16, padding: 24, maxWidth: 360, textAlign: "center" }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 44, marginBottom: 8 }}>Warning</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, color: "#111827", marginBottom: 6 }}>Kuch gadbad ho gayi</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#6B7280", marginBottom: 16, wordBreak: "break-word" }}>{String(this.state.err?.message || this.state.err)}</div>
          <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 13, border: "none", borderRadius: 10, background: "#DC2626", color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer" }}>Reload</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
}

export default function StaffApp() {
  return (
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <ToastProvider>
        <StaffAppInner />
      </ToastProvider>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

// hardening.js â€” drop-in fixes for Eat & Park POS V15 (React + Firestore)
// Import what you need into your main file and delete the old versions.
import { doc, runTransaction } from "firebase/firestore";
import { db } from "./firebase";

/* â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ 1. Input / data normalisation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
export const MAX_QTY = 99;
export const TABLE_COUNT = 12; // use everywhere instead of hardcoded 12

export const num = (v, d = 0) => { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : d; };
export const clampQty = (q) => Math.min(MAX_QTY, Math.max(0, Math.round(num(q) * 100) / 100));

// FIX: phone was used raw as a Firestore doc id. "123/456" made doc() throw
// synchronously inside useEffect and crashed the whole customer screen.
export const cleanPhone = (p) => String(p || "").replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-10);
export const isValidPhone = (p) => /^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(p);

// FIX: createdAt could be missing / Timestamp / string -> toISOString() threw RangeError
// and one bad doc blanked the Admin dashboard.
export const toMillis = (v) => {
  if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) return v;
  if (v && typeof v.toMillis === "function") return v.toMillis();
  const n = Date.parse(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
};
export const toLocalISODate = (ts) => {
  const t = toMillis(ts);
  if (!t) return "";
  const d = new Date(t);
  return new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().split("T")[0];
};
export const normOrder = (d) => {
  const raw = d.data() || {};
  return {
    ...raw,
    id: d.id,
    createdAt: toMillis(raw.createdAt),
    items: (Array.isArray(raw.items) ? raw.items : []).map((it) => ({
      ...it, price: num(it.price), qty: num(it.qty),
    })),
    customer: raw.customer || { name: "", phone: "" },
  };
};

// FIX: CSV formula injection (=cmd|...) when opened in Excel
export const csvCell = (c) => {
  const s = String(c ?? "");
  return /^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(s) ? "'" + s : s;
};

/* â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ 2. Business day (orders vanished at midnight) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
// FIX: query used midnight, so a served-but-unpaid table ("billing") dropped off the
// board at 00:00 while the app only reloads at 05:00. Use the same 5am cutoff.
export function businessDayStart(now = new Date(), startHour = 5) {
  const d = new Date(now);
  d.setHours(startHour, 0, 0, 0);
  if (d > now) d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1);
  return d.getTime();
}

/* â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ 3. Orders: atomic, idempotent, stale-safe â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
// FIX: old version did getDoc() then setDoc() and swallowed getDoc errors. After a
// timed-out write that actually landed, a retry overwrote an order the kitchen had
// already advanced. Transaction = create only if it doesn't exist.
export async function setOrderOnce(order) {
  const ref = doc(db, "orders", order.id);
  await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
    if (!snap.exists()) tx.set(ref, order);
  });
}

// FIX: advanceStatus trusted the *clicked* status. A stale tablet could push an order
// from "ready" back to "preparing". Now it aborts if the server status moved on.
export async function advanceStatusSafe(orderId, expected, STATUS_FLOW) {
  const i = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(expected);
  if (i < 0) return { ok: false, reason: "invalid" };
  const next = STATUS_FLOW[Math.min(i + 1, STATUS_FLOW.length - 1)];
  if (next === expected) return { ok: false, reason: "final" };
  const ref = doc(db, "orders", orderId);
  return runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
    if (!snap.exists()) return { ok: false, reason: "missing" };
    const cur = snap.data();
    if (cur.status === "cancelled") return { ok: false, reason: "cancelled" };
    if (cur.status !== expected) return { ok: false, reason: "stale", current: cur.status };
    const patch = { status: next };
    if (next === "served") patch.servedAt = Date.now();
    if (cur.kots?.length) patch.kots = cur.kots.map((k) => (k.status === expected ? { ...k, status: next } : k));
    tx.update(ref, patch);
    return { ok: true, next };
  });
}
// Caller: remove the optimistic setOrdersState, or roll it back when ok === false
// (the snapshot will NOT re-fire if the server doc didn't change).

// FIX: item-count comparison missed price/qty edits (lost updates between two devices).
// Use a revision counter bumped ONLY by item-affecting writers (bill save, running KOT).
export async function guardedOrderUpdate(base, patch) {
  const ref = doc(db, "orders", base.id);
  await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
    if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error("Order nahi mila");
    const cur = snap.data();
    if ((cur.rev || 0) !== (base.rev || 0)) {
      throw new Error("Ye order kisi aur ne abhi badla hai. Bill band karke dobara kholo.");
    }
    tx.update(ref, { ...patch, rev: (cur.rev || 0) + 1 });
  });
}
// Also add `rev: (cur.rev||0)+1` to addRunningItems' tx.update.

// FIX: customer cancel was only hidden in the UI; kitchen could already be cooking.
export async function cancelOrderIfNew(orderId, by = "customer") {
  const ref = doc(db, "orders", orderId);
  await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
    if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error("Order not found");
    if (snap.data().status !== "new") throw new Error("Kitchen ne order shuru kar diya hai â€” staff se cancel karwao.");
    tx.update(ref, { status: "cancelled", cancelledAt: Date.now(), cancelledBy: by });
  });
}

/* â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ 4. Loyalty: ledger inside the transaction â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
// FIX: coinHistory was written AFTER the transaction from stale local state:
//  - ledger could differ from the balance actually applied
//  - double tap = duplicate history rows
// Deterministic doc ids make this idempotent.
export async function markPaidSafe(orderId, paid, loyaltyRate, getOrderTotal) {
  await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const oref = doc(db, "orders", orderId);
    const osnap = await tx.get(oref);
    if (!osnap.exists()) throw new Error("Order not found");
    const o = osnap.data();
    if (o.status === "cancelled") throw new Error("Order cancelled hai");

    if (!paid) { tx.update(oref, { paid: false }); return; }
    if (o.coinsClaimed) { tx.update(oref, { paid: true }); return; }

    const phone = cleanPhone(o.customer?.phone);
    const earned = Math.floor(getOrderTotal(o) / (Number(loyaltyRate) || 10));
    const used = Math.max(0, num(o.rewardUsedCoins));

    let usnap = null;
    const uref = isValidPhone(phone) ? doc(db, "loyaltyUsers", phone) : null;
    if (uref && (earned || used)) usnap = await tx.get(uref); // all reads before writes

    if (uref && usnap) {
      const next = Math.max(0, num(usnap.exists() ? usnap.data().coins : 0) + earned - used);
      if (usnap.exists()) tx.update(uref, { coins: next });
      else tx.set(uref, { phone, name: o.customer?.name || "Guest", coins: next });
      const ts = Date.now();
      const tag = orderId.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase();
      if (earned > 0) tx.set(doc(db, "coinHistory", orderId + "_earn"), { phone, coins: earned, reason: `Order #${tag}`, timestamp: ts });
      if (used > 0) tx.set(doc(db, "coinHistory", orderId + "_use"), { phone, coins: -used, reason: `Redeemed #${tag}`, timestamp: ts });
    }
    tx.update(oref, { paid: true, coinsClaimed: true });
  });
}

/* â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ 5. Menu: no more whole-menu overwrite from stale state â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
// FIX: every add/edit wrote the full `items` array from the caller's local copy, so two
// devices (admin + waiter) silently erased each other's changes, and a swallowed error
// still showed "âœ… Dish added". Also refuses to save an empty menu.
// Strip the runtime-only `available` flag (menuEff adds it) before saving.
export async function updateMenuAtomic(mutator) {
  const ref = doc(db, "settings", "menu");
  return runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
    const cur = snap.exists() && Array.isArray(snap.data().items) ? snap.data().items : [];
    const next = mutator(cur);
    if (!Array.isArray(next) || next.length === 0) throw new Error("Refusing to save an empty menu");
    tx.set(ref, { items: next });
    return next;
  });
}
// Usage: await updateMenuAtomic((items) => [newDish, ...items]);
// Long term: one doc per dish in a `menu` collection (1 MB doc limit, no write races).

/* â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ 6. Razorpay: promise that can never hang â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
// FIX: `new Promise(async ...)` swallowed any throw (e.g. new Razorpay() failing) and the
// promise never settled -> isProcessingPayment stuck forever. Script was also appended
// again on every call while the first load was pending.
let rzpLoader = null;
export function loadRazorpay() {
  if (window.Razorpay) return Promise.resolve(true);
  if (!rzpLoader) {
    rzpLoader = new Promise((resolve) => {
      const s = document.createElement("script");
      s.src = "https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js";
      s.onload = () => resolve(true);
      s.onerror = () => { rzpLoader = null; resolve(false); };
      document.body.appendChild(s);
    });
  }
  return rzpLoader;
}
export async function payWithRazorpay({ key, amount, orderId, name, desc, prefill, color }) {
  if (!key || key.startsWith("YOUR_")) throw new Error("Razorpay key configure nahi hai");
  if (!(await loadRazorpay()) || !window.Razorpay) throw new Error("Payment gateway load nahi hua");
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      const rzp = new window.Razorpay({
        key, amount: Math.round(amount * 100), currency: "INR", name,
        description: desc, order_id: undefined, // TODO: create order server-side and pass order_id
        prefill, theme: { color },
        handler: resolve,
        modal: { ondismiss: () => resolve(null) },
      });
      rzp.on("payment.failed", () => resolve(null));
      rzp.open();
    } catch (e) { reject(e); }
  });
}
// NOTE: the client can never prove a payment happened. Verify razorpay_signature in a
// Cloud Function / API route before setting paid=true. Today it is "paid_unverified".

/* â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ 7. AI order: validate everything the model returns â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
// FIX: BillPOS.applyAi did `next[i].qty + line.qty` -> string concat if qty came as "2";
// WaiterOrderPanel could push NaN into the cart; CustomerView accepted qty = 1e9.
export function sanitizeAiLines(data, menu) {
  const byId = new Map((menu || []).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
  const items = [];
  for (const l of Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : []) {
    const m = byId.get(l?.id);
    const qty = Math.round(num(l?.qty));
    if (!m || !m.available || qty < 1) continue;
    items.push({ id: m.id, qty: Math.min(qty, MAX_QTY) });
  }
  const t = Math.round(num(data?.table));
  return {
    items,
    orderType: data?.orderType === "parcel" ? "parcel" : "dine_in",
    table: t >= 1 && t <= TABLE_COUNT ? t : null,
    notes: String(data?.notes || "").slice(0, 200),
    unmatched: (Array.isArray(data?.unmatched) ? data.unmatched : []).slice(0, 10).map(String),
  };
}
// FIX: fetch had no timeout; a hung API froze the modal and applied the order after close.
export async function fetchWithTimeout(url, opts = {}, ms = 15000) {
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const t = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), ms);
  try { return await fetch(url, { ...opts, signal: ctl.signal }); }
  finally { clearTimeout(t); }
}
// Also: abort in a useEffect cleanup when the modal unmounts, and stop SpeechRecognition there.

function ImageUploadButton({ currentImage, onUploaded, label }) {
  const widgetRef = useRef(null);
  const onUploadedRef = useRef(onUploaded);
  onUploadedRef.current = onUploaded;
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    let tries = 0;
    const tryInit = () => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (window.cloudinary) {
        widgetRef.current = window.cloudinary.createUploadWidget(
          {
            cloudName: "nnddxvcn",
            uploadPreset: "eatpark_uploads",
            sources: ["local", "camera", "url"],
            multiple: false,
            maxFileSize: 5000000,
            clientAllowedFormats: ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp"],
          },
          (error, result) => {
            if (error) {
              console.error("Cloudinary error:", error);
              alert("Upload fail: " + (error.statusText || error.message || JSON.stringify(error)));
              return;
            }
            if (result && result.event === "success") {
              onUploadedRef.current(result.info.secure_url);
            }
          }
        );
        setReady(true);
      } else if (++tries < 20) {
        setTimeout(tryInit, 300);
      } else {
        alert("Cloudinary script load nahi hui. public/index.html check karo.");
      }
    };
    tryInit();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const openWidget = () => {
    if (widgetRef.current) widgetRef.current.open();
  };

  return (
    <button
      onClick={openWidget}
      disabled={!ready}
      style={{
        width: "100%",
        padding: 14,
        border: "none",
        borderRadius: 12,
        background: ready ? "#D97706" : "#999",
        color: "#fff",
        fontWeight: 800,
        fontSize: 14,
        cursor: ready ? "pointer" : "wait",
      }}
    >
      {ready ? (label || "ğŸ“¸ Upload Image") : "â³ Loading..."}
    </button>
  );
}

const LOYALTY_TIERS = [
  { name: 'Bronze', points: 0, discount: 0.05, emoji: 'ğŸ¥‰', color: '#CD7F32' },
  { name: 'Silver', points: 500, discount: 0.10, emoji: 'ğŸ¥ˆ', color: '#C0C0C0' },
  { name: 'Gold', points: 1000, discount: 0.15, emoji: 'ğŸ¥‡', color: '#FFD700' },
  { name: 'Platinum', points: 2000, discount: 0.25, emoji: 'ğŸ’', color: '#E5E4E2' }
];

function getLoyaltyTier(points) {
  let tier = LOYALTY_TIERS[0];
  for (const t of LOYALTY_TIERS) if (points >= t.points) tier = t;
  return tier;
}

function uid(prefix) { return prefix + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-5) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6); }
function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
}
function inr(n) {
  const num = Number(n);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return "â‚¹0";
  return "â‚¹" + num.toLocaleString("en-IN");
}
const isWalkIn = (s) => /^walk-?in$/i.test(String(s || "").trim());
const getBaseKots = (o) => (o.kots?.length ? o.kots : [{ id: uid("kot"), kotNumber: 1, items: o.items || [], createdAt: o.createdAt, status: o.status }])
  .map(k => (k.status === "new" && o.status !== "new" ? { ...k, status: o.status } : k));
const getNextKotNo = (o) => Math.max(...getBaseKots(o).map(k => k.kotNumber || 1)) + 1;

// Ek hi jagah se order total (coupon + loyalty + delivery sab included)
function getOrderTotal(o) {
  const hasRunning = (o?.kots || []).some(k => k.isRunning);
  // If finalTotal is trusted (no running KOT or bill was manually edited), use it.
  if (Number.isFinite(o?.finalTotal) && (!hasRunning || o?.billEditedAt)) return o.finalTotal;
  // Otherwise compute from items. NOTE: items array already includes running KOT items,
  // and runningPatch() updates finalTotal only when billEditedAt is set â€” so no double count.
  const sub = (o?.items || []).reduce((s, it) => s + it.price * it.qty, 0);
  const coupon = Math.round((sub * (o?.discount || 0)) / 100);
  return Math.max(0, sub - coupon - (o?.loyaltyDiscount || 0)) + (o?.deliveryFee || 0);
}

// Firestore doc ko safe shape deta hai (purane/adhure docs se crash nahi hoga)
const normOrder = HX.normOrder;
const normOrderLegacy = (d) => {
  const o = { id: d.id, ...d.data() };
  if (!Array.isArray(o.items)) o.items = [];
  if (!o.customer) o.customer = { name: "", phone: "" };
  return o;
};

// Running KOT aane par total / paid status theek karta hai
const runningPatch = (o, added) => {
  const addT = added.reduce((s, it) => s + it.price * it.qty, 0);
  const p = {};
  if (o.billEditedAt) {
    const g = Number(o.gstRate) || 0;
    p.finalTotal = Math.round((Number(o.finalTotal) || 0) + addT * (1 - (Number(o.billDiscountPct) || 0) / 100) * (1 + g / 100));
    p.subtotal = (Number(o.subtotal) || 0) + addT;
  }
  if (o.paid) { p.paid = false; p.paymentStatus = "pending"; }
  return p;
};

const patchAt = (list, idx, patch) => list.map((x, i) => (i === idx ? { ...x, ...patch } : x));

// Agar bill khulne ke baad order me naya KOT/item aa gaya to save rok do
async function guardedOrderUpdate(base, patch) {
  const ref = doc(db, "orders", base.id);
  await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
    if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error("Order nahi mila");
    const cur = snap.data();
    if ((cur.items || []).length !== (base.items || []).length || (cur.kots || []).length !== (base.kots || []).length) {
      throw new Error("Ye order kisi aur ne abhi badla hai (naya KOT/item). Bill band karke dobara kholo.");
    }
    tx.update(ref, patch);
  });
}

function getEstimatedTime(items, menu = []) {
  if (!items || items.length === 0) return 5;
  const maxTime = Math.max(...items.map(it => { 
    const item = menu.find(m => m.id === it.itemId); 
    return PREP_TIME_ESTIMATES[item?.category || "Fun Food"] || 15; 
  }));
  return (Number.isFinite(maxTime) ? maxTime : 15) + 2;
}

function getOrderProgress(status) {
  const map = { new: 15, preparing: 50, ready: 85, served: 100 };
  return map[status] || 0;
}

// Cart helpers â€” Flash sale / Combo price override handle karte hain
function getCartQty(cartEntry) {
  if (!cartEntry) return 0;
  if (typeof cartEntry === 'number') return cartEntry;
  return cartEntry.qty || 0;
}

function getCartLineTotal(cartEntry, menuItem) {
  if (!cartEntry || !menuItem) return 0;
  const price = cartEntry.priceOverride ?? menuItem.price ?? 0;
  const _q = getCartQty(cartEntry);
  if (cartEntry.priceOverride == null) return price * _q;
  const _cap = Math.min(_q, cartEntry.ovQty ?? _q);
  return price * _cap + (menuItem.price ?? 0) * (_q - _cap);
}

function getSmartSuggestionPool(menu, cart) {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  let cats;
  if (hour < 11) cats = ["Shakes & Drinks", "Momos & Rolls"];
  else if (hour < 15) cats = ["Biryani & Rice", "Thali", "Dal, Roti & Chole"];
  else if (hour < 18) cats = ["Maggi, Corn & Fries", "Shakes & Drinks", "Momos & Rolls"];
  else cats = ["Tandoor", "Chinese", "Paneer & Mushroom"];
  return menu.filter(m => cats.includes(m.category) && m.available && !cart[m.id]);
}
function getSmartSuggestionPoolOld(menu, cart) {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  let pool = [];
  if (hour < 11) pool = menu.filter(m => m.category.includes("Tea") || m.category.includes("Bread"));
  else if (hour < 13) pool = menu.filter(m => m.category.includes("Biryani") || m.category.includes("Pulao"));
  else if (hour < 17) pool = menu.filter(m => m.category.includes("Snacks") || m.category.includes("Drinks"));
  else pool = menu.filter(m => m.category.includes("Tandoori") || m.category.includes("Mains"));
  return pool.filter(m => m.available && !cart[m.id]);
}

class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null };
  }
  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }
  componentDidCatch(error, info) {
    console.error('ğŸ”´ ErrorBoundary caught:', error);
    console.error('ğŸ”´ Component Stack:', info.componentStack);
    this.setState({ error, errorInfo: info });
  }
  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError && this.props.compact) {
      return (
        <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 400, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", padding: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 16, padding: 20, maxWidth: 320, textAlign: "center" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 40 }}>âš ï¸</div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, margin: "8px 0 14px" }}>Ye screen me dikkat aayi. Band karke dobara kholo.</div>
            <button onClick={() => { this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null }); if (this.props.onReset) this.props.onReset(); }} style={{ background: COLORS.ink, color: "#fff", border: "none", padding: "10px 24px", borderRadius: 10, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>Theek hai</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div style={{ minHeight: '100vh', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 20 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '4rem', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>ğŸ˜…</div>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color: COLORS.ink, marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>Something went wrong</h2>
          <pre style={{ background: '#f5f5f5', padding: 16, borderRadius: 8, maxWidth: 600, overflow: 'auto', fontSize: 12, color: '#c00', marginBottom: 16, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>
            {this.state.error?.toString()}
            {'\n\n'}
            {this.state.errorInfo?.componentStack}
          </pre>
          <button onClick={() => { try { localStorage.removeItem('eatpark_cart'); } catch (e) {} window.location.reload(); }} style={{ background: COLORS.copper, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '10px 20px', borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 'bold', cursor: 'pointer' }}>Clear Cache & Refresh</button>
          <button onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null })} style={{ background: COLORS.ink, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '10px 20px', borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 'bold', cursor: 'pointer', marginTop: 10 }}>ğŸ”„ Try Again</button>
          <button onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null })} style={{ background: COLORS.ink, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '10px 20px', borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 'bold', cursor: 'pointer', marginTop: 10 }}>ğŸ”„ Try Again</button>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

const SearchBar = memo(({ value, onChange, placeholder = "Search menu..." }) => {
  const timeoutRef = useRef(null);
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => { setLocalValue(value); }, [value]);
  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const q = e.target.value;
    setLocalValue(q);
    clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => onChange(q), 250);
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "relative", flex: 1 }}>
      <input type="text" value={localValue} onChange={handleChange} placeholder={placeholder} className="keep-color"
        style={{ padding: "12px 16px 12px 42px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 16, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", background: "#fff", color: COLORS.ink }} />
      <span style={{ position: "absolute", left: 14, top: "50%", transform: "translateY(-50%)", fontSize: 18, color: COLORS.textLight }}>ğŸ”</span>
      {localValue && (<button onClick={() => { setLocalValue(""); onChange(""); }} style={{ position: "absolute", right: 12, top: "50%", transform: "translateY(-50%)", background: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 18, color: COLORS.textLight, padding: "4px 8px" }}>âœ•</button>)}
    </div>
  );
});

function useLiveNow(intervalMs = 30000) {
  const [, forceTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => forceTick(x => x + 1), intervalMs);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [intervalMs]);
  // Returns nothing on purpose â€” just forces a re-render every intervalMs.
  // Callers use this to refresh relative timestamps like timeAgo().
}
const useLocalStorage = (key, initialValue) => {
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue;
    } catch (error) { return initialValue; }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    try { window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(storedValue)); }
    catch (error) { console.error('useLocalStorage error:', error); }
  }, [key, storedValue]);
  return [storedValue, setStoredValue];
};

// ğŸ–¥ï¸ğŸ“± APP / DESKTOP MODE
const VIEW_KEY = "eatpark_viewmode";
function useViewMode() {
  const read = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(VIEW_KEY);
      if (saved === "desktop" || saved === "app") return saved;
    } catch (e) {}
    return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.innerWidth >= 1024 ? "desktop" : "app";
  };
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState(read);
  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setModeState(read());
    window.addEventListener("eatpark_viewmode_change", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("eatpark_viewmode_change", sync);
  }, []);
  const setMode = useCallback((m) => {
    try { localStorage.setItem(VIEW_KEY, m); } catch (e) {}
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("eatpark_viewmode_change"));
  }, []);
  return [mode, setMode];
}

// ğŸ“Œ ADMIN PRESETS (Firebase: settings/presets) â€” waiters, customers, notes, discount, GST
const DEFAULT_PRESETS = { waiters: [], notes: [], discounts: [], gstRates: [], customers: [] };
function usePresets() {
  const [presets, setPresetsState] = useState(() => {
    try { return { ...DEFAULT_PRESETS, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("eatpark_presets") || "{}") }; }
    catch (e) { return DEFAULT_PRESETS; }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = onSnapshot(doc(db, "settings", "presets"), (snap) => {
      if (snap.exists()) {
        const d = { ...DEFAULT_PRESETS, ...snap.data() };
        setPresetsState(d);
        try { localStorage.setItem("eatpark_presets", JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {}
      }
    }, (err) => console.error("presets listener:", err));
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);
  const savePresets = async (next) => {
    setPresetsState(next);
    try { localStorage.setItem("eatpark_presets", JSON.stringify(next)); } catch (e) {}
    try { await setDoc(doc(db, "settings", "presets"), next); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); alert("âš ï¸ Presets save nahi hue. Internet / Firebase rules check karo."); }
  };
  return [presets, savePresets];
}

const ViewModeToggle = memo(() => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useViewMode();
  const isDesktop = mode === "desktop";
  return (
    <button onClick={() => setMode(isDesktop ? "app" : "desktop")} title="App / Desktop mode badlo"
      style={{ background: COLORS.paper2, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: "8px 12px", cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, marginLeft: 8, color: COLORS.ink }}>
      {isDesktop ? "ğŸ“± App Mode" : "ğŸ–¥ï¸ Desktop Mode"}
    </button>
  );
});

// 5 galat PIN ke baad 30 second lock
function usePinLockout(max = 5, lockMs = 30000) {
  const [fails, setFails] = useState(0);
  const [lockedUntil, setLockedUntil] = useState(0);
  return {
    isLocked: () => Date.now() < lockedUntil,
    secondsLeft: () => Math.max(0, Math.ceil((lockedUntil - Date.now()) / 1000)),
    registerFail: () => {
      const n = fails + 1;
      if (n >= max) { setLockedUntil(Date.now() + lockMs); setFails(0); } else setFails(n);
    },
    reset: () => setFails(0)
  };
}

const useLocalStorageOld = (key, initialValue) => {
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue;
    } catch (error) {
      return initialValue;
    }
  });

  const setValue = useCallback((value) => {
    setStoredValue(prev => {
      try {
        const v = value instanceof Function ? value(prev) : value;
        window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(v));
        return v;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('useLocalStorage error:', error);
        return prev;
      }
    });
  }, [key]);

  return [storedValue, setValue];
};

const LoyaltyProgress = memo(({ currentPoints, nextTier, loyaltyRules }) => {
  if (!nextTier) return null;
  const currentTierIndex = LOYALTY_TIERS.indexOf(nextTier) - 1;
  const previousTierPoints = currentTierIndex >= 0 ? LOYALTY_TIERS[currentTierIndex].points : 0;
  const pointsNeeded = nextTier.points - currentPoints;
  const progress = Math.min(((currentPoints - previousTierPoints) / (nextTier.points - previousTierPoints)) * 100, 100);
  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 8, padding: '10px 12px', background: '#fff', borderRadius: 10, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 4 }}>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: COLORS.textLight }}>{nextTier.emoji} Next: {nextTier.name}</span>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: pointsNeeded > 0 ? COLORS.copper : COLORS.success }}>{pointsNeeded > 0 ? `${pointsNeeded} away` : 'ğŸ‰ Unlocked!'}</span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 6, background: COLORS.paper2, borderRadius: 999, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <div style={{ width: `${Math.min(progress, 100)}%`, height: '100%', background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${COLORS.gold}, ${nextTier.color || COLORS.sage})`, borderRadius: 999, transition: 'width 0.8s ease' }} />
      </div>
      {pointsNeeded > 0 && (<div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, marginTop: 4 }}>ğŸ’° Spend â‚¹{Math.ceil(pointsNeeded * loyaltyRules.rate)} more</div>)}
    </div>
  );
});

const ChatBox = memo(({ orderId, customerId }) => {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState('');
  const messagesRef = useMemo(() => collection(db, 'chats', orderId, 'messages'), [orderId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const q = query(messagesRef, orderBy('timestamp', 'asc'));
      const unsub = onSnapshot(q, (snap) => {
        setMessages(snap.docs.map(doc => { const data = doc.data(); if (!data.timestamp) data.timestamp = Date.now(); return { id: doc.id, ...data }; }));
      });
      return unsub;
    } catch (e) { console.error('Chat error:', e); }
  }, [orderId, messagesRef]);
  const sendMessage = async () => {
    if (!newMessage.trim()) return;
    try {
      await addDoc(messagesRef, { text: newMessage, senderId: customerId, senderName: customerId === 'customer' ? 'Customer' : 'Restaurant', timestamp: serverTimestamp() });
      setNewMessage('');
    } catch (e) { console.error('Chat send error:', e); }
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ border: '1px solid #ddd', borderRadius: 8, padding: 12, background: '#fff' }}>
      <div style={{ maxHeight: 250, overflowY: 'auto', marginBottom: 8 }}>
        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <div key={msg.id} style={{ textAlign: msg.senderId === customerId ? 'right' : 'left', margin: '4px 0' }}>
            <span style={{ background: msg.senderId === customerId ? COLORS.copper : '#e9ecef', color: msg.senderId === customerId ? '#fff' : '#000', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 12, display: 'inline-block', maxWidth: '80%' }}>{msg.text}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
        <input value={newMessage} onChange={(e) => setNewMessage(e.target.value)} placeholder="Type a message..." style={{ flex: 1, padding: 8, border: '1px solid #ccc', borderRadius: 4 }} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && sendMessage()} />
        <button onClick={sendMessage} style={{ background: COLORS.copper, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 4, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Send</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

const loadRazorpayScript = () => new Promise((resolve) => {
  if (window.Razorpay) { resolve(true); return; }
  const script = document.createElement('script');
  script.src = 'https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js';
  script.onload = () => resolve(true);
  script.onerror = () => resolve(false);
  document.body.appendChild(script);
});

// Success pe Razorpay response, cancel/fail pe null return karta hai
const processRazorpayPaymentLegacy = (amount, orderId, customerName, customerPhone) =>
  new Promise(async (resolve) => {
    if (!RAZORPAY_KEY || RAZORPAY_KEY.startsWith("YOUR_")) {
      alert("âš ï¸ Razorpay key configure nahi hai.");
      return resolve(null);
    }
    const loaded = await loadRazorpayScript();
    if (!loaded || !window.Razorpay) { alert("âš ï¸ Payment gateway load nahi hua."); return resolve(null); }
    const rzp = new window.Razorpay({
      key: RAZORPAY_KEY, amount: Math.round(amount * 100), currency: "INR",
      name: RESTAURANT.name, description: `Order #${orderId.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}`,
      prefill: { name: customerName, contact: customerPhone },
      theme: { color: COLORS.copper },
      handler: (response) => resolve(response),
      modal: { ondismiss: () => resolve(null) }
    });
    rzp.on('payment.failed', () => resolve(null));
    rzp.open();
  });

// ==
// 13.5 AI ORDER MODAL (VOICE & TEXT)
// ==

function AIOrderModal({ menu, onOrderParsed, onClose }) {
  const [aiText, setAiText] = useState("");
  const [aiBusy, setAiBusy] = useState(false);
  const [aiErr, setAiErr] = useState("");
  const [listening, setListening] = useState(false);
  const recRef = useRef(null);

  const startMic = () => {
    const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if (!SR) {
      setAiErr("âš ï¸ Is browser me mic support nahi hai. Keyboard ka mic use karein.");
      return;
    }

    // Agar pehle se sun raha hai toh stop karein
    if (listening && recRef.current) {
      try {
        recRef.current.stop();
      } catch (err) {}
      setListening(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const r = new SR();
      r.lang = "hi-IN";
      r.interimResults = false;
      r.continuous = false;

      r.onstart = () => {
        setListening(true);
        setAiErr("");
      };

      r.onresult = (e) => {
        const transcript = Array.from(e.results)
          .map((res) => res[0].transcript)
          .join(" ");
        setAiText((prev) => (prev ? prev + " " : "") + transcript);
      };

      r.onerror = (e) => {
        setListening(false);
        if (e.error === "not-allowed") {
          setAiErr("âš ï¸ Mic permission blocked hai. Settings me allow karein.");
        } else if (e.error === "no-speech") {
          setAiErr("âš ï¸ Koi aawaz nahi suni gayi. Dobara bolein.");
        } else {
          setAiErr(`âš ï¸ Mic error: ${e.error || "Aawaz capture nahi hui"}`);
        }
      };

      r.onend = () => {
        setListening(false);
      };

      recRef.current = r;
      r.start();
    } catch (err) {
      setListening(false);
      setAiErr("âš ï¸ Mic start nahi ho paya. Dobara tap karein.");
    }
  };

  const runAi = async () => {
    const text = aiText.trim();
    if (!text || aiBusy) return;
    setAiBusy(true);
    setAiErr("");
    try {
      const r = await HX.fetchWithTimeout("/api/parse-order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...(auth.currentUser ? { Authorization: "Bearer " + (await auth.currentUser.getIdToken()) } : {}) },

        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          menu: (menu || [])
            .filter((m) => m.available)
            .map((m) => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name, portion: m.portion || "" })),
        }),
      });
      const data = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "AI processing fail ho gayi");
      onOrderParsed(HX.sanitizeAiLines(data, menu));
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setAiErr("âš ï¸ " + (e.message || e));
    } finally {
      setAiBusy(false);
    }
  };


  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.65)", zIndex: 280, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", padding: 14 }} onClick={onClose}>
      <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 18, padding: 18, width: "100%", maxWidth: 390, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 10 }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 18, fontFamily: "'Outfit', sans-serif" }}>ğŸ¤– AI Order</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", fontSize: 18, cursor: "pointer" }}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8A8375" }}>Bolo ya likho: "2 veg roll, 1 cold coffee"</div>
        <textarea
          rows={3}
          value={aiText}
          onChange={(e) => setAiText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Order yahan likhein ya mic se bolein..."
          style={{ width: "100%", padding: 10, borderRadius: 10, border: "1.5px solid #E8E6DC", boxSizing: "border-box", fontSize: 14, resize: "none" }}
        />
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
          <button type="button" onClick={startMic} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 10, background: listening ? "#C0392B" : "#FAFAF8", border: "1.5px solid #E8E6DC", fontWeight: 800, color: listening ? "#fff" : "#1A1A1A", cursor: "pointer" }}>
            {listening ? "â¹ï¸ Ruko" : "ğŸ¤ Bolo"}
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={runAi} disabled={aiBusy || !aiText.trim()} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 10, background: "#3B82F6", color: "#fff", border: "none", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", opacity: (aiBusy || !aiText.trim()) ? 0.6 : 1 }}>
            {aiBusy ? "â³ Soch raha..." : "âœ¨ Samjho"}
          </button>
        </div>
        {aiErr && <div style={{ color: "#EF4444", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700 }}>{aiErr}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const RunningOrderModal = memo(({ order, menu, onConfirm, onClose }) => {
