const TableStatusBoard = memo(({ orders, tables = 12, onTableClick, onEmptyTableClick, showStats = true, compact = false, isDark = false }) => { useLiveNow(30000);
  const tableData = useMemo(() => {
    const activeOrders = (orders || []).filter(o =>
      o.orderType === "dine_in" &&
      o.status !== "cancelled" &&
      o.status !== "served" &&
      !o.paid
    );

    const map = {};
    for (let i = 1; i <= tables; i++) {
      map[i] = { table: i, order: null, status: "empty" };
    }

    [...activeOrders].sort((a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt).forEach(o => {
      const t = Number(o.table);
      if (map[t]) {
        map[t].all = [...(map[t].all || []), o]; map[t].order = o;
        if (!map[t].all.some(x => x.status === "new" || x.status === "preparing")) map[t].status = "billing";
        else map[t].status = "occupied";
      }
    });

    return Object.values(map);
  }, [orders, tables]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const active = tableData.filter(t => t.order);
    const totalAmount = active.reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.all || [t.order]).reduce((s, x) => s + getOrderTotal(x), 0), 0);
    return {
      occupied: active.length,
      empty: tables - active.length,
      running: totalAmount,
    };
  }, [tableData, tables]);
   
  const statusColors = {
    empty:    { bg: "#E8F5E9", border: "#4A7C59", label: "Empty",    emoji: "ğŸŸ¢" },
    occupied: { bg: "#FFEBEE", border: "#EF4444", label: "Occupied", emoji: "ğŸ”´" },

  };

  if (compact) {

          {tableData.map(t => {
            const c = statusColors[t.status];
            return (
              <button
                key={t.table}
                onClick={() => (t.order ? (onTableClick && onTableClick(t.order)) : (onEmptyTableClick && onEmptyTableClick(t.table)))}
                disabled={!t.order && !onEmptyTableClick}
                style={{
                  aspectRatio: '1', borderRadius: 14,

            <div style={{ fontFamily: "'Outfit', sans-serif", fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 800 }}>Table Status Board</div>

              <span style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>ğŸ”´</span>

const WaiterOrderPanel = memo(({ menu, table, setTable, onSubmit, onClose, onAddMoreItems, orders, setMenuState, categories }) => {
  const [cart, setCart] = useState({});
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [waiterName, setWaiterName] = useState("");
  const [customerName, setCustomerName] = useState("");
  const [customerPhone, setCustomerPhone] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [orderMode, setOrderMode] = useState("dine_in"); 
  const [placedOrder, setPlacedOrder] = useState(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showAiModal, setShowAiModal] = useState(false);


  // ğŸ†• Add Menu Item State
  const [showAddItem, setShowAddItem] = useState(false);
  const [newItem, setNewItem] = useState({
    name: "",
    price: "",
    category: categories[0] || "Thali",
    veg: true,
    portion: "",
    desc: "",
    image: "",
    isBestseller: false
  });
  const [isSavingItem, setIsSavingItem] = useState(false);

  const filtered = menu.filter(m => m.available && (!search.trim() || m.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())));
  const cartItems = Object.entries(cart).filter(([, e]) => getCartQty(e) > 0);
  const cartCount = cartItems.reduce((s, [, e]) => s + getCartQty(e), 0);
  const subtotal = cartItems.reduce((s, [id, e]) => {
    const item = menu.find((m) => m.id === id);
    return s + getCartLineTotal(e, item);
  }, 0);
    const setQty = (id, q) => {
    setCart(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (q <= 0) delete next[id];
      else next[id] = { qty: q };
      return next;
    });
  };
  const inputStyle = { padding: 12, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 14, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", fontFamily: "'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif", background: "#fff", color: COLORS.ink, colorScheme: "light" };


  // ğŸ”¥ Running tables
  const runningTables = useMemo(() => {
    return (orders || [])
      .filter(o => o.orderType === "dine_in" && o.status !== "served" && o.status !== "cancelled")
      .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
  }, [orders]);

  const currentTableRunning = runningTables.find(o => Number(o.table) === Number(table));

  // ğŸ†• SAVE NEW MENU ITEM TO FIREBASE
  const handleSaveNewItem = async () => {
    if (!newItem.name.trim()) { alert("âš ï¸ Item name required"); return; }
    if (!newItem.price || Number(newItem.price) <= 0) { alert("âš ï¸ Valid price required"); return; }

    setIsSavingItem(true);
    try {
      // Naya item banao
      const newDish = mi(
        uid("m"),
        newItem.name.trim(),
        Number(newItem.price),
        newItem.category,
        newItem.veg,
        newItem.desc.trim(),
        newItem.portion.trim(),
        newItem.isBestseller,
        true,
        newItem.image.trim()
      );

      // Menu mein sabse upar add karo
      const updatedMenu = [newDish, ...menu];

      // Firestore mein save karo
      await setDoc(doc(db, "settings", "menu"), { items: updatedMenu });

      // Local state update karo
      if (setMenuState) setMenuState(updatedMenu);

      // Success message
      alert(`âœ… "${newDish.name}" added to menu!\n\nAb ise cart mein add kar sakte ho.`);

      // Form reset karo
      setNewItem({
        name: "",
        price: "",
        category: categories[0] || "Thali",
        veg: true,
        portion: "",
        desc: "",
        image: "",
        isBestseller: false
      });
      setShowAddItem(false);

      // Search mein naya item dikhane ke liye
      setSearch(newDish.name);

    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Save new item error:", error);
      alert("âŒ Failed to save item. Check internet and try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsSavingItem(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (cartItems.length === 0) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const items = cartItems.map(([id, entry]) => {
        const m = menu.find(x => x.id === id);
        return {
          itemId: id,
          name: m.name,
          portion: m.portion || "",
          price: entry.priceOverride ?? m.price,
          qty: getCartQty(entry)
        };
      });
      let created = null;
      try {
      created = await onSubmit({
  table: orderMode === "parcel" ? 0 : table,
  orderType: orderMode,
  items, waiterName,
  customerName: customerName || "Walk-in",
  customerPhone: customerPhone || "",
  notes
});
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        alert("âŒ Order send nahi hua:\n" + (err.code || err.message || err));
      }
      if (created) {
        setPlacedOrder(created);
        setCart({});
        setNotes("");
      }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setIsSubmitting(false); }
  };

  const handlePrintKOT = (order) => {
    const w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=300,height=600');
    if (!w) return;
    const totalAmount = getOrderTotal(order);
    w.document.write(`<html><head><title>KOT</title>
      <style>body{font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;padding:12px;width:280px}
      h2,h4{text-align:center;margin:4px 0}
      .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #000}</style></head><body>

                    <button disabled={cartItems.length === 0 || isSubmitting}
            onClick={handleSubmit}
            style={{ width: "100%", padding: 16, border: "none", borderRadius: 14, background: cartItems.length ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.paper2, color: cartItems.length ? "#fff" : COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, cursor: cartItems.length && !isSubmitting ? "pointer" : "not-allowed" }}>
            {isSubmitting ? "â³ Sending..." : "ğŸ³ Send Order to Kitchen"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {showAiModal && (
        <AIOrderModal
          menu={menu}
          onClose={() => setShowAiModal(false)}
          onOrderParsed={(data) => {
            (data.items || []).forEach((line) => {
              setQty(line.id, (cart[line.id]?.qty || 0) + line.qty);
            });
            if (data.orderType === "parcel") {
              setOrderMode("parcel");
            } else if (data.table) {
              setOrderMode("dine_in");
              setTable(Number(data.table));
            }
            if (data.notes) {
              setNotes((prev) => (prev ? prev + ", " + data.notes : data.notes));
            }
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

const WAITER_FLAG = "eatpark_waiter_open";

// KOT slip print (hidden iframe)
function printKotSlipGlobal(order) {
  try {
    const kot = (order.kots && order.kots.length ? order.kots[order.kots.length - 1] : null) || { kotNumber: 1, items: order.items || [] };
    const rows = (kot.items || []).map((it) => `<div class="r"><span>${it.qty} x ${escapeHtml(it.name)}${it.portion ? " (" + escapeHtml(it.portion) + ")" : ""}</span></div>`).join("");
    const now = new Date().toLocaleString("en-IN", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.style.cssText = "position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:0;border:0;";
    document.body.appendChild(iframe);
    const w = iframe.contentWindow;
    setTimeout(() => { try { document.body.removeChild(iframe); } catch (e) {} }, 60000);
    w.document.open();
    w.document.write(`<!doctype html><html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'"><title>KOT</title><style>@page{margin:0}*{color:#000!important}body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;width:280px;margin:0 auto;padding:8px;font-weight:700}h2,h3{text-align:center;margin:3px 0}.r{font-size:17px;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #000}.c{text-align:center;font-size:12px}</style></head><body><h2>KOT #${kot.kotNumber || 1}${kot.isRunning ? " (RUNNING)" : ""}</h2><h3>${order.orderType === "parcel" ? "PARCEL" : "TABLE " + escapeHtml(String(order.table))}</h3><div class="c">${escapeHtml(now)} Â· #${escapeHtml(order.id.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase())}${order.waiter ? " Â· " + escapeHtml(order.waiter) : ""}</div><div style="margin-top:8px">${rows}</div>${order.notes ? `<div class="c" style="margin-top:8px">Note: ${escapeHtml(order.notes)}</div>` : ""}</body></html>`);
    w.document.close();
    setTimeout(() => { try { w.focus(); w.print(); } catch (e) { alert("âš ï¸ KOT print nahi ho paya: " + e.message); } }, 400);
  } catch (e) { console.error("KOT print error:", e); }
}

  const now = new Date().toLocaleString("en-IN", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
  const itemsHtml = items.map((it) => `<tr><td style="text-align:left">${escapeHtml(it.name)}${it.portion ? ` <small>(${escapeHtml(it.portion)})</small>` : ""}</td><td style="text-align:center">${it.qty}</td><td style="text-align:right">â‚¹${it.price}</td><td style="text-align:right">â‚¹${Math.round(it.price * it.qty * 100) / 100}</td></tr>`).join("");
  const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
  iframe.style.cssText = "position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:0;border:0;";
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);
  const w = iframe.contentWindow;
  setTimeout(() => { try { document.body.removeChild(iframe); } catch (e) {} }, 60000);
  w.document.open();
  w.document.write(`<!doctype html><html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'"><title>Bill ${billNo}</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;color:#000 !important}
@page{margin:0}
body{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;padding:8px;width:290px;margin:0 auto}
h2{text-align:center;margin:4px 0;font-size:24px;font-weight:900}
.line{border-top:2px dashed #000;margin:8px 0}

</style></head><body>
<h2>${escapeHtml(RESTAURANT.name)}</h2>
<div class="center" style="font-size:10px">${escapeHtml(RESTAURANT.address)}</div>
<div class="center" style="font-size:10px">Ph: ${RESTAURANT.phones.join(" / ")}</div>
${RESTAURANT.gstin ? `<div class="center" style="font-size:10px">GSTIN: ${escapeHtml(RESTAURANT.gstin)}</div>` : ""}
<div class="line"></div>
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px">${showBillNo ? `<div>Bill #: ${billNo}</div>` : `<div>&nbsp;</div>`}<div>${order.orderType === "parcel" ? "PARCEL" : "T-" + escapeHtml(String(order.table))}</div></div>
<div style="font-size:10px;text-align:center;margin-top:4px">${now}</div>

const deriveBill = (o) => ({
  items: (o.items || []).map((it, i) => ({ ...it, _origQty: it.qty, _rowId: i + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6) })),
  gstRate: o.gstRate ?? 0,
  disc: o.billEditedAt ? (o.billDiscount || 0) : (o.loyaltyDiscount || 0),
  discPct: o.billEditedAt ? (o.billDiscountPct || 0) : (o.discount || 0),
  payMode: o.payment || "cash",
  payStatus: o.paid ? "paid" : "pending",
  custName: isWalkIn(o.customer?.name) ? "" : (o.customer?.name || ""),
  custPhone: isWalkIn(o.customer?.phone) ? "" : (o.customer?.phone || ""),
  gstin: o.customerGstin || "",
  notes: o.notes || "",
  table: Number(o.table) || 1,
  orderType: o.orderType || "dine_in",
  waiter: o.waiter || "",
  sendKot: !!o.isDraft
});

// Staff wale POS ka hi logic â€” waiter ke liye
function POSController({ initialOrder, orders, menu, categories, viewMode, placeOrder, advanceStatus, setMenuState, onClose, waiterMode, onDraftChange }) {
  const [init] = useState(() => deriveBill(initialOrder));
  const [billOrder, setBillOrder] = useState(initialOrder);
  const [items, setItems] = useState(init.items);
  const [gstRate, setGstRate] = useState(init.gstRate);
  const [gstCustom, setGstCustom] = useState("");
  const [disc, setDisc] = useState(init.disc);
  const [discPct, setDiscPct] = useState(init.discPct);
  const [payMode, setPayMode] = useState(init.payMode);
  const [payStatus, setPayStatus] = useState(init.payStatus);
  const [custName, setCustName] = useState(init.custName);
  const [custPhone, setCustPhone] = useState(init.custPhone);
  const [gstin, setGstin] = useState(init.gstin);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(init.notes);
  const [showBillNo, setShowBillNo] = useState(true);
  const [table, setTable] = useState(init.table);
  const [orderType, setOrderType] = useState(init.orderType);
  const [waiter, setWaiter] = useState(init.waiter);
  const [sendKot, setSendKot] = useState(init.sendKot);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (billOrder.isDraft && onDraftChange) {
      onDraftChange(table, items, billOrder);
    }
  }, [items, table]);

  // Dusra order kholna ho (table clash pe "Wahi kholo")
  const load = (o) => {
    const d = deriveBill(o);
    setBillOrder(o); setItems(d.items); setGstRate(d.gstRate); setGstCustom("");
    setDisc(d.disc); setDiscPct(d.discPct); setPayMode(d.payMode); setPayStatus(d.payStatus);
    setCustName(d.custName); setCustPhone(d.custPhone); setGstin(d.gstin); setNotes(d.notes);
    setTable(d.table); setOrderType(d.orderType); setWaiter(d.waiter); setSendKot(d.sendKot);
  };

  const calc = useMemo(() => {
    const sub = Math.round(items.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.price || 0) * (it.qty || 0), 0));
    const gr = gstRate === "custom" ? Number(gstCustom) || 0 : Number(gstRate) || 0;
    const discPctAmt = Math.round((sub * discPct) / 100);
    const afterPct = sub - discPctAmt;
    const gst = Math.round((afterPct * gr) / 100);
    const delivery = Number(billOrder.deliveryFee) || 0;
    const total = Math.max(0, afterPct - disc) + gst + delivery;
    return { sub, gstRate: gr, gst, discPctAmt, discAmt: disc, total, delivery };
  }, [billOrder, items, gstRate, gstCustom, disc, discPct]);

  const saveBill = async (override = {}) => {
    try {
      const { sub, gstRate: gr, gst, discPctAmt, discAmt, total } = calc;
      const updated = {
        items: items.map(({ _rowId, _new, _origQty, ...rest }) => (!billOrder.isDraft && _new ? { ...rest, kotNumber: getNextKotNo(billOrder) } : rest)),
        subtotal: sub, gstRate: gr, gstAmount: gst,
        billDiscount: discAmt, billDiscountPct: discPct, billDiscountAmt: discPctAmt,
        finalTotal: total, payment: payMode,
        paid: (override.payStatus ?? payStatus) === "paid",
        paymentStatus: override.payStatus ?? payStatus,
        customer: { ...(billOrder.customer || {}), name: custName || "Walk-in", phone: custPhone || "WALK-IN" },
        customerGstin: gstin || "", notes,
        billEditedAt: Date.now(),
        billEditedBy: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || "waiter"
      };
      const clean = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(updated));
      if (billOrder.isDraft) {
        const { isDraft, ...base } = billOrder;
        const kotItems = clean.items.map((it) => ({ ...it, kotNumber: 1 }));
        const fullOrder = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({
          ...base, ...clean,
          createdBy: auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.uid : "waiter",
          table: orderType === "parcel" ? 0 : table,
          orderType, waiter: waiter || "Staff", items: kotItems,
          kots: sendKot ? [{ id: uid("kot"), kotNumber: 1, items: kotItems, createdAt: Date.now(), status: "new", isRunning: false }] : [],
          status: (sendKot && !clean.paid) ? "new" : "served",
          ...((sendKot && !clean.paid) ? {} : { servedAt: Date.now() })
        }));
        await placeOrder(fullOrder);
        return fullOrder;
      }
      const addedRows = items.map((it) => {
        if (it._new) return (it.qty || 0) > 0 ? it : null;
        const extra = (it.qty || 0) - (it._origQty ?? it.qty);
        return extra > 0 ? { ...it, qty: extra } : null;
      }).filter(Boolean);
      if (addedRows.length > 0) {
        const no = getNextKotNo(billOrder);
        const runKot = { id: uid("kot"), kotNumber: no, items: addedRows.map(({ _rowId, _new, _origQty, ...r }) => ({ ...r, kotNumber: no })), createdAt: Date.now(), status: "new", isRunning: true };
        clean.kots = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify([...getBaseKots(billOrder), runKot]));
        clean.status = "new";
        clean.lastKotAt = Date.now();
await guardedOrderUpdate(billOrder, clean);

        return { ...billOrder, ...clean, _ranKot: true };
      }
      await guardedOrderUpdate(billOrder, clean);
      return { ...billOrder, ...updated };
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("waiter saveBill error:", e);
      alert("âš ï¸ Save fail: " + e.message);
      return null;
    }
  };

  const onAction = async (mode) => {
    if (saving) return;
    if (items.length === 0) { alert("âš ï¸ Pehle items add karo"); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const wasDraft = !!billOrder.isDraft;
      // Waiter mode: koi print nahi â€” sirf save / KOT kitchen ko
      const saved = await saveBill({});
      if (!saved) return;
      addDoc(collection(db, "auditLogs"), { orderId: saved.id, action: "save", by: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || "?", before: getOrderTotal(billOrder), after: saved.finalTotal, at: Date.now() }).catch(() => {});
      onClose();
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <BillPOSScreen
      order={billOrder} orders={orders} menu={menu} categories={categories} viewMode={viewMode} setMenuState={setMenuState}
      items={items} setItems={setItems} calc={calc}
      orderType={orderType} setOrderType={setOrderType} table={table} setTable={setTable}
      waiter={waiter} setWaiter={setWaiter} sendKot={sendKot} setSendKot={setSendKot}
      custName={custName} setCustName={setCustName} custPhone={custPhone} setCustPhone={setCustPhone}
      gstin={gstin} setGstin={setGstin} gstRate={gstRate} setGstRate={setGstRate}
      gstCustom={gstCustom} setGstCustom={setGstCustom} disc={disc} setDisc={setDisc}
      discPct={discPct} setDiscPct={setDiscPct} payMode={payMode} setPayMode={setPayMode}
      payStatus={payStatus} setPayStatus={setPayStatus} notes={notes} setNotes={setNotes}
      showBillNo={showBillNo} setShowBillNo={setShowBillNo} saving={saving}
      hidePrint waiterMode={waiterMode}
      onClose={onClose} onOpenOrder={load} onAction={onAction}
    />
  );
}

// ğŸ§‘â€ğŸ³ Waiter Mode â€” fullscreen, back dabane pe band nahi hota
function WaiterMode({ orders, menu, categories, setMenuState, placeOrder, advanceStatus, onClose }) {
  useLiveNow(5000);
  const [viewMode] = useViewMode();
  const [target, setTarget] = useState(null);
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState({});
  const [showKitchenOnly, setShowKitchenOnly] = useState(false);

  const handleDraftChange = (t, items, orderData) => {
    if (items && items.length > 0) {
      setDrafts(prev => ({ ...prev, [t]: { ...orderData, items, isDraft: true, table: t } }));
    } else {
      setDrafts(prev => { const n = {...prev}; delete n[t]; return n; });
    }
  };

  const openNew = (t) => {
    if (drafts[t] && drafts[t].items && drafts[t].items.length > 0) {
      setTarget(drafts[t]);
    } else {
      setTarget({
        id: uid("o"), isDraft: true,
        table: Number(t) || 1, orderType: "dine_in",
        customer: { name: "Walk-in", phone: "WALK-IN", address: "" },
        items: [], kots: [], waiter: "", takenBy: "waiter",
        notes: "", payment: "cash", paymentStatus: "pending", paid: false,
        status: "new", createdAt: Date.now(),
        coinsClaimed: true, earnedCoins: 0, rewardUsedCoins: 0,
        deliveryFee: 0, loyaltyDiscount: 0, discount: 0
      });
    }
  };

  const exit = () => { if (window.confirm("Waiter Mode band karna hai?")) onClose(); };
  const combinedOrders = [...(orders || []), ...Object.values(drafts).map(d => ({ ...d, status: 'draft', orderType: 'dine_in' }))];

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 85, background: "#0B111A", overflowY: "auto", colorScheme: "dark" }}>
      <div style={{ background: "#161F2F", padding: "12px 20px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", borderBottom: "1px solid #273449", position: "sticky", top: 0, zIndex: 10 }}>
        <div style={{ color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 20, fontFamily: "'Outfit', sans-serif" }}>ğŸ§‘â€ğŸ³ Waiter Panel</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
          <button onClick={() => setShowKitchenOnly(prev => !prev)} style={{ background: showKitchenOnly ? "#273449" : "#38BDF8", color: showKitchenOnly ? "#fff" : "#0B111A", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 16px", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", boxShadow: "0 4px 10px rgba(56,189,248,0.3)" }}>{showKitchenOnly ? "ğŸª‘ Tables" : "ğŸ³ Kitchen View"}</button>
          <button onClick={() => openNew()} style={{ background: "#FF5A1F", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 16px", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", boxShadow: "0 4px 10px rgba(255,90,31,0.3)" }}>â• New Order</button>
          <button onClick={exit} style={{ background: "#273449", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 16px", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer" }}>âœ• Exit</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: "20px", maxWidth: 1200, margin: "0 auto" }}>
        {!showKitchenOnly ? (
          <TableStatusBoard orders={combinedOrders} tables={20} compact={false} isDark={true} showStats onTableClick={(o) => setTarget(o)} onEmptyTableClick={(t) => openNew(t)} />
        ) : (
          <div style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
            <h2 style={{ margin: "0 0 20px", fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800, color: "#fff", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>ğŸ§‘â€ğŸ³</span> Live Kitchen Orders
            </h2>
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: viewMode === "desktop" ? "repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))" : "1fr", gap: 16 }}>
              {["new", "preparing", "ready"].map((status) => {
                const list = orders.filter(o => o.status === status);
                return (
                  <div key={status} style={{ background: "#161F2F", border: "1px solid #273449", borderRadius: 18, padding: 20 }}>
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10, marginBottom: 20, alignItems: "center" }}>
                      <div style={{ width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: "50%", background: STATUS_COLOR[status] || "#fff" }} />
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 15, textTransform: "uppercase", fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: "0.05em", color: STATUS_COLOR[status] || "#fff" }}>{STATUS_LABEL[status] || status}</div>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 13, background: STATUS_COLOR[status] || "#fff", color: "#0B111A", padding: "3px 10px", borderRadius: 14, fontWeight: 800, marginLeft: "auto" }}>{list.length}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16 }}>
                      {list.map((o) => (
                        <div key={o.id} onClick={() => setTarget(o)} style={{ background: "#1F2937", border: "2px solid #374151", borderRadius: 12, padding: 14, cursor: "pointer", transition: "all 0.2s" }}>
                          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 10, alignItems: "center" }}>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 800, color: "#FCD34D" }}>
                              {o.orderType === "parcel" ? "ğŸ›ï¸ PARCEL" : `ğŸ½ï¸ Table ${o.table}`}
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: "#9CA3AF" }}>{timeAgo(o.createdAt)}</div>
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ borderTop: "1.5px dashed #374151", paddingTop: 10, marginBottom: 12 }}>
                            {(o.items || []).map((it, idx) => (
                              <div key={idx} style={{ fontSize: 14, marginBottom: 6, fontWeight: 600, color: "#E5E7EB" }}>
                                <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, display: "inline-block", width: 28 }}>{it.qty}Ã—</span> {it.name}
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
                            <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); advanceStatus(o.id, status); }} style={{ flex: 1, padding: "10px 8px", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", background: STATUS_COLOR[status] || "#38BDF8", color: "#0B111A" }}>
                              {status === "new" ? "ğŸ‘¨â€ğŸ³ Start Cooking" : status === "preparing" ? "âœ… Mark Ready" : "ğŸ½ï¸ Mark Served"}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                      {list.length === 0 && (
                        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "40px 0", color: "#6B7280", fontSize: 14, fontStyle: "italic" }}>No orders</div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {target && (
        <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 99999, background: "#0B111A", overflow: "hidden", height: "100dvh", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
          <POSController
            key={target.id}
            initialOrder={target}
            orders={orders} menu={menu} categories={categories} viewMode={viewMode}
            placeOrder={placeOrder} advanceStatus={advanceStatus} setMenuState={setMenuState}
            waiterMode={true}
            onDraftChange={handleDraftChange}
            onClose={() => setTarget(null)}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

          const u = used.find(l => l.itemId === f.id);
          if (!u) return f;

          return { ...f, stock: left, active: left > 0 ? f.active : false };

  const addComboToCart = useCallback((combo) => {
    try {
      const lines = (combo.items || []).map(it => ({ ...it, quantity: Number(it.quantity) || 1, menuItem: menu.find(m => m.id === it.id) }));
      if (lines.length === 0 || lines.some(l => !l.menuItem || !l.menuItem.available)) { showToast("âš ï¸ Combo ka koi item available nahi", 'warning'); return; }
      const totalMenuPrice = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.menuItem.price * l.quantity, 0);
      const finalPrice = Number(combo.finalPrice);
      if (!(totalMenuPrice > 0) || !Number.isFinite(finalPrice)) { showToast("âš ï¸ Combo ka price set nahi hai", 'warning'); return; }
      const ratio = finalPrice / totalMenuPrice;
      setCart(prev => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        lines.forEach(l => {
          const prevEntry = next[l.id];
          const prevQty = getCartQty(prevEntry);
          const prevPrice = prevEntry?.priceOverride ?? l.menuItem.price;
          const newQty = prevQty + l.quantity;
          const _k = prevEntry?.priceOverride != null ? (prevEntry.ovQty ?? prevQty) : 0;
          const _o = prevEntry?.priceOverride != null ? prevEntry.priceOverride : 0;
          const _cp = l.menuItem.price * ratio;
          next[l.id] = { qty: newQty, priceOverride: Math.round((_k * _o + l.quantity * _cp) / (_k + l.quantity)), ovQty: _k + l.quantity };
        });
        return next;
      });
      showToast(`ğŸ‰ ${combo.name} added!`, 'success');

            {activeModal === 'chat' && (<><ModalHeader title="ğŸ’¬ Chat" onClose={() => setActiveModal(null)} /><ChatBox orderId={activeOrderIdForChat || 'general'} customerId={custPhone || 'customer'} /></>)}

            {showWaiterMode && (
  <WaiterMode

      {showWaiterPinModal && (

          <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ background: "#fff", padding: "28px", borderRadius: 20, width: "90%", maxWidth: 340, textAlign: "center" }} className="slide-up">
            <div style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 12 }}>ğŸ§‘â€ğŸ³</div>
            <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 8px", fontFamily: "'Outfit', sans-serif", fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800 }}>Waiter Access</h3>

            <input type="email" placeholder="Email" value={waiterEmail} onChange={(e) => setWaiterEmail(e.target.value)} style={{ padding: "12px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 16, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", marginBottom: 12 }} />
            <input type="password" placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢" autoFocus value={waiterPinInput}
              onChange={(e) => setWaiterPinInput(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleWaiterPinSubmit(); }}
              style={{ padding: "14px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 28, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", textAlign: "center", letterSpacing: 10, marginBottom: 20, fontWeight: 800 }} />
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10 }}>
              <button onClick={() => { setShowWaiterPinModal(false); setWaiterPinInput(""); }}
                style={{ flex: 1, padding: "13px", borderRadius: 12, border: `2px solid ${COLORS.line}`, background: "transparent", fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>Cancel</button>
              <button onClick={handleWaiterPinSubmit}
                style={{ flex: 1, padding: "13px", borderRadius: 12, background: COLORS.info, color: "#fff", border: "none", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>Unlock</button>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}
            {runningOrderId && orders.find(o => o.id === runningOrderId) && (
        <RunningOrderModal order={orders.find(o => o.id === runningOrderId)} menu={menu} onConfirm={(items) => addRunningItems(runningOrderId, items)} onClose={() => setRunningOrderId(null)} />
      )}
{showAiModal && (
        <AIOrderModal
          menu={menu}
          onClose={() => setShowAiModal(false)}
          onOrderParsed={(data) => {
            if (data.items && data.items.length > 0) {
              setCart((prev) => {
                const next = { ...prev };
                data.items.forEach((line) => {
                  // ID se match karein, agar naam aya ho toh naam se ID dhoondein
                  let targetId = line.id;
                  const found = menu.find((m) => m.id === line.id || m.name.toLowerCase() === String(line.name || line.id).toLowerCase());
                  if (found) targetId = found.id;
                  if (!menu.some((m) => m.id === targetId)) return;

                  const curQty = getCartQty(next[targetId]);
                  next[targetId] = { qty: curQty + (Number(line.qty) || 1) };
                });
                return next;
              });
              setCartOpen(true); // Direct bill/cart khol dega taaki gayab na lage
              showToast("âœ¨ Items cart me add ho gaye!", "success");
            } else {
              showToast("âš ï¸ Koi item match nahi hua", "warning");
            }
            if (data.orderType === "parcel") setOrderType("parcel");
            else if (data.table) {
              setOrderType("dine_in");
              setTable(Number(data.table));
            }
            if (data.notes) setNotes((prev) => (prev ? prev + ", " + data.notes : data.notes));
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
// ğŸ§¾ BILL + ORDER â€” ONE SCREEN POS
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
function BillPOSScreen(p) {
  return <ErrorBoundary compact onReset={p.onClose}><BillPOSScreenInner {...p} /></ErrorBoundary>;
}
function BillPOSScreenInner(p) {
  const { order, orders, menu, viewMode, items, setItems, calc } = p;
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(order && order.isDraft ? "menu" : "bill");
  const [presets] = usePresets();
  const waiterNames = presets.waiters || [];
  const gstList = [0, ...((presets.gstRates && presets.gstRates.length ? presets.gstRates : [5, 12, 18]).filter((r) => Number(r) > 0))];
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [cat, setCat] = useState("all");
   const [wide, setWide] = useState(() => window.innerWidth >= 900);
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = () => setWide(window.innerWidth >= 900);
    window.addEventListener("resize", f);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", f);
  }, []);
  const isDesktop = viewMode === "desktop" && wide;

  const isDraft = !!(order && order.isDraft);
  const cats = p.categories && p.categories.length ? p.categories : Array.from(new Set((menu || []).map((m) => m.category)));

  const list = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return (menu || []).filter((m) => m.available && (cat === "all" || m.category === cat || (m.alsoIn || []).includes(cat)) && (!q || String(m.name).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  }, [menu, cat, search]);

  const qtyOf = (id) => items.filter((it) => it.itemId === id).reduce((s, it) => s + (it.qty || 0), 0);
  const itemCount = items.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.qty || 0), 0);

  const addItem = (m) => setItems((prev) => {
    const i = prev.findIndex((it) => it.itemId === m.id && it.price === m.price && it._new);
    if (i >= 0) return prev.map((it, k) => (k === i ? { ...it, qty: it.qty + 1 } : it));
    return [...prev, { _new: true, itemId: m.id, name: m.name, portion: m.portion || "", price: m.price, qty: 1, _rowId: Date.now() + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6) }];
  });
  const changeQty = (rowId, d) => setItems((prev) => prev.flatMap((it) => (it._rowId !== rowId ? [it] : (it.qty + d <= 0 ? [] : [{ ...it, qty: Math.round((it.qty + d) * 100) / 100 }]))));
  const [showNew, setShowNew] = useState(false);
    const [savingItem, setSavingItem] = useState(false);

  // ğŸ¤– AI ORDER
  const [aiOpen, setAiOpen] = useState(false);
  const [aiText, setAiText] = useState("");
  const [aiBusy, setAiBusy] = useState(false);
  const [aiRes, setAiRes] = useState(null);
  const [aiErr, setAiErr] = useState("");
  const [listening, setListening] = useState(false);
  const recRef = useRef(null);

  const closeAi = () => { try { recRef.current && recRef.current.stop(); } catch (e) {} setAiOpen(false); };

  const startMic = () => {
    const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if (!SR) { setAiErr("Is browser me mic nahi hai. Keyboard ka ğŸ¤ use karo."); return; }
    if (listening && recRef.current) { recRef.current.stop(); return; }
    const r = new SR();
    r.lang = "hi-IN"; r.interimResults = false; r.continuous = false;
    r.onresult = (e) => {
      const t = Array.from(e.results).map((x) => x[0].transcript).join(" ");
      setAiText((prev) => (prev ? prev + " " : "") + t);
    };
    r.onerror = () => setListening(false);
    r.onend = () => setListening(false);
    recRef.current = r; setListening(true); setAiErr("");
    try { r.start(); } catch (e) { setListening(false); }
  };

    const runAi = async () => {
    const text = aiText.trim();
    if (!text || aiBusy) return;
    setAiBusy(true);
    setAiErr("");
    setAiRes(null);
    try {
      // 1. Safe Token extraction (Never pass empty Bearer header)
      let token = null;
      if (auth.currentUser) {
        try {
          token = await auth.currentUser.getIdToken();
        } catch (tokErr) {
          console.warn("Token fetch failed:", tokErr);
        }
      }

      const headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      };
      if (token) {
        headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
      }

      // 2. Fetch call
      const r = await HX.fetchWithTimeout("/api/parse-order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          menu: (menu || [])
            .filter((m) => m.available)
            .map((m) => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name, portion: m.portion || "" })),
        }),
      });

      // 3. Handle non-JSON or error responses gracefully
      const contentType = r.headers.get("content-type");
      if (!contentType || !contentType.includes("application/json")) {
        throw new Error(`Server error (${r.status}). Backend API route /api/parse-order check karein.`);
      }

      const data = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "AI processing failed");
      setAiRes(HX.sanitizeAiLines(data, menu));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("AI Order Error:", e);
      setAiErr("âš ï¸ " + (e.message || "Failed to process order"));
    } finally {
      setAiBusy(false);
    }
  };


  const applyAi = () => {
    if (!aiRes) return;
    setItems((prev) => {
      const next = [...prev];
      (aiRes.items || []).forEach((line) => {
        const m = (menu || []).find((x) => x.id === line.id);
        if (!m) return;
        const i = next.findIndex((it) => it.itemId === m.id && it.price === m.price && it._new);
        if (i >= 0) next[i] = { ...next[i], qty: next[i].qty + line.qty };
        else next.push({ _new: true, itemId: m.id, name: m.name, portion: m.portion || "", price: m.price, qty: line.qty, _rowId: Date.now() + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6) });
      });
      return next;
    });
    if (isDraft) {
      const t = Number(aiRes.table);
      if (aiRes.orderType === "parcel") p.setOrderType("parcel");
      else if (t >= 1 && t <= 12) { p.setOrderType("dine_in"); p.setTable(t); }
    }
    if (aiRes.notes) p.setNotes(p.notes ? p.notes + ", " + aiRes.notes : aiRes.notes);
    closeAi(); setAiText(""); setAiRes(null); setTab("bill");
  };

  const emptyNew = { name: "", price: "", category: cats[0] || "Thali", veg: true, portion: "" };
  const [newItem, setNewItem] = useState(emptyNew);

      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 4 }}>
          {(presets.notes || []).length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              {(presets.notes || []).map((n) => (
                <button key={n} type="button" onClick={() => p.setNotes(p.notes ? p.notes + ", " + n : n)} style={{ ...chip(false), padding: "3px 8px", fontSize: 11 }}>+ {n}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <input placeholder="Notes..." value={p.notes} onChange={(e) => p.setNotes(e.target.value)} style={inp} />
        </div>
        {!p.hidePrint && (
          <label style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>
            <input type="checkbox" checked={p.showBillNo} onChange={(e) => p.setShowBillNo(e.target.checked)} /> Bill #
          </label>
        )}
        {isDraft && (
          <label style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>
            <input type="checkbox" checked={p.sendKot} onChange={(e) => p.setSendKot(e.target.checked)} /> ğŸ³ Kitchen ko bhejo
          </label>
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #FDFCFA 0%, #F5F3EE 100%)", borderRadius: 14, padding: "14px 16px", fontSize: 13, border: `1.5px solid #E8E0D0`, boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "3px 0" }}><span style={{ color: "#6B7280", fontWeight: 600 }}>Subtotal</span><b style={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", color: isDark ? "#fff" : "#111827" }}>â‚¹{calc.sub}</b></div>
        {p.discPct > 0 && <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", color: COLORS.success }}><span>Discount {p.discPct}%</span><b>-â‚¹{calc.discPctAmt}</b></div>}
        {p.disc > 0 && <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", color: COLORS.success }}><span>Extra discount</span><b>-â‚¹{calc.discAmt}</b></div>}
        {calc.gstRate > 0 && <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", color: COLORS.copper }}><span>GST {calc.gstRate}%</span><b>+â‚¹{calc.gst}</b></div>}
        {calc.delivery > 0 && <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", color: COLORS.copper }}><span>Delivery</span><b>+â‚¹{calc.delivery}</b></div>}
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 900, borderTop: `2px solid ${COLORS.ink}`, paddingTop: 10, marginTop: 8 }}>
          <span style={{ letterSpacing: "0.05em" }}>TOTAL</span><span style={{ color: COLORS.copper, fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", fontSize: 22 }}>â‚¹{calc.total}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6 }}>
        <button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => p.onAction("save")} style={actBtn("transparent", COLORS.sage, `2px solid ${COLORS.sage}`)}>
          {p.saving ? "â³..." : (isDraft && p.sendKot ? "ğŸ³ KOT Bhejo" : "ğŸ’¾ Save")}
        </button>
        <button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => p.onAction("print")} style={actBtn(COLORS.info, "#fff")}>ğŸ–¨ï¸ Save & Print</button>
        <button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => p.onAction("paid")} style={actBtn(COLORS.sage, "#fff")}>âœ“ Paid & Print</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(17,24,39,0.55)", backdropFilter: "blur(6px)", zIndex: 200, display: "flex", alignItems: isDesktop ? "center" : "flex-end", justifyContent: "center" }} onClick={p.onClose}>
      <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className="slide-up"
       style={{ background: isDark ? "#161F2F" : "#fff", colorScheme: "light", width: isDesktop ? "min(1200px, 97vw)" : "100%",
 maxWidth: isDesktop ? 1280 : 560, height: isDesktop ? "96vh" : "98dvh", borderRadius: isDesktop ? 14 : "20px 20px 0 0", padding: isDesktop ? 0 : "0 0 calc(0px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", boxSizing: "border-box", gap: 0, boxShadow: "0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)", overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <div style={{ fontFamily: "'Outfit', sans-serif", fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 800, background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1A1A1A 0%, #3C3C3C 100%)", WebkitBackgroundClip: "text", WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent", letterSpacing: "-0.01em" }}>ğŸ§¾ {isDraft ? "New Order + Bill" : "Order Bill"}</div>
          <button type="button" onClick={p.onClose} style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", border: "none", borderRadius: "50%", width: 30, height: 30, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer" }}>âœ•</button>
        </div>

        {(isDesktop || tab === "bill") && (
          <div style={{ order: 99, display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center", flexShrink: 0, padding: "10px 16px", background: isDark ? "#0B111A" : "#F9FAFB", borderTop: `1px solid #E5E7EB` }}>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, color: "#DC2626", fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", minWidth: 80 }}>â‚¹{calc.total}</div>
            <button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => p.onAction("save")} style={footBtn("#DC2626", "#fff")}>
              {p.saving ? "â³..." : (isDraft && p.sendKot ? "ğŸ³ Send KOT" : "ğŸ’¾ Save")}
            </button>
            {!p.hidePrint && (
              <>
                <button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => p.onAction("print")} style={footBtn(COLORS.info, "#fff")}>ğŸ–¨ï¸ Print</button>
                <button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => p.onAction("paid")} style={footBtn(COLORS.sage, "#fff")}>âœ“ Paid + Print</button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {isDesktop ? (
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1.15fr 1fr", gridTemplateRows: "minmax(0, 1fr)", gap: 14, flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflow: "hidden" }}>
            <div style={{ minHeight: 0, height: "100%", overflow: "hidden" }}>{menuPane}</div>
            <div style={{ minHeight: 0, height: "100%", overflow: "hidden" }}>{billPane}</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6 }}>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab("menu")} style={{ ...chip(tab === "menu", COLORS.ink), flex: 1, padding: "8px 6px" }}>ğŸ½ï¸ Menu</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab("bill")} style={{ ...chip(tab === "bill", COLORS.ink), flex: 1, padding: "8px 6px" }}>ğŸ§¾ Bill ({itemCount}) Â· â‚¹{calc.total}</button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: tab === "bill" ? "auto" : "hidden" }}>
              {tab === "menu" ? menuPane : billPane}
            </div>
            {tab === "menu" && (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab("bill")} style={{ padding: "14px 16px", borderRadius: 8, border: "none", background: "#DC2626", color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", boxShadow: "0 4px 12px rgba(220,38,38,0.25)" }}>
                <span>{itemCount} item{itemCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}</span><span style={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace" }}>â‚¹{calc.total} â”</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StaffView({ menu = [], orders, advanceStatus, requestPinPrompt, calls, resolveCall, cancelOrderByStaff, placeOrder, categories = [], setMenuState }) {
  const active = orders.filter((o) => o.status !== "served" && o.status !== "cancelled").sort((a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt);
  const activeCalls = calls.filter(c => c.status === 'active');
  const columns = ["new", "preparing", "ready"];
  const newOrderCount = active.filter(o => o.status === "new").length;
  const prevCountRef = useRef(newOrderCount);
  const [selectedOrderId, setSelectedOrderId] = useState(null);
  const [viewMode] = useViewMode();
  const [colTab, setColTab] = useState("new");
  const [showHelpModal, setShowHelpModal] = useState(false);
  const [billOrder, setBillOrder] = useState(null);
  const [billEditItems, setBillEditItems] = useState([]);
  const [billGstRate, setBillGstRate] = useState(0);
  const [billGstCustom, setBillGstCustom] = useState("");
  const [billDiscount, setBillDiscount] = useState(0);
  const [billDiscountPct, setBillDiscountPct] = useState(0);
  const [billPayMode, setBillPayMode] = useState("cash");
  const [billPayStatus, setBillPayStatus] = useState("paid");
  const [billCustomerName, setBillCustomerName] = useState("");
  const [billCustomerPhone, setBillCustomerPhone] = useState("");
  const [billCustomerGstin, setBillCustomerGstin] = useState("");
  const [billNotes, setBillNotes] = useState("");
  const [billSearch, setBillSearch] = useState("");
  const [billAddItemOpen, setBillAddItemOpen] = useState(false);
  const [billShowBillNo, setBillShowBillNo] = useState(true);
  const [billTable, setBillTable] = useState(1);
  const [billOrderType, setBillOrderType] = useState("dine_in");
  const [billWaiter, setBillWaiter] = useState("");
  const [billSendKot, setBillSendKot] = useState(true);
  const [billSaving, setBillSaving] = useState(false);

  // ğŸ“µ Kitchen screen band na ho
  useEffect(() => {
    let lock = null;
    const getLock = async () => {
      try { if ("wakeLock" in navigator) lock = await navigator.wakeLock.request("screen"); } catch (e) {}
    };
    getLock();
    const onVis = () => { if (document.visibilityState === "visible") getLock(); };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
      try { lock && lock.release(); } catch (e) {}
    };
  }, []);


  useEffect(() => {
    if (newOrderCount > prevCountRef.current) {
      playNotificationSound();
      if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'granted') {
        safeNotify('ğŸ›ï¸ New Order!', { body: `${newOrderCount} new waiting` });
      }
    }
    prevCountRef.current = newOrderCount;
  }, [newOrderCount]);

  const prevCallsRef = useRef(activeCalls.length);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeCalls.length > prevCallsRef.current) {
      const bell = new Audio("https://assets.mixkit.co/active_storage/sfx/951/951-preview.mp3");
      bell.play().catch(() => { });
    }
    prevCallsRef.current = activeCalls.length;
  }, [activeCalls.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e) => {
      const tag = (e.target?.tagName || "").toUpperCase();
      if (tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA" || tag === "SELECT" || e.target?.isContentEditable) return;
      if (billOrder) return;
      if (e.key === 'k' && e.ctrlKey) { e.preventDefault(); if (active[0]) setSelectedOrderId(active[0].id); }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { const i = active.findIndex(o => o.id === selectedOrderId); if (i > 0) setSelectedOrderId(active[i - 1].id); }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { const i = active.findIndex(o => o.id === selectedOrderId); if (i < active.length - 1 && i >= 0) setSelectedOrderId(active[i + 1].id); }
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && selectedOrderId) { const o = active.find(x => x.id === selectedOrderId); if (o) { e.preventDefault(); advanceStatus(o.id, o.status); } }
      if ((e.key === '?' || e.key === '/') && e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); setShowHelpModal(v => !v); }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [selectedOrderId, active, advanceStatus, billOrder]);

  const handlePrintReceipt = (order) => {
    const w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=300,height=600');
    if (!w) return;
    const kots = order.kots?.length ? order.kots : [{ kotNumber: 1, items: order.items }];
    const itemsHtml = kots.map(kot => `<div style="margin-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed #000;padding-top:6px"><strong>KOT #${kot.kotNumber}${kot.isRunning ? ' (RUNNING)' : ''}</strong>${kot.items.map(it => `<div>${it.qty}x ${escapeHtml(it.name)}</div>`).join('')}</div>`).join('');
    const totalAmount = getOrderTotal(order);
    w.document.write(`<html><head><title>KOT</title><style>body{font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;padding:10px;width:260px}h2,h4{text-align:center;margin:4px 0}</style></head><body><h2>${escapeHtml(RESTAURANT.name)}</h2><h4>${order.orderType === 'parcel' ? 'PARCEL' : `TABLE ${escapeHtml(order.table)}`}</h4><p>Order: #${escapeHtml(order.id.toUpperCase())}<br/>Customer: ${escapeHtml(order.customer.name)}</p>${itemsHtml}<div style="text-align:right;font-weight:bold;margin-top:10px">Total: â‚¹${totalAmount}</div><script>window.print();setTimeout(()=>window.close(),500)</script></body></html>`);
    w.document.close();
  };
  const handlePrintReceiptOld = (order) => {
    const w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=300,height=600');
    if (!w) return;
    const kots = order.kots?.length ? order.kots : [{ kotNumber: 1, items: order.items }];
    const itemsHtml = kots.map(kot => `<div style="margin-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed #000;padding-top:6px"><strong>KOT #${kot.kotNumber}${kot.isRunning ? ' (RUNNING)' : ''}</strong>${kot.items.map(it => `<div>${it.qty}x ${it.name}</div>`).join('')}</div>`).join('');
    const totalAmount = order.items.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.price * it.qty), 0) + (order.deliveryFee || 0) - (order.loyaltyDiscount || 0);
    w.document.write(`<html><head><title>KOT</title><style>body{font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;padding:10px;width:260px}h2,h4{text-align:center;margin:4px 0}</style></head><body><h2>${RESTAURANT.name}</h2><h4>${order.orderType === 'parcel' ? 'PARCEL' : `TABLE ${order.table}`}</h4><p>Order: #${order.id.toUpperCase()}<br/>Customer: ${order.customer.name}</p>${itemsHtml}<div style="text-align:right;font-weight:bold;margin-top:10px">Total: â‚¹${totalAmount}</div><script>window.print();setTimeout(()=>window.close(),500)</script></body></html>`);
    w.document.close();
  };

  // ğŸ§¾ OPEN BILL EDITOR
  const openBillEditor = (order) => {
    setBillOrder(order);
    setBillEditItems(
      order.items.map((it, i) => ({
        ...it,
        _origQty: it.qty,
        _rowId: i + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
      }))
    );
    setBillGstRate(order.gstRate ?? 0);
    setBillGstCustom("");
    setBillDiscount(order.billEditedAt ? (order.billDiscount || 0) : (order.loyaltyDiscount || 0));
    setBillDiscountPct(order.billEditedAt ? (order.billDiscountPct || 0) : (order.discount || 0));
    setBillPayMode(order.payment || "cash");
    setBillPayStatus(order.paid ? "paid" : "pending");
    setBillCustomerName(isWalkIn(order.customer?.name) ? "" : (order.customer?.name || ""));
    setBillCustomerPhone(isWalkIn(order.customer?.phone) ? "" : (order.customer?.phone || ""));
    setBillCustomerGstin(order.customerGstin || "");
    setBillNotes(order.notes || "");
    setBillSearch("");
    setBillAddItemOpen(false);
    setBillShowBillNo(true);
    setBillTable(Number(order.table) || 1);
    setBillOrderType(order.orderType || "dine_in");
    setBillWaiter(order.waiter || "");
    setBillSendKot(!!order.isDraft);
  };

  // â• NEW ORDER â€” table/parcel, items, KOT aur bill sab yahin se
  const openNewOrder = (preTable) => {
    openBillEditor({
      id: uid("o"), isDraft: true,
      table: Number(preTable) || 1, orderType: "dine_in",
      customer: { name: "Walk-in", phone: "WALK-IN", address: "" },
      items: [], kots: [], waiter: "", takenBy: "staff",
      notes: "", payment: "cash", paymentStatus: "pending", paid: false,
      status: "new", createdAt: Date.now(),
      coinsClaimed: true, earnedCoins: 0, rewardUsedCoins: 0,
      deliveryFee: 0, loyaltyDiscount: 0, discount: 0
    });
  };

  // mode: "save" | "print" | "paid"
  const printKotSlip = (order, onDone) => {
  let fired = false;
  const next = () => { if (fired) return; fired = true; if (onDone) onDone(); };
    try {
      const kot = (order.kots && order.kots.length ? order.kots[order.kots.length - 1] : null) || { kotNumber: 1, items: order.items || [] };
      const rows = (kot.items || []).map((it) => `<div class="r"><span>${it.qty} x ${escapeHtml(it.name)}${it.portion ? " (" + escapeHtml(it.portion) + ")" : ""}</span></div>`).join("");
      const now = new Date().toLocaleString("en-IN", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
      const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
      iframe.style.cssText = "position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:0;border:0;";
      document.body.appendChild(iframe);
      const w = iframe.contentWindow;
      setTimeout(() => { try { document.body.removeChild(iframe); } catch (e) {} }, 60000);
      w.document.open();
      w.document.write(`<!doctype html><html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'"><title>KOT</title><style>@page{margin:0}*{color:#000!important}body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;width:280px;margin:0 auto;padding:8px;font-weight:700}h2,h3{text-align:center;margin:3px 0}.r{font-size:17px;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #000}.c{text-align:center;font-size:12px}</style></head><body><h2>KOT #${kot.kotNumber || 1}${kot.isRunning ? " (RUNNING)" : ""}</h2><h3>${order.orderType === "parcel" ? "PARCEL" : "TABLE " + escapeHtml(String(order.table))}</h3><div class="c">${escapeHtml(now)} Â· #${escapeHtml(order.id.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase())}${order.waiter ? " Â· " + escapeHtml(order.waiter) : ""}</div><div style="margin-top:8px">${rows}</div>${order.notes ? `<div class="c" style="margin-top:8px">Note: ${escapeHtml(order.notes)}</div>` : ""}</body></html>`);
      w.document.close();
      w.onafterprint = () => setTimeout(next, 400);
setTimeout(next, 20000);
setTimeout(() => { try { w.focus(); w.print(); } catch (e) { alert("âš ï¸ KOT print nahi ho paya: " + e.message); next(); } }, 400);
    } catch (e) { console.error("KOT print error:", e); next(); }
  };

  const handleBillAction = async (mode) => {
    if (billSaving || !billOrder) return;
    if (billEditItems.length === 0) { alert("âš ï¸ Pehle items add karo"); return; }
    setBillSaving(true);
    try {
      const wasDraft = !!billOrder.isDraft;
      const sendKot = billSendKot;
      const saved = await saveBillEdits(mode === "paid" ? { payStatus: "paid" } : {});
      if (!saved) return;
      const itemsSnapshot = billEditItems;
      if (mode === "paid" && saved.status === "ready") await advanceStatus(saved.id, "ready");
      setBillOrder(null);
      addDoc(collection(db, "auditLogs"), { orderId: saved.id, action: mode, by: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || "?", before: getOrderTotal(billOrder), after: saved.finalTotal, at: Date.now() }).catch(() => {});
      const doBill = () => { if (mode !== "save") printFinalBill(saved, itemsSnapshot); };
      if ((wasDraft && sendKot) || saved._ranKot) setTimeout(() => printKotSlip(saved, doBill), 200);
      else setTimeout(doBill, 200);
    } finally {
      setBillSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleBillActionOld = async (mode) => {
    if (billSaving || !billOrder) return;
    if (billEditItems.length === 0) { alert("âš ï¸ Pehle items add karo"); return; }
    setBillSaving(true);
    try {
      const saved = await saveBillEdits(mode === "paid" ? { payStatus: "paid" } : {});
      if (!saved) return;
      const itemsSnapshot = billEditItems;
      if (mode === "paid" && saved.status === "ready") await advanceStatus(saved.id, "ready");
      setBillOrder(null);
      if (mode !== "save") setTimeout(() => printFinalBill(saved, itemsSnapshot), 200);
    } finally {
      setBillSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // ğŸ§® BILL CALC
  const billCalc = useMemo(() => {
    if (!billOrder) return { sub: 0, gst: 0, discAmt: 0, discPctAmt: 0, total: 0, gstRate: 0 };
    const sub = Math.round(billEditItems.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.price || 0) * (it.qty || 0), 0));
    const gstRate = billGstRate === "custom" ? Number(billGstCustom) || 0 : Number(billGstRate) || 0;
    const discPctAmt = Math.round((sub * billDiscountPct) / 100);
    const afterPct = sub - discPctAmt;
    const gst = Math.round((afterPct * gstRate) / 100);
    const delivery = Number(billOrder.deliveryFee) || 0;
    const total = Math.max(0, afterPct - billDiscount) + gst + delivery;
    return { sub, gstRate, gst, discPctAmt, discAmt: billDiscount, total, delivery };
  }, [billOrder, billEditItems, billGstRate, billGstCustom, billDiscount, billDiscountPct]);

  // ğŸ’¾ SAVE BILL EDITS TO FIRESTORE
  const saveBillEdits = async (override = {}) => {
    if (!billOrder) return null;
    try {
      const { sub, gstRate, gst, discPctAmt, discAmt, total } = billCalc;
      const updated = {
        items: billEditItems.map(({ _rowId, _new, _origQty, ...rest }) => (!billOrder.isDraft && _new ? { ...rest, kotNumber: getNextKotNo(billOrder) } : rest)),
        subtotal: sub,
        gstRate,
        gstAmount: gst,
        billDiscount: discAmt,
        billDiscountPct: billDiscountPct,
        billDiscountAmt: discPctAmt,
        finalTotal: total,
        payment: billPayMode,
        paid: (override.payStatus ?? billPayStatus) === "paid",
        paymentStatus: override.payStatus ?? billPayStatus,
        customer: {
          ...(billOrder.customer || {}),
          name: billCustomerName || "Walk-in",
          phone: billCustomerPhone || "WALK-IN",
        },
        customerGstin: billCustomerGstin || "",
        notes: billNotes,
        billEditedAt: Date.now(),
        billEditedBy: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || "staff",
      };
      const clean = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(updated)); // undefined values hata deta hai (Firestore error fix)
      if (billOrder.isDraft) {
        const { isDraft, ...base } = billOrder;
        const kotItems = clean.items.map((it) => ({ ...it, kotNumber: 1 }));
        const fullOrder = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({
          ...base, ...clean,
          table: billOrderType === "parcel" ? 0 : billTable,
          orderType: billOrderType,
          waiter: billWaiter || "Staff",
          items: kotItems,
          kots: billSendKot ? [{ id: uid("kot"), kotNumber: 1, items: kotItems, createdAt: Date.now(), status: "new", isRunning: false }] : [],
          status: billSendKot ? "new" : "served",
          ...(billSendKot ? {} : { servedAt: Date.now() })
        }));
        await placeOrder(fullOrder);
        return fullOrder;
      }
      const addedRows = billEditItems.map((it) => {

          id: uid("kot"), kotNumber: no,
          items: addedRows.map(({ _rowId, _new, _origQty, ...r }) => ({ ...r, kotNumber: no })),
          createdAt: Date.now(), status: "new", isRunning: true
        };
        clean.kots = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify([...getBaseKots(billOrder), runKot]));
        clean.status = "new";
        clean.lastKotAt = Date.now();
        await guardedOrderUpdate(billOrder, clean);
        return { ...billOrder, ...clean, _ranKot: true };
      }
      await guardedOrderUpdate(billOrder, clean);
      return { ...billOrder, ...updated };

      console.error("saveBillEdits error:", e);

                <div style={{ background: '#fff', borderRadius: 10, padding: 10, marginBottom: 12, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.info}` }}>
                  <input autoFocus placeholder="ğŸ” Search menu to add..." value={billSearch} onChange={(e) => setBillSearch(e.target.value)}
                    style={{ padding: 10, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 14, width: '100%', boxSizing: 'border-box', marginBottom: 8 }} />
                  <div style={{ maxHeight: 200, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                    {(billSearch.trim()
                      ? menu.filter((m) => m.available && m.name.toLowerCase().includes(billSearch.toLowerCase()))
                      : menu.filter((m) => m.available).slice(0, 8)
                    ).slice(0, 15).map((m) => (
                      <div key={m.id} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px 4px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>

                        <button onClick={() => {
                          const existing = billEditItems.findIndex((it) => it.itemId === m.id && !it.portion);
                          if (existing >= 0) {
                            const updated = [...billEditItems];
                            updated[existing] = { ...updated[existing], qty: updated[existing].qty + 1 };
                            setBillEditItems(updated);
                          } else {
                            setBillEditItems([...billEditItems, {
                              itemId: m.id, name: m.name, portion: m.portion || '',

                          }
                        }} style={{ background: COLORS.sage, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }}>+ Add</button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                {billEditItems.length === 0 && (

                )}
                {billEditItems.map((it, idx) => (
                  <div key={it._rowId || idx} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '10px 4px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>

                    <button onClick={() => {
                      if (window.confirm(`Remove "${it.name}"?`)) {
                        setBillEditItems(billEditItems.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
                      }
                    }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.error}`, color: COLORS.error, width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 14, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 800 }}>âœ•</button>

function KitchenMetrics({ filteredOrders }) {
  const servedOrders = filteredOrders.filter(o => o.status === "served");
  if (servedOrders.length === 0) return null;
  const hourCounts = {};
  filteredOrders.forEach(o => { const hr = new Date(o.createdAt).getHours(); hourCounts[hr] = (hourCounts[hr] || 0) + 1; });
  const peakHourEntry = Object.entries(hourCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
  const peakHourLabel = peakHourEntry ? `${peakHourEntry[0]}:00` : "â€”";
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))", gap: 16, marginBottom: 28 }}>
      <StatCard label="Completed" value={servedOrders.length} icon="âœ…" color={COLORS.sage} />
      <StatCard label="Peak Hour" value={peakHourLabel} icon="ğŸ”¥" color={COLORS.copper} />
      <StatCard label="Total" value={filteredOrders.length} icon="ğŸ“‹" color={COLORS.gold} />
    </div>
  );
}

function InventoryAlertBanner({ inventory }) {
  const critical = inventory.filter(i => i.stock < 2);
  const warning = inventory.filter(i => i.stock >= 2 && i.stock < 5);
  if (critical.length === 0 && warning.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
      {critical.length > 0 && (<div style={{ background: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)', border: `2px solid ${COLORS.error}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}><h4 style={{ color: COLORS.error, margin: '0 0 10px' }}>ğŸš¨ CRITICAL</h4>{critical.map(item => (<div key={item.id} style={{ color: COLORS.error, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14 }}>âŒ {item.name}: {item.stock} {item.unit}</div>))}</div>)}
      {warning.length > 0 && (<div style={{ background: 'rgba(255, 152, 0, 0.1)', border: `2px solid ${COLORS.warning}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12 }}><h4 style={{ color: COLORS.warning, margin: '0 0 10px' }}>âš ï¸ LOW STOCK</h4>{warning.map(item => (<div key={item.id} style={{ color: COLORS.warning, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 14 }}>âš ï¸ {item.name}: {item.stock} {item.unit}</div>))}</div>)}
    </div>
  );
}

function PresetListEditor({ title, hint, items, onChange, placeholder, number, suffix }) {
  const [val, setVal] = useState("");
  const add = () => {
    const raw = val.trim();
    if (!raw) return;
    const v = number ? Number(raw) : raw;
    if (number && (!Number.isFinite(v) || v < 0)) { alert("âš ï¸ Sahi number daalo"); return; }
    if (items.some((x) => String(x).toLowerCase() === String(v).toLowerCase())) { setVal(""); return; }
    onChange([...items, v]);
    setVal("");
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 14, padding: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
      <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16 }}>{title}</div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.textLight, marginBottom: 10 }}>{hint}</div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 10 }}>
        {items.length === 0 && <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.textLight }}>Abhi koi nahi</span>}
        {items.map((it) => (
          <span key={String(it)} style={{ display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, background: COLORS.paper2, borderRadius: 20, padding: "5px 6px 5px 12px", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13 }}>
            {it}{suffix || ""}
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { if (window.confirm(`"${it}" delete karna hai?`)) onChange(items.filter((x) => x !== it)); }}
              style={{ background: COLORS.error, color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: "50%", width: 22, height: 22, fontSize: 11, cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 800, padding: 0 }}>âœ•</button>
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
        <input type={number ? "number" : "text"} placeholder={placeholder} value={val} onChange={(e) => setVal(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") add(); }}
          style={{ padding: "10px 12px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 14, flex: 1, boxSizing: "border-box" }} />
        <button type="button" onClick={add} style={{ background: COLORS.copper, color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 18px", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>+ Add</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function PresetsAdmin() {

  const [cName, setCName] = useState("");
  const [cPhone, setCPhone] = useState("");

    if (!cName.trim()) { alert("âš ï¸ Customer ka naam daalo"); return; }
