    setCName(""); setCPhone("");
  };
  const fld = { padding: "10px 12px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 14, boxSizing: "border-box" };
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: COLORS.textLight, marginBottom: 16, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
        Yahan ek baar daalo, hamesha save rahega. Staff ke bill screen me sirf select karna padega.
      </div>
      <PresetListEditor title="ğŸ§‘â€ğŸ³ Waiters" hint="Bill screen me chips ki tarah dikhenge" placeholder="Waiter ka naam"
        items={presets.waiters || []} onChange={(l) => savePresets({ ...presets, waiters: l })} />
      <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 14, padding: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16 }}>ğŸ‘¤ Saved Customers</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.textLight, marginBottom: 10 }}>Select karte hi naam + phone bhar jayega</div>
        {customers.length === 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.textLight, marginBottom: 10 }}>Abhi koi nahi</div>}
        {customers.map((c, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", background: COLORS.paper2, borderRadius: 10, padding: "8px 12px", marginBottom: 6, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13 }}>
            <span>{c.name}{c.phone ? ` Â· ${c.phone}` : ""}</span>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { if (window.confirm(`"${c.name}" delete karna hai?`)) savePresets({ ...presets, customers: customers.filter((_, k) => k !== i) }); }}
              style={{ background: COLORS.error, color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: "50%", width: 24, height: 24, fontSize: 11, cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 800, padding: 0 }}>âœ•</button>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: 8 }}>
          <input placeholder="Naam" value={cName} onChange={(e) => setCName(e.target.value)} style={{ ...fld, flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }} />
          <input placeholder="Phone" value={cPhone} onChange={(e) => setCPhone(e.target.value)} style={{ ...fld, flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }} />
          <button type="button" onClick={addCustomer} style={{ background: COLORS.copper, color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 18px", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>+ Add</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <PresetListEditor title="ğŸ“ Quick Notes" hint="Jaise: Kam teekha, Bina pyaaz â€” bill me tap karke notes me judega" placeholder="Note likho"
        items={presets.notes || []} onChange={(l) => savePresets({ ...presets, notes: l })} />
      <PresetListEditor title="ğŸ Discount %" hint="Bill me ek tap se discount lagega" placeholder="Jaise 10" number suffix="%"
        items={presets.discounts || []} onChange={(l) => savePresets({ ...presets, discounts: l })} />
      <PresetListEditor title="ğŸ§¾ GST %" hint="Khali chhodoge to 5 / 12 / 18 chalega" placeholder="Jaise 5" number suffix="%"
        items={presets.gstRates || []} onChange={(l) => savePresets({ ...presets, gstRates: l })} />
    </div>
  );
}

function DussehraRateEditor({ items, onSave, unavail = [], toggleAvail }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(items);
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [add, setAdd] = useState({ name: "", price: "", category: DUSSEHRA_CATEGORIES[0], portion: "" });
  useEffect(() => { if (!dirty) setDraft(items); }, [items, dirty]);

  const fld = { padding: "8px 10px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 14, boxSizing: "border-box", fontFamily: "inherit" };
  const edit = (id, patch) => { setDraft((d) => d.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x))); setDirty(true); };
  const remove = (id) => { if (!window.confirm("Ye item hatana hai?")) return; setDraft((d) => d.filter((x) => x.id !== id)); setDirty(true); };
  const addItem = () => {
    const price = Number(add.price);
    if (!add.name.trim() || !Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) { alert("âš ï¸ Naam aur sahi rate daalo"); return; }
    setDraft((d) => [...d, mi(uid("dz"), add.name.trim(), price, add.category, true, "", add.portion.trim(), false, true, "")]);
    setAdd({ ...add, name: "", price: "", portion: "" });
    setDirty(true);
  };
  const save = async () => {
    if (draft.some((x) => !String(x.name || "").trim() || !Number.isFinite(Number(x.price)) || Number(x.price) <= 0)) { alert("âš ï¸ Har item ka naam aur sahi rate hona chahiye"); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    await onSave(draft.map((x) => ({ ...x, price: Number(x.price) })));
    setSaving(false); setDirty(false);
  };
  const reset = () => { if (window.confirm("Saare Dussehra rates PDF wale original par wapas karne hain?")) { setDraft(DUSSEHRA_MENU); setDirty(true); } };

  if (!open) {
    return (
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 14, marginBottom: 20, background: "#E65100", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 14, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 15, cursor: "pointer" }}>
        âœï¸ Dussehra Rates Edit karo
      </button>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1.5px solid #E65100", borderRadius: 14, padding: 16, marginBottom: 20 }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, color: "#E65100" }}>âœï¸ Dussehra Menu Rates</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
          <button onClick={reset} style={{ ...fld, background: "transparent", color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>â†©ï¸ PDF wale par reset</button>
          <button onClick={() => setOpen(false)} style={{ ...fld, background: COLORS.paper2, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>âœ• Band</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {DUSSEHRA_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
        const rows = draft.filter((x) => x.category === cat);
        if (rows.length === 0) return null;
        return (
          <div key={cat} style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, color: COLORS.textLight, marginBottom: 6 }}>{cat}</div>
            {rows.map((x) => (
              <div key={x.id} style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 6, opacity: unavail.includes(x.id) ? 0.55 : 1 }}>
                <input value={x.name} onChange={(e) => edit(x.id, { name: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }} />
                {x.portion ? <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 700, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{x.portion}</span> : null}
                <input type="number" inputMode="decimal" value={x.price} onChange={(e) => edit(x.id, { price: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, width: 80, fontWeight: 800, textAlign: "center" }} />
                <button onClick={() => toggleAvail && toggleAvail(x.id)} title="Hai / Khatam" style={{ ...fld, padding: "8px 8px", cursor: "pointer", background: unavail.includes(x.id) ? COLORS.error : COLORS.sageLight, color: unavail.includes(x.id) ? "#fff" : COLORS.sageDark, fontWeight: 800, border: "none" }}>{unavail.includes(x.id) ? "âŒ" : "âœ…"}</button>
                <button onClick={() => remove(x.id)} style={{ ...fld, padding: "8px 8px", cursor: "pointer", background: "transparent", color: COLORS.error, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.error}`, fontWeight: 800 }}>âœ•</button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      <div style={{ background: COLORS.paper, borderRadius: 10, padding: 10, marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800, color: COLORS.textLight, marginBottom: 6 }}>â• Naya item</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <input placeholder="Naam" value={add.name} onChange={(e) => setAdd({ ...add, name: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }} />
          <input type="number" placeholder="Rate" value={add.price} onChange={(e) => setAdd({ ...add, price: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, width: 80 }} />
          <input placeholder="Half / Full" value={add.portion} onChange={(e) => setAdd({ ...add, portion: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, width: 90 }} />
          <select value={add.category} onChange={(e) => setAdd({ ...add, category: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, background: "#fff" }}>
            {DUSSEHRA_CATEGORIES.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
          </select>
          <button onClick={addItem} style={{ ...fld, background: COLORS.sage, color: "#fff", border: "none", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>+ Add</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button onClick={save} disabled={!dirty || saving} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 14, border: "none", borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 15, cursor: dirty && !saving ? "pointer" : "not-allowed", background: dirty && !saving ? "#E65100" : COLORS.paper2, color: dirty && !saving ? "#fff" : COLORS.textLight }}>
        {saving ? "â³ Saving..." : dirty ? "ğŸ’¾ Save Dussehra Menu" : "Koi badlav nahi"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function AdminView({ dussehraMenu = [], saveDussehraMenu, menu, unavail = [], toggleAvail, setMenuState, bookings, orders, markPaid, requestPinPrompt, inventory, addInventory, updateStock, deleteBooking, offersList, addOffer, removeOffer, loyaltyRules, setLoyaltyRules, loyaltyUsers, settings, setSettings, gallery, setGallery, categories, updateCategories, flashSaleItems, setFlashSaleItems, comboOffers, setComboOffers, savePromotions }) {

  const [newOffer, setNewOffer] = useState({ title: "", desc: "" });

    catch (e) { console.error(e); alert("âš ï¸ Save nahi hua. Internet check karo."); }
  };

  });

  useEffect(() => {

    let off = false;
    const s = new Date(filterDate + "T00:00:00").getTime();
    getDocs(query(collection(db, "orders"), where("createdAt", ">=", s), where("createdAt", "<", s + 86400000)))
      .then((snap) => { if (!off) setHistOrders(snap.docs.map(normOrder)); })

    histOrders.forEach(o => m.set(o.id, o));
    orders.forEach(o => m.set(o.id, o));
    return Array.from(m.values()).filter(o => toLocalISODate(o.createdAt) === filterDate);

      if (!(key in cache)) {

        calls++;
        setAutoImgMsg("â³ " + (i + 1) + "/" + targets.length + " â€” " + m.name);
        try { const r = await fetch("/api/image?q=" + encodeURIComponent(key)); const d = await r.json(); cache[key] = d.url || ""; } catch (e) { cache[key] = ""; }
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
      }
      if (cache[key]) found[m.id] = cache[key];

'not-allowed' : 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{isGeneratingPDF ? 'â³' : 'ğŸ“„ PDF'}</button>

            {/* Waiter PIN */}
            <div style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 16, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>ğŸ§‘â€ğŸ³</span>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 15 }}>Waiter PIN</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight }}>Unlocks Waiter Mode on customer screen</div>

          <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", background: "#fff", borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <thead><tr style={{ background: COLORS.paper }}><th style={th}>Name</th><th style={th}>Phone</th><th style={th}>Coins</th><th style={th}>Tier</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{[...loyaltyUsers].sort((a, b) => b.coins - a.coins).map((u, i) => (<tr key={i}><td style={td}>{u.name}</td><td style={td}>{u.phone}</td><td style={{ ...td, fontWeight: 800, color: COLORS.sageDark }}>{u.coins}</td><td style={td}>{getLoyaltyTier(u.coins).name}</td></tr>))}</tbody>
          </table>
        </>
      )}

      {tab === "offers" && (
        <>
          <div style={{ background: COLORS.paper, padding: 24, borderRadius: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 20, marginBottom: 16, fontWeight: 700 }}>Create Offer</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12 }}>
              <input type="text" placeholder="Title" value={newOffer.title} onChange={e => setNewOffer({ ...newOffer, title: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 1 }} />
              <input type="text" placeholder="Description" value={newOffer.desc} onChange={e => setNewOffer({ ...newOffer, desc: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2 }} />
              <button onClick={handleAddOffer} style={primaryBtn}>+ Add</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          {offersList.map((off) => (
            <div key={off.id} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, padding: 20, borderRadius: 14, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div><div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 18 }}>{off.title}</div><div style={{ color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 600 }}>{off.desc}</div></div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                <button onClick={() => { const nt = prompt("Title:", off.title); if (nt !== null) { const nd = prompt("Desc:", off.desc); if (nd !== null) { addOffer({ ...off, title: nt.trim(), desc: nd.trim() }); } } }} style={{ background: COLORS.copperLight, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.copper}`, color: COLORS.copperDark, padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 10, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>âœï¸</button>
                <button onClick={() => removeOffer(off.id)} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 10, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 800 }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </>
      )}

      

      {tab === "orders" && (
        <div style={{ overflowX: "auto", borderRadius: 16, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
          <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", fontSize: 14, background: "#fff" }}>
            <thead><tr style={{ textAlign: "left", background: COLORS.paper }}><th style={th}>Time</th><th style={th}>Table</th><th style={th}>Items</th><th style={th}>Total</th><th style={th}>Payment</th><th style={th}>Action</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {[...filteredOrders].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt).map((o) => (
                <tr key={o.id} style={{ opacity: o.status === "cancelled" ? 0.5 : 1 }}>
                  <td style={{ ...td, color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 600 }}>{new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</td>
                  <td style={td}>{o.orderType === "parcel" ? <Badge color={COLORS.copper}>Parcel</Badge> : <strong>T-{o.table}</strong>}{o.status === "cancelled" && <span style={{ color: COLORS.error, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, display: 'block' }}>âŒ Cancelled</span>}</td>
                  <td style={td}>{o.items.map((it) => `${it.qty}Ã—${it.name}`).join(", ")}</td>
                  <td style={{ ...td, fontWeight: 700 }}>{inr(getOrderTotal(o))}</td>
                  <td style={td}>{o.payment || "cash"}<span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: o.paid ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.textLight, display: 'block' }}>{o.paid ? "âœ…" : "â³"}</span></td>
                  <td style={td}><button onClick={() => markPaid(o.id, o.paid && !o.coinsClaimed ? true : !o.paid)} style={{ border: `1.5px solid ${o.paid ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.line}`, background: o.paid ? COLORS.sage : "transparent", color: o.paid ? "#fff" : COLORS.ink, borderRadius: 10, padding: "6px 14px", fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 700 }}>{o.paid ? (o.coinsClaimed ? "âœ“ Paid" : "ğŸª™ Award coins") : "Mark paid"}</button></td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

            {tab === "bookings" && (
        <div style={{ overflowX: "auto", borderRadius: 16, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
          <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", fontSize: 14, background: "#fff" }}>
            <thead><tr style={{ background: COLORS.paper }}><th style={th}>Type</th><th style={th}>Details</th><th style={th}>Date</th><th style={th}>Action</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {bookings.map(b => (
                <tr key={b.id}>
                  <td style={td}>{b.type === "party" ? "ğŸ‰ Party" : "ğŸ½ï¸ Table"}</td>
                  <td style={td}><strong>{b.name}</strong><br />{b.phone}<br />{b.guests} Guests</td>
                  <td style={td}>{b.date} at {b.time}</td>
                  <td style={td}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      <a 
                        href={`https://wa.me/91${b.phone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(
                          `Hello ${b.name}! ğŸ½ï¸\n\nAapki ${b.type === "party" ? "Party" : "Table"} booking confirm ho gayi hai.\n\nğŸ“… Date: ${b.date}\nâ° Time: ${b.time}\nğŸ‘¥ Guests: ${b.guests}\n\nEat & Park mein aapka swagat hai! ğŸ‰`
                        )}`}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        style={{ 
                          background: '#25D366', color: '#fff', 
                          padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, 
                          textDecoration: 'none', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12,
                          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4
                        }}
                      >
                        âœ… Confirm
                      </a>
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => deleteBooking(b.id)} 
                        style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}
                      >
                        Delete
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === "promotions" && (
        <>
          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>âš¡ Flash Sale</h3>
          {flashSaleItems.map((item, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <select value={item.id}
                  onChange={e => { const m = menu.find(x => x.id === e.target.value); if (m) setFlashSaleItems(patchAt(flashSaleItems, idx, { id: m.id, name: m.name, price: m.price })); }}
                  style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2, minWidth: 200 }}>
                  {!menu.some(m => m.id === item.id) && <option value={item.id}>âš ï¸ {item.name} (menu mein nahi)</option>}
                  {menu.map(m => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.name}{m.portion ? ` (${m.portion})` : ""} â€” â‚¹{m.price}</option>)}
                </select>
                <input type="number" placeholder="Sale â‚¹" value={item.discountPrice} onChange={e => setFlashSaleItems(patchAt(flashSaleItems, idx, { discountPrice: Number(e.target.value) }))} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 100 }} />
                <input type="number" placeholder="Stock" value={item.stock} onChange={e => setFlashSaleItems(patchAt(flashSaleItems, idx, { stock: Number(e.target.value) }))} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 90 }} />
                <button onClick={() => setFlashSaleItems(patchAt(flashSaleItems, idx, { active: !item.active }))} style={{ background: item.active ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.error, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{item.active ? 'âœ… Active' : 'âŒ Inactive'}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Delete?')) setFlashSaleItems(flashSaleItems.filter((_, i) => i !== idx)); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button onClick={() => {
            const m = menu[0]; if (!m) return;
            setFlashSaleItems([...flashSaleItems, { id: m.id, name: m.name, price: m.price, discountPrice: Math.round(m.price * 0.8), stock: 10, active: true }]);
          }} style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: COLORS.sage, marginBottom: 30 }}>+ Add Flash Item</button>

          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>ğŸ¯ Combo Offers</h3>
          {comboOffers.map((combo, idx) => {
            const broken = !combo.items?.every(it => menu.some(m => m.id === it.id));
            return (
              <div key={idx} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${broken ? COLORS.error : COLORS.line}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
                {broken && <div style={{ color: COLORS.error, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 8 }}>âš ï¸ Is combo ke kuch items menu mein nahi hain â€” customers ko dikhega nahi. Delete karke naya banao.</div>}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <input value={combo.name} onChange={e => setComboOffers(patchAt(comboOffers, idx, { name: e.target.value }))} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2 }} />
                  <input type="number" value={combo.discount} onChange={e => { const d = Number(e.target.value); setComboOffers(patchAt(comboOffers, idx, { discount: d, finalPrice: Math.round(combo.totalPrice * (1 - d / 100)) })); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 100 }} />
                  <input value={combo.image} onChange={e => setComboOffers(patchAt(comboOffers, idx, { image: e.target.value }))} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 80 }} />
                  <button onClick={() => setComboOffers(patchAt(comboOffers, idx, { active: !combo.active }))} style={{ background: combo.active ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.error, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{combo.active ? 'âœ…' : 'âŒ'}</button>
                  <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Delete?')) setComboOffers(comboOffers.filter((_, i) => i !== idx)); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Delete</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
          <button onClick={() => {
            const picks = menu.slice(0, 2); if (picks.length === 0) return;
            const total = picks.reduce((s, m) => s + m.price, 0);
            setComboOffers([...comboOffers, {
              id: 'combo' + Date.now(), name: 'New Combo',
              items: picks.map(m => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name, price: m.price, quantity: 1 })),
              totalPrice: total, discount: 10, finalPrice: Math.round(total * 0.9), image: 'ğŸ½ï¸', active: true
            }]);
          }} style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: COLORS.gold, marginBottom: 20 }}>+ Add Combo</button>
          <button onClick={savePromotions} style={{ ...primaryBtn, width: '100%' }}>ğŸ’¾ Save All</button>
        </>
      )}
      {false /* legacy promotions UI removed */ && (
        <>
          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>âš¡ Flash Sale</h3>
          {flashSaleItems.map((item, idx) => (
            <div key={item.id} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <input value={item.name} onChange={e => { const u = [...flashSaleItems]; u[idx].name = e.target.value; setFlashSaleItems(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2 }} />
                <input type="number" value={item.discountPrice} onChange={e => { const u = [...flashSaleItems]; u[idx].discountPrice = Number(e.target.value); setFlashSaleItems(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 100 }} />
                <input type="number" value={item.stock} onChange={e => { const u = [...flashSaleItems]; u[idx].stock = Number(e.target.value); setFlashSaleItems(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 80 }} />
                <button onClick={() => { const u = [...flashSaleItems]; u[idx].active = !u[idx].active; setFlashSaleItems(u); }} style={{ background: item.active ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.error, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{item.active ? 'âœ… Active' : 'âŒ Inactive'}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Delete?')) setFlashSaleItems(flashSaleItems.filter((_, i) => i !== idx)); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button onClick={() => setFlashSaleItems([...flashSaleItems, { id: 'flash' + Date.now(), name: 'New', price: 0, discountPrice: 0, stock: 0, active: true }])} style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: COLORS.sage, marginBottom: 30 }}>+ Add Flash Item</button>

          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>ğŸ¯ Combo Offers</h3>
          {comboOffers.map((combo, idx) => (
            <div key={combo.id} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <input value={combo.name} onChange={e => { const u = [...comboOffers]; u[idx].name = e.target.value; setComboOffers(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2 }} />
                <input type="number" value={combo.discount} onChange={e => { const u = [...comboOffers]; u[idx].discount = Number(e.target.value); u[idx].finalPrice = Math.round(u[idx].totalPrice * (1 - u[idx].discount / 100)); setComboOffers(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 100 }} />
                <input value={combo.image} onChange={e => { const u = [...comboOffers]; u[idx].image = e.target.value; setComboOffers(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 80 }} />
                <button onClick={() => { const u = [...comboOffers]; u[idx].active = !u[idx].active; setComboOffers(u); }} style={{ background: combo.active ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.error, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{combo.active ? 'âœ…' : 'âŒ'}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Delete?')) setComboOffers(comboOffers.filter((_, i) => i !== idx)); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button onClick={() => setComboOffers([...comboOffers, { id: 'combo' + Date.now(), name: 'New Combo', items: [{ id: 'f2', name: 'Pizza', price: 280, quantity: 1 }], totalPrice: 280, discount: 10, finalPrice: 252, image: 'ğŸ½ï¸', active: true }])} style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: COLORS.gold, marginBottom: 20 }}>+ Add Combo</button>
          <button onClick={savePromotions} style={{ ...primaryBtn, width: '100%' }}>ğŸ’¾ Save All</button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const ProgressRing = memo(({ progress, size = 60, strokeWidth = 3 }) => {
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * ((size - strokeWidth) / 2);
  const offset = circumference - (progress / 100) * circumference;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size}>
      <g transform={`rotate(-90 ${size / 2} ${size / 2})`}>
        <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={(size - strokeWidth) / 2}
          fill="none" stroke={COLORS.line} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
        <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={(size - strokeWidth) / 2}
          fill="none" stroke={COLORS.sage} strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
          strokeDasharray={circumference} strokeDashoffset={offset}
          style={{ transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 0.5s ease' }} />
      </g>
      <text x="50%" y="50%" textAnchor="middle" dy="0.35em"
        fontSize="16" fontWeight="700" fill={COLORS.sage}>
        {progress}%
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
});

const OrderTimer = memo(({ createdAt, estimatedTime }) => {
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => { const t = setInterval(() => setElapsed(Math.floor((Date.now() - createdAt) / 1000)), 1000); return () => clearInterval(t); }, [createdAt]);
  const minutes = Math.floor(elapsed / 60); const seconds = elapsed % 60; const isOvertime = elapsed > (estimatedTime * 60);
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, padding: '8px 12px', background: isOvertime ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)' : COLORS.sageLight, borderRadius: 10, borderLeft: `3px solid ${isOvertime ? COLORS.error : COLORS.sage}` }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, color: isOvertime ? COLORS.error : COLORS.sageDark }}>â±ï¸ {minutes}:{seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 600 }}>/ {estimatedTime}m</span>
    </div>
  );
});

async function setOrderOnce(order) {
  const ref = doc(db, "orders", order.id);
  try { const ex = await getDoc(ref); if (ex.exists()) return; } catch (e) {}
  await setDoc(ref, order);
}

function authMsg(e) {
  const c = (e && e.code) || "";
  const m = {
    "auth/operation-not-allowed": "Login system band hai (Firebase > Authentication > Anonymous ON karo)",
    "auth/admin-restricted-operation": "Login system band hai (Firebase > Authentication > Anonymous ON karo)",
    "auth/network-request-failed": "Internet/network dikkat. Dobara try karo",
    "auth/web-storage-unsupported": "Is browser me storage band hai. Chrome/Safari me link kholo",
    "auth/unauthorized-domain": "Ye website Firebase Authorized domains me nahi hai",
    "auth/too-many-requests": "Bahut try ho gaye, thodi der baad try karo",
    "permission-denied": "Order allow nahi hua (Firestore rules) - staff ko batao"
  };
  return "Order fail: " + (m[c] || c || (e && e.message) || "unknown");
}
let _anonInFlight = null;
async function ensureUser() {
  try { await Promise.race([authReady, new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 8000))]); } catch (e) {}
  if (auth.currentUser) return auth.currentUser;
  if (!_anonInFlight) {
    _anonInFlight = (async () => {
      let lastErr;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        try { return (await signInAnonymously(auth)).user; }
        catch (e) { lastErr = e; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600 * (i + 1))); }
      }
      throw lastErr;
    })().finally(() => { _anonInFlight = null; });
  }
  return _anonInFlight;
}

    setAuthUser(u);
    if (u) hadUserRef.current = true;
    else if (hadUserRef.current) signInAnonymously(auth).catch((e) => console.error("anon re-login:", e));
    if (u && !u.isAnonymous) {
      try {
        const s = await getDoc(doc(db, "staff", u.uid));
        const _r = s.exists() ? (s.data().role || "staff") : null;
        setStaffRole(_r);
        try {
          const saved = sessionStorage.getItem("eatpark_role");
          if (_r && (saved === "staff" || (saved === "admin" && _r === "admin"))) setRole(saved);

      } catch (e) { setStaffRole(null); }
    } else setStaffRole(null);
  }), []);

  const advanceStatus = async (orderId, currentStatus) => {
    const idx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(currentStatus);
    const nextStatus = STATUS_FLOW[Math.min(idx + 1, STATUS_FLOW.length - 1)];
    if (nextStatus === currentStatus) return;
    const order = orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
    const updateData = { status: nextStatus, ...(nextStatus === "served" ? { servedAt: Date.now() } : {}) };
    if (order?.kots?.length) {
      updateData.kots = order.kots.map(k => (k.status === currentStatus ? { ...k, status: nextStatus } : k));
    }
    setOrdersState(prev => prev.map(o => (o.id === orderId ? { ...o, ...updateData } : o)));
    try {
      await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
        const ref = doc(db, "orders", orderId);
        const snap = await tx.get(ref);
        if (!snap.exists()) return;
        const cur = snap.data();
        if (cur.status === "cancelled") return;
        if (cur.status !== currentStatus) throw new Error("STALE_STATUS"); // another screen already moved it
        const patch = { status: nextStatus, ...(nextStatus === "served" ? { servedAt: Date.now() } : {}) };
        if (cur.kots?.length) patch.kots = cur.kots.map(k => (k.status === currentStatus ? { ...k, status: nextStatus } : k));
        tx.update(ref, patch);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setOrdersState(prev => prev.map(o => (o.id === orderId ? { ...o, status: currentStatus, ...(order?.kots ? { kots: order.kots } : {}) } : o)));
      alert(String(e && e.message).includes("STALE_STATUS") ? "âš ï¸ Ye order kisi aur screen se pehle hi aage badh chuka hai." : "âš ï¸ Status update fail hua. Dobara try karo.");

    setOrdersState(orders.map(o => o.id === orderId ? { ...o, ...updateData } : o));

 const markPaid = async (orderId, paid) => {
  try {
    await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
      const orderRef = doc(db, "orders", orderId);
      const orderSnap = await tx.get(orderRef);
      if (!orderSnap.exists()) throw new Error("Order not found");
      if (orderSnap.data().status === "cancelled") throw new Error("Order cancelled hai");

      const order = orderSnap.data();

      // Agar already paid mark ho chuka hai toh skip
      if (paid && order.coinsClaimed) {
        tx.update(orderRef, { paid: true });
        return;
      }

      if (paid) {
const earned = Math.floor(getOrderTotal(order) / (Number(loyaltyRules?.rate) || 10));

        const used = Math.max(0, Number(order.rewardUsedCoins) || 0);
        const phone = order.customer?.phone;

        if (phone && phone.length >= 10) {
          const userRef = doc(db, "loyaltyUsers", phone);
          const userSnap = await tx.get(userRef);
          const curCoins = userSnap.exists() ? (userSnap.data().coins || 0) : 0;
          if (used > curCoins) throw new Error("Customer ke paas itne coins nahi - reward claim galat hai");
          const newCoins = Math.max(0, curCoins + earned - used);

          if (userSnap.exists()) {
            tx.update(userRef, { coins: newCoins });
          } else {
            tx.set(userRef, { phone, name: order.customer?.name || "Guest", coins: newCoins });
          }
        }
        tx.update(orderRef, { paid: true, coinsClaimed: true });
      } else {
        tx.update(orderRef, { paid: false });
      }
    });

    // Transaction ke baad history alag se likho (idempotent check)
    // Note: yahan hum fresh data use kar rahe hain, aur agar `coinHistory` mein
    // duplicate add ho raha ho to coinsClaimed flag ke through ruk jayega
    const order = orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
    const alreadyClaimed = order && order.coinsClaimed;
    if (paid && order && !alreadyClaimed) {
      const phone = order.customer?.phone;
      const earned = order.earnedCoins || 0;
      const used = order.rewardUsedCoins || 0;
      if (phone && phone.length >= 10) {
        if (earned > 0) {
          await addDoc(collection(db, "coinHistory"), {
            phone, coins: earned,
            reason: `Order #${order.id.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}`,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          });
        }
        if (used > 0) {
          await addDoc(collection(db, "coinHistory"), {
            phone, coins: -used,
            reason: `Redeemed #${order.id.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}`,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          });
        }
        setLoyaltyUsers(prev => {
          const ex = prev.find(u => u.phone === phone);
          const newCoins = Math.max(0, (ex?.coins || 0) + earned - used);
          if (ex) return prev.map(u => u.phone === phone ? { ...u, coins: newCoins } : u);
          return [...prev, { phone, name: order.customer?.name || "Guest", coins: newCoins }];
        });
      }
    }

    setOrdersState(prev => prev.map(o =>
      o.id === orderId ? { ...o, paid, coinsClaimed: paid ? true : o.coinsClaimed } : o
    ));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("markPaid error:", e);
    alert("âš ï¸ Payment update failed: " + (e.message || "unknown"));
  }
};

  const bookEvent = async (booking) => { await setDoc(doc(db, "bookings", booking.id), booking); };

  const cancelOrderByStaff = async (orderId) => {
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", orderId), { status: "cancelled", cancelledAt: Date.now(), cancelledBy: "staff" }); addDoc(collection(db, "auditLogs"), { orderId, action: "cancel", by: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || "?", at: Date.now() }).catch(() => {});  } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (<div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", background: COLORS.paper, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 18, color: COLORS.copper }}>ğŸ½ï¸ Loading Eat & Park POS...</div>);
  }

  return (
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <div className={isDark ? "dark-theme" : ""} style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: "var(--bg-color, #FAFAF8)", color: COLORS.ink, fontFamily: "'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif" }}>
        <style>{FONTS}</style>
        {!online && (<div style={{ position: "fixed", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, zIndex: 9999, background: COLORS.error, color: "#fff", textAlign: "center", padding: "6px 8px", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13 }}>ğŸ“µ Internet nahi hai â€” order / KOT abhi nahi jayega</div>)}
        <div className="app-content">
  
  
  {role === "customer" && <ErrorBoundary key="cust"><CustomerView menu={currentMenu} orders={orders} placeOrder={placeOrder} bookEvent={bookEvent} gallery={gallery} offersList={offersList} table={table} setTable={setTable} requestPinPrompt={requestPinPrompt} settings={settings} isDark={isDark} setIsDark={setIsDark} requestWaiter={requestWaiter} loyaltyRules={loyaltyRules} loyaltyUsers={loyaltyUsers} coinHistory={coinHistory} setOrdersState={setOrdersState} categories={currentCategories} flashSaleItems={validFlashSaleItems} comboOffers={validComboOffers} setMenuState={setMenuState} setLoyaltyRules={saveLoyaltyRules} advanceStatus={advanceStatus} /></ErrorBoundary>}
  
  {role === "staff" && <ErrorBoundary key="staff"><StaffView menu={currentMenu} orders={orders} placeOrder={placeOrder} categories={currentCategories} setMenuState={setMenuState} advanceStatus={advanceStatus} requestPinPrompt={requestPinPrompt} calls={calls} resolveCall={resolveCall} cancelOrderByStaff={cancelOrderByStaff} /></ErrorBoundary>}
  
  {role === "admin" && <ErrorBoundary key="admin"><AdminView dussehraMenu={dussehraMenu} saveDussehraMenu={saveDussehraMenu} menu={menu} unavail={unavail} toggleAvail={toggleAvail} setMenuState={setMenuState} bookings={bookings} orders={orders} markPaid={markPaid} requestPinPrompt={requestPinPrompt} inventory={inventory} addInventory={addInventory} updateStock={updateStock} deleteBooking={deleteBooking} offersList={offersList} addOffer={addOffer} removeOffer={removeOffer} loyaltyRules={loyaltyRules} setLoyaltyRules={saveLoyaltyRules} loyaltyUsers={loyaltyUsers} settings={settings} setSettings={setSettings} gallery={gallery} setGallery={setGallery} categories={categories} updateCategories={updateCategories} flashSaleItems={flashSaleItems} setFlashSaleItems={setFlashSaleItems} comboOffers={comboOffers} setComboOffers={setComboOffers} savePromotions={savePromotions} /></ErrorBoundary>}
  
  {/* (Removed unreachable fallback â€” role is always one of customer/staff/admin) */}
</div>
        {showPinModal && (
          <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)", backdropFilter: "blur(4px)", zIndex: 999, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} onClick={() => setShowPinModal(false)}>
            <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ background: "#fff", padding: "28px", borderRadius: 20, width: "90%", maxWidth: 340, textAlign: "center" }} className="slide-up">
              <div style={{ fontSize: 36, marginBottom: 16 }}>ğŸ”’</div>
              <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 20px", fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700 }}>Login ({targetRole.toUpperCase()})</h3>
              <input type="email" placeholder="Email" value={emailInput} onChange={(e) => setEmailInput(e.target.value)} style={{ padding: "14px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 16, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", marginBottom: 12 }} />
              <input type="password" placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢" autoFocus value={pinInput} onChange={(e) => setPinInput(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handlePinSubmit(); }} style={{ padding: "16px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 32, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", textAlign: "center", letterSpacing: 12, marginBottom: 24, fontWeight: 800 }} />
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 12 }}>
                <button onClick={() => { setShowPinModal(false); setPinInput(""); }} style={{ flex: 1, padding: "14px", borderRadius: 12, border: `2px solid ${COLORS.line}`, background: "transparent", fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>Cancel</button>
                <button onClick={handlePinSubmit} style={{ flex: 1, padding: "14px", borderRadius: 12, background: COLORS.ink, color: "#fff", border: "none", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>Login</button>
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, marginTop: 16 }}></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

===== ./src/recover.js =====
const RELOAD_FLAG = "ep_fs_recover_ts";
const RELOAD_COOLDOWN_MS = 60_000;
const FS_ERROR_PATTERN = /INTERNAL ASSERTION FAILED|isCorePipeline|getTargetData/i;

function isFirestoreCrash(err) {
  if (!err) return false;
  const msg = String(err.message || (err.reason && err.reason.message) || err);
  return FS_ERROR_PATTERN.test(msg);
}

async function wipeFirestoreIndexedDB() {
  if (typeof indexedDB === "undefined") return;
  try {
    const dbs = indexedDB.databases ? await indexedDB.databases() : [];
    await Promise.all(
      dbs.filter((d) => d.name && d.name.toLowerCase().includes("firestore"))
        .map((d) => new Promise((res) => {
          const r = indexedDB.deleteDatabase(d.name);
          r.onsuccess = r.onerror = r.onblocked = () => res();
        }))
    );
  } catch (e) { console.warn("[recover] IDB wipe failed:", e); }
}

export async function tryRecover(err) {
  if (!isFirestoreCrash(err)) return false;
  try {
    const last = Number(sessionStorage.getItem(RELOAD_FLAG) || 0);
    if (Date.now() - last < RELOAD_COOLDOWN_MS) return false;
    sessionStorage.setItem(RELOAD_FLAG, String(Date.now()));
  } catch (_) {}
  console.warn("[recover] Firestore crash â†’ wipe cache + reload");
  await wipeFirestoreIndexedDB();
  window.location.reload();
  return true;
}

if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.addEventListener("error", (e) => tryRecover(e.error || e.message));
  window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e) => tryRecover(e.reason));
}

===== ./src/lib/guards.js =====
// Order ka chhota signature: items, qty, KOT ya total badle to alag aayega.
// (status change ya kitchen ka Start/Ready isse nahi badalta)
export const orderSig = (o) => [
  (o.items || []).length,
  (o.items || []).reduce((s, it) => s + (Number(it.qty) || 0), 0),
  (o.kots || []).length,
  Number(o.finalTotal) || 0,
].join("|");

export function assertEditable(live, seen) {
  if (!live) throw new Error("Order ab maujood nahi hai");
  if (live.paid) throw new Error("Order paid ho chuka hai - edit nahi ho sakta");
  if (live.status === "cancelled") throw new Error("Order cancelled hai");
  if (seen && orderSig(live) !== orderSig(seen)) throw new Error("Order kisi aur ne badal diya - wapas table kholo");
}

export const resolveVendorId = (name, map) =>
  map[String(name || "").trim().toLowerCase()] || null;

import { describe, test, expect } from "vitest";
import { assertEditable, resolveVendorId } from "./guards";

describe("assertEditable", () => {
  test("rejects missing order", () => expect(() => assertEditable(null, { items: [] })).toThrow(/maujood/));
  test("rejects paid", () => expect(() => assertEditable({ paid: true, items: [] }, { items: [] })).toThrow(/paid/));
  test("rejects cancelled", () => expect(() => assertEditable({ status: "cancelled", items: [] }, { items: [] })).toThrow(/cancelled/));
  test("allows unchanged open order", () =>
    expect(() => assertEditable({ items: [{ itemId: "a", qty: 1 }] }, { items: [{ itemId: "a", qty: 1 }] })).not.toThrow());
});

describe("resolveVendorId", () => {
  test("case + whitespace insensitive", () => expect(resolveVendorId("  Ramesh ", { ramesh: "v1" })).toBe("v1"));
  test("unknown vendor -> null", () => expect(resolveVendorId("Suresh", { ramesh: "v1" })).toBeNull());
  test("empty name -> null", () => expect(resolveVendorId("", { ramesh: "v1" })).toBeNull());
});
===== ./src/lib/orderRules.js.pre-patch2 =====
// Eat & Park - order ke saare business rules yahin hain.
// Rule badalna ho to sirf yahan badlo; Tables, Dashboard, Orders sab yahi use karte hain.
// NOTE: ye functions .filter(isOpenParcel) jaise seedhe pass hote hain,
// isliye inme sirf 1 argument (order) rakho. Doosra argument mat jodna.

export const OPEN_WINDOW_MS = 18 * 3600 * 1000;
export const PAID_STATUSES = ["paid"];

export const isCancelled = (o) => o.status === "cancelled";

// Due = udhaar, abhi paisa nahi aaya
export const isDue = (o) => o.paymentStatus === "due" && !o.paid && !isCancelled(o);

// Chalu order (table/parcel): unpaid, due nahi, cancelled nahi, aur 18 ghante ke andar
const isOpenBase = (o) =>
  !isCancelled(o) && !o.paid &&
  o.paymentStatus !== "due" && !PAID_STATUSES.includes(o.paymentStatus) &&
  Date.now() - (o.createdAt || 0) < OPEN_WINDOW_MS;

export const isOpenParcel = (o) => o.orderType === "parcel" && isOpenBase(o);
export const isOpenDineIn = (o) => o.orderType === "dine_in" && isOpenBase(o);

// "Active" = unpaid, due nahi, cancelled nahi (Tables, Dashboard, Orders tab teeno yahi)
export const isActiveOrder = (o) => !isCancelled(o) && !o.paid && o.paymentStatus !== "due";

// Paid orders aur unka revenue (cancelled kabhi nahi ginte)
export const paidOrders = (orders) => orders.filter((o) => o.paid && !isCancelled(o));
export const paidRevenue = (orders) =>
  paidOrders(orders).reduce((s, o) => s + (Number(o.finalTotal) || 0), 0);

// "Paid" karte waqt Firestore me jo fields likhni hain (Orders tab + Billing dono yahi use karte hain).
// Parcel ya ready order paid hote hi "served" ho jata hai; preparing/new ka status nahi chhedte
// (warna kitchen se order beech me gayab ho jayega).
export const buildPaidPatch = (order, mode, by) => {
  const patch = {
    paid: true,
    paymentStatus: "paid",
    paidAt: Date.now(),
    paidBy: by || "Staff",
    payment: mode,
  };
  if (order.orderType === "parcel" || order.status === "ready") patch.status = "served";
  return patch;
};
===== ./src/lib/orderRules.test.js =====
// Chalane ke liye:  node --test src/lib/orderRules.test.js
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  isActiveOrder, isOpenDineIn, isOpenParcel, isDue, paidOrders, paidRevenue, buildPaidPatch, OPEN_WINDOW_MS,
} from "./orderRules.js";

const now = () => Date.now();
const mk = (o) => ({ orderType: "dine_in", status: "new", paid: false, createdAt: now(), finalTotal: 100, ...o });

test("unpaid order active hai", () => {
  assert.equal(isActiveOrder(mk({})), true);
});
test("served par bhi unpaid hai to active hai", () => {
  assert.equal(isActiveOrder(mk({ status: "served" })), true);
});
test("paid order active nahi, chahe status ready ho", () => {
  assert.equal(isActiveOrder(mk({ paid: true, status: "ready" })), false);
});
test("due order active nahi", () => {
  assert.equal(isActiveOrder(mk({ paymentStatus: "due" })), false);
});
test("cancelled order active nahi", () => {
  assert.equal(isActiveOrder(mk({ status: "cancelled" })), false);
});

test("chalu dine-in table occupied hai", () => {
  assert.equal(isOpenDineIn(mk({})), true);
});
test("paid dine-in table occupied nahi", () => {
  assert.equal(isOpenDineIn(mk({ paid: true })), false);
});
test("18 ghante se purana order table occupied nahi", () => {
  assert.equal(isOpenDineIn(mk({ createdAt: now() - OPEN_WINDOW_MS - 1000 })), false);
});
test("parcel dine-in nahi ginta, aur dine-in parcel nahi", () => {
  assert.equal(isOpenDineIn(mk({ orderType: "parcel" })), false);
  assert.equal(isOpenParcel(mk({ orderType: "dine_in" })), false);
  assert.equal(isOpenParcel(mk({ orderType: "parcel" })), true);
});
test(".filter(isOpenDineIn) index ki wajah se galat nahi hota", () => {
  const list = [mk({}), mk({}), mk({ paid: true })];
  assert.equal(list.filter(isOpenDineIn).length, 2);
});

test("isDue sirf unpaid due ko pakadta hai", () => {
  assert.equal(isDue(mk({ paymentStatus: "due" })), true);
  assert.equal(isDue(mk({ paymentStatus: "due", paid: true })), false);
});

test("revenue me sirf paid aur non-cancelled", () => {
  const list = [
    mk({ paid: true, finalTotal: 500 }),
    mk({ paid: true, finalTotal: 300, status: "cancelled" }),
    mk({ paid: false, finalTotal: 900 }),
    mk({ paid: true, finalTotal: "200" }),
  ];
  assert.equal(paidOrders(list).length, 2);
  assert.equal(paidRevenue(list), 700);
});
test("finalTotal na ho to 0 maana jaye", () => {
  assert.equal(paidRevenue([mk({ paid: true, finalTotal: undefined })]), 0);
});

test("buildPaidPatch: sahi fields likhta hai", () => {
  const p = buildPaidPatch(mk({}), "upi", "Ramesh");
  assert.equal(p.paid, true);
  assert.equal(p.paymentStatus, "paid");
  assert.equal(p.payment, "upi");
  assert.equal(p.paidBy, "Ramesh");
  assert.equal(typeof p.paidAt, "number");
});
test("buildPaidPatch: naam na ho to Staff", () => {
  assert.equal(buildPaidPatch(mk({}), "cash").paidBy, "Staff");
});
test("buildPaidPatch: parcel paid hote hi served", () => {
  assert.equal(buildPaidPatch(mk({ orderType: "parcel", status: "new" }), "cash").status, "served");
});
test("buildPaidPatch: ready dine-in served ho jata hai", () => {
  assert.equal(buildPaidPatch(mk({ status: "ready" }), "cash").status, "served");
});
test("buildPaidPatch: preparing/new ka status nahi chhedta (kitchen se gayab na ho)", () => {
  assert.equal("status" in buildPaidPatch(mk({ status: "preparing" }), "cash"), false);
  assert.equal("status" in buildPaidPatch(mk({ status: "new" }), "cash"), false);
});

function ImageUploadButton({ currentImage, onUploaded, label }) {
  const widgetRef = useRef(null);
  const onUploadedRef = useRef(onUploaded);
  onUploadedRef.current = onUploaded;
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    let tries = 0;
    const tryInit = () => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (window.cloudinary) {
        widgetRef.current = window.cloudinary.createUploadWidget(
          {
            cloudName: "nnddxvcn",
            uploadPreset: "eatpark_uploads",
            sources: ["local", "camera", "url"],
            multiple: false,
            maxFileSize: 5000000,
            clientAllowedFormats: ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp"],
          },
          (error, result) => {
            if (error) {
              console.error("Cloudinary error:", error);
              alert("Upload fail: " + (error.statusText || error.message || JSON.stringify(error)));
              return;
            }
            if (result && result.event === "success") {
              onUploadedRef.current(result.info.secure_url);
            }
          }
        );
        setReady(true);
      } else if (++tries < 20) {
        setTimeout(tryInit, 300);
      } else {
        alert("Cloudinary script load nahi hui. public/index.html check karo.");
      }
    };
    tryInit();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const openWidget = () => {
    if (widgetRef.current) widgetRef.current.open();
  };

  return (
    <button
      onClick={openWidget}
      disabled={!ready}
      style={{
        width: "100%",
        padding: 14,
        border: "none",
        borderRadius: 12,
        background: ready ? "#D97706" : "#999",
        color: "#fff",
        fontWeight: 800,
        fontSize: 14,
        cursor: ready ? "pointer" : "wait",
      }}
    >
      {ready ? (label || "ğŸ“¸ Upload Image") : "â³ Loading..."}
    </button>
  );
}

function getLoyaltyTier(points) {
  let tier = LOYALTY_TIERS[0];
  for (const t of LOYALTY_TIERS) if (points >= t.points) tier = t;
  return tier;
}

function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
}

// Ek hi jagah se order total (coupon + loyalty + delivery sab included)
function getOrderTotal(o) {
  const hasRunning = (o?.kots || []).some(k => k.isRunning);
  // If finalTotal is trusted (no running KOT or bill was manually edited), use it.
  if (Number.isFinite(o?.finalTotal) && (!hasRunning || o?.billEditedAt)) return o.finalTotal;
  // Otherwise compute from items. NOTE: items array already includes running KOT items,
  // and runningPatch() updates finalTotal only when billEditedAt is set â€” so no double count.
  const sub = (o?.items || []).reduce((s, it) => s + it.price * it.qty, 0);
  const coupon = Math.round((sub * (o?.discount || 0)) / 100);
  return Math.max(0, sub - coupon - (o?.loyaltyDiscount || 0)) + (o?.deliveryFee || 0);
}

// Firestore doc ko safe shape deta hai (purane/adhure docs se crash nahi hoga)
const normOrder = HX.normOrder;
const normOrderLegacy = (d) => {
  const o = { id: d.id, ...d.data() };
  if (!Array.isArray(o.items)) o.items = [];
  if (!o.customer) o.customer = { name: "", phone: "" };
  return o;
};

// Running KOT aane par total / paid status theek karta hai
const runningPatch = (o, added) => {
  const addT = added.reduce((s, it) => s + it.price * it.qty, 0);
  const p = {};
  if (o.billEditedAt) {
    const g = Number(o.gstRate) || 0;
    p.finalTotal = Math.round((Number(o.finalTotal) || 0) + addT * (1 - (Number(o.billDiscountPct) || 0) / 100) * (1 + g / 100));
    p.subtotal = (Number(o.subtotal) || 0) + addT;
  }
  if (o.paid) { p.paid = false; p.paymentStatus = "pending"; }
  return p;
};

const patchAt = (list, idx, patch) => list.map((x, i) => (i === idx ? { ...x, ...patch } : x));

// Agar bill khulne ke baad order me naya KOT/item aa gaya to save rok do
async function guardedOrderUpdate(base, patch) {
  const ref = doc(db, "orders", base.id);
  await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(ref);
    if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error("Order nahi mila");
    const cur = snap.data();
    if ((cur.items || []).length !== (base.items || []).length || (cur.kots || []).length !== (base.kots || []).length) {
      throw new Error("Ye order kisi aur ne abhi badla hai (naya KOT/item). Bill band karke dobara kholo.");
    }
    tx.update(ref, patch);
  });
}

    const item = menu.find(m => m.id === it.itemId); 
    return PREP_TIME_ESTIMATES[item?.category || "Fun Food"] || 15; 
  }));
  return (Number.isFinite(maxTime) ? maxTime : 15) + 2;
}

function getOrderProgress(status) {
  if (status === 'served' || status === 'delivered' || status === 'completed') return 100;
  if (status === 'out_for_delivery') return 90;
  if (status === 'ready') return 70;
  if (status === 'preparing') return 40;
  if (status === 'new') return 15;
  return 0;
}

// Cart helpers â€” Flash sale / Combo price override handle karte hain
function getCartQty(cartEntry) {
  if (!cartEntry) return 0;
  if (typeof cartEntry === 'number') return cartEntry;
  return cartEntry.qty || 0;
}

function getCartLineTotal(cartEntry, menuItem) {
  if (!cartEntry || !menuItem) return 0;
  const price = cartEntry.priceOverride ?? menuItem.price ?? 0;
  const _q = getCartQty(cartEntry);
  if (cartEntry.priceOverride == null) return price * _q;
  const _cap = Math.min(_q, cartEntry.ovQty ?? _q);
  return price * _cap + (menuItem.price ?? 0) * (_q - _cap);
}

function getSmartSuggestionPool(menu, cart) {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  let cats;
  if (hour < 11) cats = ["Shakes & Drinks", "Momos & Rolls"];
  else if (hour < 15) cats = ["Biryani & Rice", "Thali", "Dal, Roti & Chole"];
  else if (hour < 18) cats = ["Maggi, Corn & Fries", "Shakes & Drinks", "Momos & Rolls"];
  else cats = ["Tandoor", "Chinese", "Paneer & Mushroom"];
  return menu.filter(m => cats.includes(m.category) && m.available && !cart[m.id]);
}
function getSmartSuggestionPoolOld(menu, cart) {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  let pool = [];
  if (hour < 11) pool = menu.filter(m => m.category.includes("Tea") || m.category.includes("Bread"));
  else if (hour < 13) pool = menu.filter(m => m.category.includes("Biryani") || m.category.includes("Pulao"));
  else if (hour < 17) pool = menu.filter(m => m.category.includes("Snacks") || m.category.includes("Drinks"));
  else pool = menu.filter(m => m.category.includes("Tandoori") || m.category.includes("Mains"));
  return pool.filter(m => m.available && !cart[m.id]);
}

class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null };
  }
  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }
  componentDidCatch(error, info) {
    tryRecover(arguments[0]);
    console.error('ğŸ”´ ErrorBoundary caught:', error);
    console.error('ğŸ”´ Component Stack:', info.componentStack);
    this.setState({ error, errorInfo: info });
  }
  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError && this.props.compact) {
      return (
        <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 400, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", padding: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 16, padding: 20, maxWidth: 320, textAlign: "center" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 40 }}>âš ï¸</div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, margin: "8px 0 14px" }}>Ye screen me dikkat aayi. Band karke dobara kholo.</div>
            <button onClick={() => { this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null }); if (this.props.onReset) this.props.onReset(); }} style={{ background: COLORS.ink, color: "#fff", border: "none", padding: "10px 24px", borderRadius: 10, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>Theek hai</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div style={{ minHeight: '100vh', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 20 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '4rem', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>ğŸ˜…</div>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color: COLORS.ink, marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>Something went wrong</h2>
          <pre style={{ background: '#f5f5f5', padding: 16, borderRadius: 8, maxWidth: 600, overflow: 'auto', fontSize: 12, color: '#c00', marginBottom: 16, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>
            {this.state.error?.toString()}
            {'\n\n'}
            {this.state.errorInfo?.componentStack}
          </pre>
          <button onClick={() => { try { localStorage.removeItem('eatpark_cart'); } catch (e) {} window.location.reload(); }} style={{ background: COLORS.copper, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '10px 20px', borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 'bold', cursor: 'pointer' }}>Clear Cache & Refresh</button>
          <button onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null })} style={{ background: COLORS.ink, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '10px 20px', borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 'bold', cursor: 'pointer', marginTop: 10 }}>ğŸ”„ Try Again</button>
          <button onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null })} style={{ background: COLORS.ink, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '10px 20px', borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 'bold', cursor: 'pointer', marginTop: 10 }}>ğŸ”„ Try Again</button>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

function useLiveNow(intervalMs = 30000) {
  const [, forceTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => forceTick(x => x + 1), intervalMs);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [intervalMs]);
  // Returns nothing on purpose â€” just forces a re-render every intervalMs.
  // Callers use this to refresh relative timestamps like timeAgo().
}
const useLocalStorage = (key, initialValue) => {
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue;
    } catch (error) { return initialValue; }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    try { window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(storedValue)); }
    catch (error) { console.error('useLocalStorage error:', error); }
  }, [key, storedValue]);
  return [storedValue, setStoredValue];
};

// ğŸ–¥ï¸ğŸ“± APP / DESKTOP MODE
const VIEW_KEY = "eatpark_viewmode";
function useViewMode() {
  const read = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(VIEW_KEY);
      if (saved === "desktop" || saved === "app") return saved;
    } catch (e) {}
    return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.innerWidth >= 1024 ? "desktop" : "app";
  };
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState(read);
  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setModeState(read());
    window.addEventListener("eatpark_viewmode_change", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("eatpark_viewmode_change", sync);
  }, []);
  const setMode = useCallback((m) => {
    try { localStorage.setItem(VIEW_KEY, m); } catch (e) {}
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("eatpark_viewmode_change"));
  }, []);
  return [mode, setMode];
}

// ğŸ“Œ ADMIN PRESETS (Firebase: settings/presets) â€” waiters, customers, notes, discount, GST
const DEFAULT_PRESETS = { waiters: [], notes: [], discounts: [], gstRates: [], customers: [] };
function usePresets() {
  const [presets, setPresetsState] = useState(() => {
    try { return { ...DEFAULT_PRESETS, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("eatpark_presets") || "{}") }; }
    catch (e) { return DEFAULT_PRESETS; }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = onSnapshot(doc(db, "settings", "presets"), (snap) => {
      if (snap.exists()) {
        const d = { ...DEFAULT_PRESETS, ...snap.data() };
        setPresetsState(d);
        try { localStorage.setItem("eatpark_presets", JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {}
      }
    }, (err) => console.error("presets listener:", err));
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);
  const savePresets = async (next) => {
    setPresetsState(next);
    try { localStorage.setItem("eatpark_presets", JSON.stringify(next)); } catch (e) {}
    try { await setDoc(doc(db, "settings", "presets"), next); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); alert("âš ï¸ Presets save nahi hue. Internet / Firebase rules check karo."); }
  };
  return [presets, savePresets];
}

// 5 galat PIN ke baad 30 second lock
function usePinLockout(max = 5, lockMs = 30000) {
  const [fails, setFails] = useState(0);
  const [lockedUntil, setLockedUntil] = useState(0);
  return {
    isLocked: () => Date.now() < lockedUntil,
    secondsLeft: () => Math.max(0, Math.ceil((lockedUntil - Date.now()) / 1000)),
    registerFail: () => {
      const n = fails + 1;
      if (n >= max) { setLockedUntil(Date.now() + lockMs); setFails(0); } else setFails(n);
    },
    reset: () => setFails(0)
  };
}

const useLocalStorageOld = (key, initialValue) => {
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue;
    } catch (error) {
      return initialValue;
    }
  });

  const setValue = useCallback((value) => {
    setStoredValue(prev => {
      try {
        const v = value instanceof Function ? value(prev) : value;
        window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(v));
        return v;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('useLocalStorage error:', error);
        return prev;
      }
    });
  }, [key]);

  return [storedValue, setValue];
};

function categoryImage(category) {
  const c = String(category || "");
  const hit = CATEGORY_IMG.find(([k]) => c.includes(k));
  return IMG(hit ? hit[1] : DEFAULT_IMG_ID);
}
function dishImage(name, category) {
  const n = String(name || "");
  const hit = DISH_IMG_RULES.find(([re]) => re.test(n));
  return hit ? IMG(hit[1]) : "";
}
const GENERIC_IMAGES = new Set([IMG(DEFAULT_IMG_ID), ...CATEGORY_IMG.map(([, id]) => IMG(id))]);
const withDishImage = (m) => (!m.image || GENERIC_IMAGES.has(m.image) ? { ...m, image: dishImage(m.name, m.category) } : m);

function mi(id, name, price, category, veg, desc, portion, isBestseller = false, available = true, customImg = "") {
  return { id, name, desc: desc || "Freshly prepared with premium ingredients.", price, category, veg, available, image: customImg || dishImage(name, category), portion: portion || "", isBestseller };
}

const LoyaltyProgress = memo(({ currentPoints, nextTier, loyaltyRules }) => {
  if (!nextTier) return null;
  const currentTierIndex = LOYALTY_TIERS.indexOf(nextTier) - 1;
  const previousTierPoints = currentTierIndex >= 0 ? LOYALTY_TIERS[currentTierIndex].points : 0;
  const pointsNeeded = nextTier.points - currentPoints;
  const progress = Math.min(((currentPoints - previousTierPoints) / (nextTier.points - previousTierPoints)) * 100, 100);
  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 8, padding: '10px 12px', background: '#fff', borderRadius: 10, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 4 }}>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: COLORS.textLight }}>{nextTier.emoji} Next: {nextTier.name}</span>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: pointsNeeded > 0 ? COLORS.copper : COLORS.success }}>{pointsNeeded > 0 ? `${pointsNeeded} away` : 'ğŸ‰ Unlocked!'}</span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 6, background: COLORS.paper2, borderRadius: 999, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <div style={{ width: `${Math.min(progress, 100)}%`, height: '100%', background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${COLORS.gold}, ${nextTier.color || COLORS.sage})`, borderRadius: 999, transition: 'width 0.8s ease' }} />
      </div>
      {pointsNeeded > 0 && (<div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, marginTop: 4 }}>ğŸ’° Spend â‚¹{Math.ceil(pointsNeeded * loyaltyRules.rate)} more</div>)}
    </div>
  );
});

const ChatBox = memo(({ orderId, customerId }) => {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState('');
  const messagesRef = useMemo(() => collection(db, 'chats', orderId, 'messages'), [orderId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const q = query(messagesRef, orderBy('timestamp', 'asc'));
      const unsub = onSnapshot(q, (snap) => {
        setMessages(snap.docs.map(doc => { const data = doc.data(); if (!data.timestamp) data.timestamp = Date.now(); return { id: doc.id, ...data }; }));
      });
      return unsub;
    } catch (e) { console.error('Chat error:', e); }
  }, [orderId, messagesRef]);
  const sendMessage = async () => {
    if (!newMessage.trim()) return;
    try {
      await addDoc(messagesRef, { text: newMessage, senderId: customerId, senderName: customerId === 'customer' ? 'Customer' : 'Restaurant', timestamp: serverTimestamp() });
      setNewMessage('');
    } catch (e) { console.error('Chat send error:', e); }
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ border: '1px solid #ddd', borderRadius: 8, padding: 12, background: '#fff' }}>
      <div style={{ maxHeight: 250, overflowY: 'auto', marginBottom: 8 }}>
        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <div key={msg.id} style={{ textAlign: msg.senderId === customerId ? 'right' : 'left', margin: '4px 0' }}>
            <span style={{ background: msg.senderId === customerId ? COLORS.copper : '#e9ecef', color: msg.senderId === customerId ? '#fff' : '#000', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 12, display: 'inline-block', maxWidth: '80%' }}>{msg.text}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
        <input value={newMessage} onChange={(e) => setNewMessage(e.target.value)} placeholder="Type a message..." style={{ flex: 1, padding: 8, border: '1px solid #ccc', borderRadius: 4 }} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && sendMessage()} />
        <button onClick={sendMessage} style={{ background: COLORS.copper, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 4, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Send</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

const loadRazorpayScript = () => new Promise((resolve) => {
  if (window.Razorpay) { resolve(true); return; }
  const script = document.createElement('script');
  script.src = 'https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js';
  script.onload = () => resolve(true);
  script.onerror = () => resolve(false);
  document.body.appendChild(script);
});

// Success pe Razorpay response, cancel/fail pe null return karta hai
const processRazorpayPaymentLegacy = (amount, orderId, customerName, customerPhone) =>
  new Promise(async (resolve) => {
    if (!RAZORPAY_KEY || RAZORPAY_KEY.startsWith("YOUR_")) {
      alert("âš ï¸ Razorpay key configure nahi hai.");
      return resolve(null);
    }
    const loaded = await loadRazorpayScript();
    if (!loaded || !window.Razorpay) { alert("âš ï¸ Payment gateway load nahi hua."); return resolve(null); }
    const rzp = new window.Razorpay({
      key: RAZORPAY_KEY, amount: Math.round(amount * 100), currency: "INR",
      name: RESTAURANT.name, description: `Order #${orderId.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}`,
      prefill: { name: customerName, contact: customerPhone },
      theme: { color: COLORS.copper },
      handler: (response) => resolve(response),
      modal: { ondismiss: () => resolve(null) }
    });
    rzp.on('payment.failed', () => resolve(null));
    rzp.open();
  });

const processRazorpayPayment = async (amount, orderId, customerName, customerPhone) => {
  try {
    return await HX.payWithRazorpay({

      desc: `Order #${orderId.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}`,
      prefill: { name: customerName, contact: customerPhone }, color: COLORS.copper
    });
  } catch (e) { alert("âš ï¸ " + (e.message || e)); return null; }
};

// 13.5 AI ORDER MODAL (VOICE & TEXT)
// ==

function AIOrderModal({ menu, onOrderParsed, onClose }) {
  const [aiText, setAiText] = useState("");
  const [aiBusy, setAiBusy] = useState(false);
  const [aiErr, setAiErr] = useState("");
  const [listening, setListening] = useState(false);
  const recRef = useRef(null);

  const startMic = () => {
    const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if (!SR) {
      setAiErr("âš ï¸ Is browser me mic support nahi hai. Keyboard ka mic use karein.");
      return;
    }

    // Agar pehle se sun raha hai toh stop karein
    if (listening && recRef.current) {
      try {
        recRef.current.stop();
      } catch (err) {}
      setListening(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const r = new SR();
      r.lang = "hi-IN";
      r.interimResults = false;
      r.continuous = false;

      r.onstart = () => {
        setListening(true);
        setAiErr("");
      };

      r.onresult = (e) => {
        const transcript = Array.from(e.results)
          .map((res) => res[0].transcript)
          .join(" ");
        setAiText((prev) => (prev ? prev + " " : "") + transcript);
      };

      r.onerror = (e) => {
        setListening(false);
        if (e.error === "not-allowed") {
          setAiErr("âš ï¸ Mic permission blocked hai. Settings me allow karein.");
        } else if (e.error === "no-speech") {
          setAiErr("âš ï¸ Koi aawaz nahi suni gayi. Dobara bolein.");
        } else {
          setAiErr(`âš ï¸ Mic error: ${e.error || "Aawaz capture nahi hui"}`);
        }
      };

      r.onend = () => {
        setListening(false);
      };

      recRef.current = r;
      r.start();
    } catch (err) {
      setListening(false);
      setAiErr("âš ï¸ Mic start nahi ho paya. Dobara tap karein.");
    }
  };

  const runAi = async () => {
    const text = aiText.trim();
    if (!text || aiBusy) return;
    setAiBusy(true);
    setAiErr("");
    try {
      const r = await HX.fetchWithTimeout("/api/parse-order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...(auth.currentUser ? { Authorization: "Bearer " + (await auth.currentUser.getIdToken()) } : {}) },

        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          menu: (menu || [])
            .filter((m) => m.available)
            .map((m) => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name, portion: m.portion || "" })),
        }),
      });
      const data = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "AI processing fail ho gayi");
      onOrderParsed(HX.sanitizeAiLines(data, menu));
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setAiErr("âš ï¸ " + (e.message || e));
    } finally {
      setAiBusy(false);
    }
  };


  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.65)", zIndex: 280, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", padding: 14 }} onClick={onClose}>
      <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 18, padding: 18, width: "100%", maxWidth: 390, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 10 }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 18, fontFamily: "'Outfit', sans-serif" }}>ğŸ¤– AI Order</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", fontSize: 18, cursor: "pointer" }}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8A8375" }}>Bolo ya likho: "2 veg roll, 1 cold coffee"</div>
        <textarea
          rows={3}
          value={aiText}
          onChange={(e) => setAiText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Order yahan likhein ya mic se bolein..."
          style={{ width: "100%", padding: 10, borderRadius: 10, border: "1.5px solid #E8E6DC", boxSizing: "border-box", fontSize: 14, resize: "none" }}
        />
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
          <button type="button" onClick={startMic} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 10, background: listening ? "#C0392B" : "#FAFAF8", border: "1.5px solid #E8E6DC", fontWeight: 800, color: listening ? "#fff" : "#1A1A1A", cursor: "pointer" }}>
            {listening ? "â¹ï¸ Ruko" : "ğŸ¤ Bolo"}
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={runAi} disabled={aiBusy || !aiText.trim()} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 10, background: "#3B82F6", color: "#fff", border: "none", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", opacity: (aiBusy || !aiText.trim()) ? 0.6 : 1 }}>
            {aiBusy ? "â³ Soch raha..." : "âœ¨ Samjho"}
          </button>
        </div>
        {aiErr && <div style={{ color: "#EF4444", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700 }}>{aiErr}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const RunningOrderModal = memo(({ order, menu, onConfirm, onClose }) => {
  const [additions, setAdditions] = useState({});
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const filtered = menu.filter(m => m.available && (!search.trim() || m.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())));
  const itemsToAdd = Object.entries(additions).filter(([, q]) => q > 0);
  const addTotal = itemsToAdd.reduce((s, [id, q]) => { const m = menu.find(x => x.id === id); return s + (m ? m.price * q : 0); }, 0);

  const handleSetQty = (id, q) => { setAdditions(prev => { const next = { ...prev, [id]: q }; if (q <= 0) delete next[id]; return next; }); };

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)", backdropFilter: "blur(4px)", zIndex: 85, display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-end" }} onClick={onClose}>
      <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} className="slide-up" style={{ background: "#fff", width: "100%", maxWidth: 480, margin: "0 auto", borderRadius: "24px 24px 0 0", padding: "20px", maxHeight: "85vh", overflowY: "auto" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: "'Outfit', sans-serif", fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800 }}>â• Add Running Items</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.textLight, marginTop: 2 }}>Order #{order.id.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()} Â· New KOT #{Math.max(1, ...(order.kots || [{ kotNumber: 1 }]).map(k => k.kotNumber || 1)) + 1}</div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", border: "none", borderRadius: "50%", width: 36, height: 36, fontSize: 18, cursor: "pointer" }}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        <SearchBar value={search} onChange={setSearch} placeholder="Search menu..." />
        <div style={{ marginTop: 16, maxHeight: "45vh", overflowY: "auto" }}>
          {filtered.map(item => {
            const qty = additions[item.id] || 0;
            return (
              <div key={item.id} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", padding: "10px 0", borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}><VegDot veg={item.veg} /><strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{item.name}</strong></div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: COLORS.copper, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 2 }}>{inr(item.price)}</div>
                </div>
                <AddBtnStepper qty={qty} onChange={q => handleSetQty(item.id, q)} available={item.available} />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <div style={{ borderTop: `2px solid ${COLORS.line}`, paddingTop: 16, marginTop: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 17, marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <span>Additional Total</span><span style={{ color: COLORS.copper, fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace" }}>{inr(addTotal)}</span>
          </div>
          <button disabled={itemsToAdd.length === 0}
            onClick={() => {
              if (itemsToAdd.length === 0) return;
