function DussehraRateEditor({ items, onSave, unavail = [], toggleAvail }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(items);
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [add, setAdd] = useState({ name: "", price: "", category: DUSSEHRA_CATEGORIES[0], portion: "" });
  useEffect(() => { if (!dirty) setDraft(items); }, [items, dirty]);

  const fld = { padding: "8px 10px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 14, boxSizing: "border-box", fontFamily: "inherit" };
  const edit = (id, patch) => { setDraft((d) => d.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x))); setDirty(true); };
  const remove = (id) => { if (!window.confirm("Ye item hatana hai?")) return; setDraft((d) => d.filter((x) => x.id !== id)); setDirty(true); };
  const addItem = () => {
    const price = Number(add.price);
    if (!add.name.trim() || !Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) { alert("âš ï¸ Naam aur sahi rate daalo"); return; }
    setDraft((d) => [...d, mi(uid("dz"), add.name.trim(), price, add.category, true, "", add.portion.trim(), false, true, "")]);
    setAdd({ ...add, name: "", price: "", portion: "" });
    setDirty(true);
  };
  const save = async () => {
    if (draft.some((x) => !String(x.name || "").trim() || !Number.isFinite(Number(x.price)) || Number(x.price) <= 0)) { alert("âš ï¸ Har item ka naam aur sahi rate hona chahiye"); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    await onSave(draft.map((x) => ({ ...x, price: Number(x.price) })));
    setSaving(false); setDirty(false);
  };
  const reset = () => { if (window.confirm("Saare Dussehra rates PDF wale original par wapas karne hain?")) { setDraft(DUSSEHRA_MENU); setDirty(true); } };

  if (!open) {
    return (
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 14, marginBottom: 20, background: "#E65100", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 14, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 15, cursor: "pointer" }}>
        âœï¸ Dussehra Rates Edit karo
      </button>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1.5px solid #E65100", borderRadius: 14, padding: 16, marginBottom: 20 }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, color: "#E65100" }}>âœï¸ Dussehra Menu Rates</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
          <button onClick={reset} style={{ ...fld, background: "transparent", color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>â†©ï¸ PDF wale par reset</button>
          <button onClick={() => setOpen(false)} style={{ ...fld, background: COLORS.paper2, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>âœ• Band</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {DUSSEHRA_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
        const rows = draft.filter((x) => x.category === cat);
        if (rows.length === 0) return null;
        return (
          <div key={cat} style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, color: COLORS.textLight, marginBottom: 6 }}>{cat}</div>
            {rows.map((x) => (
              <div key={x.id} style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 6, opacity: unavail.includes(x.id) ? 0.55 : 1 }}>
                <input value={x.name} onChange={(e) => edit(x.id, { name: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }} />
                {x.portion ? <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 700, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{x.portion}</span> : null}
                <input type="number" inputMode="decimal" value={x.price} onChange={(e) => edit(x.id, { price: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, width: 80, fontWeight: 800, textAlign: "center" }} />
                <button onClick={() => toggleAvail && toggleAvail(x.id)} title="Hai / Khatam" style={{ ...fld, padding: "8px 8px", cursor: "pointer", background: unavail.includes(x.id) ? COLORS.error : COLORS.sageLight, color: unavail.includes(x.id) ? "#fff" : COLORS.sageDark, fontWeight: 800, border: "none" }}>{unavail.includes(x.id) ? "âŒ" : "âœ…"}</button>
                <button onClick={() => remove(x.id)} style={{ ...fld, padding: "8px 8px", cursor: "pointer", background: "transparent", color: COLORS.error, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.error}`, fontWeight: 800 }}>âœ•</button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      <div style={{ background: COLORS.paper, borderRadius: 10, padding: 10, marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800, color: COLORS.textLight, marginBottom: 6 }}>â• Naya item</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <input placeholder="Naam" value={add.name} onChange={(e) => setAdd({ ...add, name: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }} />
          <input type="number" placeholder="Rate" value={add.price} onChange={(e) => setAdd({ ...add, price: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, width: 80 }} />
          <input placeholder="Half / Full" value={add.portion} onChange={(e) => setAdd({ ...add, portion: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, width: 90 }} />
          <select value={add.category} onChange={(e) => setAdd({ ...add, category: e.target.value })} style={{ ...fld, background: "#fff" }}>
            {DUSSEHRA_CATEGORIES.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
          </select>
          <button onClick={addItem} style={{ ...fld, background: COLORS.sage, color: "#fff", border: "none", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>+ Add</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button onClick={save} disabled={!dirty || saving} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 14, border: "none", borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 15, cursor: dirty && !saving ? "pointer" : "not-allowed", background: dirty && !saving ? "#E65100" : COLORS.paper2, color: dirty && !saving ? "#fff" : COLORS.textLight }}>
        {saving ? "â³ Saving..." : dirty ? "ğŸ’¾ Save Dussehra Menu" : "Koi badlav nahi"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function AdminView({ dussehraMenu = [], saveDussehraMenu, menu, unavail = [], toggleAvail, setMenuState, bookings, orders, markPaid, requestPinPrompt, inventory, addInventory, updateStock, deleteBooking, offersList, addOffer, removeOffer, loyaltyRules, setLoyaltyRules, loyaltyUsers, settings, setSettings, gallery, setGallery, categories, updateCategories, flashSaleItems, setFlashSaleItems, comboOffers, setComboOffers, savePromotions }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("overview");
  const [filterDate, setFilterDate] = useState(toLocalISODate(Date.now()));
  const [newInv, setNewInv] = useState({ name: "", stock: "", unit: "kg" });
  const [newOffer, setNewOffer] = useState({ title: "", desc: "" });
  const [newReward, setNewReward] = useState({ cost: "", item: "" });
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState(null);
  const [newItemName, setNewItemName] = useState("");
  const [newItemPrice, setNewItemPrice] = useState("");
  const [newItemCat, setNewItemCat] = useState((categories && categories[0]) || CATEGORIES[0]);
  const [newItemImage, setNewItemImage] = useState("");
  const [addMenuName, setAddMenuName] = useState("");
  const [addMenuPrice, setAddMenuPrice] = useState("");
  const [addMenuCat, setAddMenuCat] = useState((categories && categories[0]) || CATEGORIES[0]);
  const [addMenuVeg, setAddMenuVeg] = useState(true);
  const [addMenuDesc, setAddMenuDesc] = useState("");
  const [addMenuImage, setAddMenuImage] = useState("");
  const [newGalleryImg, setNewGalleryImg] = useState("");
  const [heroImgInput, setHeroImgInput] = useState(settings?.heroImage || "");
  const [isGeneratingPDF, setIsGeneratingPDF] = useState(false);
  const [newCategoryInput, setNewCategoryInput] = useState('');
  const [manageCat, setManageCat] = useState(null);
  const [manageSearch, setManageSearch] = useState("");
  const hiddenCats = settings?.hiddenCategories || [];
  // ğŸ©¹ ONE-SHOT MENU FIX â€” duplicates + naam + desc + photos (Wikipediaâ†’Cloudinary)
  const [fixState, setFixState] = useState(null);
  const [fixReport, setFixReport] = useState(null);
  const [fixProgress, setFixProgress] = useState({ done: 0, total: 0, msg: "" });
  const CLOUD_NAME = "nnddxvcn";
  const UPLOAD_PRESET = "eatpark_uploads";
  const isOwnImage = (u) => /cloudinary\.com|pexels\.com/.test(u || "");
  const normalizeDishName = (s) => {
    let n = String(s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    n = n.replace(/\bchilly\b/gi, "Chilli").replace(/\bchily\b/gi, "Chilli").replace(/\bchili\b/gi, "Chilli").replace(/\bmutter\b/gi, "Mutton");
    return n.split(" ").map(w => w ? w[0].toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase() : "").join(" ");
  };
  const normalizeDesc = (s, name) => {
    let d = String(s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (!d || d.length < 6) return `${name || "Fresh dish"} â€” freshly prepared with quality ingredients.`;
    if (!/[.!?]$/.test(d)) d += ".";
    return d[0].toUpperCase() + d.slice(1);
  };
  const wikiImage = async (dishName) => {
    const clean = String(dishName || "").replace(/\(.*?\)/g, "").replace(/\b\d+\s*(pc|pcs|piece|pieces|kg|gm|ml|ltr|plate|eggs?)\b/gi, "").replace(/\b(half|full|quarter|regular|special|small|large|medium|dry|gravy|steam|fry|tandoori)\b/gi, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (!clean) return "";
    try {
      const url = `https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&generator=search&gsrsearch=${encodeURIComponent(clean + " food")}&gsrlimit=1&prop=pageimages&piprop=thumbnail|original&pithumbsize=600&format=json&origin=*`;
      const r = await fetch(url);
      if (!r.ok) return "";
      const d = await r.json();
      const first = Object.values(d?.query?.pages || {})[0];
      const img = first?.thumbnail?.source || first?.original?.source;
      if (img && /\.(jpe?g|png|webp)/i.test(img)) return img;
    } catch (e) {}
    return "";
  };
  const cloudinaryUpload = async (remoteUrl) => {
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("file", remoteUrl);
      fd.append("upload_preset", UPLOAD_PRESET);
      fd.append("folder", "eatpark_auto");
      const r = await fetch(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload`, { method: "POST", body: fd });
      if (r.ok) { const d = await r.json(); if (d.secure_url) return d.secure_url; }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      const ir = await fetch(remoteUrl, { mode: "cors" });
      if (!ir.ok) return "";
      const blob = await ir.blob();
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("file", blob, "auto.jpg");
      fd.append("upload_preset", UPLOAD_PRESET);
      fd.append("folder", "eatpark_auto");
      const r = await fetch(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload`, { method: "POST", body: fd });
      if (r.ok) { const d = await r.json(); return d.secure_url || ""; }
    } catch (e) {}
    return "";
  };
  const scanFix = () => {
    setFixState("scanning");
    try {
      const norm = (s) => String(s || "").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      const richness = (m) => (isOwnImage(m.image) ? 20 : 0) + (m.image ? 5 : 0) + (m.desc ? 3 : 0) + (m.isBestseller ? 2 : 0) + ((m.alsoIn || []).length);
      const seen = {}, dupDeleteIds = new Set(), dupPairs = [];
      [...menu].sort((a, b) => richness(b) - richness(a)).forEach((m) => {
        const key = [norm(m.name), norm(m.portion), norm(m.category), Math.round(Number(m.price) || 0)].join("|");
        if (seen[key]) { dupDeleteIds.add(m.id); dupPairs.push({ keep: seen[key].name, del: m.name, price: m.price }); }
        else seen[key] = m;
      });
      const surviving = menu.filter(m => !dupDeleteIds.has(m.id));
      const nameFixes = [], descFixes = [];
      surviving.forEach(m => {
        const newName = normalizeDishName(m.name);
        if (newName && newName !== m.name) nameFixes.push({ id: m.id, from: m.name, to: newName });
        const newDesc = normalizeDesc(m.desc, newName || m.name);
        if (newDesc !== (m.desc || "")) descFixes.push({ id: m.id, from: m.desc || "(empty)", to: newDesc });
      });
      const imgTargets = surviving.filter(m => !isOwnImage(m.image)).map(m => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name, category: m.category }));
      setFixReport({ dupPairs, dupDeleteIds: [...dupDeleteIds], nameFixes, descFixes, imgTargets });
      setFixState("report");
    } catch (e) { alert("âŒ Scan fail: " + e.message); setFixState(null); }
  };
  const applyFix = async () => {
    if (!fixReport) return;
    const { dupDeleteIds, nameFixes, descFixes, imgTargets } = fixReport;
    const totalSteps = dupDeleteIds.length + nameFixes.length + descFixes.length + imgTargets.length;
    if (!window.confirm(`Final fix:\nâ€¢ ${dupDeleteIds.length} duplicates delete\nâ€¢ ${nameFixes.length} naam fix\nâ€¢ ${descFixes.length} description fix\nâ€¢ ${imgTargets.length} photo fetch\n\nBackup pehle save hoga. Continue?`)) return;
    setFixState("applying");
    setFixProgress({ done: 0, total: totalSteps, msg: "Backup save..." });
    try {
      try { localStorage.setItem("menu_backup_" + Date.now(), JSON.stringify({ at: Date.now(), menu })); } catch (e) {}
      try { const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify({ at: Date.now(), menu }, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" })); a.download = `menu-backup-${Date.now()}.json`; a.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 3000); } catch (e) {}
      const delSet = new Set(dupDeleteIds);
      const nameMap = Object.fromEntries(nameFixes.map(n => [n.id, n.to]));
      const descMap = Object.fromEntries(descFixes.map(n => [n.id, n.to]));
      let working = menu.filter(m => !delSet.has(m.id)).map(m => { let o = { ...m }; if (nameMap[m.id]) o.name = nameMap[m.id]; if (descMap[m.id]) o.desc = descMap[m.id]; return o; });
      let done = dupDeleteIds.length + nameFixes.length + descFixes.length;
      setFixProgress({ done, total: totalSteps, msg: "Photos fetch..." });
      for (let i = 0; i < imgTargets.length; i++) {
        const t = imgTargets[i];
        setFixProgress({ done: done + i, total: totalSteps, msg: `ğŸ–¼ï¸ ${i + 1}/${imgTargets.length}: ${t.name}` });
        try {
          const wikiUrl = await wikiImage(t.name);
          if (wikiUrl) { const cdnUrl = await cloudinaryUpload(wikiUrl); if (cdnUrl) working = working.map(m => m.id === t.id ? { ...m, image: cdnUrl } : m); }
        } catch (e) { console.warn("skip:", t.name); }
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
      }
      setFixProgress({ done: totalSteps, total: totalSteps, msg: "Firestore save..." });
      await setDoc(doc(db, "settings", "menu"), { items: working });
      setMenuState(working);
      setFixState("done");
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); alert("âŒ Apply fail: " + e.message); setFixState("report"); }
  };
  const closeFix = () => { setFixState(null); setFixReport(null); setFixProgress({ done: 0, total: 0, msg: "" }); };


  const saveAppSetting = async (patch) => {
    setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...patch }));
    try { await setDoc(doc(db, "settings", "appSettings"), patch, { merge: true }); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); alert("âš ï¸ Save nahi hua. Internet check karo."); }
  };
  const toggleVegMode = () => saveAppSetting({ vegMode: !settings?.vegMode });
  const toggleCategory = (c) => saveAppSetting({
    hiddenCategories: hiddenCats.includes(c) ? hiddenCats.filter((x) => x !== c) : [...hiddenCats, c]
  });

                <button onClick={() => { const nt = prompt("Title:", off.title); if (nt !== null) { const nd = prompt("Desc:", off.desc); if (nd !== null) { addOffer({ ...off, title: nt.trim(), desc: nd.trim() }); } } }} style={{ background: COLORS.copperLight, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.copper}`, color: COLORS.copperDark, padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 10, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>âœï¸</button>
                <button onClick={() => removeOffer(off.id)} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 10, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 800 }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </>
      )}

      

      {tab === "orders" && (
        <div style={{ overflowX: "auto", borderRadius: 16, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
          <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", fontSize: 14, background: "#fff" }}>
            <thead><tr style={{ textAlign: "left", background: COLORS.paper }}><th style={th}>Time</th><th style={th}>Table</th><th style={th}>Items</th><th style={th}>Total</th><th style={th}>Payment</th><th style={th}>Action</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {[...filteredOrders].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt).map((o) => (
                <tr key={o.id} style={{ opacity: o.status === "cancelled" ? 0.5 : 1 }}>
                  <td style={{ ...td, color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 600 }}>{new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</td>
                  <td style={td}>{o.orderType === "parcel" ? <Badge color={COLORS.copper}>Parcel</Badge> : <strong>T-{o.table}</strong>}{o.status === "cancelled" && <span style={{ color: COLORS.error, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, display: 'block' }}>âŒ Cancelled</span>}</td>
                  <td style={td}>{o.items.map((it) => `${it.qty}Ã—${it.name}`).join(", ")}</td>
                  <td style={{ ...td, fontWeight: 700 }}>{inr(getOrderTotal(o))}</td>
                  <td style={td}>{o.payment || "cash"}<span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: o.paid ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.textLight, display: 'block' }}>{o.paid ? "âœ…" : "â³"}</span></td>
                  <td style={td}><button onClick={() => markPaid(o.id, o.paid && !o.coinsClaimed ? true : !o.paid)} style={{ border: `1.5px solid ${o.paid ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.line}`, background: o.paid ? COLORS.sage : "transparent", color: o.paid ? "#fff" : COLORS.ink, borderRadius: 10, padding: "6px 14px", fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 700 }}>{o.paid ? (o.coinsClaimed ? "âœ“ Paid" : "ğŸª™ Award coins") : "Mark paid"}</button></td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

            {tab === "bookings" && (
        <div style={{ overflowX: "auto", borderRadius: 16, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
          <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", fontSize: 14, background: "#fff" }}>
            <thead><tr style={{ background: COLORS.paper }}><th style={th}>Type</th><th style={th}>Details</th><th style={th}>Date</th><th style={th}>Action</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {bookings.map(b => (
                <tr key={b.id}>
                  <td style={td}>{b.type === "party" ? "ğŸ‰ Party" : "ğŸ½ï¸ Table"}</td>
                  <td style={td}><strong>{b.name}</strong><br />{b.phone}<br />{b.guests} Guests</td>
                  <td style={td}>{b.date} at {b.time}</td>
                  <td style={td}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      <a 
                        href={`https://wa.me/91${b.phone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(
                          `Hello ${b.name}! ğŸ½ï¸\n\nAapki ${b.type === "party" ? "Party" : "Table"} booking confirm ho gayi hai.\n\nğŸ“… Date: ${b.date}\nâ° Time: ${b.time}\nğŸ‘¥ Guests: ${b.guests}\n\nEat & Park mein aapka swagat hai! ğŸ‰`
                        )}`}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        style={{ 
                          background: '#25D366', color: '#fff', 
                          padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, 
                          textDecoration: 'none', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12,
                          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4
                        }}
                      >
                        âœ… Confirm
                      </a>
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => deleteBooking(b.id)} 
                        style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}
                      >
                        Delete
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === "promotions" && (
        <>
          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>âš¡ Flash Sale</h3>
          {flashSaleItems.map((item, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <select value={item.id}
                  onChange={e => { const m = menu.find(x => x.id === e.target.value); if (m) setFlashSaleItems(patchAt(flashSaleItems, idx, { id: m.id, name: m.name, price: m.price })); }}
                  style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2, minWidth: 200 }}>
                  {!menu.some(m => m.id === item.id) && <option value={item.id}>âš ï¸ {item.name} (menu mein nahi)</option>}
                  {menu.map(m => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.name}{m.portion ? ` (${m.portion})` : ""} â€” â‚¹{m.price}</option>)}
                </select>
                <input type="number" placeholder="Sale â‚¹" value={item.discountPrice} onChange={e => setFlashSaleItems(patchAt(flashSaleItems, idx, { discountPrice: Number(e.target.value) }))} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 100 }} />
                <input type="number" placeholder="Stock" value={item.stock} onChange={e => setFlashSaleItems(patchAt(flashSaleItems, idx, { stock: Number(e.target.value) }))} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 90 }} />
                <button onClick={() => setFlashSaleItems(patchAt(flashSaleItems, idx, { active: !item.active }))} style={{ background: item.active ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.error, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{item.active ? 'âœ… Active' : 'âŒ Inactive'}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Delete?')) setFlashSaleItems(flashSaleItems.filter((_, i) => i !== idx)); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button onClick={() => {
            const m = menu[0]; if (!m) return;
            setFlashSaleItems([...flashSaleItems, { id: m.id, name: m.name, price: m.price, discountPrice: Math.round(m.price * 0.8), stock: 10, active: true }]);
          }} style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: COLORS.sage, marginBottom: 30 }}>+ Add Flash Item</button>

          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>ğŸ¯ Combo Offers</h3>
          {comboOffers.map((combo, idx) => {
            const broken = !combo.items?.every(it => menu.some(m => m.id === it.id));
            return (
              <div key={idx} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${broken ? COLORS.error : COLORS.line}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
                {broken && <div style={{ color: COLORS.error, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 8 }}>âš ï¸ Is combo ke kuch items menu mein nahi hain â€” customers ko dikhega nahi. Delete karke naya banao.</div>}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <input value={combo.name} onChange={e => setComboOffers(patchAt(comboOffers, idx, { name: e.target.value }))} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2 }} />
                  <input type="number" value={combo.discount} onChange={e => { const d = Number(e.target.value); setComboOffers(patchAt(comboOffers, idx, { discount: d, finalPrice: Math.round(combo.totalPrice * (1 - d / 100)) })); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 100 }} />
                  <input value={combo.image} onChange={e => setComboOffers(patchAt(comboOffers, idx, { image: e.target.value }))} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 80 }} />
                  <button onClick={() => setComboOffers(patchAt(comboOffers, idx, { active: !combo.active }))} style={{ background: combo.active ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.error, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{combo.active ? 'âœ…' : 'âŒ'}</button>
                  <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Delete?')) setComboOffers(comboOffers.filter((_, i) => i !== idx)); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Delete</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
          <button onClick={() => {
            const picks = menu.slice(0, 2); if (picks.length === 0) return;
            const total = picks.reduce((s, m) => s + m.price, 0);
            setComboOffers([...comboOffers, {
              id: 'combo' + Date.now(), name: 'New Combo',
              items: picks.map(m => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name, price: m.price, quantity: 1 })),
              totalPrice: total, discount: 10, finalPrice: Math.round(total * 0.9), image: 'ğŸ½ï¸', active: true
            }]);
          }} style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: COLORS.gold, marginBottom: 20 }}>+ Add Combo</button>
          <button onClick={savePromotions} style={{ ...primaryBtn, width: '100%' }}>ğŸ’¾ Save All</button>
        </>
      )}
      {false /* legacy promotions UI removed */ && (
        <>
          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>âš¡ Flash Sale</h3>
          {flashSaleItems.map((item, idx) => (
            <div key={item.id} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <input value={item.name} onChange={e => { const u = [...flashSaleItems]; u[idx].name = e.target.value; setFlashSaleItems(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2 }} />
                <input type="number" value={item.discountPrice} onChange={e => { const u = [...flashSaleItems]; u[idx].discountPrice = Number(e.target.value); setFlashSaleItems(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 100 }} />
                <input type="number" value={item.stock} onChange={e => { const u = [...flashSaleItems]; u[idx].stock = Number(e.target.value); setFlashSaleItems(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 80 }} />
                <button onClick={() => { const u = [...flashSaleItems]; u[idx].active = !u[idx].active; setFlashSaleItems(u); }} style={{ background: item.active ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.error, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{item.active ? 'âœ… Active' : 'âŒ Inactive'}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Delete?')) setFlashSaleItems(flashSaleItems.filter((_, i) => i !== idx)); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button onClick={() => setFlashSaleItems([...flashSaleItems, { id: 'flash' + Date.now(), name: 'New', price: 0, discountPrice: 0, stock: 0, active: true }])} style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: COLORS.sage, marginBottom: 30 }}>+ Add Flash Item</button>

          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>ğŸ¯ Combo Offers</h3>
          {comboOffers.map((combo, idx) => (
            <div key={combo.id} style={{ background: '#fff', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <input value={combo.name} onChange={e => { const u = [...comboOffers]; u[idx].name = e.target.value; setComboOffers(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2 }} />
                <input type="number" value={combo.discount} onChange={e => { const u = [...comboOffers]; u[idx].discount = Number(e.target.value); u[idx].finalPrice = Math.round(u[idx].totalPrice * (1 - u[idx].discount / 100)); setComboOffers(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 100 }} />
                <input value={combo.image} onChange={e => { const u = [...comboOffers]; u[idx].image = e.target.value; setComboOffers(u); }} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 80 }} />
                <button onClick={() => { const u = [...comboOffers]; u[idx].active = !u[idx].active; setComboOffers(u); }} style={{ background: combo.active ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.error, color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700 }}>{combo.active ? 'âœ…' : 'âŒ'}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('Delete?')) setComboOffers(comboOffers.filter((_, i) => i !== idx)); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button onClick={() => setComboOffers([...comboOffers, { id: 'combo' + Date.now(), name: 'New Combo', items: [{ id: 'f2', name: 'Pizza', price: 280, quantity: 1 }], totalPrice: 280, discount: 10, finalPrice: 252, image: 'ğŸ½ï¸', active: true }])} style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: COLORS.gold, marginBottom: 20 }}>+ Add Combo</button>
          <button onClick={savePromotions} style={{ ...primaryBtn, width: '100%' }}>ğŸ’¾ Save All</button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const ProgressRing = memo(({ progress, size = 60, strokeWidth = 3 }) => {
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * ((size - strokeWidth) / 2);
  const offset = circumference - (progress / 100) * circumference;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size}>
      <g transform={`rotate(-90 ${size / 2} ${size / 2})`}>
        <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={(size - strokeWidth) / 2}
          fill="none" stroke={COLORS.line} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
        <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={(size - strokeWidth) / 2}
          fill="none" stroke={COLORS.sage} strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
          strokeDasharray={circumference} strokeDashoffset={offset}
          style={{ transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 0.5s ease' }} />
      </g>
      <text x="50%" y="50%" textAnchor="middle" dy="0.35em"
        fontSize="16" fontWeight="700" fill={COLORS.sage}>
        {progress}%
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
});

const OrderTimer = memo(({ createdAt, servedAt, status, estimatedTime }) => {
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === 'served' || status === 'delivered' || status === 'completed') {
      if (servedAt) setElapsed(Math.floor((servedAt - createdAt) / 1000));
      return;
    }
    if (status === 'cancelled') return;
    const t = setInterval(() => setElapsed(Math.floor((Date.now() - createdAt) / 1000)), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [createdAt, servedAt, status]);
  const minutes = Math.floor(elapsed / 60); const seconds = elapsed % 60; const isOvertime = elapsed > (estimatedTime * 60) && status !== 'served' && status !== 'delivered' && status !== 'completed';
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, padding: '8px 12px', background: isOvertime ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)' : COLORS.sageLight, borderRadius: 10, borderLeft: `3px solid ${isOvertime ? COLORS.error : COLORS.sage}` }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, color: isOvertime ? COLORS.error : COLORS.sageDark }}>â±ï¸ {minutes}:{seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 600 }}>/ {estimatedTime}m</span>
    </div>
  );
});

async function setOrderOnce(order) {
  const ref = doc(db, "orders", order.id);
  try { const ex = await getDoc(ref); if (ex.exists()) return; } catch (e) {}
  await setDoc(ref, order);
}

function authMsg(e) {
  const c = (e && e.code) || "";
  const m = {
    "auth/operation-not-allowed": "Login system band hai (Firebase > Authentication > Anonymous ON karo)",
    "auth/admin-restricted-operation": "Login system band hai (Firebase > Authentication > Anonymous ON karo)",
    "auth/network-request-failed": "Internet/network dikkat. Dobara try karo",
    "auth/web-storage-unsupported": "Is browser me storage band hai. Chrome/Safari me link kholo",
    "auth/unauthorized-domain": "Ye website Firebase Authorized domains me nahi hai",
    "auth/too-many-requests": "Bahut try ho gaye, thodi der baad try karo",
    "permission-denied": "Order allow nahi hua (Firestore rules) - staff ko batao"
  };
  return "Order fail: " + (m[c] || c || (e && e.message) || "unknown");
}
let _anonInFlight = null;
async function ensureUser() {
  try { await Promise.race([authReady, new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 8000))]); } catch (e) {}
  await setPersistence(auth, browserLocalPersistence); // Ye line add karo
  if (auth.currentUser) return auth.currentUser;
  if (!_anonInFlight) {
    _anonInFlight = (async () => {
      let lastErr;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        try { return (await signInAnonymously(auth)).user; }
        catch (e) { lastErr = e; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600 * (i + 1))); }
      }
      throw lastErr;
    })().finally(() => { _anonInFlight = null; });
  }
  return _anonInFlight;
}

  const advanceStatus = async (orderId, currentStatus) => {
    const order = orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
    if (order && order.orderType === "parcel" && currentStatus === "ready") {
      alert("Parcel order delivery boy handle karega. Aap ise 'Delivered' mark nahi kar sakte.");
      return;
    }
    const idx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(currentStatus);
    const nextStatus = STATUS_FLOW[Math.min(idx + 1, STATUS_FLOW.length - 1)];
    if (nextStatus === currentStatus) return;
    const updateData = { status: nextStatus, ...(nextStatus === "served" ? { servedAt: Date.now() } : {}) };
    if (order?.kots?.length) {
      updateData.kots = order.kots.map(k => (k.status === currentStatus ? { ...k, status: nextStatus } : k));
    }
    setOrdersState(prev => prev.map(o => (o.id === orderId ? { ...o, ...updateData } : o)));
    try {
      await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
        const ref = doc(db, "orders", orderId);
        const snap = await tx.get(ref);
        if (!snap.exists()) return;
        const cur = snap.data();
        if (cur.status === "cancelled") return;
        if (cur.status !== currentStatus) throw new Error("STALE_STATUS"); // another screen already moved it
        const patch = { status: nextStatus, ...(nextStatus === "served" ? { servedAt: Date.now() } : {}) };
        if (cur.kots?.length) patch.kots = cur.kots.map(k => (k.status === currentStatus ? { ...k, status: nextStatus } : k));
        tx.update(ref, patch);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setOrdersState(prev => prev.map(o => (o.id === orderId ? { ...o, status: currentStatus, ...(order?.kots ? { kots: order.kots } : {}) } : o)));
      alert(String(e && e.message).includes("STALE_STATUS") ? "âš ï¸ Ye order kisi aur screen se pehle hi aage badh chuka hai." : "âš ï¸ Status update fail hua. Dobara try karo.");

    setOrdersState(orders.map(o => o.id === orderId ? { ...o, ...updateData } : o));

 const markPaid = async (orderId, paid) => {
  try {
    await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
      const orderRef = doc(db, "orders", orderId);
      const orderSnap = await tx.get(orderRef);
      if (!orderSnap.exists()) throw new Error("Order not found");
      if (orderSnap.data().status === "cancelled") throw new Error("Order cancelled hai");

      const order = orderSnap.data();

      // Agar already paid mark ho chuka hai toh skip
      if (paid && order.coinsClaimed) {
        tx.update(orderRef, { paid: true });
        return;
      }

      if (paid) {
const earned = Math.floor(getOrderTotal(order) / (Number(loyaltyRules?.rate) || 10));

        const used = Math.max(0, Number(order.rewardUsedCoins) || 0);
        const phone = order.customer?.phone;

        if (phone && phone.length >= 10) {
          const userRef = doc(db, "loyaltyUsers", phone);
          const userSnap = await tx.get(userRef);
          const curCoins = userSnap.exists() ? (userSnap.data().coins || 0) : 0;
          if (used > curCoins) throw new Error("Customer ke paas itne coins nahi - reward claim galat hai");
          const newCoins = Math.max(0, curCoins + earned - used);

          if (userSnap.exists()) {
            tx.update(userRef, { coins: newCoins });
          } else {
            tx.set(userRef, { phone, name: order.customer?.name || "Guest", coins: newCoins });
          }
        }
        tx.update(orderRef, { paid: true, coinsClaimed: true });
      } else {
        tx.update(orderRef, { paid: false });
      }
    });

    // Transaction ke baad history alag se likho (idempotent check)
    // Note: yahan hum fresh data use kar rahe hain, aur agar `coinHistory` mein
    // duplicate add ho raha ho to coinsClaimed flag ke through ruk jayega
    const order = orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
    const alreadyClaimed = order && order.coinsClaimed;
    if (paid && order && !alreadyClaimed) {
      const phone = order.customer?.phone;
      const earned = order.earnedCoins || 0;
      const used = order.rewardUsedCoins || 0;
      if (phone && phone.length >= 10) {
        if (earned > 0) {
          await addDoc(collection(db, "coinHistory"), {
            phone, coins: earned,
            reason: `Order #${order.id.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}`,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          });
        }
        if (used > 0) {
          await addDoc(collection(db, "coinHistory"), {
            phone, coins: -used,
            reason: `Redeemed #${order.id.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}`,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          });
        }
        setLoyaltyUsers(prev => {
          const ex = prev.find(u => u.phone === phone);
          const newCoins = Math.max(0, (ex?.coins || 0) + earned - used);
          if (ex) return prev.map(u => u.phone === phone ? { ...u, coins: newCoins } : u);
          return [...prev, { phone, name: order.customer?.name || "Guest", coins: newCoins }];
        });
      }
    }

    setOrdersState(prev => prev.map(o =>
      o.id === orderId ? { ...o, paid, coinsClaimed: paid ? true : o.coinsClaimed } : o
    ));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("markPaid error:", e);
    alert("âš ï¸ Payment update failed: " + (e.message || "unknown"));
  }
};

  const bookEvent = async (booking) => { await setDoc(doc(db, "bookings", booking.id), booking); };

  const cancelOrderByStaff = async (orderId) => {
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", orderId), { status: "cancelled", cancelledAt: Date.now(), cancelledBy: "staff" }); addDoc(collection(db, "auditLogs"), { orderId, action: "cancel", by: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || "?", at: Date.now() }).catch(() => {});  } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (<div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", background: COLORS.paper, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 18, color: COLORS.copper }}>ğŸ½ï¸ Loading Eat & Park POS...</div>);
  }

  return (
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <div className={isDark ? "dark-theme" : ""} style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: "var(--bg-color, #FAFAF8)", color: COLORS.ink, fontFamily: "'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif" }}>
        <style>{FONTS}</style>
        {!online && (<div style={{ position: "fixed", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, zIndex: 9999, background: COLORS.error, color: "#fff", textAlign: "center", padding: "6px 8px", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13 }}>ğŸ“µ Internet nahi hai â€” order / KOT abhi nahi jayega</div>)}
        <div className="app-content">
  
  
  {role === "customer" && <ErrorBoundary key="cust"><CustomerView menu={currentMenu} orders={orders} placeOrder={placeOrder} bookEvent={bookEvent} gallery={gallery} offersList={offersList} table={table} setTable={setTable} requestPinPrompt={requestPinPrompt} settings={settings} isDark={isDark} setIsDark={setIsDark} requestWaiter={requestWaiter} loyaltyRules={loyaltyRules} loyaltyUsers={loyaltyUsers} coinHistory={coinHistory} setOrdersState={setOrdersState} categories={currentCategories} flashSaleItems={validFlashSaleItems} comboOffers={validComboOffers} setMenuState={setMenuState} setLoyaltyRules={saveLoyaltyRules} advanceStatus={advanceStatus} /></ErrorBoundary>}
  
  {role === "staff" && <ErrorBoundary key="staff"><StaffView menu={currentMenu} orders={orders} placeOrder={placeOrder} categories={currentCategories} setMenuState={setMenuState} advanceStatus={advanceStatus} requestPinPrompt={requestPinPrompt} calls={calls} resolveCall={resolveCall} cancelOrderByStaff={cancelOrderByStaff} /></ErrorBoundary>}
  
  {role === "admin" && <ErrorBoundary key="admin"><AdminView dussehraMenu={dussehraMenu} saveDussehraMenu={saveDussehraMenu} menu={menu} unavail={unavail} toggleAvail={toggleAvail} setMenuState={setMenuState} bookings={bookings} orders={orders} markPaid={markPaid} requestPinPrompt={requestPinPrompt} inventory={inventory} addInventory={addInventory} updateStock={updateStock} deleteBooking={deleteBooking} offersList={offersList} addOffer={addOffer} removeOffer={removeOffer} loyaltyRules={loyaltyRules} setLoyaltyRules={saveLoyaltyRules} loyaltyUsers={loyaltyUsers} settings={settings} setSettings={setSettings} gallery={gallery} setGallery={setGallery} categories={categories} updateCategories={updateCategories} flashSaleItems={flashSaleItems} setFlashSaleItems={setFlashSaleItems} comboOffers={comboOffers} setComboOffers={setComboOffers} savePromotions={savePromotions} /></ErrorBoundary>}
  
  {/* (Removed unreachable fallback â€” role is always one of customer/staff/admin) */}
</div>
        {showPinModal && (
          <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)", backdropFilter: "blur(4px)", zIndex: 999, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }} onClick={() => setShowPinModal(false)}>
            <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ background: "#fff", padding: "28px", borderRadius: 20, width: "90%", maxWidth: 340, textAlign: "center" }} className="slide-up">
              <div style={{ fontSize: 36, marginBottom: 16 }}>ğŸ”’</div>
              <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 20px", fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700 }}>Login ({targetRole.toUpperCase()})</h3>
              <input type="email" placeholder="Email" value={emailInput} onChange={(e) => setEmailInput(e.target.value)} style={{ padding: "14px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 16, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", marginBottom: 12 }} />
              <input type="password" placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢" autoFocus value={pinInput} onChange={(e) => setPinInput(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handlePinSubmit(); }} style={{ padding: "16px", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 32, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", textAlign: "center", letterSpacing: 12, marginBottom: 24, fontWeight: 800 }} />
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 12 }}>
                <button onClick={() => { setShowPinModal(false); setPinInput(""); }} style={{ flex: 1, padding: "14px", borderRadius: 12, border: `2px solid ${COLORS.line}`, background: "transparent", fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>Cancel</button>
                <button onClick={handlePinSubmit} style={{ flex: 1, padding: "14px", borderRadius: 12, background: COLORS.ink, color: "#fff", border: "none", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}>Login</button>
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, marginTop: 16 }}></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import { db, auth } from "./firebase";
import { signInWithEmailAndPassword, signOut, onAuthStateChanged, setPersistence, browserLocalPersistence } from "firebase/auth";
import { collection, query, where, onSnapshot, doc, updateDoc, getDoc } from "firebase/firestore";

const timeAgo = (ts) => {
  if (!ts) return "";
  const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts) / 1000);
  if (s < 60) return s + "s ago";
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  if (m < 60) return m + "m ago";
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
  if (h < 24) return h + "h ago";
  return Math.floor(h / 24) + "d ago";
};

const alertAudio = new Audio("https://assets.mixkit.co/active_storage/sfx/2869/2869-preview.mp3");
alertAudio.volume = 1.0;

export default function DeliveryApp() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [loginError, setLoginError] = useState("");
  
  const [activeOrders, setActiveOrders] = useState([]);
  const [historyOrders, setHistoryOrders] = useState([]);
  
  const [page, setPage] = useState("orders"); // orders | dashboard | history
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedOrder, setSelectedOrder] = useState(null);

  const prevOrdersRef = useRef([]);
  const isFirstLoad = useRef(true);

  // Unlock audio on first user interaction
  useEffect(() => {
    const unlock = () => {
      alertAudio.play().then(() => {
        alertAudio.pause();
        alertAudio.currentTime = 0;
      }).catch(() => {});
      document.removeEventListener("click", unlock);
      document.removeEventListener("touchstart", unlock);
    };
    document.addEventListener("click", unlock);
    document.addEventListener("touchstart", unlock);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("click", unlock);
      document.removeEventListener("touchstart", unlock);
    };
  }, []);

  // Auth Check
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (u) => {
      if (u) {
        try {
          const s = await getDoc(doc(db, "staff", u.uid));
          if (s.exists() && s.data().role === "delivery") {
            setUser(u);
          } else {
            await signOut(auth);
            setLoginError("Ye account delivery boy ka nahi hai.");
          }
        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      } else { setUser(null); }
      setLoading(false);
    });
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);

  // Fetch Orders
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    const q = query(collection(db, "orders"), where("orderType", "==", "parcel"));
    const unsub = onSnapshot(q, (snap) => {
      const all = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
      
      // Strict Filter: Sirf valid delivery orders (No Walk-ins, No missing address/phone)
      const validOrders = all.filter(o => 
        o.status !== "cancelled" &&
        o.customer?.name && o.customer.name !== "Walk-in" &&
        o.customer?.phone && o.customer?.phone.length >= 10 &&
        (o.customer?.exactAddress || o.customer?.address)
      );

      const active = validOrders
        .filter(o => o.status !== "served")
        .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
      
      // ğŸ”” Notification Alert Logic
      if (!isFirstLoad.current) {
        const newOrders = active.filter(o => !prevOrdersRef.current.includes(o.id));
        if (newOrders.length > 0) {
          try {
            alertAudio.currentTime = 0;
            alertAudio.play().catch(e => console.log("Audio blocked", e));
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([200, 100, 200, 100, 500]);
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }
      
      prevOrdersRef.current = active.map(o => o.id);
      isFirstLoad.current = false;
      
      setActiveOrders(active);

      const hist = validOrders
        .filter(o => o.status === "served" && (!o.deliveredBy || o.deliveredBy === user.email || o.deliveredBy === user.uid))
        .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
        .slice(0, 50);
      setHistoryOrders(hist);
    });
    return () => unsub();
  }, [user]);

  // Stats for Dashboard
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const today = new Date().setHours(0,0,0,0);
    const myHist = historyOrders.filter(o => o.deliveredAt >= today);
    const cash = myHist.reduce((s, o) => s + (Number(o.finalTotal) || 0), 0);
    return { count: myHist.length, cash };
  }, [historyOrders]);

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoginError("");
    try { 
      await setPersistence(auth, browserLocalPersistence);
      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email.trim(), password); 
    }
    catch (err) { setLoginError("Email ya password galat hai."); }
  };

  const markOutForDelivery = async (orderId) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Kya aapne restaurant se order pick up kar liya hai?")) return;
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", orderId), { status: "out_for_delivery" });

  const markDelivered = async (orderId) => {

    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", orderId), {
        status: "served",
        paid: true,
        paymentStatus: "paid",
        deliveredAt: Date.now(),
        deliveredBy: user.email || user.uid

    } catch (e) { alert("Error: " + e.message); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div style={{ padding: 50, textAlign: "center", color: "#fff", background: "#0B111A", minHeight: "100vh" }}>Loading...</div>;

            {loginError && <div style={{ color: "#EF4444", fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 10 }}>{loginError}</div>}
            <button type="submit" style={{ width: "100%", padding: 14, borderRadius: 10, background: "#F59E0B", color: "#fff", border: "none", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, cursor: "pointer" }}>Login</button>

            â˜°

          <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 18 }}>Delivery Panel</div>

      {/* SIDEBAR / DRAWER */}
      {menuOpen && (

          <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ width: 260, background: "#161F2F", height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", padding: 20, animation: "slideInLeft 0.2s ease-out" }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, marginBottom: 30, paddingBottom: 20, borderBottom: "1px solid #273449" }}>
              <div style={{ width: 45, height: 45, background: "#F59E0B", borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", fontSize: 20, color: "#fff" }}>ğŸ›µ</div>
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 15 }}>{user.email.split('@')[0]}</div>

"#273449" : "transparent", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, color: page === "orders" ? "#F59E0B" : "#fff", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

"#273449" : "transparent", border: "none", borderRadius: 10, color: page === "dashboard" ? "#F59E0B" : "#fff", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>ğŸ“Š</span> Dashboard

                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8B9BB4", fontWeight: 700 }}>Cash Collected</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 900, color: "#F59E0B", marginTop: 4 }}>â‚¹{stats.cash}</div>
              </div>

          </div>
        )}

        {/* ORDERS LIST PAGE (Active/History) */}
        {page !== "dashboard" && (
          <>
            <h2 style={{ fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 15, color: "#fff" }}>
              {page === "orders" ? "Active Orders" : "Recent Deliveries"}
            </h2>
            
            {ordersToShow.length === 0 && (
              <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 50, color: "#8B9BB4" }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 10 }}>ğŸ˜´</div>
                <div>{page === "orders" ? "Koi naya order nahi hai." : "Abhi tak kuch deliver nahi kiya."}</div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 12 }}>
              {ordersToShow.map(o => (
                <div key={o.id} onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(o)} style={{ background: "#161F2F", border: "1px solid #273449", padding: 14, borderRadius: 14, cursor: "pointer", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", boxShadow: "0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)" }}>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 900, color: "#F59E0B", fontSize: 15 }}>#{o.id.slice(1,5).toUpperCase()}</span>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#8B9BB4", background: "#273449", padding: "2px 6px", borderRadius: 4 }}>
                        {o.status === "out_for_delivery" ? "ON THE WAY" : o.status === "ready" ? "READY TO PICK" : o.status === "preparing" ? "COOKING" : "NEW ORDER"}
                      </span>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#8B9BB4" }}>{timeAgo(o.createdAt)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, color: "#fff", marginBottom: 4 }}>{o.customer?.name}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8B9BB4", whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", maxWidth: 220 }}>
                      ğŸ“ {o.customer?.exactAddress || o.customer?.address}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ textAlign: "right", marginLeft: 10 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 18, color: o.paid ? "#10B981" : "#F59E0B" }}>â‚¹{o.finalTotal}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: o.paid ? "#10B981" : "#F59E0B", marginTop: 2, fontWeight: 700, background: o.paid ? "rgba(16,185,129,0.15)" : "rgba(245,158,11,0.15)", padding: "2px 6px", borderRadius: 4 }}>
                      {o.paid ? "PAID" : "COLLECT"}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ORDER DETAILS MODAL */}
      {selectedOrder && (
        <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)", zIndex: 100, display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
          <div style={{ background: "#161F2F", width: "100%", maxWidth: 600, margin: "0 auto", borderRadius: "24px 24px 0 0", padding: 20, maxHeight: "92vh", overflowY: "auto", animation: "slideUp 0.3s ease-out" }}>
            
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 15 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 900 }}>Order #{selectedOrder.id.slice(1,5).toUpperCase()}</div>
              <button onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(null)} style={{ background: "#273449", border: "none", color: "#fff", width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 16, fontSize: 16, cursor: "pointer" }}>âœ•</button>
            </div>

            {/* CUSTOMER DETAILS */}
            <div style={{ background: "#0B111A", padding: 15, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 15 }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 5 }}>{selectedOrder.customer?.name}</div>
              <div style={{ color: "#8B9BB4", marginBottom: 10, fontWeight: 700 }}>ğŸ“ {selectedOrder.customer?.phone}</div>
              <div style={{ color: "#fff", marginBottom: 15, lineHeight: 1.4, fontSize: 14 }}>
                ğŸ“ {selectedOrder.customer?.exactAddress} {selectedOrder.customer?.pincode ? "(PIN: " + selectedOrder.customer.pincode + ")" : ""}
              </div>

                {selectedOrder.customer?.address?.includes("Lat:") && (
                  <button onClick={() => {
                    const match = selectedOrder.customer.address.match(/Lat: ([\d.-]+), Lng: ([\d.-]+)/);
                    if (match) window.open("https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=" + match[1] + "," + match[2], "_blank");
                  }} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 12, background: "#3B82F6", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer" }}>
                    ğŸ—ºï¸ Open Maps
                  </button>
                )}
                <a href={"tel:" + selectedOrder.customer?.phone} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 12, background: "#10B981", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14, textAlign: "center", textDecoration: "none" }}>
                  ğŸ“ Call Customer
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ITEMS */}
            <div style={{ background: "#0B111A", padding: 15, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 20 }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, marginBottom: 10, color: "#8B9BB4", fontSize: 12 }}>ORDER ITEMS</div>
              {selectedOrder.items?.map((it, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 8, fontSize: 14 }}>
                  <span>{it.qty}x {it.name}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>â‚¹{it.price * it.qty}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div style={{ borderTop: "1px dashed #273449", margin: "10px 0", paddingTop: 10, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 18 }}>
                <span>Total</span>
                <span style={{ color: selectedOrder.paid ? "#10B981" : "#F59E0B" }}>â‚¹{selectedOrder.finalTotal}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ACTION BUTTONS */}
            {selectedOrder.status !== "served" ? (
              <>
                {/* STATUS: READY - Pickup Button */}
                {selectedOrder.status === "ready" && (
                  <button onClick={() => markOutForDelivery(selectedOrder.id)} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 16, background: "#F59E0B", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 16, cursor: "pointer", marginBottom: 10, boxShadow: "0 4px 12px rgba(245,158,11,0.3)" }}>
                    ğŸ›µ Mark Out for Delivery
                  </button>
                )}

                {/* STATUS: OUT FOR DELIVERY - Deliver Button */}
                {selectedOrder.status === "out_for_delivery" && (
                  <button onClick={() => markDelivered(selectedOrder.id)} style={{ width: "100%", padding: 16, background: "#10B981", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 16, cursor: "pointer", boxShadow: "0 4px 12px rgba(16,185,129,0.3)" }}>
                    âœ… Delivered & Collected â‚¹{selectedOrder.finalTotal}
                  </button>
                )}

                {/* STATUS: NEW OR PREPARING - Wait Message */}
                {(selectedOrder.status === "new" || selectedOrder.status === "preparing") && (
                  <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 16, background: "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)", border: "1px dashed #F59E0B", color: "#F59E0B", borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14 }}>
                    ğŸ‘¨â€ğŸ³ Kitchen me khana ban raha hai... Ready hone ka wait karein.
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 15, background: "#0A2A20", color: "#10B981", borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 800 }}>
                âœ… Ye order successfully deliver ho chuka hai
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ SAFE HELPERS ============
function getErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message) return error.message;
  if (typeof error === "string") return error;
  if (error && typeof error === "object" && "message" in error) {
    return String(error.message);
  }
  return "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.";
}
function isRefreshNeeded(error) {
  const msg = getErrorMessage(error);
  return msg === "REFRESH_NEEDED" || msg.includes("badal diya");
}
function safeStorageGet(key, fallback = null) {
  try {
    const v = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    return v === null ? fallback : v;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}
function safeStorageSet(key, value) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, String(value));
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
function safeStorageRemove(key) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function getRangeBounds(range, customDate) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (range === "today") { const d = new Date(); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now }; }
  if (range === "yesterday") { const s = new Date(); s.setDate(s.getDate()-1); s.setHours(0,0,0,0); const e = new Date(); e.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: s.getTime(), end: e.getTime() }; }
  if (range === "7days") { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate()-6); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now }; }
  if (range === "30days") { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate()-29); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now }; }
  if (range === "month") { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(1); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now }; }
  if (range === "custom" && customDate) { const start = new Date(customDate + "T00:00:00").getTime(); return { start, end: start + 86400000 }; }
  const d = new Date(); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return { start: d.getTime(), end: now };
}

function useHaptic() {
  return useCallback((ms = 10) => { try { if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(ms); } catch (e) {} }, []);
}
function useDebounce(value, delay = 150) {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delay);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, delay]);
  return debounced;
}
function useOnline() {
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.onLine : true);
  useEffect(() => {
    const up = () => setOnline(true), down = () => setOnline(false);
    window.addEventListener("online", up);
    window.addEventListener("offline", down);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("online", up); window.removeEventListener("offline", down); };
  }, []);
  return online;
}

const ToastCtx = createContext(null);
const useToast = () => useContext(ToastCtx)?.toast || (() => {});

function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const toast = useCallback((msg, type = "info", opts = {}) => {
    const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    setToasts(t => [...t, { id, msg, type, ...opts }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts(t => t.filter(x => x.id !== id)), opts.duration || 2800);
  }, []);
  return (
    <ToastCtx.Provider value={{ toast }}>
      {children}
      <div style={{ position: "fixed", top: 70, left: "50%", transform: "translateX(-50%)", zIndex: 9999, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 8, pointerEvents: "none", width: "calc(100% - 32px)", maxWidth: 420 }}>
        {toasts.map(t => {
          const bg = t.type === "success" ? "#16A34A" : t.type === "error" ? "#DC2626" : t.type === "warning" ? "#F59E0B" : "#111827";
          const icon = t.type === "success" ? "âœ…" : t.type === "error" ? "âš ï¸" : t.type === "warning" ? "â±ï¸" : "â„¹ï¸";
          return (
            <div key={t.id} style={{ background: bg, color: "#fff", padding: "12px 18px", borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, boxShadow: "0 10px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.22)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, animation: "slideInTop 0.22s ease-out", pointerEvents: "auto" }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>{icon}</span>
              <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{t.msg}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </ToastCtx.Provider>
  );
}

function Skeleton({ w, h = 20, r = 8, style }) {

function AnimatedNumber({ value, duration = 600, format = true }) {
  const [display, setDisplay] = useState(0);
  const prevRef = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const from = prevRef.current;
    const to = Number(value) || 0;
    const start = Date.now();
    let raf;
    const tick = () => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (Date.now() - start) / duration);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      setDisplay(Math.round(from + (to - from) * eased));
      if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else prevRef.current = to;
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [value, duration]);
  return <>{format ? inr(display) : display}</>;
}

function Confetti({ show, duration = 1500 }) {
  const [items] = useState(() => Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: i,
    left: Math.random() * 100,
    delay: Math.random() * 0.3,
    dur: 1 + Math.random() * 0.8,
    color: ["#DC2626", "#16A34A", "#F59E0B", "#2563EB", "#EC4899", "#8B5CF6"][i % 6],
    size: 6 + Math.random() * 8,
  })));
  if (!show) return null;
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, pointerEvents: "none", zIndex: 9999, overflow: "hidden" }}>
      {items.map(p => (
        <div key={p.id} style={{
          position: "absolute", left: p.left + "%", top: -20,
          width: p.size, height: p.size,
          background: p.color, borderRadius: "50%",
          animation: `confettiFall ${p.dur}s ease-out ${p.delay}s forwards`,
        }} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function ModalShell({ C, open, onClose, isMobile, title, icon, children, maxWidth = 400 }) {

  return (
    <div onClick={onClose} style={{
      position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)",
      backdropFilter: "blur(6px)", WebkitBackdropFilter: "blur(6px)",
      zIndex: 500, display: "flex",
      alignItems: isMobile ? "flex-end" : "center",
      justifyContent: "center", padding: isMobile ? 0 : 16,
      animation: "fadeIn 0.15s ease-out",
    }}>
      <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} style={{
        background: C.card, borderRadius: isMobile ? "20px 20px 0 0" : 16,
        padding: 24, width: "100%", maxWidth: isMobile ? "100%" : maxWidth,
        maxHeight: isMobile ? "92vh" : "88vh", overflowY: "auto",
        animation: isMobile ? "slideUp 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)" : "scaleIn 0.18s ease-out",
        boxShadow: "0 -8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)",
      }}>
        {isMobile && (
          <div style={{ width: 40, height: 4, background: C.line, borderRadius: 2, margin: "0 auto 16px" }} />
        )}
        {(title || icon) && (
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            {icon && <div style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>{icon}</div>}
            {title && <div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>{title}</div>}
          </div>
        )}
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

}
