// Staff wale POS ka hi logic â€” waiter ke liye
function POSController({ initialOrder, orders, menu, categories, viewMode, placeOrder, advanceStatus, setMenuState, onClose }) {
  const [init] = useState(() => deriveBill(initialOrder));
  const [billOrder, setBillOrder] = useState(initialOrder);
  const [items, setItems] = useState(init.items);
  const [gstRate, setGstRate] = useState(init.gstRate);
  const [gstCustom, setGstCustom] = useState("");
  const [disc, setDisc] = useState(init.disc);
  const [discPct, setDiscPct] = useState(init.discPct);
  const [payMode, setPayMode] = useState(init.payMode);
  const [payStatus, setPayStatus] = useState(init.payStatus);
  const [custName, setCustName] = useState(init.custName);
  const [custPhone, setCustPhone] = useState(init.custPhone);
  const [gstin, setGstin] = useState(init.gstin);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(init.notes);
  const [showBillNo, setShowBillNo] = useState(true);
  const [table, setTable] = useState(init.table);
  const [orderType, setOrderType] = useState(init.orderType);
  const [waiter, setWaiter] = useState(init.waiter);
  const [sendKot, setSendKot] = useState(init.sendKot);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // Dusra order kholna ho (table clash pe "Wahi kholo")
  const load = (o) => {
    const d = deriveBill(o);
    setBillOrder(o); setItems(d.items); setGstRate(d.gstRate); setGstCustom("");
    setDisc(d.disc); setDiscPct(d.discPct); setPayMode(d.payMode); setPayStatus(d.payStatus);
    setCustName(d.custName); setCustPhone(d.custPhone); setGstin(d.gstin); setNotes(d.notes);
    setTable(d.table); setOrderType(d.orderType); setWaiter(d.waiter); setSendKot(d.sendKot);
  };

  const calc = useMemo(() => {
    const sub = Math.round(items.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.price || 0) * (it.qty || 0), 0));
    const gr = gstRate === "custom" ? Number(gstCustom) || 0 : Number(gstRate) || 0;
    const discPctAmt = Math.round((sub * discPct) / 100);
    const afterPct = sub - discPctAmt;
    const gst = Math.round((afterPct * gr) / 100);
    const delivery = Number(billOrder.deliveryFee) || 0;
    const total = Math.max(0, afterPct - disc) + gst + delivery;
    return { sub, gstRate: gr, gst, discPctAmt, discAmt: disc, total, delivery };
  }, [billOrder, items, gstRate, gstCustom, disc, discPct]);

  const saveBill = async (override = {}) => {
    try {
      const { sub, gstRate: gr, gst, discPctAmt, discAmt, total } = calc;
      const updated = {
        items: items.map(({ _rowId, _new, _origQty, ...rest }) => (!billOrder.isDraft && _new ? { ...rest, kotNumber: getNextKotNo(billOrder) } : rest)),
        subtotal: sub, gstRate: gr, gstAmount: gst,
        billDiscount: discAmt, billDiscountPct: discPct, billDiscountAmt: discPctAmt,
        finalTotal: total, payment: payMode,
        paid: (override.payStatus ?? payStatus) === "paid",
        paymentStatus: override.payStatus ?? payStatus,
        customer: { ...(billOrder.customer || {}), name: custName || "Walk-in", phone: custPhone || "WALK-IN" },
        customerGstin: gstin || "", notes,
        billEditedAt: Date.now(),
        billEditedBy: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || "waiter"
      };
      const clean = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(updated));
      if (billOrder.isDraft) {
        const { isDraft, ...base } = billOrder;
        const kotItems = clean.items.map((it) => ({ ...it, kotNumber: 1 }));
        const fullOrder = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({
          ...base, ...clean,
          table: orderType === "parcel" ? 0 : table,
          orderType, waiter: waiter || "Staff", items: kotItems,
          kots: sendKot ? [{ id: uid("kot"), kotNumber: 1, items: kotItems, createdAt: Date.now(), status: "new", isRunning: false }] : [],
          status: sendKot ? "new" : "served",
          ...(sendKot ? {} : { servedAt: Date.now() })
        }));
        await placeOrder(fullOrder);
        return fullOrder;
      }
      const addedRows = items.map((it) => {
        if (it._new) return (it.qty || 0) > 0 ? it : null;
        const extra = (it.qty || 0) - (it._origQty ?? it.qty);
        return extra > 0 ? { ...it, qty: extra } : null;
      }).filter(Boolean);
      if (addedRows.length > 0) {
        const no = getNextKotNo(billOrder);
        const runKot = { id: uid("kot"), kotNumber: no, items: addedRows.map(({ _rowId, _new, _origQty, ...r }) => ({ ...r, kotNumber: no })), createdAt: Date.now(), status: "new", isRunning: true };
        clean.kots = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify([...getBaseKots(billOrder), runKot]));
        clean.status = "new";
        clean.lastKotAt = Date.now();
await guardedOrderUpdate(billOrder, clean);

        return { ...billOrder, ...clean, _ranKot: true };
      }
      await guardedOrderUpdate(billOrder, clean);
      return { ...billOrder, ...updated };
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("waiter saveBill error:", e);
      alert("âš ï¸ Save fail: " + e.message);
      return null;
    }
  };

  const onAction = async (mode) => {
    if (saving) return;
    if (items.length === 0) { alert("âš ï¸ Pehle items add karo"); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const wasDraft = !!billOrder.isDraft;
      // Waiter mode: koi print nahi â€” sirf save / KOT kitchen ko
      const saved = await saveBill({});
      if (!saved) return;
      addDoc(collection(db, "auditLogs"), { orderId: saved.id, action: "save", by: (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || "?", before: getOrderTotal(billOrder), after: saved.finalTotal, at: Date.now() }).catch(() => {});
      onClose();
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <BillPOSScreen
      order={billOrder} orders={orders} menu={menu} categories={categories} viewMode={viewMode} setMenuState={setMenuState}
      items={items} setItems={setItems} calc={calc}
      orderType={orderType} setOrderType={setOrderType} table={table} setTable={setTable}
      waiter={waiter} setWaiter={setWaiter} sendKot={sendKot} setSendKot={setSendKot}
      custName={custName} setCustName={setCustName} custPhone={custPhone} setCustPhone={setCustPhone}
      gstin={gstin} setGstin={setGstin} gstRate={gstRate} setGstRate={setGstRate}
      gstCustom={gstCustom} setGstCustom={setGstCustom} disc={disc} setDisc={setDisc}
      discPct={discPct} setDiscPct={setDiscPct} payMode={payMode} setPayMode={setPayMode}
      payStatus={payStatus} setPayStatus={setPayStatus} notes={notes} setNotes={setNotes}
      showBillNo={showBillNo} setShowBillNo={setShowBillNo} saving={saving}
      hidePrint
      onClose={onClose} onOpenOrder={load} onAction={onAction}
    />
  );
}

// ğŸ§‘â€ğŸ³ Waiter Mode â€” fullscreen, back dabane pe band nahi hota
function WaiterMode({ orders, menu, categories, setMenuState, placeOrder, advanceStatus, onClose }) {
  useLiveNow(30000);
  const [viewMode] = useViewMode();
  const [target, setTarget] = useState(null);

  // ğŸ”™ Back button block â€” sirf âœ• Exit se band hoga
  useEffect(() => {
    window.history.pushState({ eatparkWaiter: true }, "");
    const onPop = () => window.history.pushState({ eatparkWaiter: true }, "");
    window.addEventListener("popstate", onPop);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", onPop);
  }, []);

  const active = useMemo(
    () => (orders || []).filter((o) => o.status !== "cancelled" && o.status !== "served").sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt),
    [orders]
  );

  const openNew = (t) => setTarget({
    id: uid("o"), isDraft: true,
    table: Number(t) || 1, orderType: "dine_in",
    customer: { name: "Walk-in", phone: "WALK-IN", address: "" },
    items: [], kots: [], waiter: "", takenBy: "waiter",
    notes: "", payment: "cash", paymentStatus: "pending", paid: false,
    status: "new", createdAt: Date.now(),
    coinsClaimed: true, earnedCoins: 0, rewardUsedCoins: 0,
    deliveryFee: 0, loyaltyDiscount: 0, discount: 0
  });

  const exit = () => { if (window.confirm("Waiter Mode band karna hai?")) onClose(); };

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 85, background: COLORS.paper, overflowY: "auto", colorScheme: "light" }}>
      <div style={{ maxWidth: viewMode === "desktop" ? 1100 : 560, margin: "0 auto", padding: "0 12px 40px" }}>

            <button onClick={() => openNew()} style={{ background: COLORS.sage, color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 12, padding: "10px 14px", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 14 }}>â• New Order</button>
            <button onClick={exit} style={{ background: COLORS.paper2, border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: "10px 14px", fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 14 }}>âœ• Exit</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 8 }}>ğŸ‘† Table pe tap = uska bill / aur items Â· Khali table pe tap = naya order</div>
        <TableStatusBoard orders={orders} tables={20} compact showStats onTableClick={(o) => setTarget(o)} onEmptyTableClick={(t) => openNew(t)} />

        <div style={{ fontFamily: "'Outfit', sans-serif", fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 800, margin: "18px 0 10px" }}>ğŸ”¥ Chal rahe orders ({active.length})</div>
        {active.length === 0 && <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 24, color: COLORS.textLight, fontSize: 13 }}>Koi active order nahi</div>}
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: viewMode === "desktop" ? "repeat(2, 1fr)" : "1fr", gap: 10 }}>
          {active.map((o) => (
            <button key={o.id} onClick={() => setTarget(o)} style={{ background: "#fff", border: `1.5px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 14, padding: 12, textAlign: "left", cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
              <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 15 }}>
                  {o.orderType === "parcel" ? "ğŸ›ï¸ Parcel" : `ğŸ½ï¸ Table ${o.table}`}
                  <span style={{ marginLeft: 6, fontSize: 11, color: COLORS.textLight, fontWeight: 600 }}>#{o.id.slice(1, 5).toUpperCase()}</span>
                  <KotBadge kots={o.kots} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.textLight, marginTop: 3 }}>
                  {o.waiter ? `ğŸ§‘â€ğŸ³ ${o.waiter} Â· ` : ""}{o.items.length} item{o.items.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} Â· {timeAgo(o.createdAt)}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 3, fontWeight: 800, color: STATUS_COLOR[o.status] }}>{STATUS_LABEL[o.status]}</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ textAlign: "right", flexShrink: 0 }}>
                <div style={{ fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", fontWeight: 800, color: COLORS.copper, fontSize: 16 }}>{inr(getOrderTotal(o))}</div>
                <div style={{ marginTop: 4, background: COLORS.info, color: "#fff", borderRadius: 8, padding: "4px 10px", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800 }}>ğŸ§¾ Bill / â•</div>
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {target && (
        <POSController
          key={target.id}
          initialOrder={target}
          orders={orders} menu={menu} categories={categories} viewMode={viewMode}
          placeOrder={placeOrder} advanceStatus={advanceStatus} setMenuState={setMenuState}
          onClose={() => setTarget(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Estimate Panel v4 (full rule table) - v2 ya v3 ke upar lagao.

Usage (project root me):
    python3 apply_estimate_v4.py                 # file khud dhoondh lega
    python3 apply_estimate_v4.py src/StaffApp.jsx

Sirf Estimate panel wala block badalta hai. Backup: <file>.v3.bak

import sys, glob, shutil

SEP = "// ==========================================================================="

NEW_PANEL = r'''// ===========================================================================
// ğŸ“‹ ESTIMATE PANEL v4 â€” full rule table (sabzi/starter/roti/rice/biryani/dal/snacks...), persistent items
// ===========================================================================
//LOGIC-START
// ğŸ‘‰ Apne hisaab se numbers yahan badal sakte ho.
// per = [Kam, Normal, Zyada] per log.
// pieces:true => per = per log piece, plate = ek plate me default piece (naam me "(4pc)" ho to wahi)
//               extra = 2+ item hon to per log total piece itna badhta hai ((item ginti - 1) x extra)
// pieces nahi => per = per log plate/unit
const EST_LEVELS = [
  { id: "kam", label: "Kam", i: 0 },
  { id: "normal", label: "Normal", i: 1 },
  { id: "zyada", label: "Zyada", i: 2 },
];
const EST_RULES = {
  pc:      { label: "sabzi/dry",     pieces: true, per: [2, 3, 4],       extra: 1,   plate: 8 },
  starter: { label: "starter/kabab", pieces: true, per: [1.5, 2, 3],     extra: 0.5, plate: 6 },
  momo:    { label: "momos/spring roll", pieces: true, per: [3, 4, 6],   extra: 2,   plate: 8 },
  roti:    { label: "roti/naan",     per: [2, 2, 3],         unit: "roti" },
  rice:    { label: "rice/pulao",    per: [0.33, 0.4, 0.5],  unit: "plate" },
  biryani: { label: "biryani",       per: [0.5, 0.6, 0.75],  unit: "plate" },
  dal:     { label: "dal",           per: [0.25, 0.33, 0.4], unit: "plate" },
  noodle:  { label: "noodles/pasta", per: [0.4, 0.5, 0.7],   unit: "plate" },
  fries:   { label: "fries",         per: [0.3, 0.5, 0.6],   unit: "plate" },
  pizza:   { label: "pizza",         per: [0.35, 0.4, 0.5],  unit: "pizza" },
  snack:   { label: "roll/burger",   per: [0.75, 1, 1.25],   unit: "pc" },
  soup:    { label: "soup",          per: [0.75, 1, 1],      unit: "bowl" },
  dessert: { label: "dessert",       per: [0.75, 1, 1.25],   unit: "pc" },
  side:    { label: "raita/salad",   per: [0.25, 0.3, 0.4],  unit: "plate" },
  papad:   { label: "papad",         per: [1, 1, 1.5],       unit: "pc" },
  thali:   { label: "thali/combo",   per: [1, 1, 1],         unit: "plate" },
  drink:   { label: "drink/shake",   per: [0.75, 1, 1],      unit: "pc" },
  water:   { label: "water",         per: [0.2, 0.2, 0.2],   unit: "litre bottle" },
};

function estKind(m) {
  const n = String(m.name || "").toLowerCase();
  const t = n + " " + String(m.category || "").toLowerCase();
  if (/thali|combo/.test(n)) return "thali";
  if (/roti|naan|paratha|parotta|parantha|kulcha|phulka|chapati/.test(n)) return "roti";
  if (/biryani|biriyani/.test(n)) return "biryani";
  if (/\brice\b|pulao|pulav/.test(n)) return "rice";
  if (/\bdal\b|daal|dhal/.test(n)) return "dal";
  if (/\bwater\b|mineral|bisleri/.test(n)) return "water";
  if (/pizza/.test(n)) return "pizza";
  if (/momo|dumpling|dim ?sum|spring roll/.test(n)) return "momo";
  if (/roll|burger|sandwich|wrap|maggi/.test(n)) return "snack";
  if (/soup|shorba/.test(n)) return "soup";
  if (/shake|lassi|juice|mojito|coffee|\btea\b|chai|cold drink|coke|pepsi|sprite|thums|soda|lemonade|mocktail|smoothie|buttermilk|chaas|sharbat/.test(n)) return "drink";
  if (/ice ?cream|kulfi|falooda|brownie|halwa|jalebi|gulab|rasgulla|rasmalai|kheer|sundae|dessert|sweet(?! corn)|cake|pastry|rabri/.test(n)) return "dessert";
  if (/noodle|chowmein|chow mein|chaumin|hakka|pasta|macaroni/.test(n)) return "noodle";
  if (/fries|wedges|finger chips/.test(n)) return "fries";
  if (/raita|salad|chutney|achar|pickle/.test(n)) return "side";
  if (/papad/.test(n)) return "papad";
  if (/tikka|kabab|kebab|seekh|tandoori|tangdi|reshmi|malai chaap|lollipop|\b65\b|crispy|nugget|wings|afghani|achari|hariyali|bbq|barbeque|pakora|pakoda|cutlet|tikki|\bfry\b/.test(n)
      && !/masala|gravy|kadai|kadhai|handi|korma|curry|makhani|butter|lababdar|bhuna|rogan|do pyaza/.test(n)) return "starter";
  if (/paneer|mushroom|chicken|mutton|fish|egg|manchurian|chilly|chilli|kadai|kadhai|masala|curry|soya|chaap|veg|gobi|aloo|sabzi|handi|korma|butter|dum|bhurji|kofta|palak|matar|tadka|lababdar|bhuna|rogan|starter|main|gravy|dry|chinese/.test(t)) return "pc";
  return "other";
}
function estPcPerPlate(name, def) {
  const mm = String(name || "").match(/(\d+)\s*(pc|pcs|piece|pieces)\b/i);
  return mm && Number(mm[1]) > 0 ? Number(mm[1]) : def;
}
const estFmt = (n) => String(Math.round(n * 100) / 100);
const estCeil = (x) => Math.max(1, Math.ceil(x - 0.05));
function estTag(m) {
  const r = EST_RULES[estKind(m)];
  if (!r) return "manual qty";
  return r.label + (r.pieces ? " Â· " + estPcPerPlate(m.name, r.plate) + " pc" : "");
}
function estLegend(lv) {
  const g = (k) => estFmt(EST_RULES[k].per[lv.i]);
  return "Per log: sabzi " + g("pc") + " pc Â· starter " + g("starter") + " pc Â· roti " + g("roti") + " Â· rice " + g("rice") + " Â· biryani " + g("biryani") + " Â· dal " + g("dal") + " plate";
}

// items: [{id,name,price,qty}], menuById: {id: menuItem}, pax: number, lv: EST_LEVELS entry
// return: { [id]: { qty, note } }  (sirf wahi items jinka rule hai)
function estCompute(items, menuById, pax, lv) {
  const groups = {};
  items.forEach((i) => {
    const k = estKind(menuById[i.id] || i);
    if (EST_RULES[k]) (groups[k] = groups[k] || []).push(i);
  });
  const out = {};
  Object.keys(groups).forEach((k) => {
    const r = EST_RULES[k], arr = groups[k], n = arr.length;
    if (r.pieces) {
      const pool = r.per[lv.i] + r.extra * (n - 1); // per log total piece (is type ki sab dish mila ke)
      const share = pool / n;                         // per log, is dish ke piece
      arr.forEach((it) => {
        const per = estPcPerPlate(it.name, r.plate);
        const pieces = share * pax;
        const qty = estCeil(pieces / per);
        out[it.id] = { qty, note: pax + " log x " + estFmt(share) + " pc = " + Math.round(pieces) + " pc / " + per + " pc plate = " + qty + " plate" };
      });
    } else {
      const each = r.per[lv.i];
      const total = (pax * each) / n;
      arr.forEach((it) => {
        const qty = estCeil(total);
        out[it.id] = { qty, note: pax + " log x " + estFmt(each) + " " + r.unit + (n > 1 ? " / " + n + " item" : "") + " = " + qty };
      });
    }
  });
  return out;
}
//LOGIC-END

function EstStepper({ C, q, onChange, size = 32 }) {
  const b = { width: size, height: size, border: "none", fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 900, cursor: "pointer", padding: 0, fontFamily: "inherit" };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", border: "1.5px solid " + C.gold, borderRadius: 10, overflow: "hidden", flexShrink: 0, background: C.card }}>
      <button onClick={() => onChange(q - 1)} style={{ ...b, background: C.cardAlt, color: C.ink }}>âˆ’</button>
      <span style={{ minWidth: 30, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 14, color: C.ink, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{q}</span>
      <button onClick={() => onChange(q + 1)} style={{ ...b, background: C.gold, color: "#fff" }}>+</button>
    </div>
  );
}

function EstimatePanel({ C, menu, orders, isMobile, items, setItems, persons, setPersons, onClose, onMoveToCart }) {
  const haptic = useHaptic();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [search, setSearch] = React.useState("");
  const dSearch = useDebounce(search, 150);
  const [catFilter, setCatFilter] = React.useState("All");
  const [showSel, setShowSel] = React.useState(false);
  const [level, setLevel] = React.useState(() => { try { return localStorage.getItem("staff_estimate_level") || "normal"; } catch (e) { return "normal"; } });

  const lv = EST_LEVELS.find((l) => l.id === level) || EST_LEVELS[1];
  const pax = Math.max(1, Number(persons) || 1);
  const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
  const count = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty, 0);
  const qtyOf = (id) => { const it = items.find((p) => p.id === id); return it ? it.qty : 0; };

  const menuById = React.useMemo(() => { const o = {}; menu.forEach((m) => { o[m.id] = m; }); return o; }, [menu]);
  const sug = React.useMemo(() => estCompute(items, menuById, pax, lv), [items, menuById, pax, lv]);

  const pickLevel = (id) => { haptic(6); setLevel(id); try { localStorage.setItem("staff_estimate_level", id); } catch (e) {} };

  const setQty = (m, q) => {
    haptic(6);
    setItems((prev) => {
      if (q <= 0) return prev.filter((p) => p.id !== m.id);
      if (prev.some((p) => p.id === m.id)) return prev.map((p) => (p.id === m.id ? { ...p, qty: q } : p));
      return [...prev, { id: m.id, name: m.name, price: Number(m.price) || 0, qty: q }];
    });
  };
  const removeId = (id) => setItems((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
  const clearAll = () => {
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (window.confirm("Estimate ke saare items hata dein?")) { setItems([]); setShowSel(false); }
  };
  const applyAuto = () => {
    if (!items.length) { toast("Pehle items add karo, phir Auto qty dabao", "warning"); return; }
    const n = Object.keys(sug).length;
    if (!n) { toast("In items ke liye auto rule nahi hai, qty khud badlo", "warning"); return; }
    haptic(12);
    setItems((prev) => prev.map((p) => (sug[p.id] ? { ...p, qty: sug[p.id].qty } : p)));
    setShowSel(true);
    toast("âœ… " + n + " items ki qty " + pax + " log ke hisaab se set ho gayi", "success");
  };
  const setPax = (v) => {
    if (v === "") { setPersons(""); return; }
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(999, parseInt(v, 10) || 1));
    setPersons(n);
  };

  const categories = React.useMemo(
    () => ["All", ...Array.from(new Set(menu.map((m) => m.category).filter(Boolean)))],
    [menu]
  );

  const popular = React.useMemo(() => {
    const cnt = {};
    (orders || []).forEach((o) => {
      if (o.status === "cancelled") return;
      (o.items || []).forEach((it) => { cnt[it.itemId] = (cnt[it.itemId] || 0) + (Number(it.qty) || 0); });
    });
    const seen = new Set();
    return menu
      .filter((m) => m.available !== false && cnt[m.id])
      .sort((a, b) => cnt[b.id] - cnt[a.id])
      .filter((m) => { const k = String(m.name || "").trim().toLowerCase(); if (seen.has(k)) return false; seen.add(k); return true; })
      .slice(0, 8);
  }, [orders, menu]);

  const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
    const s = dSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    return menu.filter((m) =>
      m.available !== false &&
      (catFilter === "All" || m.category === catFilter) &&
      (!s || String(m.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(s))
    ).slice(0, 250);
  }, [menu, dSearch, catFilter]);

  const chip = (active) => ({
    padding: "7px 14px", borderRadius: 20, border: "1px solid " + (active ? C.gold : C.line),
    background: active ? C.gold : C.card, color: active ? "#fff" : C.gray,
    fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", whiteSpace: "nowrap", flexShrink: 0, fontFamily: "inherit",
  });
  const sb = { width: 36, height: 36, border: "none", fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 900, cursor: "pointer", padding: 0, fontFamily: "inherit" };

  return (
    <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "rgba(0,0,0,.55)", backdropFilter: "blur(4px)", zIndex: 9999, display: "flex", alignItems: isMobile ? "flex-end" : "center", justifyContent: "center", padding: isMobile ? 0 : 16 }} onClick={onClose}>
      <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ textAlign: "left", background: C.card, color: C.ink, borderRadius: isMobile ? "20px 20px 0 0" : 16, width: "100%", maxWidth: isMobile ? "100%" : 620, height: isMobile ? "94vh" : "88vh", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflow: "hidden", animation: isMobile ? "slideUp .25s ease-out" : "scaleIn .18s ease-out", boxShadow: "0 -8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25)" }}>

        {/* HEADER */}
        <div style={{ padding: "14px 16px 10px", borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.line, flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 19, fontWeight: 900 }}>ğŸ“‹ Estimate</div>
            <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: C.cardAlt, border: "none", borderRadius: "50%", width: 34, height: 34, fontSize: 15, cursor: "pointer", color: C.ink }}>âœ•</button>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", background: C.cardAlt, borderRadius: 12, padding: "8px 12px", marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13 }}>ğŸ‘¥ Kitne log?</span>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", border: "1.5px solid " + C.gold, borderRadius: 10, overflow: "hidden", background: C.card }}>
              <button onClick={() => setPax(pax - 1)} style={{ ...sb, background: C.cardAlt, color: C.ink }}>âˆ’</button>
              <input type="number" inputMode="numeric" min="1" value={persons} onChange={(e) => setPax(e.target.value)} onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()} style={{ width: 62, height: 36, border: "none", textAlign: "center", fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 900, fontFamily: "monospace", background: C.card, color: C.ink, outline: "none", boxSizing: "border-box" }} />
              <button onClick={() => setPax(pax + 1)} style={{ ...sb, background: C.gold, color: "#fff" }}>+</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            {EST_LEVELS.map((l) => (
              <button key={l.id} onClick={() => pickLevel(l.id)} style={{ padding: "7px 12px", borderRadius: 20, border: "1.5px solid " + (level === l.id ? C.gold : C.line), background: level === l.id ? C.goldLight : C.card, color: level === l.id ? C.goldText : C.gray, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{l.label}</button>
            ))}
            <button onClick={applyAuto} style={{ marginLeft: "auto", padding: "8px 14px", borderRadius: 10, border: "none", background: "linear-gradient(135deg, " + C.gold + " 0%, " + C.goldDark + " 100%)", color: "#fff", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>âš¡ Auto qty</button>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 6, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
            {estLegend(lv)}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* SCROLL AREA */}
        <div style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: "auto", padding: "12px 16px" }}>
          <input placeholder="ğŸ” Item search..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} style={{ width: "100%", padding: "11px 14px", borderRadius: 10, border: "1.5px solid " + C.line, fontSize: 14, boxSizing: "border-box", background: C.card, color: C.ink, outline: "none", marginBottom: 10 }} />

          {!search.trim() && catFilter === "All" && popular.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, color: C.gray, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: 0.5, marginBottom: 6 }}>ğŸ”¥ Zyada bikne wale (tap = +1)</div>
              <div className="ep-noscroll" style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, overflowX: "auto", paddingBottom: 4 }}>
                {popular.map((m) => {
                  const q = qtyOf(m.id);
                  return (
                    <button key={m.id} onClick={() => setQty(m, q + 1)} style={{ padding: "8px 12px", borderRadius: 20, border: "1.5px solid " + C.gold, background: q ? C.gold : C.goldLight, color: q ? "#fff" : C.goldText, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer", whiteSpace: "nowrap", flexShrink: 0, fontFamily: "inherit" }}>{m.name}{q ? " Ã—" + q : ""}</button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="ep-noscroll" style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, overflowX: "auto", paddingBottom: 8 }}>
            {categories.map((c) => (
              <button key={c} onClick={() => setCatFilter(c)} style={chip(catFilter === c)}>{c}</button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div style={{ border: "1px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 12, overflow: "hidden" }}>
            {filtered.map((m) => {
              const q = qtyOf(m.id);
              return (

                  </div>

                    : <button onClick={() => setQty(m, 1)} style={{ padding: "8px 16px", borderRadius: 10, border: "1.5px solid " + C.gold, background: "transparent", color: C.goldText, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit", flexShrink: 0 }}>+ Add</button>}

def die(msg):
    print("âŒ " + msg)

def find_file():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        return sys.argv[1]
    cands = [p for p in glob.glob("**/*.jsx", recursive=True) + glob.glob("**/*.js", recursive=True)
             if "node_modules" not in p and "ESTIMATE PANEL v" in open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()]
    if len(cands) == 1:
        return cands[0]
    die("Staff file nahi mili ya ek se zyada hain: %s\nPath do: python3 apply_estimate_v4.py src/StaffApp.jsx" % cands)


def main():
    path = find_file()
    src = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    print("ğŸ“„ File:", path)

    if "ESTIMATE PANEL v4" in src:
        die("v4 pehle se lagi hui hai.")
    i_est = src.find("// ğŸ“‹ ESTIMATE PANEL v")
    if i_est < 0:
        die("Estimate panel (v2/v3) nahi mila. Pehle apply_estimate_v2.py chalao.")
    i_main = src.find("// MAIN APP")
    if i_main < 0 or i_main < i_est:
        die("MAIN APP banner nahi mila.")
    start = src.rfind(SEP, 0, i_est)
    end = src.rfind(SEP, 0, i_main)
    if start < 0 or end <= start:
        die("Banner lines nahi mili.")

    out = src[:start] + NEW_PANEL + src[end:]
    shutil.copyfile(path, path + ".v3.bak")
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(out)
    print("âœ… Estimate v4 lag gayi")
    print("ğŸ’¾ Backup:", path + ".v3.bak")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

function InteractiveSuggest({ C, menu, persons, onSuggest, onCancel }) {
  const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0);
  const [selections, setSelections] = React.useState({});

  const steps = [
    { 
      title: "1. Starter (Snacks)", 
      filter: (m) => /starter|snack|tandoor|momos|roll/i.test(m.category || ""), 
      calcQty: (p) => Math.ceil(p / 3) // 3 logo ke liye 1 plate
    },
    { 
      title: "2. Main Course (Paneer/Chicken)", 
      filter: (m) => /main|curry|sabzi|gravy|paneer|chicken|mutton/i.test(m.category || ""), 
      calcQty: (p) => Math.ceil(p / 4) // 4 logo ke liye 1 plate
    },
    { 
      title: "3. Bread (Roti/Naan)", 
      filter: (m) => /bread|roti|naan/i.test(m.category || ""), 
      calcQty: (p) => p * 2 // Har banda 2 roti
    },
    { 
      title: "4. Rice / Biryani", 
      filter: (m) => /rice|biryani|pulao/i.test(m.category || ""), 
      calcQty: (p) => Math.ceil(p / 3) // 3 logo ke liye 1 plate
    },
    { 
      title: "5. Drinks / Shakes", 
      filter: (m) => /drink|shake|juice|cold|mojito/i.test(m.category || ""), 
      calcQty: (p) => p // Har bande ko 1
    }
  ];

  const currentStepData = steps[step];
  const stepItems = menu.filter(m => m.available && currentStepData.filter(m));

  const handleSelectItem = (item) => {
    setSelections(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (next[item.id]) delete next[item.id];
      else next[item.id] = { item, qty: 1 };
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (step < steps.length - 1) {
      setStep(step + 1);
    } else {
      const finalItems = Object.values(selections).map(sel => {
        const autoQty = currentStepData.calcQty(persons);
        return { id: sel.item.id, name: sel.item.name, price: sel.item.price, qty: Math.max(1, autoQty) };
      });
      onSuggest(finalItems);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 16, background: C.cardAlt, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid " + C.line }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>{currentStepData.title}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700 }}>{step + 1}/{steps.length} (For {persons} pax)</div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ maxHeight: 200, overflowY: 'auto', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        {stepItems.map(m => {
          const isSelected = !!selections[m.id];
          return (
            <div key={m.id} onClick={() => !isSelected && handleSelectItem(m)} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: 8, borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.line, background: isSelected ? C.goldLight : 'transparent', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <span style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: '50%', background: m.veg ? 'green' : 'red' }}></span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: C.ink }}>{m.name}</span>
              </div>
              {isSelected ? <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.goldText, fontWeight: 800 }}>Selected âœ“</span> : <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.goldText }}>{inr(m.price)} +</span>}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
        {step > 0 && <button onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid " + C.line, background: C.card, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', color: C.ink }}>â† Pichla</button>}
        {step < steps.length - 1 ? (

        ) : (
          <button onClick={handleNext} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: "none", background: C.green, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, cursor: 'pointer' }}>âœ… Items Lagao</button>
        )}
      </div>
      <button onClick={onCancel} style={{ width: '100%', marginTop: 10, padding: 8, border: 'none', background: 'transparent', color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12 }}>Cancel (Wapas Manual pe jao)</button>
    </div>
  );
}
`;

import fs from "fs";

const FILE = "src/StaffApp.jsx";
const src = fs.readFileSync(FILE, "utf8");

if (src.includes("function safeStorageGet")) {
  console.log("Helpers already present. Nothing to do.");
  process.exit(0);
}

const helpers = `// ============ SAFE HELPERS ============
function getErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message) return error.message;
  if (typeof error === "string") return error;
  if (error && typeof error === "object" && "message" in error) {
    return String(error.message);
  }
  return "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.";
}
function isRefreshNeeded(error) {
  const msg = getErrorMessage(error);
  return msg === "REFRESH_NEEDED" || msg.includes("badal diya");
}
function safeStorageGet(key, fallback = null) {
  try {
    const v = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    return v === null ? fallback : v;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}
function safeStorageSet(key, value) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, String(value));
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
function safeStorageRemove(key) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
// ======================================

`;

// Split into lines, find the LAST line that is part of an import statement.
// An import statement ends on a line that contains `;` and starts with `import` or `}`.
const lines = src.split("\n");
let insertAt = -1;

for (let k = 0; k < lines.length; k++) {
  const line = lines[k].trim();
  if (line === "") continue;
  // Skip everything until imports are done
  if (line.startsWith("import ") || line.startsWith("} from") || (insertAt >= 0 && !line.startsWith("import ") && !line.startsWith("}"))) {
    if (line.startsWith("import ") || line.startsWith("} from")) {
      insertAt = k + 1; // insert AFTER this line
    }
    continue;
  }
  // First non-import, non-blank line after imports â€” stop
  break;
}

if (insertAt === -1) {
  console.log("Could not detect imports. Aborting â€” do manual insert.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const before = lines.slice(0, insertAt).join("\n");
const after = lines.slice(insertAt).join("\n");
fs.writeFileSync(FILE, before + "\n" + helpers + after);
console.log(`Helpers inserted after line ${insertAt}.`);
===== ./firestore.rules.proposed =====
rules_version = '2';
// PROPOSED - not deployed. Diff against the rules in your Firebase console first.
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{db}/documents {

    function signedIn() {
      return request.auth != null;
    }
    function hasStaffDoc() {
      return signedIn() && exists(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid));
    }
    function role() {
      return get(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role;
    }
    function isStaff() {
      return hasStaffDoc() && role() in ['admin', 'owner', 'manager', 'staff', 'waiter'];
    }
    // mirrors the app's isOwner (owner / admin / manager)
    function isAdmin() {
      return hasStaffDoc() && role() in ['admin', 'owner', 'manager'];
    }

    match /staff/{uid} {
      allow read: if signedIn() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow write: if false;
    }

    // C1: wildcard no longer overlaps privatePins (rules are additive)
    match /settings/{docId} {
      allow read: if docId != 'privatePins';
      allow write: if isStaff() && docId != 'privatePins';
    }
    match /settings/privatePins {
      allow read, write: if isAdmin();
    }

    // C2 (partial): paid orders are locked for non-admins except status changes
    match /orders/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn() && request.resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid;
      allow read: if isStaff() || (signedIn() && resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid);
      allow update: if isStaff() && (
        resource.data.paid != true
        || isAdmin()
        || request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'lastKotAt'])
      );
      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }

    // --- unchanged (customer app) ---
    match /customers/{phone} {
      allow read, write: if signedIn();
    }
    match /loyaltyUsers/{phone} {
      allow get: if signedIn();
      allow list, write: if isStaff();
    }
    match /coinHistory/{id} {
      allow read: if signedIn();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /calls/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn();
      allow read, update: if isStaff();
      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /bookings/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn();
      allow read, update, delete: if isStaff();
    }
    match /chats/{orderId}/messages/{msgId} {
      allow read, write: if signedIn();
    }
    match /auditLogs/{id} {
      allow read: if isAdmin();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }

    // H9: staff can read stock (low-stock badge), only admins write
    match /inventory/{id} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow write: if isAdmin();
    }

    // H8: collections the staff app uses that had no rule
    match /auditLog/{id} {
      allow read: if isAdmin();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /expenses/{id} {
      allow read, create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /vendors/{id} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow write: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /vendorPayments/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /dayClose/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /feedback/{id} {
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow read: if isAdmin();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
  }
}

/*
  EP-PATCH â€” Build fix + Customer login gate
  Usage (project root se):
      node ep-patch.cjs                 -> src/App.jsx patch karega
      node ep-patch.cjs path/to/App.jsx -> custom path

  - Pehle backup banata hai (App.jsx.bak)
  - Sab patches ek saath check hote hain; koi ek fail to file bilkul nahi badalti
  - Dobara chalane se kuch double nahi hota (already applied skip ho jata hai)
*/
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const target = path.resolve(process.argv[2] || "src/App.jsx");
if (!fs.existsSync(target)) {
  console.error("âŒ File nahi mili: " + target);
  console.error("   Project root se chalao, ya path do: node ep-patch.cjs src/App.jsx");
  process.exit(1);
}

// ---- patches ko isi file ke neeche wale comment se padho ----
const self = fs.readFileSync(__filename, "utf8");
const m = self.match(/\/\*@@PATCHES([\s\S]*?)PATCHES@@\*\//);
if (!m) { console.error("âŒ Patch data nahi mila"); process.exit(1); }

const patches = [];
m[1].split(/^@@PATCH /m).slice(1).forEach((block) => {
  const nl = block.indexOf("\n");
  const name = block.slice(0, nl).trim();
  const body = block.slice(nl + 1);
  const grab = (tag, next) => {
    const s = body.indexOf("@@" + tag + "\n");
    if (s < 0) return null;
    const from = s + tag.length + 3;
    const e = next ? body.indexOf("@@" + next + "\n", from) : body.length;
    return body.slice(from, e < 0 ? body.length : e).trim();
  };
  patches.push({
    name,
    skipif: grab("SKIPIF", "FIND"),
    find: grab("FIND", "REPLACE"),
    replace: grab("REPLACE", null),
  });
});

let src = fs.readFileSync(target, "utf8");
const count = (hay, needle) => (needle ? hay.split(needle).length - 1 : 0);

// ---- sab ko pehle check karo ----
const plan = [];
let bad = false;
for (const p of patches) {
  if (p.skipif && src.includes(p.skipif)) { plan.push({ p, action: "skip" }); continue; }
  const n = count(src, p.find);
  if (n === 1) plan.push({ p, action: "apply" });
  else if (n === 0 && src.includes(p.replace)) plan.push({ p, action: "skip" });
  else {
    bad = true;
    plan.push({ p, action: "fail", why: n === 0 ? "FIND text file me nahi mila (file alag ho gayi hai?)" : "FIND " + n + " baar mila (sirf 1 hona chahiye)" });
  }
}

plan.forEach(({ p, action, why }) => {
  const icon = action === "apply" ? "ğŸ› ï¸ " : action === "skip" ? "â­ï¸ " : "âŒ";
  console.log(icon + " " + p.name + (action === "skip" ? " (pehle se laga hua)" : "") + (why ? " â€” " + why : ""));
});

if (bad) {
  console.error("\nâŒ Kuch patches fail hue. File mein koi badlav NAHI kiya gaya.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const todo = plan.filter((x) => x.action === "apply");
if (todo.length === 0) { console.log("\nâœ… Sab patches pehle se laga hua hai. Kuch karna nahi."); process.exit(0); }

// ---- backup + apply ----
fs.writeFileSync(target + ".bak", src);
for (const { p } of todo) src = src.replace(p.find, () => p.replace);
fs.writeFileSync(target, src);

console.log("\nâœ… " + todo.length + " patch(es) lag gaye â†’ " + target);
console.log("ğŸ’¾ Backup: " + target + ".bak");
console.log("\nAb chalao:  npm run build   (check ke liye)");
console.log("Phir:       git add -A && git commit -m \"login gate + build fix\" && git push");
process.exit(0);

// node eatpark-patch.cjs   (optional: node eatpark-patch.cjs path/to/src)
const fs = require("fs"), path = require("path");
const MARK = "EP-PATCH-v1", SRC = process.argv[2] || "src";
const ok = [], warn = [];

function walk(d, out = []) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(d)) return out;
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(d)) {
    if (f === "node_modules") continue;
    const p = path.join(d, f), st = fs.statSync(p);
    if (st.isDirectory()) walk(p, out); else if (/\.(jsx?|tsx?)$/.test(f)) out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}
function rep(s, from, to, label, all) {
  if (!s.includes(from)) { warn.push(label); return s; }
  ok.push(label);
  return all ? s.split(from).join(to) : s.replace(from, () => to);
}
const CSP = '<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="script-src \'none\'; object-src \'none\'">';
function csp(s, label) {
  const src = /(<!doctype html>\s*<html><head>)(?!<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy")/;
  if (!src.test(s)) { warn.push(label + " CSP"); return s; }
  ok.push(label + " CSP");
  return s.replace(new RegExp(src.source, "g"), (m, a) => a + CSP);
}

const RULES = `rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{db}/documents {

    function signedIn() { return request.auth != null; }
    function hasStaffDoc() {
      return signedIn() && exists(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid));
    }
    function staffRole() {
      return get(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role;
    }
    function isStaff() { return hasStaffDoc() && staffRole() in ['admin', 'owner', 'manager', 'staff', 'waiter']; }
    function isAdmin() { return hasStaffDoc() && staffRole() in ['admin', 'owner', 'manager']; }
    function ownsOrder(orderId) {
      return signedIn()
        && exists(/databases/$(db)/documents/orders/$(orderId))
        && get(/databases/$(db)/documents/orders/$(orderId)).data.createdBy == request.auth.uid;
    }
    function validCustomerOrder() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.status == 'new'
        && d.paid == false
        && d.orderType in ['dine_in', 'parcel']
        && d.table is int && d.table >= 0 && d.table <= 20
        && d.items is list && d.items.size() > 0 && d.items.size() <= 40
        && d.finalTotal is number && d.finalTotal >= 0 && d.finalTotal <= 100000
        && (!('discount' in d) || (d.discount is number && d.discount >= 0 && d.discount <= 50))
        && (!('paymentStatus' in d) || d.paymentStatus in ['pending', 'paid_unverified'])
        && d.keys().size() <= 60;
    }

    match /staff/{uid} {
      allow read: if signedIn() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow write: if false;
    }

    match /settings/{docId} {
      allow read: if (docId != 'privatePins' && docId != 'presets')
                  || (docId == 'presets' && isStaff())
                  || isAdmin();
      allow write: if isAdmin()
                  || (isStaff() && docId in ['menu', 'availability', 'favourites', 'expenseCats']);
    }

    match /orders/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && id.matches('^o[a-z0-9]{6,40}$')
        && request.resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid
        && (isStaff() || validCustomerOrder());
      allow read: if isStaff() || (signedIn() && resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid);
      allow update: if isStaff()
        || (signedIn() && resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid
            && resource.data.status == 'new' && resource.data.paid == false
            && request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
            && request.resource.data.status == 'cancelled');
      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }

    match /customers/{phone} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow create: if signedIn() && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid;
      allow update: if isStaff() || (signedIn() && resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid);

    match /loyaltyUsers/{phone} {

function patchFile(file, fn) {
  if (!file) return;
  let s = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  if (s.includes(MARK)) { console.log("Already patched:", file); return; }
  fs.writeFileSync(file + ".bak", s);
  s = fn(s);
  fs.writeFileSync(file, s + "\n// " + MARK + "\n");
}

// ---------- customer (App.jsx) ----------
patchFile(customerFile, (s) => {
  const L = "App";
  s = rep(s, 'import { signInWithEmailAndPassword, signOut, onAuthStateChanged, signInAnonymously } from "firebase/auth";',
    'import { signInWithEmailAndPassword, signOut, onAuthStateChanged, signInAnonymously, RecaptchaVerifier, linkWithPhoneNumber, PhoneAuthProvider, signInWithCredential } from "firebase/auth";', L + " import");
  s = rep(s, "let _anonInFlight = null;", AUTH_MSG, L + " authMsg");
  s = rep(s, "setTimeout(r, 4000)", "setTimeout(r, 8000)", L + " auth wait 8s");
  s = rep(s, 'Order fail: " + (e.code || e.message || "unknown"), \'error\')', '" + authMsg(e), \'error\')', L + " order error text");
  s = rep(s, "const handleSendOtp = () => {", OTP_SEND, L + " OTP send");
  s = rep(s, "const handleVerifyOtp = () => {", OTP_VERIFY, L + " OTP verify");
  s = rep(s, "Quick OTP</div>", 'Quick OTP</div>\n                  <div id="otp-recaptcha"></div>', L + " recaptcha div");
  s = rep(s, "const newCoins = Math.max(0, curCoins + earned - used);", COIN_CHECK, L + " coin check");
  s = csp(s, L + " print");
  return s;
});

  const gstList = [0, ...((presets.gstRates && presets.gstRates.length ? presets.gstRates : [5, 12, 18]).filter((r) => Number(r) > 0))];
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [cat, setCat] = useState("all");
   const [wide, setWide] = useState(() => window.innerWidth >= 900);
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = () => setWide(window.innerWidth >= 900);
    window.addEventListener("resize", f);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", f);

      // 1. Safe Token extraction (Never pass empty Bearer header)

        try {
          token = await auth.currentUser.getIdToken();
        } catch (tokErr) {
          console.warn("Token fetch failed:", tokErr);
        }
      }

      const headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      };
      if (token) {
        headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
      }

      // 2. Fetch call
      const r = await HX.fetchWithTimeout("/api/parse-order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          menu: (menu || [])
            .filter((m) => m.available)
            .map((m) => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name, portion: m.portion || "" })),
        }),
      });

      // 3. Handle non-JSON or error responses gracefully
      const contentType = r.headers.get("content-type");
      if (!contentType || !contentType.includes("application/json")) {
        throw new Error(`Server error (${r.status}). Backend API route /api/parse-order check karein.`);
      }

      const data = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "AI processing failed");
      setAiRes(HX.sanitizeAiLines(data, menu));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("AI Order Error:", e);

ğŸ”„ Aapka Naya Superfast Workflow
Ab manual npm run build aur folder upload karne ka jhanjhat hamesha ke liye khatam. Jab bhi aapko code mein kuch update karna ho (jaise koi naya feature dalna):

VS Code mein apne changes save karein.

Terminal mein type karein: git add .

Phir type karein: git commit -m "koi bhi message jaise: naya feature add kiya"

Aur aakhir mein: git push

Bas! Netlify automatically aapke GitHub se naya code uthayega aur ishi link par background mein update kar dega. Aapko Netlify ka dashboard dobara kholne ki zaroorat hi nahi padegi.

Ab jab app live ho chuki hai, toh kya hum ek dummy order ya test entry daal kar check karein ki live website se data aapke Firebase database mein theek se sync ho raha hai ya nahi?===== ./public/import React, { useState, useEffect.txt =====

const STATUS_FLOW = ["new", "preparing", "ready", "served"];

function inr(n) {
  return "â‚¹" + Number(n).toLocaleString("en-IN");
}

function uid(prefix) {
  return prefix + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
}

function timeAgo(ts) {
  const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts) / 1000);
  if (s < 60) return s + "s ago";
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  if (m < 60) return m + "m ago";
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
  return h + "h " + (m % 60) + "m ago";
}

/* ---------------- storage helpers ---------------- */

async function loadShared(key, fallback) {
  try {
    const res = await window.storage.get(key, true);
    return res ? JSON.parse(res.value) : fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
}
async function saveShared(key, value) {
  try {
    await window.storage.set(key, JSON.stringify(value), true);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("storage set failed", key, e);
  }
}

/* ---------------- small UI atoms ---------------- */

function Badge({ children, color }) {
  return (
    <span
      style={{
        background: color,
        color: "#fff",
        fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace",
        fontSize: 11,
        letterSpacing: "0.06em",
        textTransform: "uppercase",
        padding: "4px 9px",
        borderRadius: 999,
        fontWeight: 600,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

function TornEdge({ flip }) {
  const teeth = 18;
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox={`0 0 ${teeth * 10} 10`}
      preserveAspectRatio="none"
      style={{ width: "100%", height: 10, display: "block", transform: flip ? "rotate(180deg)" : "none" }}
    >
      {Array.from({ length: teeth }).map((_, i) => (
        <circle key={i} cx={i * 10 + 5} cy={flip ? 10 : 0} r="5" fill={COLORS.paper} />
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

/* Ticket / receipt-style card â€” the app's signature element */
function Ticket({ children, stampColor = COLORS.copper, code, style }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ filter: "drop-shadow(0 3px 10px rgba(32,38,31,0.12))", ...style }}>
      <div style={{ background: COLORS.paper, borderLeft: `1px dashed ${COLORS.line}`, borderRight: `1px dashed ${COLORS.line}` }}>
        <TornEdge />
        <div style={{ padding: "16px 18px", position: "relative" }}>
          {code && (
            <div
              style={{
                position: "absolute",
                top: 12,
                right: 14,
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                borderRadius: "50%",
                border: `2px solid ${stampColor}`,
                color: stampColor,
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace",
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: 700,
                transform: "rotate(8deg)",
                textAlign: "center",
                lineHeight: 1.1,
              }}
            >
              {code}
            </div>
          )}
          {children}
        </div>
        <TornEdge flip />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function VegDot({ veg }) {
  const c = veg ? VEG : NONVEG;
  return (
    <span
      style={{
        width: 12,
        height: 12,
        border: `1.4px solid ${c}`,
        display: "inline-flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
    >
      <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: veg ? "50%" : "50%", background: c }} />
    </span>
  );
}

function Stepper({ qty, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}>
      <button
        onClick={() => onChange(Math.max(0, qty - 1))}
        style={stepBtnStyle}
        aria-label="Decrease quantity"
      >
        âˆ’
      </button>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", fontWeight: 600, minWidth: 16, textAlign: "center" }}>{qty}</span>
      <button onClick={() => onChange(qty + 1)} style={stepBtnStyle} aria-label="Increase quantity">
        +
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
const stepBtnStyle = {
  width: 28,
  height: 28,
  borderRadius: "50%",
  border: `1px solid ${COLORS.copper}`,
  background: "transparent",
  color: COLORS.copper,
  fontSize: 16,
  lineHeight: 1,
  cursor: "pointer",
  display: "flex",
  alignItems: "center",
  justifyContent: "center",
};

/* =========================================================
   CUSTOMER VIEW
========================================================= */
function CustomerView({ menu, orders, placeOrder, table, setTable }) {
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(CATEGORIES[0]);
  const [cart, setCart] = useState({}); // itemId -> qty
  const [cartOpen, setCartOpen] = useState(false);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState("cash");
  const [myOrderId, setMyOrderId] = useState(null);
  const [placing, setPlacing] = useState(false);

  const availableInCat = menu.filter((m) => m.category === category && m.available);
  const cartItems = Object.entries(cart).filter(([, q]) => q > 0);
  const cartCount = cartItems.reduce((s, [, q]) => s + q, 0);
  const cartTotal = cartItems.reduce((s, [id, q]) => {
    const item = menu.find((m) => m.id === id);
    return s + (item ? item.price * q : 0);
  }, 0);

  const setQty = (id, q) => setCart((c) => ({ ...c, [id]: q }));

  const myOrder = orders.find((o) => o.id === myOrderId);

  async function handlePlaceOrder() {
    if (cartItems.length === 0) return;
    setPlacing(true);
    const order = {
      id: uid("o"),
      table,
      items: cartItems.map(([id, qty]) => {
        const m = menu.find((mi) => mi.id === id);
        return { itemId: id, name: m.name, price: m.price, qty };
      }),
      notes,
      payment,
      status: "new",
      paid: false,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
    await placeOrder(order);
    setMyOrderId(order.id);
    setCart({});
    setNotes("");
    setCartOpen(false);
    setPlacing(false);
  }

  if (myOrder) {
    const stepIdx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(myOrder.status);
    return (
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 480, margin: "0 auto", padding: "28px 16px 60px" }}>
        <Header table={table} />
        <div style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>
          <Ticket code={"#" + myOrder.id.slice(1, 4).toUpperCase()} stampColor={STATUS_COLOR[myOrder.status]}>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 22, color: COLORS.ink, marginBottom: 2 }}>
              Order placed
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", fontSize: 12, color: "#8A8375", marginBottom: 16 }}>
              Table {myOrder.table} Â· {timeAgo(myOrder.createdAt)}
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 14 }}>
              {STATUS_FLOW.map((s, i) => (
                <div key={s} style={{ textAlign: "center", flex: 1, opacity: i <= stepIdx ? 1 : 0.35 }}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      width: 12,
                      height: 12,
                      borderRadius: "50%",
                      background: i <= stepIdx ? STATUS_COLOR[myOrder.status] : COLORS.line,
                      margin: "0 auto 6px",
                    }}
                  />
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.05em" }}>
                    {STATUS_LABEL[s]}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div style={{ borderTop: `1px dashed ${COLORS.line}`, paddingTop: 12 }}>
              {myOrder.items.map((it) => (
                <div key={it.itemId} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontSize: 14, marginBottom: 4 }}>
                  <span>{it.qty}Ã— {it.name}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace" }}>{inr(it.price * it.qty)}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 8, paddingTop: 8, borderTop: `1px dashed ${COLORS.line}` }}>
                <span>Total</span>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace" }}>{inr(myOrder.items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.price * it.qty, 0))}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8A8375", marginTop: 8 }}>
                Pay at counter Â· {myOrder.payment === "cash" ? "Cash" : "UPI"}
                {myOrder.paid && <span style={{ color: COLORS.sage, fontWeight: 600 }}> Â· Paid</span>}
              </div>
            </div>
          </Ticket>
          <button
            onClick={() => setMyOrderId(null)}
            style={{ ...primaryBtn, background: "transparent", color: COLORS.copper, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.copper}`, marginTop: 18, width: "100%" }}
          >
            Order more
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 480, margin: "0 auto", paddingBottom: cartCount ? 90 : 30 }}>
      <div style={{ padding: "28px 16px 0" }}>
        <Header table={table} setTable={setTable} />
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, overflowX: "auto", padding: "18px 16px 10px", scrollbarWidth: "none" }}>
        {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
          <button
            key={c}
            onClick={() => setCategory(c)}
            style={{
              whiteSpace: "nowrap",
              padding: "8px 14px",
              borderRadius: 999,
              border: `1px solid ${category === c ? COLORS.copper : COLORS.line}`,
              background: category === c ? COLORS.copper : "transparent",
              color: category === c ? "#fff" : COLORS.ink,
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: "pointer",
            }}
          >
            {c}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: "6px 16px" }}>
        {availableInCat.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ color: "#8A8375", fontSize: 14, padding: "24px 0", textAlign: "center" }}>Nothing here right now â€” try another category.</div>
        )}
        {availableInCat.map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item.id}
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              alignItems: "center",
              padding: "14px 0",
              borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`,
              gap: 12,
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 7 }}>
                <VegDot veg={item.veg} />
                <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 17, color: COLORS.ink }}>{item.name}</div>
              </div>
              {item.desc && <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#8A8375", marginTop: 2 }}>{item.desc}</div>}
              <div style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", fontSize: 13, color: COLORS.copperDark, marginTop: 6, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                {inr(item.price)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <Stepper qty={cart[item.id] || 0} onChange={(q) => setQty(item.id, q)} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "22px 16px 4px", fontSize: 12, color: "#8A8375", lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
        {RESTAURANT.address}
        <br />
        {RESTAURANT.phones.join(" Â· ")}
      </div>

      {cartCount > 0 && !cartOpen && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setCartOpen(true)}
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            bottom: 18,
            left: "50%",
            transform: "translateX(-50%)",
            width: "calc(100% - 32px)",
            maxWidth: 448,
            background: COLORS.ink,
            color: COLORS.paper,
            border: "none",
            borderRadius: 14,
            padding: "15px 20px",
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 15,
            cursor: "pointer",
            boxShadow: "0 8px 24px rgba(32,38,31,0.28)",
          }}
        >
          <span>{cartCount} item{cartCount > 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace" }}>{inr(cartTotal)} Â· View cart</span>
        </button>
      )}

      {cartOpen && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            inset: 0,
            background: "rgba(32,38,31,0.45)",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "flex-end",
            zIndex: 20,
          }}
          onClick={() => setCartOpen(false)}
        >
          <div
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{
              background: COLORS.paper,
              width: "100%",
              maxWidth: 480,
              margin: "0 auto",
              borderRadius: "18px 18px 0 0",
              padding: "20px 18px 26px",
              maxHeight: "82vh",
              overflowY: "auto",
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 20, marginBottom: 14 }}>Your order</div>
            {cartItems.map(([id, q]) => {
              const item = menu.find((m) => m.id === id);
              return (
                <div key={id} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 10 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{item.name}</div>
                  <Stepper qty={q} onChange={(nq) => setQty(id, nq)} />
                </div>
              );
            })}
            <textarea
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Notes for the kitchen (allergies, spice level...)"
              style={{
                width: "100%",
                marginTop: 12,
                border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`,
                borderRadius: 10,
                padding: 10,
                fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
                fontSize: 13,
                resize: "none",
                background: "#fff",
              }}
              rows={2}
            />

            <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.05em", color: "#8A8375", marginBottom: 8 }}>
                Pay at counter
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
                {["cash", "upi"].map((p) => (
                  <button
                    key={p}
                    onClick={() => setPayment(p)}
                    style={{
                      flex: 1,
                      padding: "10px 0",
                      borderRadius: 10,
                      border: `1px solid ${payment === p ? COLORS.copper : COLORS.line}`,
                      background: payment === p ? COLORS.copper : "#fff",
                      color: payment === p ? "#fff" : COLORS.ink,
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      fontSize: 13,
                      cursor: "pointer",
                    }}
                  >
                    {p === "cash" ? "Cash" : "UPI"}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 16, fontSize: 15 }}>
              <span>Total</span>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace" }}>{inr(cartTotal)}</span>
            </div>

            <button onClick={handlePlaceOrder} disabled={placing} style={{ ...primaryBtn, width: "100%", marginTop: 16 }}>
              {placing ? "Placing orderâ€¦" : "Place order"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Header({ table, setTable }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
      <div>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontStyle: "italic", fontSize: 13, color: COLORS.copper }}>{RESTAURANT.tagline}</div>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 28, color: COLORS.ink, lineHeight: 1.1 }}>{RESTAURANT.name}</div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#8A8375", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.05em" }}>Table</div>
        {setTable ? (
          <select
            value={table}
            onChange={(e) => setTable(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{
              fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace",
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: 18,
              border: "none",
              background: "transparent",
              color: COLORS.ink,
              textAlign: "right",
            }}
          >
            {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 18 }}>{table}</div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
