/* =========================================================
   STAFF / KITCHEN VIEW
========================================================= */
function StaffView({ orders, advanceStatus }) {
  const active = orders.filter((o) => o.status !== "served").sort((a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt);
  const columns = ["new", "preparing", "ready"];

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: "22px 16px 60px", maxWidth: 1100, margin: "0 auto" }}>
      <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 26, color: COLORS.ink, marginBottom: 4 }}>Kitchen board</div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#8A8375", marginBottom: 20 }}>{active.length} active order{active.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}</div>

      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))", gap: 16 }}>
        {columns.map((status) => {
          const list = active.filter((o) => o.status === status);
          return (
            <div key={status}>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <div style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", background: STATUS_COLOR[status] }} />
                <div style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", fontSize: 12, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.06em", fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  {STATUS_LABEL[status]} Â· {list.length}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 12 }}>
                {list.map((o) => (
                  <Ticket key={o.id} code={"T" + o.table} stampColor={STATUS_COLOR[o.status]}>
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 6 }}>
                      <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 16 }}>Table {o.table}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#8A8375", fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace" }}>{timeAgo(o.createdAt)}</div>
                    </div>
                    {o.items.map((it) => (
                      <div key={it.itemId} style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 2 }}>
                        {it.qty}Ã— {it.name}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    {o.notes && (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.rust, marginTop: 6, fontStyle: "italic" }}>â€œ{o.notes}â€</div>
                    )}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => advanceStatus(o.id)}
                      style={{ ...primaryBtn, width: "100%", marginTop: 12, padding: "9px 0", fontSize: 12.5, background: COLORS.ink }}
                    >
                      {status === "new" ? "Start preparing" : status === "preparing" ? "Mark ready" : "Mark served"}
                    </button>
                  </Ticket>
                ))}
                {list.length === 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#B7AF9E", padding: "10px 0" }}>Empty</div>}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* =========================================================
   ADMIN VIEW
========================================================= */
function AdminView({ menu, setMenu, orders, markPaid, clearOrders }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("overview");
  const today = new Date().toDateString();
  const todaysOrders = orders.filter((o) => new Date(o.createdAt).toDateString() === today);
  const revenue = todaysOrders.filter((o) => o.paid).reduce((s, o) => s + o.items.reduce((a, it) => a + it.price * it.qty, 0), 0);
  const itemCounts = {};
  todaysOrders.forEach((o) => o.items.forEach((it) => { itemCounts[it.name] = (itemCounts[it.name] || 0) + it.qty; }));
  const topItems = Object.entries(itemCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 3);

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: "22px 16px 60px", maxWidth: 1000, margin: "0 auto" }}>
      <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 26, color: COLORS.ink, marginBottom: 16 }}>Admin</div>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, marginBottom: 22, borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
        {["overview", "menu", "orders"].map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t}
            onClick={() => setTab(t)}
            style={{
              background: "none",
              border: "none",
              padding: "10px 4px",
              marginRight: 18,
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: 14,
              textTransform: "capitalize",
              color: tab === t ? COLORS.ink : "#8A8375",
              borderBottom: tab === t ? `2px solid ${COLORS.copper}` : "2px solid transparent",
              cursor: "pointer",
            }}
          >
            {t}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {tab === "overview" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr))", gap: 14, marginBottom: 24 }}>
            <StatCard label="Orders today" value={todaysOrders.length} />
            <StatCard label="Revenue (paid)" value={inr(revenue)} />
            <StatCard label="Avg order value" value={todaysOrders.length ? inr(Math.round(revenue / Math.max(1, todaysOrders.filter(o => o.paid).length))) : inr(0)} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 10 }}>Top items today</div>
          {topItems.length === 0 && <div style={{ color: "#8A8375", fontSize: 13 }}>No orders yet today.</div>}
          {topItems.map(([name, qty]) => (
            <div key={name} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "8px 0", borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, fontSize: 14 }}>
              <span>{name}</span>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", fontWeight: 600 }}>{qty}Ã—</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === "menu" && <MenuEditor menu={menu} setMenu={setMenu} />}

      {tab === "orders" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <button
              onClick={() => { if (window.confirm("Clear all order history? This can't be undone.")) clearOrders(); }}
              style={{ background: "none", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.rust}`, color: COLORS.rust, borderRadius: 8, padding: "6px 12px", fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer" }}
            >
              Clear all orders
            </button>
          </div>
          <div style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
            <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", fontSize: 13 }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ textAlign: "left", color: "#8A8375", fontSize: 11, textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.05em" }}>
                  <th style={th}>Table</th>
                  <th style={th}>Items</th>
                  <th style={th}>Total</th>
                  <th style={th}>Status</th>
                  <th style={th}>Payment</th>
                  <th style={th}>Paid</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {[...orders].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt).map((o) => (
                  <tr key={o.id} style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
                    <td style={td}>{o.table}</td>
                    <td style={td}>{o.items.map((it) => `${it.qty}Ã—${it.name}`).join(", ")}</td>
                    <td style={{ ...td, fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace" }}>{inr(o.items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.price * it.qty, 0))}</td>
                    <td style={td}><Badge color={STATUS_COLOR[o.status]}>{STATUS_LABEL[o.status]}</Badge></td>
                    <td style={td}>{o.payment === "cash" ? "Cash" : "UPI"}</td>
                    <td style={td}>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => markPaid(o.id, !o.paid)}
                        style={{
                          border: `1px solid ${o.paid ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.line}`,
                          background: o.paid ? COLORS.sage : "transparent",
                          color: o.paid ? "#fff" : COLORS.ink,
                          borderRadius: 8,
                          padding: "4px 10px",
                          fontSize: 12,
                          cursor: "pointer",
                        }}
                      >
                        {o.paid ? "Paid" : "Mark paid"}
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {orders.length === 0 && <div style={{ color: "#8A8375", fontSize: 13, padding: "20px 0" }}>No orders yet.</div>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
const th = { padding: "8px 10px" };
const td = { padding: "8px 10px" };

function StatCard({ label, value }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: "14px 16px" }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#8A8375", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.05em" }}>{label}</div>
      <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 24, color: COLORS.ink, marginTop: 4 }}>{value}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MenuEditor({ menu, setMenu }) {
  const [newItem, setNewItem] = useState({ name: "", price: "", category: CATEGORIES[0], desc: "", veg: true });

  function update(id, patch) {
    setMenu(menu.map((m) => (m.id === id ? { ...m, ...patch } : m)));
  }
  function remove(id) {
    setMenu(menu.filter((m) => m.id !== id));
  }
  function add() {
    if (!newItem.name || !newItem.price) return;
    setMenu([...menu, { id: uid("m"), name: newItem.name, desc: newItem.desc, price: Number(newItem.price), category: newItem.category, veg: newItem.veg, available: true }]);
    setNewItem({ name: "", price: "", category: newItem.category, desc: "", veg: true });
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (
        <div key={cat} style={{ marginBottom: 22 }}>
          <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 17, marginBottom: 8 }}>{cat}</div>
          {menu.filter((m) => m.category === cat).map((item) => (
            <div key={item.id} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, padding: "8px 0", borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}` }}>
              <VegDot veg={item.veg} />
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600, opacity: item.available ? 1 : 0.4 }}>{item.name}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8A8375" }}>{item.desc}</div>
              </div>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={item.price}
                onChange={(e) => update(item.id, { price: Number(e.target.value) })}
                style={{ width: 70, padding: "5px 7px", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 6, fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace", fontSize: 13 }}
              />
              <button
                onClick={() => update(item.id, { available: !item.available })}
                style={{
                  border: `1px solid ${item.available ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.line}`,
                  background: item.available ? COLORS.sage : "transparent",
                  color: item.available ? "#fff" : "#8A8375",
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  padding: "5px 10px",
                  fontSize: 12,
                  cursor: "pointer",
                  whiteSpace: "nowrap",
                }}
              >
                {item.available ? "Available" : "86'd"}
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => remove(item.id)} style={{ border: "none", background: "none", color: COLORS.rust, cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 13 }}>
                Remove
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ))}

      <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 16, marginTop: 10 }}>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: "Fraunces, serif", fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 10 }}>Add menu item</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
          <input placeholder="Name" value={newItem.name} onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, name: e.target.value })} style={inputStyle} />
          <input placeholder="Description" value={newItem.desc} onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, desc: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 2 }} />
          <input placeholder="Price" type="number" value={newItem.price} onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, price: e.target.value })} style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 90 }} />
          <select value={newItem.category} onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, category: e.target.value })} style={inputStyle}>
            {CATEGORIES.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
          </select>
          <select value={newItem.veg ? "veg" : "nonveg"} onChange={(e) => setNewItem({ ...newItem, veg: e.target.value === "veg" })} style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: "none", minWidth: 90 }}>
            <option value="veg">Veg</option>
            <option value="nonveg">Non-veg</option>
          </select>
          <button onClick={add} style={{ ...primaryBtn, padding: "9px 16px" }}>Add</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
const inputStyle = { padding: "9px 10px", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.line}`, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 13, fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", flex: 1, minWidth: 100 };

function readUrlParams() {
  try {
    const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const role = p.get("role");
    const table = p.get("table");
    return {
      role: ["customer", "staff", "admin"].includes(role) ? role : null,
      table: table ? Number(table) : null,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { role: null, table: null };
  }
}

export default function App() {
  const urlParams = useRef(readUrlParams()).current;
  const [role, setRole] = useState(urlParams.role || "customer");
  const [table, setTable] = useState(urlParams.table || 4);
  const forcedRole = !!urlParams.role; // true when opened from a table/staff/admin QR link â€” hides the demo switcher
  const lockedTable = !!urlParams.table; // true when a specific table was passed in the link
  const [menu, setMenuState] = useState(DEFAULT_MENU);
  const [orders, setOrdersState] = useState([]);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const pollRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const [m, o] = await Promise.all([loadShared("cf-menu", DEFAULT_MENU), loadShared("cf-orders", [])]);
      setMenuState(m);
      setOrdersState(o);
      setReady(true);
    })();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    pollRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
      const o = await loadShared("cf-orders", []);
      setOrdersState(o);
    }, 3500);
    return () => clearInterval(pollRef.current);
  }, []);

  const setMenu = useCallback((next) => {
    setMenuState(next);
    saveShared("cf-menu", next);
  }, []);

  const placeOrder = useCallback(async (order) => {
    const latest = await loadShared("cf-orders", []);
    const next = [...latest, order];
    setOrdersState(next);
    await saveShared("cf-orders", next);
  }, []);

  const advanceStatus = useCallback(async (orderId) => {
    const latest = await loadShared("cf-orders", []);
    const next = latest.map((o) => {
      if (o.id !== orderId) return o;
      const idx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(o.status);
      return { ...o, status: STATUS_FLOW[Math.min(idx + 1, STATUS_FLOW.length - 1)] };
    });
    setOrdersState(next);
    await saveShared("cf-orders", next);
  }, []);

  const markPaid = useCallback(async (orderId, paid) => {
    const latest = await loadShared("cf-orders", []);
    const next = latest.map((o) => (o.id === orderId ? { ...o, paid } : o));
    setOrdersState(next);
    await saveShared("cf-orders", next);
  }, []);

  const clearOrders = useCallback(async () => {
    setOrdersState([]);
    await saveShared("cf-orders", []);
  }, []);

  if (!ready) {
    return (
      <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: COLORS.paper, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", color: "#8A8375" }}>
        Loadingâ€¦
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: COLORS.paper, color: COLORS.ink, fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif" }}>
      <style>{FONTS}</style>
      {!forcedRole && (
      <div
        style={{
          position: "sticky",
          top: 0,
          zIndex: 10,
          background: COLORS.ink,
          color: COLORS.paper,
          display: "flex",
          justifyContent: "center",
          gap: 4,
          padding: "8px",
        }}
      >
        {[
          ["customer", "Customer (QR view)"],
          ["staff", "Kitchen"],
          ["admin", "Admin"],
        ].map(([key, label]) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            onClick={() => setRole(key)}
            style={{
              background: role === key ? COLORS.copper : "transparent",
              color: role === key ? "#fff" : COLORS.paper,
              border: "none",
              borderRadius: 8,
              padding: "7px 14px",
              fontSize: 12.5,
              fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: "pointer",
              fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif",
            }}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      )}

      {role === "customer" && <CustomerView menu={menu} orders={orders} placeOrder={placeOrder} table={table} setTable={lockedTable ? null : setTable} />}
      {role === "staff" && <StaffView orders={orders} advanceStatus={advanceStatus} />}
      {role === "admin" && <AdminView menu={menu} setMenu={setMenu} orders={orders} markPaid={markPaid} clearOrders={clearOrders} />}
    </div>
  );
}===== ./firestore.rules =====
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{db}/documents {

    function signedIn() { return request.auth != null; }
    function hasStaffDoc() {
      return signedIn() && exists(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid))
        && get(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid)).data.get('active', true) != false;
    }
    function staffRole() {
      return get(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role;
    }
    function isStaff() { return hasStaffDoc() && staffRole() in ['admin', 'owner', 'manager', 'staff', 'waiter']; }
    function isAdmin() { return hasStaffDoc() && staffRole() in ['admin', 'owner', 'manager']; }
    function ownsOrder(orderId) {
      return signedIn()
        && exists(/databases/$(db)/documents/orders/$(orderId))
        && get(/databases/$(db)/documents/orders/$(orderId)).data.createdBy == request.auth.uid;
    }
    // Waiter/staff (admin/owner/manager nahi) ke liye: console se bhi ye 3 cheezein nahi ho sakti
    //  - paid order ko unpaid karna (Undo Paid sirf owner)
    //  - cancelled order ko wapas chalu karna (Restore sirf owner)
    //  - discount % badhana (discount sirf owner)
    function staffEditOk() {
      let before = resource.data;
      let after = request.resource.data;
      return !(before.get('paid', false) == true && after.get('paid', false) != true)
        && !(before.get('status', '') == 'cancelled' && after.get('status', '') != 'cancelled')
        && after.get('billDiscountPct', 0) <= before.get('billDiscountPct', 0);
    }
    function staffCreateOk() {
      return request.resource.data.get('billDiscountPct', 0) == 0;
    }
    function validCustomerOrder() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.status == 'new'
        && d.paid == false
        && d.orderType in ['dine_in', 'parcel']
        && d.table is int && d.table >= 0 && d.table <= 20
        && d.items is list && d.items.size() > 0 && d.items.size() <= 40
        && d.finalTotal is number && d.finalTotal >= 0 && d.finalTotal <= 100000
        && (!('discount' in d) || (d.discount is number && d.discount >= 0 && d.discount <= 50))
        && (!('paymentStatus' in d) || d.paymentStatus in ['pending', 'paid_unverified'])
        && d.keys().size() <= 60;
    }

    match /staff/{uid} {
      allow read: if signedIn() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow write: if false;
    }

    match /settings/{docId} {
      allow read: if (docId != 'privatePins' && docId != 'presets')
                  || (docId == 'presets' && isStaff())
                  || isAdmin();
      allow write: if isAdmin()
                  || (isStaff() && docId in ['menu', 'availability', 'favourites', 'expenseCats']);
    }

    match /orders/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && id.matches('^o[a-z0-9]{6,40}$')
        && request.resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid
        && ((isStaff() && (isAdmin() || staffCreateOk())) || validCustomerOrder());
      allow read: if isStaff() || (signedIn() && resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid);
      allow update: if (isStaff() && (isAdmin() || staffEditOk()))
        || (signedIn() && resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid
            && resource.data.status == 'new' && resource.data.paid == false
            && request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
            && request.resource.data.status == 'cancelled');
      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }

    match /customers/{phone} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow create: if signedIn() && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid;
      allow update: if isStaff() || (signedIn() && resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid);
    }

    match /loyaltyUsers/{phone} {
      allow get: if isStaff() || (signedIn() && request.auth.token.phone_number == '+91' + phone);
      allow list, write: if isStaff();
    }

    match /coinHistory/{id} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }

    match /calls/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && request.resource.data.status == 'active'
        && request.resource.data.table is int
        && request.resource.data.table >= 1 && request.resource.data.table <= 20
        && request.resource.data.keys().size() <= 6;
      allow read, update: if isStaff();
      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }

    match /bookings/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && request.resource.data.status == 'pending'
        && request.resource.data.keys().size() <= 12
        && request.resource.data.name is string && request.resource.data.name.size() <= 80;
      allow read, update, delete: if isStaff();
    }

    match /chats/{orderId}/messages/{msgId} {
      allow read: if isStaff() || ownsOrder(orderId);
      allow create: if (isStaff() || ownsOrder(orderId) || (signedIn() && orderId.matches('^general_.{1,15}$')))
        && request.resource.data.text is string && request.resource.data.text.size() <= 500;
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }

    match /inventory/{id} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow write: if isAdmin() || (isStaff() && id != 'items');
    }

    match /expenses/{id} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /vendors/{id} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow write: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /vendorPayments/{id} { allow read, write: if isAdmin(); }
    match /dayClose/{id}       { allow read, write: if isAdmin(); }
    match /feedback/{id} {
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow read: if isAdmin();
    }

    match /auditLogs/{id} {
      allow read: if isAdmin();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
  }
}

import sys, os, re, shutil, datetime

def backup(path):
    bak = path + ".bak_banner." + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%H%M%S")
    shutil.copy2(path, bak)
    print(f"ğŸ’¾ Backup created: {bak}")

def main():
    file_path = "src/StaffApp.jsx"
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        print(f"âŒ File not found: {file_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    backup(file_path)
    with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        src = f.read()

    print("ğŸ”§ Finding tab patterns to insert Calls Banner...\n")

    calls_banner = """
{calls.length > 0 && (
  <div style={{ background: C.amberLight, borderBottom: `2px solid ${C.amber}`, padding: "10px 16px", display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>
    <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, color: C.amber }}>ğŸ”” Waiter Called ({calls.length}):</span>
    {calls.map(c => (
      <div key={c.id} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, background: C.card, borderRadius: 20, padding: "4px 6px 4px 12px", border: `1px solid ${C.line}` }}>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, color: C.ink }}>Table {c.table}</span>
        <button onClick={() => resolveCall(c.id)} style={{ background: C.green, color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 14, padding: "4px 10px", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 11, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>âœ“ Done</button>
      </div>
    ))}
  </div>
)}
"""

    # Find all `{activeTab === "..." && (` patterns
    pattern = re.compile(r'\{\s*activeTab\s*===\s*"([^"]+)"\s*&&\s*\(')
    matches = list(pattern.finditer(src))

    if not matches:
        print("âŒ Koi bhi activeTab pattern nahi mila. File structure alag hai.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print("ğŸ“ Milne wale tabs:")
    for m in matches:
        print(f"   - Tab: {m.group(1)} at pos {m.start()}")

    # Insert banner BEFORE the first tab render block
    first_match = matches[0]
    insert_pos = first_match.start()
    src = src[:insert_pos] + calls_banner + "\n" + src[insert_pos:]
    print(f"\nâœ… Calls Banner inserted before the first tab: '{first_match.group(1)}'")

    with open(file_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print("\nğŸ’¾ File saved!")
    print("ğŸš€ Ab 'npm run build' chalayein.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { beforeAll, afterAll, describe, test } from "vitest";
import { initializeTestEnvironment, assertFails, assertSucceeds } from "@firebase/rules-unit-testing";
import { doc, getDoc, setDoc, updateDoc, addDoc, deleteDoc, collection, getDocs } from "firebase/firestore";

let env;
const as = (uid) => env.authenticatedContext(uid).firestore();
const anon = () => env.unauthenticatedContext().firestore();

beforeAll(async () => {
  env = await initializeTestEnvironment({
    projectId: "demo-eatpark",
    firestore: { rules: readFileSync("firestore.rules.proposed", "utf8") },
  });
  await env.clearFirestore();
  await env.withSecurityRulesDisabled(async (ctx) => {
    const db = ctx.firestore();
    await setDoc(doc(db, "staff/w1"), { role: "waiter" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "staff/a1"), { role: "admin" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "staff/o1"), { role: "owner" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "settings/privatePins"), { pin: "x" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "settings/menu"), { items: [] });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "orders/paid1"), { paid: true, status: "served", finalTotal: 100, createdBy: "c1" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "orders/open1"), { paid: false, status: "new", finalTotal: 100, createdBy: "c1" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "expenses/e1"), { amount: 10, date: "2026-10-30" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "inventory/items"), { list: [] });
  });
});

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Eat & Park â€” Unified Sync Fix
Dono apps (staff.jsx + customer.jsx) pe ek saath apply hota hai.
Usage:
    python3 sync_fix.py staff.jsx customer.jsx
Agar file names alag hain toh args mein do.
"""
import sys, os, re, shutil, datetime

def backup(path):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        bak = path + ".bak." + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
        shutil.copy2(path, bak)
        print(f"  ğŸ’¾ Backup: {bak}")

def replace_once(text, old, new, label):
    if old not in text:
        print(f"  âš ï¸  SKIP (not found): {label}")
        return text
    print(f"  âœ… Applied: {label}")
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)

def replace_all(text, old, new, label):
    if old not in text:
        print(f"  âš ï¸  SKIP (not found): {label}")
        return text
    count = text.count(old)
    print(f"  âœ… Applied: {label}  (x{count})")
    return text.replace(old, new)

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# STAFF APP FIXES

def fix_staff(src):
    print("\nğŸ”§ STAFF APP PATCHES")

    # 1.1 â€” auditLog â†’ auditLogs
    src = replace_all(src, 'collection(db, "auditLog")',
                      'collection(db, "auditLogs")',
                      "auditLog â†’ auditLogs (collection name)")

    # 1.2 â€” isOpenDineIn / isOpenParcel paid_unverified

  o.orderType === "parcel" && o.status !== "cancelled" && !o.paid && o.paymentStatus !== "due" &&
  Date.now() - (o.createdAt || 0) < 18 * 3600 * 1000;'''
    new_parcel = '''const PAID_STATUSES = ["paid", "paid_unverified"];
const isOpenParcel = (o) =>
  o.orderType === "parcel" && o.status !== "cancelled" && !o.paid &&
  o.paymentStatus !== "due" && !PAID_STATUSES.includes(o.paymentStatus) &&
  Date.now() - (o.createdAt || 0) < 18 * 3600 * 1000;'''
    src = replace_once(src, old_parcel, new_parcel, "isOpenParcel paid_unverified fix")

      () => {}

  }, [user]);
  const resolveCall = async (id) => {

    catch (e) { setCalls(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== id)); }

    src = replace_once(src, anchor_calls, calls_block, "calls + bookings listeners + resolveCall")

    # 1.4 â€” bookings tab in tabs array

            tab_anchor + '\n            { id: "bookings", label: "ğŸ“… Bookings" },',

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# CUSTOMER APP FIXES
# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def fix_customer(src):
    print("\nğŸ”§ CUSTOMER APP PATCHES")

    # 2.4 â€” uid stronger
    old_uid = 'function uid(prefix) { return prefix + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8); }'
    new_uid = 'function uid(prefix) { return prefix + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-5) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6); }'
    src = replace_once(src, old_uid, new_uid, "uid stronger (customer)")

    # 2.1 â€” Razorpay paid:true
    old_paid = 'status: "new", paid: false,'
    new_paid = 'status: "new", paid: (paymentInfo.status === "paid" || paymentInfo.status === "paid_unverified"),'
    src = replace_once(src, old_paid, new_paid, "Razorpay success = paid:true")

    # 2.2 â€” remove inventory tab from AdminView tabs
    old_tabs = '["overview", "menu", "tables", "presets", "gallery", "settings", "offers", "loyalty", "inventory", "orders", "bookings", "promotions"]'
    new_tabs = '["overview", "menu", "tables", "presets", "gallery", "settings", "offers", "loyalty", "orders", "bookings", "promotions"]'
    src = replace_once(src, old_tabs, new_tabs, "inventory tab removed from tabs array")

    # inventory block: remove {tab === "inventory" && (...)} â€” regex approach
    # Match from '{tab === "inventory" &&' up to matching close of that JSX block.
    # Safer: look for the marker lines and cut until the closing ')}' at same depth.
    pattern = re.compile(r'\{\s*tab\s*===\s*"inventory"\s*&&\s*\(', re.M)
    m = pattern.search(src)
    if m:
        start = m.start()
        # find matching parens
        depth = 0
        i = m.end() - 1  # points at '('
        # walk back to the '(' of the arrow
        # Actually walk from m.start() to find '(' of && then balance
        j = m.end() - 1
        depth = 1
        k = j + 1
        while k < len(src) and depth > 0:
            c = src[k]
            if c == '(':
                depth += 1
            elif c == ')':
                depth -= 1
            k += 1
        # k now past the ')' â€” expect '}'
        while k < len(src) and src[k] in ' \n\t':
            k += 1
        if k < len(src) and src[k] == '}':
            k += 1
        removed = src[start:k]
        src = src[:start] + src[k:]
        print(f"  âœ… Removed inventory tab block ({len(removed)} chars)")
    else:
        print("  âš ï¸  SKIP: inventory tab block not found (already removed?)")

    return src

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 3:

        sys.exit(1)

    staff_path, customer_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

    print("ğŸ“¦ BACKUPS")

const newAICode = `
function InteractiveSuggest({ C, menu, persons, onSuggest, onCancel }) {
  const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0);
  const [selections, setSelections] = React.useState({});

  const isVeg = (m) => m.veg;
  
  // Har step ke liye categories aur unke items filter karo
  const steps = [
    {
      title: "1. Starter (Snacks)",
      filter: (m) => /starter|snack|tandoor|momos|roll/i.test(m.category || ""),
    },
    {
      title: "2. Main Course",
      filter: (m) => /main|curry|sabzi|gravy|paneer|chicken|mutton/i.test(m.category || ""),
    },
    {
      title: "3. Bread (Roti/Naan)",
      filter: (m) => /bread|roti|naan/i.test(m.category || ""),
    },
    {
      title: "4. Rice / Biryani",
      filter: (m) => /rice|biryani|pulao/i.test(m.category || ""),
    },
    {
      title: "5. Drinks",
      filter: (m) => /drink|shake|juice|cold|mojito/i.test(m.category || ""),
    }
  ];

  const currentStepData = steps[step];
  
  // Current step ke items (veg/non-veg dono)
  const stepItems = menu.filter(m => m.available && currentStepData.filter(m));

  const handleSelectItem = (item) => {
    setSelections(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (next[item.id]) delete next[item.id];
      else next[item.id] = { item, qty: 1 };
      return next;
    });
  };

  const changeQty = (item, delta) => {
    setSelections(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (next[item.id]) {
        const newQty = next[item.id].qty + delta;
        if (newQty <= 0) delete next[item.id];
        else next[item.id].qty = newQty;
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (step < steps.length - 1) {
      setStep(step + 1);
    } else {
      // Calculation based on persons
      const finalItems = Object.values(selections).map(sel => {
        let qty = sel.qty;
        // Smart quantity logic based on category
        const cat = sel.item.category || "";
        if (/bread|roti|naan/i.test(cat)) qty = persons * 2;
        else if (/rice|biryani/i.test(cat)) qty = Math.ceil(persons / 2);
        else if (/starter|snack/i.test(cat)) qty = persons; 
        else if (/drink|shake/i.test(cat)) qty = persons;
        else qty = Math.ceil(persons * 0.7); // Main course
        
        return { id: sel.item.id, name: sel.item.name, price: sel.item.price, qty: Math.max(1, qty) };
      });
      
      onSuggest(finalItems);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 16, background: C.cardAlt, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid " + C.line }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>{currentStepData.title}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700 }}>Step {step + 1}/{steps.length} (For {persons} persons)</div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ maxHeight: 200, overflowY: 'auto', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        {stepItems.length === 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: C.gray, textAlign: 'center', padding: 10 }}>Is category me kuch nahi mila</div>}
        {stepItems.map(m => {
          const isSelected = !!selections[m.id];
          const qty = selections[m.id]?.qty || 0;
          return (
            <div key={m.id} onClick={() => !isSelected && handleSelectItem(m)} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: 8, borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.line, background: isSelected ? C.goldLight : 'transparent', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <span style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: '50%', background: m.veg ? 'green' : 'red' }}></span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: C.ink }}>{m.name}</span>
              </div>
              
              {isSelected ? (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, background: C.card, borderRadius: 6, padding: '2px 6px', border: "1px solid " + C.line }}>
                  <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); changeQty(m, -1); }} style={{ border: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontSize: 16, cursor: 'pointer', color: C.gray }}>âˆ’</button>

with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    src = f.read()

applied = 0; skipped = 0

def sub(name, old, new, count=1):
    global src, applied, skipped
    if new in src:
        print("PEHLE SE", name); return
    n = src.count(old)
    if n == count:
        src = src.replace(old, new); applied += 1; print("OK    ", name)
    else:
        skipped += 1; print("SKIP  ", name, "(%d mila, %d chahiye)" % (n, count))


IMPORT_BLOCK = r'''
// ===========================================================================
// BULK IMPORT (patch 6)
// Gemini se nikala hua JSON import karke vendors + expenses auto-create
// ===========================================================================

function ImportView({ C, isMobile, isOwner, waiterName, onDone }) {
  const toast = useToast(); const haptic = useHaptic();
  const G = goldOf(C); const GT = goldTextOf(C);
  const [rawJson, setRawJson] = useState("");
  const [parsed, setParsed] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [existingVendors, setExistingVendors] = useState([]);
  const [modeOverride, setModeOverride] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    getDocs(collection(db, "vendors"))
      .then((s) => setExistingVendors(s.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }))))
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const parseJson = (text, overrideArg) => {
    const override = overrideArg === undefined ? modeOverride : overrideArg;
    setError(""); setResult(null);
    if (!text.trim()) { setParsed(null); return; }
    try {
      const clean = text.replace(/^```json\s*/i, "").replace(/^```\s*/i, "").replace(/```\s*$/i, "").trim();
      const obj = JSON.parse(clean);
      const bills = Array.isArray(obj) ? obj : (obj.bills || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(bills)) throw new Error("JSON mein 'bills' array nahi mila");
      const normalized = bills.map((b, i) => ({
        _idx: i,
        vendorName: String(b.vendorName || "").trim(),
        vendorPhone: b.vendorPhone ? String(b.vendorPhone).trim() : "",
        date: b.date || invDateKey(),
        amount: Number(b.amount) || 0,
        category: b.category || "Anya",
        mode: override || b.mode || "credit",
        note: b.note || "",
        confidence: Number(b.confidence) || 1,
        _valid: !!b.vendorName && Number(b.amount) > 0,
        _skip: false,
        _existingVendorId: "",
      }));
      normalized.forEach((n) => {
        const match = existingVendors.find((v) => v.name.toLowerCase() === n.vendorName.toLowerCase());
        if (match) n._existingVendorId = match.id;
      });
      setParsed(normalized);
    } catch (e) {
      setParsed(null);
      setError("JSON galat hai: " + e.message);
    }
  };

  const handleFile = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.name.endsWith(".json")) { toast("Sirf .json file daalo", "warning"); return; }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
      const txt = String(ev.target.result || "");
      setRawJson(txt);
      parseJson(txt);
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  const toggleSkip = (idx) => {
    setParsed((prev) => prev.map((p) => p._idx === idx ? { ...p, _skip: !p._skip } : p));
  };
  const editField = (idx, field, value) => {
    setParsed((prev) => prev.map((p) => {
      if (p._idx !== idx) return p;
      const upd = { ...p, [field]: value };
      upd._valid = !!upd.vendorName && Number(upd.amount) > 0;
      return upd;
    }));
  };

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (!parsed) return null;
    const active = parsed.filter((p) => !p._skip && p._valid);
    const newVendors = new Set();
    active.forEach((p) => { if (!p._existingVendorId) newVendors.add(p.vendorName.toLowerCase()); });
    return {
      total: parsed.length,
      importing: active.length,
      skipped: parsed.filter((p) => p._skip).length,
      invalid: parsed.filter((p) => !p._skip && !p._valid).length,
      newVendors: newVendors.size,
      totalAmount: active.reduce((s, p) => s + Number(p.amount || 0), 0),
    };
  }, [parsed]);

  const runImport = async () => {
    if (!parsed || !stats || stats.importing === 0) { toast("Kuch import karne layak nahi", "warning"); return; }
    if (!window.confirm(stats.importing + " bills import honge. " + stats.newVendors + " naye vendor banenge. Confirm?")) return;
    setImporting(true);
    const imported = { expenses: 0, vendors: 0, errors: [] };
    try {
      const nameToId = {};
      existingVendors.forEach((v) => { nameToId[v.name.toLowerCase()] = v.id; });

      const newVendorNames = new Set();
      parsed.filter((p) => !p._skip && p._valid && !p._existingVendorId).forEach((p) => newVendorNames.add(p.vendorName));
      for (const vName of newVendorNames) {
        try {
          const ref = await addDoc(collection(db, "vendors"), {
            name: vName, phone: "", openingDue: 0, active: true, createdAt: Date.now(),
          });
          nameToId[vName.toLowerCase()] = ref.id;
          imported.vendors++;
        } catch (e) {
          imported.errors.push("Vendor '" + vName + "': " + e.message);
        }
      }

      const active = parsed.filter((p) => !p._skip && p._valid);
      for (let i = 0; i < active.length; i += 20) {
        const chunk = active.slice(i, i + 20);
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        chunk.forEach((p) => {
          const vId = p._existingVendorId || nameToId[p.vendorName.toLowerCase()] || null;
          const ref = doc(collection(db, "expenses"));
          batch.set(ref, {
            date: p.date,
            amount: Number(p.amount),
            category: p.category,
            mode: p.mode,
            vendorId: vId,
            note: (p.note || "") + (p.vendorPhone ? " | " + p.vendorPhone : ""),
            by: waiterName || "Staff",
            createdAt: Date.now(),
            importedFrom: "gemini",
          });
          imported.expenses++;
        });
        await batch.commit();
      }

      try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, "auditLog"), {
          action: "bulk_import",
          amount: stats.totalAmount,
          count: imported.expenses,
          by: waiterName || "Staff",
          at: Date.now(),
          detail: imported.vendors + " new vendors, " + imported.expenses + " expenses",
        });
      } catch (e) {}

      haptic(50);
      setResult({ ok: true, ...imported, totalAmount: stats.totalAmount });
      toast("Import ho gaya: " + imported.expenses + " expenses, " + imported.vendors + " naye vendor", "success");
      if (onDone) onDone();
    } catch (e) {
      setResult({ ok: false, error: e.message });
      toast("Import fail: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
    }
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setRawJson(""); setParsed(null); setError(""); setResult(null);
  };

  const box = { background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 14, padding: isMobile ? 14 : 18, marginBottom: 16 };
  const field = { width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", padding: "11px 12px", border: "1.5px solid " + C.line, borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 14, background: C.card, color: C.ink, outline: "none", fontFamily: "inherit" };

  if (!isOwner) {
    return (
      <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 50, color: C.gray }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>ğŸ”’</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, marginTop: 8 }}>Bulk import sirf owner kar sakta hai</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 style={{ margin: "0 0 4px", fontSize: isMobile ? 18 : 22, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>ğŸ“¥ Bulk Import</h2>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 14 }}>
        Gemini se nikala hua JSON file yahan daalo - vendors aur expenses auto-create ho jayenge
      </div>

      {!parsed && !result && (
        <>
          <div style={box}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 10 }}>ğŸ“¸ Step 1: Bills ki photo Gemini ko bhejo</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.gray, lineHeight: 1.6, marginBottom: 12 }}>
              Gemini ko bill photo + niche wala prompt bhejo. Wo aapko JSON dega. Us JSON ko <b>.json</b> file mein save karo.
            </div>
            <details style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
              <summary style={{ cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800, color: GT, padding: "8px 0" }}>ğŸ“‹ Gemini Prompt dekho / copy karo</summary>
              <pre style={{ background: C.cardAlt, padding: 12, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 10, overflowX: "auto", color: C.ink, lineHeight: 1.5, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{`Tum ek restaurant accounting assistant ho. Main tumhe purane bill/invoice ki photo bhej raha hoon. Tumhe isse structured JSON nikaalna hai.

RULES:
1. Sirf valid JSON return karo, koi explanation nahi.
2. Agar koi field samajh nahi aaye toh null daalo.
3. Amount number mein.
4. Date YYYY-MM-DD format mein.
5. Category choose karo: ["Saman / Kaccha maal", "Salary", "Kiraya", "Gas / Coyla", "Bijli / Pani", "Repair", "Packing", "Marketing", "Anya"]
6. "paid" likha ho toh mode="cash", warna mode="credit".
7. Multiple bills ho toh array.

OUTPUT:
{
  "bills": [
    {
      "vendorName": "Ramesh Vegetables",
      "vendorPhone": "9876543210",
      "date": "2026-10-15",
      "amount": 10000,
      "category": "Saman / Kaccha maal",
      "mode": "credit",
      "note": "Paneer 5kg",
      "confidence": 0.95
    }
  ]
}`}</pre>
            </details>
          </div>

          <div style={box}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink, marginBottom: 10 }}>ğŸ“ Step 2: JSON file upload karo</div>
            <input type="file" accept=".json,application/json" onChange={handleFile} style={{ ...field, padding: 10, cursor: "pointer" }} />
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, marginTop: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>Ya niche seedha paste karo:</div>
            <textarea
              value={rawJson}
              onChange={(e) => { setRawJson(e.target.value); parseJson(e.target.value); }}
              placeholder='{"bills": [{"vendorName": "...", "amount": 1000, ...}]}'
              style={{ ...field, minHeight: 160, marginTop: 8, fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: 12 }}

const SMART_AI_STEPS = [

  { key: "starter", q: "Starter (Snacks) me kya loge?", options: ["Veg Starter", "Non-Veg Starter", "Starter Skip karo"] },

function InteractiveSuggest({ C, menu, persons, onSuggest, onCancel }) {
  const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = React.useState({});

  const handleSelect = (opt) => {
    const newAns = { ...answers, [SMART_AI_STEPS[step].key]: opt };
    setAnswers(newAns);

    if (step < SMART_AI_STEPS.length - 1) {
      setStep(step + 1);
    } else {
      const items = [];
      const addItem = (categoryRegex, pickLimit, perPersonRatio) => {
        const pool = menu.filter((m) => m.available !== false && categoryRegex.test(m.category || ""));
        if (!pool.length) return;
        const picked = pool.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, pickLimit);

          const totalQty = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(persons * perPersonRatio));
          items.push({ id: m.id, name: m.name, price: m.price, qty: totalQty });
        });
      };

      if (newAns.starter === "Veg Starter") addItem(/starter|snack|tandoor|momos/i, 1, 0.5);
      else if (newAns.starter === "Non-Veg Starter") addItem(/chicken|mutton|fish/i, 1, 0.5);

      else if (newAns.main === "Chicken / Mutton (Non-Veg)") addItem(/chicken|mutton/i, 2, 0.7);

      if (newAns.drink === "Dessert (Sweet)" || newAns.drink === "Dono") addItem(/sweet|dessert|ice/i, 1, 0.5);

      onSuggest(items);
    }
  };

  return (

  },

const cache = {};
const load = (key) => {
  if (cache[key]) return cache[key];
  const p = files[key];
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) { cache[key] = { path: p, missing: true }; return cache[key]; }
  let src = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
  const crlf = src.includes("\r\n");
  if (crlf) src = src.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
  cache[key] = { path: p, src, crlf, changed: false };
  return cache[key];
};

const report = [];
let applied = 0;
for (const e of edits) {
  const f = load(e.file);
  if (f.missing) { report.push("SKIP    " + e.name + "  (file nahi mili: " + f.path + ")"); continue; }
  const count = f.src.split(e.find).length - 1;
  if (count === 1) {
    f.src = f.src.replace(e.find, () => e.repl);
    f.changed = true;
    applied++;
    report.push("OK      " + e.name);
  } else if (count === 0) {
    report.push("SKIP    " + e.name + "  (nahi mila - shayad pehle hi apply ho chuka)");
  } else {
    report.push("SKIP    " + e.name + "  (" + count + " jagah mila - unsafe)");
  }
}

for (const key of Object.keys(cache)) {
  const f = cache[key];
  if (f.missing || !f.changed) continue;
  fs.copyFileSync(f.path, f.path + ".pre-patch2");
  fs.writeFileSync(f.path, f.crlf ? f.src.replace(/\n/g, "\r\n") : f.src, "utf8");
}

console.log(report.join("\n"));
console.log("\n" + applied + "/" + edits.length + " edits apply hue (backup: <file>.pre-patch2)");

===== ./estimate-fix.cjs =====
const fs = require("fs"), path = require("path");
const MARK = "EP-EST-v1";
function walk(d, out = []) {
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(d)) {
    if (f === "node_modules") continue;
    const p = path.join(d, f), st = fs.statSync(p);
    if (st.isDirectory()) walk(p, out);
    else if (/\.jsx?$/.test(f) && !/backup/i.test(f)) out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}
const file = walk(process.argv[2] || "src").find(f => fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8").includes("function StaffAppInner("));
if (!file) { console.log("Staff file nahi mili"); process.exit(1); }
let s = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
if (s.includes(MARK)) { console.log("Already patched:", file); process.exit(0); }
fs.writeFileSync(file + ".bak2", s);
const ok = [], warn = [];
function rep(from, to, label) {
  if (!s.includes(from)) { warn.push(label); return; }
  s = s.replace(from, () => to); ok.push(label);
}

rep('const [showEstimate, setShowEstimate] = useState(false);',
    'const [showEstimate, setShowEstimate] = useState(false);\n  const [estimatePending, setEstimatePending] = useState(false);', "state");

    'onTableClick={(t) => { haptic(); setSelectedTable(t); setCart((p) => (estimatePending ? p : {})); setEstimatePending(false); setBillOrder(null); setAddMoreMode(false); }}', "table click keeps cart");

rep('onNew={() => { haptic(); setSelectedTable("parcel"); setCart({}); setBillOrder(null); setAddMoreMode(false); }}',
    'onNew={() => { haptic(); setSelectedTable("parcel"); setCart((p) => (estimatePending ? p : {})); setEstimatePending(false); setBillOrder(null); setAddMoreMode(false); }}', "parcel new keeps cart");

rep('onBack={() => { setSelectedTable(null); setCart({}); setBillOrder(null); setAddMoreMode(false); }}',
    'onBack={() => { setSelectedTable(null); setCart({}); setEstimatePending(false); setBillOrder(null); setAddMoreMode(false); }}', "back resets");

rep('if (!selectedTable) setActiveTab("tables");',
    'setEstimatePending(true);\n            if (!selectedTable) setActiveTab("tables");', "estimate sets pending");

rep('items cart me chale gaye', 'items cart me hain - ab table ya Parcel chuno', "toast text");

import os

os.makedirs("api", exist_ok=True)

code = r'''const UA = { "User-Agent": "EatParkMenu/1.0 (restaurant menu app)" };

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const q = String(req.query.q || "").trim().slice(0, 80);
  if (!q) return res.status(400).json({ url: null });
  try {
    const api =
      "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&format=json&generator=search&gsrlimit=6" +
      "&prop=pageimages&piprop=thumbnail&pithumbsize=600&gsrsearch=" +
      encodeURIComponent(q + " food");
    const r = await fetch(api, { headers: UA });
    const d = await r.json();
    const pages = Object.values((d.query && d.query.pages) || {}).sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
    const hit = pages.find((p) => p.thumbnail && !/\.svg|flag|logo|map/i.test(p.thumbnail.source));
    if (!hit) return res.status(200).json({ url: null });

    const imgRes = await fetch(hit.thumbnail.source, { headers: UA });
    if (!imgRes.ok) return res.status(200).json({ url: null });
    const type = imgRes.headers.get("content-type") || "image/jpeg";
    const buf = Buffer.from(await imgRes.arrayBuffer());

    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("file", "data:" + type + ";base64," + buf.toString("base64"));
    fd.append("upload_preset", "eatpark_uploads");
    const up = await fetch("https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/nnddxvcn/image/upload", { method: "POST", body: fd });
    const u = await up.json();

    res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "s-maxage=86400");
    res.status(200).json({ url: u.secure_url || null });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ url: null });
  }
}
'''

open("api/image.js", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(code)
print("OK api/image.js Wikipedia + Cloudinary version se badal diya (koi key nahi chahiye)")
print("Ab: git add -A && git commit -m 'image api: wikipedia + cloudinary' && git push")

    },
    {
      title: "5. Drinks / Shakes",
      filter: (m) => /drink|shake|juice|cold|mojito/i.test(m.category || ""),
      calcQty: (p) => p,
    }
  ];

  const currentStepData = steps[step];
  const stepItems = menu.filter(m => m.available && currentStepData.filter(m));

  const handleSelectItem = (item) => {
    setSelections(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (next[item.id]) delete next[item.id];
      else next[item.id] = { item, qty: 1 };
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (step < steps.length - 1) {
      setStep(step + 1);
    } else {
      const finalItems = Object.values(selections).map(sel => {
        const autoQty = currentStepData.calcQty(persons);
        return { id: sel.item.id, name: sel.item.name, price: sel.item.price, qty: Math.max(1, autoQty) };
      });
      onSuggest(finalItems);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 16, background: C.cardAlt, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid " + C.line }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>{currentStepData.title}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700 }}>{step + 1}/{steps.length} (For {persons} pax)</div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ maxHeight: 200, overflowY: 'auto', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        {stepItems.map(m => {
          const isSelected = !!selections[m.id];
          return (
            <div key={m.id} onClick={() => !isSelected && handleSelectItem(m)} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: 8, borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.line, background: isSelected ? C.goldLight : 'transparent', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <span style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: '50%', background: m.veg ? 'green' : 'red' }}></span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: C.ink }}>{m.name}</span>
              </div>
              {isSelected ? <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.goldText, fontWeight: 800 }}>Selected âœ“</span> : <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.goldText }}>{inr(m.price)} +</span>}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
        {step > 0 && <button onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid " + C.line, background: C.card, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', color: C.ink }}>â† Pichla</button>}
        {step < steps.length - 1 ? (
          <button onClick={handleNext} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: "none", background: C.gold, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Aage â†’</button>
        ) : (
          <button onClick={handleNext} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: "none", background: C.green, color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, cursor: 'pointer' }}>âœ… Items Add Karo</button>
        )}
      </div>
      <button onClick={onCancel} style={{ width: '100%', marginTop: 10, padding: 8, border: 'none', background: 'transparent', color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12 }}>Cancel</button>
    </div>
  );
}
`;

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# PATCH 4 (sab kuch ek me):
#   1. Kharcha (Expenses) tab  - roz ka kharcha, category, cash/UPI/bank
#   2. Reports tab             - Profit/Loss, Excel download (multi-sheet), PDF/Print, WhatsApp
#   3. Day Close               - cash gin ke match, din ka hisab Firestore me save
#   4. Billing: Favourite quick-add (top 8 bikne wale) + item rate editable (sirf owner)
#   5. Tables: 60 min se zyada baithe table par timer
#   6. Merge Table atomic (writeBatch) + Saman tab par low-stock badge
#
# Usage:  python3 patch_staff4.py src/StaffApp.jsx
# Patch 1/2/3 lagi ho ya na ho - ye dono me chalta hai.

import sys, shutil, datetime

if len(sys.argv) < 2:
    print(__doc__)
    sys.exit(1)

path = sys.argv[1]
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    src = f.read()

applied = 0
skipped = 0


def sub(name, old, new, count=1):
    global src, applied, skipped
    if new in src:
        print("PEHLE SE", name)
        return
    n = src.count(old)
    if n == count:
        src = src.replace(old, new)
        applied += 1
        print("OK    ", name)
    else:
        skipped += 1
        print("SKIP  ", name, "(%d jagah mila, %d chahiye)" % (n, count))


BLOCK = r'''
// ===========================================================================
// KHARCHA (EXPENSES) + REPORTS / P&L + DAY CLOSE   (patch 4)
// Firestore collections: expenses/{id}, dayClose/{YYYY-MM-DD}
// ===========================================================================
const EXP_CATS = ["Saman / Kaccha maal", "Salary", "Kiraya", "Gas / Coyla", "Bijli / Pani", "Repair", "Packing", "Marketing", "Anya"];
const goldOf = (C) => C.gold || C.red;
const goldTextOf = (C) => C.goldText || C.red;
const rs = (n) => "Rs " + (Number(n) || 0).toLocaleString("en-IN");
const xmlEsc = (s) => String(s === null || s === undefined ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));

// Multi-sheet Excel file (SpreadsheetML) - koi library nahi chahiye
function downloadXls(filename, sheets) {
  const body = sheets.map((sh) => {
    const name = xmlEsc(String(sh.name).replace(/[\\/?*\[\]:]/g, " ").slice(0, 31));
    const rows = sh.rows.map((r) => "<Row>" + r.map((c) => {
      const isNum = typeof c === "number" && isFinite(c);
      return '<Cell><Data ss:Type="' + (isNum ? "Number" : "String") + '">' + xmlEsc(c) + "</Data></Cell>";
    }).join("") + "</Row>").join("");
    return '<Worksheet ss:Name="' + name + '"><Table>' + rows + "</Table></Worksheet>";
  }).join("");
  const xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><?mso-application progid="Excel.Sheet"?><Workbook xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet" xmlns:ss="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet">' + body + "</Workbook>";
  const blob = new Blob([xml], { type: "application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8" });
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 4000);
}

const loadOrdersRange = async (fromKey, toKey) => {
  const start = new Date(fromKey + "T00:00:00").getTime();
  const end = new Date(toKey + "T00:00:00").getTime() + 86400000;
  const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "orders"), where("createdAt", ">=", start), where("createdAt", "<", end)));
  return snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
};
const loadExpensesRange = async (fromKey, toKey) => {
  const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "expenses"), where("date", ">=", fromKey), where("date", "<=", toKey)));
  return snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
};

function calcStats(orders, expenses) {
  const sum = (arr, f) => arr.reduce((s, x) => s + (Number(f(x)) || 0), 0);
  const valid = orders.filter((o) => o.status !== "cancelled");
  const paid = valid.filter((o) => o.paid);
  const duePending = sum(valid.filter((o) => o.paymentStatus === "due" && !o.paid), (o) => o.finalTotal);
  const revenue = sum(paid, (o) => o.finalTotal);
  const pay = { cash: 0, upi: 0, card: 0 };
  paid.forEach((o) => { const m = String(o.payment || "cash").toLowerCase(); pay[m] = (pay[m] || 0) + (Number(o.finalTotal) || 0); });
  const expTotal = sum(expenses, (e) => e.amount);
  const expByCat = {};
  expenses.forEach((e) => { const c = e.category || "Anya"; expByCat[c] = (expByCat[c] || 0) + (Number(e.amount) || 0); });
  const catRows = Object.entries(expByCat).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  const saman = sum(expenses.filter((e) => /saman|maal/i.test(e.category || "")), (e) => e.amount);
  const profit = revenue - expTotal;
  const margin = revenue > 0 ? (profit / revenue) * 100 : 0;
  const dayMap = {};
  const dayOf = (k) => { if (!dayMap[k]) dayMap[k] = { date: k, orders: 0, revenue: 0, expense: 0 }; return dayMap[k]; };
  valid.forEach((o) => { const d = dayOf(invDateKey(new Date(o.createdAt || 0))); d.orders++; if (o.paid) d.revenue += Number(o.finalTotal) || 0; });
  expenses.forEach((e) => { if (e.date) dayOf(e.date).expense += Number(e.amount) || 0; });
  const daily = Object.values(dayMap).sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? -1 : 1)).map((d) => ({ ...d, profit: d.revenue - d.expense }));
  const itemMap = {};
  paid.forEach((o) => (o.items || []).forEach((it) => {
    const k = it.name + (it.portion ? " (" + it.portion + ")" : "");
    if (!itemMap[k]) itemMap[k] = { name: k, qty: 0, amt: 0 };
    itemMap[k].qty += Number(it.qty) || 0;
    itemMap[k].amt += (Number(it.price) || 0) * (Number(it.qty) || 0);
  }));
  const items = Object.values(itemMap).sort((a, b) => b.amt - a.amt);
  const wMap = {};
  paid.forEach((o) => { const w = o.waiter || "Staff"; if (!wMap[w]) wMap[w] = { name: w, orders: 0, amt: 0 }; wMap[w].orders++; wMap[w].amt += Number(o.finalTotal) || 0; });
  const waiters = Object.values(wMap).sort((a, b) => b.amt - a.amt);
  return {
    valid, paid, revenue, pay, duePending, expTotal, catRows, saman, profit, margin, daily, items, waiters,
    cancelled: orders.length - valid.length,
    avg: paid.length ? Math.round(revenue / paid.length) : 0,
    discount: sum(paid, (o) => o.billDiscount),
    gst: sum(paid, (o) => o.gstAmount),
  };
}

      {sub && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 4 }}>{sub}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

  useEffect(() => {

  const total = list.reduce((s, e) => s + (Number(e.amount) || 0), 0);

// REPORTS: PROFIT / LOSS + DOWNLOAD + DAY CLOSE

function ReportsView({ C, isMobile, isOwner, waiterName }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const haptic = useHaptic();
  const G = goldOf(C);
  const GT = goldTextOf(C);
  const [preset, setPreset] = useState("month");
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(() => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(1); return invDateKey(d); });
  const [to, setTo] = useState(invDateKey());
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState([]);
  const [closes, setCloses] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const a = from <= to ? from : to;
      const b = from <= to ? to : from;
      const [o, e] = await Promise.all([loadOrdersRange(a, b), loadExpensesRange(a, b)]);
      setOrders(o);
      setExpenses(e);
    } catch (err) { toast("Report load nahi hui: " + err.message, "error"); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, [from, to]);
  useEffect(() => { if (isOwner) load(); }, [load, isOwner]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOwner) return;
    const unsub = onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "dayClose"), orderBy("date", "desc"), limit(15)),
      (s) => setCloses(s.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }))), () => {});
    return () => unsub();
  }, [isOwner]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => calcStats(orders, expenses), [orders, expenses]);
  const rangeLabel = from === to ? from : from + " se " + to;
  const todayKey = invDateKey();
  const isTodayOnly = from === todayKey && to === todayKey;

  const setRange = (p) => {
    haptic();
    setPreset(p);
    const now = new Date();
    const k = (d) => invDateKey(d);
    if (p === "today") { setFrom(k(now)); setTo(k(now)); }
    else if (p === "yesterday") { const d = new Date(now); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1); setFrom(k(d)); setTo(k(d)); }
    else if (p === "7days") { const d = new Date(now); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 6); setFrom(k(d)); setTo(k(now)); }
    else if (p === "month") { setFrom(k(new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1))); setTo(k(now)); }

const UA = { "User-Agent": "EatParkMenu/1.0 (restaurant menu app)" };

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const q = String(req.query.q || "").trim().slice(0, 80);
  if (!q) return res.status(400).json({ url: null });
  try {
    const api =
      "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&format=json&generator=search&gsrlimit=6" +
      "&prop=pageimages&piprop=thumbnail&pithumbsize=600&gsrsearch=" +
      encodeURIComponent(q + " food");
    const r = await fetch(api, { headers: UA });
    const d = await r.json();
    const pages = Object.values((d.query && d.query.pages) || {}).sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
    const hit = pages.find((p) => p.thumbnail && !/\.svg|flag|logo|map/i.test(p.thumbnail.source));
    if (!hit) return res.status(200).json({ url: null });

    const imgRes = await fetch(hit.thumbnail.source, { headers: UA });
    if (!imgRes.ok) return res.status(200).json({ url: null });
    const type = imgRes.headers.get("content-type") || "image/jpeg";
    const buf = Buffer.from(await imgRes.arrayBuffer());

    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("file", "data:" + type + ";base64," + buf.toString("base64"));
    fd.append("upload_preset", "eatpark_uploads");
    const up = await fetch("https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/nnddxvcn/image/upload", { method: "POST", body: fd });
    const u = await up.json();

    res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "s-maxage=86400");
    res.status(200).json({ url: u.secure_url || null });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ url: null });
  }
}
===== ./api/parse-order.js =====
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", true);
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET,OPTIONS,PATCH,DELETE,POST,PUT");
  res.setHeader(
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers",
    "X-CSRF-Token, X-Requested-With, Accept, Accept-Version, Content-Length, Content-MD5, Content-Type, Date, X-Api-Version, Authorization"
  );

  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return res.status(200).end();
  }

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return res.status(405).json({ error: "Only POST allowed" });
  }

  try {
    const { text, menu } = req.body || {};
    if (!text) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: "Order text nahi mila" });
    }

    const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
    if (!apiKey) {
      return res.status(500).json({ error: "GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable missing hai" });
    }

    const prompt = `
Aap ek restaurant order parser hain. Customer text aur available menu match karke structured JSON return karein.
Text: "${text}"

Available Menu:
${JSON.stringify(menu || [])}

Rules:
1. Table number extract karein (agar text mein ho). Agar parcel bola hai toh orderType "parcel", warna "dine_in".
2. Har item ki quantity aur menu ID strictly match karein.
3. Agar koi item samajh na aaye toh "unmatched" array mein daalein.

Output MUST be strict JSON in this exact structure without markdown or backticks:
{
  "orderType": "dine_in",
  "table": 5,
  "items": [
    { "id": "matched_menu_id", "qty": 1 }
  ],
  "notes": "",
  "unmatched": []
}
`;

    // Updated model URL
    const geminiUrl = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;

    const response = await fetch(geminiUrl, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
      }),
    });

    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) {
      // Agar 2.5 na mile toh 1.5-flash fallback
      throw new Error(data.error?.message || "Gemini API error");
    }

    const rawText = data.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || "{}";
    const cleanJson = rawText.replace(/```json/gi, "").replace(/```/g, "").trim();
    const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanJson);

    return res.status(200).json(parsed);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("AI order error:", err);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || "Order parsing fail ho gaya" });
  }
}

// Usage (project root se):
//   node patch-firestore.cjs            -> sirf 2 zaroori fix (auditLogs + feedback)
//   node patch-firestore.cjs --harden   -> upar wale 2 + orders update ki security tight
// Backup: firestore.rules.pre-patch
const fs = require("fs");

const file = process.argv.find((a) => a.endsWith(".rules")) || "firestore.rules";
const harden = process.argv.includes("--harden");

if (!fs.existsSync(file)) {
  console.error("firestore.rules nahi mili. Aise chalao: node patch-firestore.cjs path/to/firestore.rules");
  process.exit(1);
}

let src = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
const crlf = src.includes("\r\n");
if (crlf) src = src.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");

const report = [];
let applied = 0;

function applyLiteral(name, find, repl) {
  const count = src.split(find).length - 1;
  if (count === 1) { src = src.replace(find, () => repl); applied++; report.push("OK      " + name); }
  else if (count === 0) report.push("SKIP    " + name + "  (nahi mila - shayad pehle hi apply ho chuka)");
  else report.push("SKIP    " + name + "  (" + count + " jagah mila - unsafe)");
}

function applyRegex(name, re, replFn) {
  const m = src.match(re);
  if (m) { src = src.replace(re, replFn); applied++; report.push("OK      " + name); }
  else report.push("SKIP    " + name + "  (pattern nahi mila)");
}

// 1) App "auditLogs" collection me likhta hai, rules me sirf "auditLog" tha -> sab write deny ho rahe the
if (/match \/auditLogs\/\{id\}/.test(src)) {
  report.push("SKIP    F1. auditLogs rule  (pehle se hai)");
} else {
  applyLiteral(
    "F1. auditLogs collection ka rule",
    `match /auditLog/{id} {`,
    `match /auditLogs/{id} {
      allow read: if isAdmin();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /auditLog/{id} {`
  );
}

// 2) FeedbackModal "feedback" collection me likhta hai, rules me tha hi nahi
if (/match \/feedback\/\{id\}/.test(src)) {
  report.push("SKIP    F2. feedback rule  (pehle se hai)");
} else {
  applyLiteral(
    "F2. feedback collection ka rule",
    `match /day/{id} {`,
    `match /feedback/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn();
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /day/{id} {`
  );
}

// 3) (optional) waiter ko owner-only kaam se rokna: cancel / undo paid / discount badalna / restore
if (harden) {
  applyRegex(
    "H1. orders update: waiter cancel/undo-paid/discount nahi kar sakta",
    /(allow read: if isStaff\(\) \|\| \(signedIn\(\) && resource\.data\.createdBy == request\.auth\.uid\);\s*)allow update: if isStaff\(\);/,
    (_, head) => head + `allow update: if isAdmin() || (isStaff()
        && resource.data.get('status', '') != 'cancelled'
        && (request.resource.data.get('status', '') != 'cancelled' || request.resource.data.get('cancelledBy', '') == 'merge')
        && !(resource.data.get('paid', false) == true && request.resource.data.get('paid', false) != true)
        && request.resource.data.get('billDiscountPct', 0) == resource.data.get('billDiscountPct', 0));`
  );
}

if (applied > 0) {
  fs.copyFileSync(file, file + ".pre-patch");
  fs.writeFileSync(file, crlf ? src.replace(/\n/g, "\r\n") : src, "utf8");
}
console.log(report.join("\n"));
console.log("\n" + applied + " edits apply hue" + (applied ? " | backup: " + file + ".pre-patch" : ""));
