#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Estimate Panel v3 (rule-based qty) - v2 ke upar lagao.

Usage (project root me):
    python3 apply_estimate_v3.py                 # file khud dhoondh lega
    python3 apply_estimate_v3.py src/StaffApp.jsx

Sirf Estimate panel wala block badalta hai. Backup: <file>.v2.bak
"""
import sys, glob, shutil

SEP = "// ==========================================================================="

NEW_PANEL = r'''// ===========================================================================
// ğŸ“‹ ESTIMATE PANEL v3 â€” rule-based qty (pc / roti / rice / dal), persistent items
// ===========================================================================
//LOGIC-START
// ğŸ‘‰ Apne hisaab se yahan numbers badal sakte ho
const EST_LEVELS = [
  { id: "kam", label: "Kam", pc: 2, roti: 2, rice: 0.33, dal: 0.25, drink: 1 },
  { id: "normal", label: "Normal", pc: 3, roti: 2, rice: 0.4, dal: 0.33, drink: 1 },
  { id: "zyada", label: "Zyada", pc: 4, roti: 3, rice: 0.5, dal: 0.4, drink: 1 },
];
const EST_PC_DEFAULT = 8;        // ek plate me kitne piece (naam me "(4pc)" ho to wahi use hoga)
const EST_PC_EXTRA_PER_DISH = 1; // 2+ sabzi hon to per log total piece itna badhta hai (dish ginti - 1) x ye

function estKind(m) {
  const n = String(m.name || "").toLowerCase();
  const t = n + " " + String(m.category || "").toLowerCase();
  if (/roti|naan|paratha|kulcha|phulka|chapati/.test(n)) return "roti";
  if (/biryani|rice|pulao|pulav/.test(n)) return "rice";
  if (/\bdal\b|daal|dhal/.test(n)) return "dal";
  if (/water|cold drink|coke|pepsi|sprite|soda|lassi|juice|mojito|shake|coffee|\btea\b|chai/.test(n)) return "drink";
  if (/momo|roll|burger|pizza|sandwich|fries|maggi|pasta|noodle|chowmein|chaumin|soup|ice cream|dessert|sweet|gulab|rasgulla|rasmalai|salad|papad|raita/.test(t)) return "other";
  if (/paneer|mushroom|chicken|mutton|fish|egg|manchurian|chilly|chilli|kadai|kadhai|masala|curry|tikka|kabab|kebab|soya|chaap|veg|gobi|aloo|sabzi|handi|korma|butter|tandoor|starter|main|gravy|dry|chinese/.test(t)) return "pc";
  return "other";
}
function estPcPerPlate(name) {
  const mm = String(name || "").match(/(\d+)\s*(pc|pcs|piece|pieces)\b/i);
  return mm && Number(mm[1]) > 0 ? Number(mm[1]) : EST_PC_DEFAULT;
}
const estFmt = (n) => String(Math.round(n * 100) / 100);
const estCeil = (x) => Math.max(1, Math.ceil(x - 0.05));

// items: [{id,name,price,qty}], menuById: {id: menuItem}, pax: number, lv: EST_LEVELS entry
// return: { [id]: { qty, note } }  (sirf wahi items jinka rule hai)
function estCompute(items, menuById, pax, lv) {
  const groups = { pc: [], roti: [], rice: [], dal: [], drink: [] };
  items.forEach((i) => {
    const k = estKind(menuById[i.id] || i);
    if (groups[k]) groups[k].push(i);
  });
  const out = {};
  const nPc = groups.pc.length;
  if (nPc) {
    const pool = lv.pc + EST_PC_EXTRA_PER_DISH * (nPc - 1); // per log total piece (sab sabzi mila ke)
    const share = pool / nPc;                                // per log, is dish ke piece
    groups.pc.forEach((i) => {
      const per = estPcPerPlate(i.name);
      const pieces = share * pax;
      const qty = estCeil(pieces / per);
      out[i.id] = { qty, note: pax + " log x " + estFmt(share) + " pc = " + Math.round(pieces) + " pc / " + per + " pc plate = " + qty + " plate" };
    });
  }
  [["roti", "roti", "roti"], ["rice", "rice", "plate"], ["dal", "dal", "plate"], ["drink", "drink", "pc"]].forEach(([g, key, unit]) => {
    const arr = groups[g];
    if (!arr.length) return;
    const total = (pax * lv[key]) / arr.length;
    arr.forEach((i) => {
      const qty = estCeil(total);
      out[i.id] = { qty, note: pax + " log x " + estFmt(lv[key]) + " " + unit + (arr.length > 1 ? " / " + arr.length + " item" : "") + " = " + qty };
    });
  });
  return out;
}
//LOGIC-END

function EstStepper({ C, q, onChange, size = 32 }) {
  const b = { width: size, height: size, border: "none", fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 900, cursor: "pointer", padding: 0, fontFamily: "inherit" };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", border: "1.5px solid " + C.gold, borderRadius: 10, overflow: "hidden", flexShrink: 0, background: C.card }}>
      <button onClick={() => onChange(q - 1)} style={{ ...b, background: C.cardAlt, color: C.ink }}>âˆ’</button>
      <span style={{ minWidth: 30, textAlign: "center", fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 14, color: C.ink, fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{q}</span>
      <button onClick={() => onChange(q + 1)} style={{ ...b, background: C.gold, color: "#fff" }}>+</button>
    </div>
  );
}

function EstimatePanel({ C, menu, orders, isMobile, items, setItems, persons, setPersons, onClose, onMoveToCart }) {
  const haptic = useHaptic();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [search, setSearch] = React.useState("");
  const dSearch = useDebounce(search, 150);
  const [catFilter, setCatFilter] = React.useState("All");
  const [showSel, setShowSel] = React.useState(false);
  const [level, setLevel] = React.useState(() => { try { return localStorage.getItem("staff_estimate_level") || "normal"; } catch (e) { return "normal"; } });

  const lv = EST_LEVELS.find((l) => l.id === level) || EST_LEVELS[1];
  const pax = Math.max(1, Number(persons) || 1);
  const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
  const count = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty, 0);
  const qtyOf = (id) => { const it = items.find((p) => p.id === id); return it ? it.qty : 0; };

  const menuById = React.useMemo(() => { const o = {}; menu.forEach((m) => { o[m.id] = m; }); return o; }, [menu]);
  const sug = React.useMemo(() => estCompute(items, menuById, pax, lv), [items, menuById, pax, lv]);

  const pickLevel = (id) => { haptic(6); setLevel(id); try { localStorage.setItem("staff_estimate_level", id); } catch (e) {} };

  const setQty = (m, q) => {
    haptic(6);
    setItems((prev) => {
      if (q <= 0) return prev.filter((p) => p.id !== m.id);
      if (prev.some((p) => p.id === m.id)) return prev.map((p) => (p.id === m.id ? { ...p, qty: q } : p));
      return [...prev, { id: m.id, name: m.name, price: Number(m.price) || 0, qty: q }];
    });
  };
  const removeId = (id) => setItems((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
  const clearAll = () => {
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (window.confirm("Estimate ke saare items hata dein?")) { setItems([]); setShowSel(false); }
  };
  const applyAuto = () => {
    if (!items.length) { toast("Pehle items add karo, phir Auto qty dabao", "warning"); return; }
    const n = Object.keys(sug).length;
    if (!n) { toast("In items ke liye auto rule nahi hai, qty khud badlo", "warning"); return; }

  const setPax = (v) => {
    if (v === "") { setPersons(""); return; }
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(999, parseInt(v, 10) || 1));
    setPersons(n);
  };

  const categories = React.useMemo(
    () => ["All", ...Array.from(new Set(menu.map((m) => m.category).filter(Boolean)))],
    [menu]
  );

  const popular = React.useMemo(() => {
    const cnt = {};
    (orders || []).forEach((o) => {
      if (o.status === "cancelled") return;
      (o.items || []).forEach((it) => { cnt[it.itemId] = (cnt[it.itemId] || 0) + (Number(it.qty) || 0); });
    });
    const seen = new Set();

      .filter((m) => m.available !== false && cnt[m.id])
      .sort((a, b) => cnt[b.id] - cnt[a.id])

  });

      <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ textAlign: "left", background: C.card, color: C.ink, borderRadius: isMobile ? "20px 20px 0 0" : 16, width: "100%", maxWidth: isMobile ? def die(msg):
    print("âŒ " + msg)
    print("File me koi badlav NAHI hua.")
    sys.exit(1)


def find_file():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        return sys.argv[1]
    cands = [p for p in glob.glob("**/*.jsx", recursive=True) + glob.glob("**/*.js", recursive=True)
             if "node_modules" not in p and "ESTIMATE PANEL v2" in open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()]
    if len(cands) == 1:
        return cands[0]
    die("Staff file nahi mili ya ek se zyada hain: %s\nPath do: python3 apply_estimate_v3.py src/StaffApp.jsx" % cands)


def main():
    path = find_file()
    src = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    print("ğŸ“„ File:", path)

    if "ESTIMATE PANEL v3" in src:
        die("v3 pehle se lagi hui hai.")
    i_est = src.find("// ğŸ“‹ ESTIMATE PANEL v2")
    if i_est < 0:
        die("v2 nahi mili. Pehle apply_estimate_v2.py chalao.")
    i_main = src.find("// MAIN APP")
    if i_main < 0 or i_main < i_est:
        die("MAIN APP banner nahi mila.")
    start = src.rfind(SEP, 0, i_est)
    end = src.rfind(SEP, 0, i_main)
    if start < 0 or end <= start:
        die("Banner lines nahi mili.")

    out = src[:start] + NEW_PANEL + src[end:]
    shutil.copyfile(path, path + ".v2.bak")
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(out)
    print("âœ… Estimate v3 lag gayi")
    print("ğŸ’¾ Backup:", path + ".v2.bak")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Fix for ReportsView close PnL fragment

import sys, re

path = "src/StaffApp.jsx"
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    src = f.read()

# ReportsView ke andar, {!loading && ( <> ... </> )} ke baad
# {rTab === "pnl" && (<> ... </>)} close karna hai

# Step 1: Check karo patch 5 laga hai (state for tab)
if 'const [rTab, setRTab] = useState("pnl");' not in src:
    print("ERROR: Patch 5 nahi laga. Pehle patch_staff5.py chalao.")
    sys.exit(1)

# Step 2: Agar already fixed hai
if '      </>)}\n    </div>\n  );\n}' in src:
    print("PEHLE SE: ReportsView closing fixed hai")
    sys.exit(0)

# Step 3: ReportsView dhoondo aur uska end fix karo
# Strategy: ReportsView function ke andar, {!loading && ( <> ... </> )} ke baad
# {rTab === "pnl" && (<> ... </>)} ka close add karo

# Find ReportsView start
m = re.search(r'function ReportsView\([^)]+\)\s*\{', src)
if not m:
    print("ERROR: ReportsView nahi mila")
    sys.exit(1)

start = m.start()
# Find next function (ReportsView ka end)
next_fn = re.search(r'\nfunction [A-Z]', src[start+10:])
if not next_fn:
    print("ERROR: ReportsView ka end nahi mila")
    sys.exit(1)

end = start + 10 + next_fn.start()
reports_body = src[start:end]

# Ab is body ke end mein, last ')}' + '</div>' + ');' + '}' dhoondo
# Pattern: '      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}' (ReportsView ka end)
old_pattern = '      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}'
new_pattern = '      )}\n      </>)}\n    </div>\n  );\n}'

# Sirf ReportsView ke andar replace karo
if old_pattern not in reports_body:
    print("ERROR: ReportsView ke end mein expected pattern nahi mila.")
    print("Body ka last 200 chars:")
    print(repr(reports_body[-200:]))
    sys.exit(1)

new_body = reports_body.replace(old_pattern, new_pattern, 1)
src = src[:start] + new_body + src[end:]

# Backup
import shutil, datetime
bak = path + ".bak_fix-" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
shutil.copyfile(path, bak)

with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(src)

print("OK: ReportsView closing fix ho gaya")
print("Backup:", bak)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Usage: python3 patch_staff3.py src/StaffApp.jsx
# Golden professional theme: warm ivory / warm black palette, gold buttons, header, tabs, chips,
# gold focus ring, serif headings. Danger/status colours (red/green/amber) jaise ke waise rahte hain.

import sys, re, shutil, datetime

if len(sys.argv) < 2:
    print(__doc__)
    sys.exit(1)

path = sys.argv[1]
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    src = f.read()

applied = 0
skipped = 0

def exact(name, old, new, expect_one=True):
    """exact string replace (sab jagah)"""
    global src, applied, skipped
    n = src.count(old)
    if n == 0:
        if new in src:
            print("PEHLE SE", name)
        else:
            skipped += 1
            print("SKIP  ", name, "(mila nahi)")
        return
    if expect_one and n != 1:
        skipped += 1
        print("SKIP  ", name, "(%d jagah mila)" % n)
        return
    src = src.replace(old, new)
    applied += 1
    print("OK    ", name, "(%d)" % n)

def rx(name, pattern, repl):
    global src, applied, skipped
    src, n = re.subn(pattern, repl, src)
    if n:
        applied += 1
        print("OK    ", name, "(%d)" % n)
    else:
        skipped += 1
        print("SKIP  ", name, "(mila nahi)")

const edit = (name, find, replace, doneIf) => {
  if (src.includes(doneIf)) return console.log("SKIP (pehle se hai):", name);
  const isRe = find instanceof RegExp;
  const n = isRe ? (src.match(new RegExp(find.source, "g")) || []).length : src.split(find).length - 1;
  if (n !== 1) {
    console.error("FAIL:", name, "- match " + n + " mile (1 chahiye)");
    failed = true;
    return;
  }
  src = src.replace(find, () => replace);
  console.log("OK  :", name);
};

// ============================================================
// projectpatch.js â€” Eat & Park Staff POS mega patch
// Usage: node projectpatch.js [path/to/StaffApp.jsx]
// Default: src/StaffApp.jsx
// ============================================================
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const FILE = process.argv[2] || 'src/StaffApp.jsx';
if (!fs.existsSync(FILE)) {
  console.error('\nâŒ File not found: ' + FILE);
  console.error('   Usage: node projectpatch.js path/to/StaffApp.jsx\n');
  process.exit(1);
}

const SRC = fs.readFileSync(FILE, 'utf8');
const BACKUP = FILE + '.backup.' + Date.now();
fs.writeFileSync(BACKUP, SRC);
console.log('\nğŸ“¦ Backup: ' + path.relative(process.cwd(), BACKUP) + '\n');

let src = SRC;
const report = [];
let failed = 0;

// ---------- helpers ----------
function apply(name, from, to, optional) {
  if (!src.includes(from)) {
    if (!optional) failed++;
    report.push((optional ? 'âšª ' : 'âŒ ') + name + (optional ? ' (skipped)' : ' â€” anchor not found'));
    return;
  }
  src = src.replace(from, to);
  report.push('âœ… ' + name);
}
function applyAll(name, from, to) {
  const n = src.split(from).length - 1;
  if (n === 0) { failed++; report.push('âŒ ' + name); return; }
  src = src.split(from).join(to);
  report.push('âœ… ' + name + ' (' + n + 'x)');
}
function findFunctionBounds(name) {
  const re = new RegExp('function\\s+' + name + '\\s*\\(');
  const m = src.match(re);
  if (!m) return null;
  const startIdx = m.index;
  let i = startIdx + m[0].length - 1;
  let pd = 1; i++;
  while (i < src.length && pd > 0) {
    if (src[i] === '(') pd++;
    else if (src[i] === ')') pd--;
    i++;
  }
  while (i < src.length && /\s/.test(src[i])) i++;
  if (src[i] !== '{') return null;
  let depth = 1; i++;
  while (i < src.length && depth > 0) {
    if (src[i] === '{') depth++;
    else if (src[i] === '}') depth--;
    i++;
  }
  if (depth !== 0) return null;
  return { start: startIdx, end: i };
}

const NEW_ORDERS_VIEW = String.raw`function OrdersView({ C, isMobile, orders, menu, waiterName, isOwner, filter, setFilter, rangeStart, rangeEnd, setOrders, onPaidSuccess, onAddMore, onEditBill }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const haptic = useHaptic();
  const defaultStart = useMemo(() => { const d = new Date(); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return d.getTime(); }, []);
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState(null);
  const payLockRef = useRef(false);
  const [payFor, setPayFor] = useState(null);
  const [cancellingId, setCancellingId] = useState(null);
  const start = rangeStart ?? defaultStart;
  const end = rangeEnd ?? Date.now();
  const rangeAll = orders.filter(o => {
    if (o.createdAt < start || o.createdAt >= end) return false;
    if (filter === "cancelled") return o.status === "cancelled";
    return o.status !== "cancelled";
  });
  const filtered =
    filter === "all" ? rangeAll
    : filter === "active" ? rangeAll.filter(o => o.status !== "served" && !o.paid)
    : filter === "paid" ? rangeAll.filter(o => o.paid)
    : filter === "served" ? rangeAll.filter(o => o.status === "served")
    : filter === "cancelled" ? rangeAll
    : rangeAll.filter(o => o.status === filter);

  const advanceOrder = async (order) => {
    const idx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(order.status);
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= STATUS_FLOW.length - 1) return;
    const next = STATUS_FLOW[idx + 1];
    haptic(12);
    setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, status: next } : o));
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", order.id), { status: next }); toast("Order â†’ " + STATUS[next].label, "success"); }
    catch (e) {
      setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, status: order.status } : o));
      toast(e.message, "error");
    }
  };

  const voidOrder = async (o) => {
    if (!isOwner) { toast("Sirf owner delete kar sakta hai", "warning"); return; }
    const label = o.orderType === "parcel" ? "Parcel" : "Table " + o.table;
    if (!window.confirm(label + " - " + inr(o.finalTotal || 0) + (o.paid ? " (PAID)" : "") + "\nDelete karein? Revenue se hat jayega.")) return;
    const reason = window.prompt("Cancel karne ka reason? (zaroori)", "");
    if (reason === null) return;
    if (!reason.trim()) { toast("Reason likhna zaroori hai", "warning"); return; }
    setCancellingId(o.id);
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", o.id), {
        status: "cancelled", cancelledAt: Date.now(),
        cancelledBy: waiterName || "Staff",
        cancelledReason: reason.trim(),
        voidedWasPaid: !!o.paid,
      });
      logAudit("void_order", { orderId: o.id, total: o.finalTotal || 0, wasPaid: !!o.paid, reason: reason.trim() });
      toast("Order delete ho gaya", "success");
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
    finally { setCancellingId(null); }
  };

  const restoreOrder = async (o) => {
    if (!isOwner) { toast("Sirf owner restore kar sakta hai", "warning"); return; }
    if (!window.confirm("Is cancelled order ko restore karein?")) return;

      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", o.id), {

      });

  };

      });
      logAudit("undo_paid", { orderId: o.id, total: o.finalTotal || 0 });
      toast("Payment undo ho gaya", "success");
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, "error"); }
  };

  const markPaidWith = async (order, mode) => {
    if (payLockRef.current) return;
    payLockRef.current = true;
    haptic(30);
    const patch = { paid: true, paymentStatus: "paid", paidAt: Date.now(), paidBy: waiterName || "Staff", payment: mode };
    if (order.orderType === "parcel") patch.status = "served";
    setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, ...patch } : o));
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "orders", order.id), patch);
      toast("Payment received!", "success");
      if (onPaidSuccess) onPaidSuccess();
    } catch (e) {
      setOrders(prev => prev.map(o => o.id === order.id ? { ...o, paid: false, paymentStatus: "pending" } : o));
      toast(e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      payLockRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  const filterLabel = filter === "cancelled" ? "Cancelled" : filter.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + filter.slice(1);

              ))}

===== ./functions/index.js =====
const functions = require("firebase-functions");
const admin = require("firebase-admin");

admin.initializeApp();

exports.setStaffRole = functions.https.onCall(async (data, context) => {
  const BOOTSTRAP_SECRET = "CHANGE_ME_12345";
  const isBootstrap = data.bootstrap === true && data.bootstrapSecret === BOOTSTRAP_SECRET;

  if (!isBootstrap) {
    if (!context.auth || context.auth.token.role !== "admin") {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("permission-denied", "Sirf admin hi role assign kar sakta hai");
    }
  }

  const { uid, role } = data;
  if (!uid || !["admin", "staff", "waiter"].includes(role)) {
    throw new functions.https.HttpsError("invalid-argument", "uid ya role invalid hai");
  }

  await admin.auth().setCustomUserClaims(uid, { role });
  await admin.firestore().collection("staff").doc(uid).set(
    { role, updatedAt: Date.now() },
    { merge: true }
  );

  return { ok: true, uid, role };
});

exports.health = functions.https.onRequest((req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: "ok", timestamp: Date.now() });
});

import fs from "fs";
const file = process.argv[2];
if (!file) { console.error("usage: node apply-patch.js <path-to-staff-file>"); process.exit(1); }
let src = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
const crlf = src.includes("\r\n");
if (crlf) src = src.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
// fs.copyFileSync(file, file + ".bak");
const L = (...a) => a.join("\n");
let ok = 0; const bad = [];
const note = (n, good) => { if (good) { ok++; console.log("OK  ", n); } else { bad.push(n); console.log("SKIP", n, "(anchor not found or already applied)"); } };
function rep(n, a, b, all) {
  const tag = /\/\*(P\d+)\*\//.exec(b); if (tag && src.includes(tag[0])) return note(n, false);
  if (!src.includes(a)) return note(n, false);
  src = all ? src.split(a).join(b) : src.replace(a, () => b);
  note(n, true);
}
function between(n, s, e, b) {
  const tag = /\/\*(P\d+)\*\//.exec(b); if (tag && src.includes(tag[0])) return note(n, false);
  const i = src.indexOf(s); if (i < 0) return note(n, false);
  const j = src.indexOf(e, i); if (j < 0) return note(n, false);
  src = src.slice(0, i) + b + src.slice(j + e.length); note(n, true);
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
patch_staff5.py - Eat & Park Staff POS: audit fixes in ONE patch.

Run from the repo root (the folder that has package.json):
  python3 patch_staff5.py --dry-run     # checks every anchor, writes NOTHING
  python3 patch_staff5.py               # applies (all-or-nothing, makes a .bak)

What it does NOT do: deploy, push, install packages, or touch your live
firestore.rules. The proposed rules go to firestore.rules.proposed only.
"""

GUARDS = r'''export function assertEditable(live, seen) {
  if (!live) throw new Error("Order ab maujood nahi hai");
  if (live.paid) throw new Error("Order paid ho chuka hai - edit nahi ho sakta");
  if (live.status === "cancelled") throw new Error("Order cancelled hai");
  if (JSON.stringify(live.items || []) !== JSON.stringify(seen.items || []))
    throw new Error("Order kisi aur ne badal diya - screen band karke dobara kholo");
}

export const resolveVendorId = (name, map) =>
  map[String(name || "").trim().toLowerCase()] || null;
'''

GUARDS_TEST = r'''import { describe, test, expect } from "vitest";
import { assertEditable, resolveVendorId } from "./guards";

describe("assertEditable", () => {
  test("rejects missing order", () => expect(() => assertEditable(null, { items: [] })).toThrow(/maujood/));
  test("rejects paid", () => expect(() => assertEditable({ paid: true, items: [] }, { items: [] })).toThrow(/paid/));
  test("rejects cancelled", () => expect(() => assertEditable({ status: "cancelled", items: [] }, { items: [] })).toThrow(/cancelled/));
  test("rejects items changed elsewhere", () =>
    expect(() => assertEditable({ items: [{ itemId: "a", qty: 2 }] }, { items: [{ itemId: "a", qty: 1 }] })).toThrow(/badal/));
  test("allows unchanged open order", () =>
    expect(() => assertEditable({ items: [{ itemId: "a", qty: 1 }] }, { items: [{ itemId: "a", qty: 1 }] })).not.toThrow());
});

describe("resolveVendorId", () => {
  test("case + whitespace insensitive", () => expect(resolveVendorId("  Ramesh ", { ramesh: "v1" })).toBe("v1"));
  test("unknown vendor -> null", () => expect(resolveVendorId("Suresh", { ramesh: "v1" })).toBeNull());
  test("empty name -> null", () => expect(resolveVendorId("", { ramesh: "v1" })).toBeNull());
});
'''

RULES_PROPOSED = r'''rules_version = '2';
// PROPOSED - not deployed. Diff against the rules in your Firebase console first.
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{db}/documents {

    function signedIn() {
      return request.auth != null;
    }
    function hasStaffDoc() {
      return signedIn() && exists(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid));
    }
    function role() {
      return get(/databases/$(db)/documents/staff/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role;
    }
    function isStaff() {
      return hasStaffDoc() && role() in ['admin', 'owner', 'manager', 'staff', 'waiter'];
    }
    // mirrors the app's isOwner (owner / admin / manager)
    function isAdmin() {
      return hasStaffDoc() && role() in ['admin', 'owner', 'manager'];
    }

    match /staff/{uid} {
      allow read: if signedIn() && request.auth.uid == uid;
      allow write: if false;
    }

    // C1: wildcard no longer overlaps privatePins (rules are additive)
    match /settings/{docId} {
      allow read: if docId != 'privatePins';
      allow write: if isStaff() && docId != 'privatePins';
    }
    match /settings/privatePins {
      allow read, write: if isAdmin();
    }

    // C2 (partial): paid orders are locked for non-admins except status changes
    match /orders/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn() && request.resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid;
      allow read: if isStaff() || (signedIn() && resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid);
      allow update: if isStaff() && (
        resource.data.paid != true
        || isAdmin()
        || request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'lastKotAt'])
      );
      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }

    // --- unchanged (customer app) ---
    match /customers/{phone} {
      allow read, write: if signedIn();
    }
    match /loyaltyUsers/{phone} {
      allow get: if signedIn();
      allow list, write: if isStaff();
    }
    match /coinHistory/{id} {
      allow read: if signedIn();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /calls/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn();
      allow read, update: if isStaff();
      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /bookings/{id} {
      allow create: if signedIn();
      allow read, update, delete: if isStaff();
    }
    match /chats/{orderId}/messages/{msgId} {
      allow read, write: if signedIn();
    }
    match /auditLogs/{id} {
      allow read: if isAdmin();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }

    // H9: staff can read stock (low-stock badge), only admins write
    match /inventory/{id} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow write: if isAdmin();
    }

    // H8: collections the staff app uses that had no rule
    match /auditLog/{id} {
      allow read: if isAdmin();
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
    match /expenses/{id} {
      allow read, create: if isStaff();
      allow update, delete: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /vendors/{id} {
      allow read: if isStaff();
      allow write: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /vendorPayments/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /dayClose/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isAdmin();
    }
    match /feedback/{id} {
      allow create: if isStaff();
      allow read: if isAdmin();
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
  }
}
'''

RULES_TEST = r'''import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { beforeAll, afterAll, describe, test } from "vitest";
import { initializeTestEnvironment, assertFails, assertSucceeds } from "@firebase/rules-unit-testing";
import { doc, getDoc, setDoc, updateDoc, addDoc, deleteDoc, collection, getDocs } from "firebase/firestore";

let env;
const as = (uid) => env.authenticatedContext(uid).firestore();
const anon = () => env.unauthenticatedContext().firestore();

beforeAll(async () => {
  env = await initializeTestEnvironment({
    projectId: "demo-eatpark",
    firestore: { rules: readFileSync("firestore.rules.proposed", "utf8") },
  });
  await env.clearFirestore();
  await env.withSecurityRulesDisabled(async (ctx) => {
    const db = ctx.firestore();
    await setDoc(doc(db, "staff/w1"), { role: "waiter" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "staff/a1"), { role: "admin" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "staff/o1"), { role: "owner" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "settings/privatePins"), { pin: "x" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "settings/menu"), { items: [] });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "orders/paid1"), { paid: true, status: "served", finalTotal: 100, createdBy: "c1" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "orders/open1"), { paid: false, status: "new", finalTotal: 100, createdBy: "c1" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "expenses/e1"), { amount: 10, date: "2026-10-30" });
    await setDoc(doc(db, "inventory/items"), { list: [] });
  });
});
afterAll(async () => { await env.cleanup(); });

describe("settings", () => {
  test("anon cannot read privatePins", () => assertFails(getDoc(doc(anon(), "settings/privatePins"))));
  test("waiter cannot write privatePins", () => assertFails(setDoc(doc(as("w1"), "settings/privatePins"), { pin: "y" })));
  test("admin can read privatePins", () => assertSucceeds(getDoc(doc(as("a1"), "settings/privatePins"))));
  test("anon can still read menu", () => assertSucceeds(getDoc(doc(anon(), "settings/menu"))));
});

describe("orders", () => {
  test("waiter cannot change total on paid order", () => assertFails(updateDoc(doc(as("w1"), "orders/paid1"), { finalTotal: 1 })));
  test("waiter can change status on paid order", () => assertSucceeds(updateDoc(doc(as("w1"), "orders/paid1"), { status: "served" })));
  test("owner can undo paid", () => assertSucceeds(updateDoc(doc(as("o1"), "orders/paid1"), { paid: false })));
  test("waiter can mark open order paid", () => assertSucceeds(updateDoc(doc(as("w1"), "orders/open1"), { paid: true })));
  test("waiter cannot delete order", () => assertFails(deleteDoc(doc(as("w1"), "orders/open1"))));
  test("owner role passes isStaff (reads orders)", () => assertSucceeds(getDoc(doc(as("o1"), "orders/open1"))));
});

describe("other collections", () => {
  test("waiter can write auditLog", () => assertSucceeds(addDoc(collection(as("w1"), "auditLog"), { action: "x" })));
  test("waiter cannot read auditLog", () => assertFails(getDocs(collection(as("w1"), "auditLog"))));

SCRIPTS = {
    "test": "vitest run src",
    "test:rules": "firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-eatpark --only firestore \"vitest run tests/rules\"",
}


def apply_patches(src):
    """Returns (new_src, report_lines, failed_count)."""
    report, failed = [], 0
    for name, kind, old, new, marker in PATCHES:
        if marker in src:
            report.append("  = already applied : " + name)
            continue
        if kind == "re":
            n = len(re.findall(old, src, flags=re.S))
        else:
            n = src.count(old)
        if n != 1:
            failed += 1
            report.append("  X anchor matches %d (need exactly 1): %s" % (n, name))
            continue
        if kind == "re":
            src = re.sub(old, lambda m: new, src, count=1, flags=re.S)
        else:
            src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
        report.append("  + will apply      : " + name)
    return src, report, failed


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(APP):
        sys.exit("Cannot find %s - run this from the repo root." % APP)
    with open(APP, encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        original = f.read()

    new_src, report, failed = apply_patches(original)
    print("\n".join(report))
    if failed:
        print("\n%d anchor(s) did not match your file. NOTHING was written." % failed)
        print("Send me the lines above marked X (or your current StaffApp.jsx) and I will adjust.")
        sys.exit(1)
    if DRY:
        print("\nDry run OK - every anchor matched. Nothing written.")
        return

    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    bak = APP + "." + stamp + ".bak"
    shutil.copy2(APP, bak)
    with open(APP, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(new_src)
    print("\nPatched %s (backup: %s)" % (APP, bak))

    for path, text in NEW_FILES.items():
        if os.path.exists(path):
            print("  skip (exists): " + path)
            continue
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)
        print("  created      : " + path)

    if os.path.exists("package.json"):
        with open("package.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            pkg = json.load(f)
        pkg.setdefault("scripts", {})
        added = [k for k in SCRIPTS if k not in pkg["scripts"]]
        for k in added:
            pkg["scripts"][k] = SCRIPTS[k]
        if added:
            with open("package.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(pkg, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
                f.write("\n")
        print("  package.json scripts added: " + (", ".join(added) or "none"))

    print("""
NEXT (run these yourself, in order):
  npm i -D vitest @firebase/rules-unit-testing firebase-tools
  npm run build
  npx oxlint src
  npm test
  npm run test:rules        # needs Java for the Firestore emulator
Nothing has been deployed. firestore.rules.proposed is NOT live.
To undo: git checkout src/StaffApp.jsx   (or copy the .bak back)""")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

const newAI = `
function InteractiveSuggest({ C, menu, persons, onSuggest, onCancel }) {
  const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0);
  const [selections, setSelections] = React.useState({});

  const steps = [
    { title: "1. Starter (Snacks)", filter: (m) => /starter|snack|tandoor|momos|roll/i.test(m.category || ""), calcQty: (p) => Math.ceil(p / 3) },
    { title: "2. Main Course", filter: (m) => /main|curry|sabzi|gravy|paneer|chicken|mutton/i.test(m.category || ""), calcQty: (p) => Math.ceil(p / 4) },
    { title: "3. Bread (Roti/Naan)", filter: (m) => /bread|roti|naan/i.test(m.category || ""), calcQty: (p) => p * 2 },
    { title: "4. Rice / Biryani", filter: (m) => /rice|biryani|pulao/i.test(m.category || ""), calcQty: (p) => Math.ceil(p / 3) },
    { title: "5. Drinks / Shakes", filter: (m) => /drink|shake|juice|cold|mojito/i.test(m.category || ""), calcQty: (p) => p }
  ];

  const currentStepData = steps[step];
  const stepItems = menu.filter(m => m.available && currentStepData.filter(m));

  const handleSelectItem = (item) => {
    setSelections(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (next[item.id]) delete next[item.id];
      else next[item.id] = { item, qty: 1 };
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (step < steps.length - 1) {
      setStep(step + 1);
    } else {
      const finalItems = Object.values(selections).map(sel => {
        const autoQty = currentStepData.calcQty(persons);
        return { id: sel.item.id, name: sel.item.name, price: sel.item.price, qty: Math.max(1, autoQty) };
      });
      onSuggest(finalItems);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: 16, background: C.cardAlt, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid " + C.line }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, color: C.ink }}>{currentStepData.title}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: C.gray, fontWeight: 700 }}>{step + 1}/{steps.length} (For {persons} pax)</div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ maxHeight: 200, overflowY: 'auto', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        {stepItems.map(m => {
          const isSelected = !!selections[m.id];
          return (
            <div key={m.id} onClick={() => !isSelected && handleSelectItem(m)} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: 8, borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.line, background: isSelected ? C.goldLight : 'transparent', borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <span style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: '50%', background: m.veg ? 'green' : 'red' }}></span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: C.ink }}>{m.name}</span>
              </div>
              {isSelected ? <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: C.goldText, fontWeight: 800 }}>Selected âœ“</span> : <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: C.goldText }}>{inr(m.price)} +</span>}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
        {step > 0 && <button onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)} style={{ flex: 1, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid " + C.line, background: C.card, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', color: C.ink }}>â† Pichla</button>}
        {step < steps.length - 1 ? (

import fs from "fs";

const FILE = "src/StaffApp.jsx";

const helpers = `// ============ SAFE HELPERS ============
function getErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message) return error.message;
  if (typeof error === "string") return error;
  if (error && typeof error === "object" && "message" in error) {
    return String(error.message);
  }
  return "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.";
}
function isRefreshNeeded(error) {
  const msg = getErrorMessage(error);
  return msg === "REFRESH_NEEDED" || msg.includes("badal diya");
}
function safeStorageGet(key, fallback = null) {
  try {
    const v = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    return v === null ? fallback : v;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}
function safeStorageSet(key, value) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, String(value));
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
function safeStorageRemove(key) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
// ======================================
`;

// Read file as array of lines
const text = fs.readFileSync(FILE, "utf8");
const lines = text.split("\n");

// Already inserted?
if (text.includes("function safeStorageGet")) {
  console.log("Helpers already present. Nothing to do.");
  process.exit(0);
}

// Find the line index (0-based) of "} from \"firebase/firestore\";"
let firestoreEndIdx = -1;
for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
  if (lines[i].includes('} from "firebase/firestore"')) {
    firestoreEndIdx = i;
    break;
  }
}

if (firestoreEndIdx === -1) {
  console.log('ERROR: Could not find line: } from "firebase/firestore"');
  console.log("File ka pehla 15 line dekho:");
  console.log(lines.slice(0, 15).map((l, i) => `${i + 1}: ${l}`).join("\n"));
  process.exit(1);
}

// Insert helpers AFTER that line (insert blank line, helpers, blank line)
const insertPos = firestoreEndIdx + 1;
const before = lines.slice(0, insertPos);
const after = lines.slice(insertPos);

const newLines = [
  ...before,
  "",                       // blank line
  ...helpers.split("\n"),   // helpers block
  "",                       // blank line
  ...after,
];

fs.writeFileSync(FILE, newLines.join("\n"));

console.log("=================================================");
console.log("SUCCESS");
console.log("=================================================");
console.log(`Firestore import end found at: line ${firestoreEndIdx + 1}`);
console.log(`Helpers inserted after line ${insertPos}`);
console.log(`Total helpers lines added: ${helpers.split("\n").length}`);
console.log("=================================================");

    // Jab hume Cancel Modal mila, toh uske upar wale hisse mein missing </div> daalenge
    // Hum check karenge ki kya pehle se koi </div> missing hai
    if (!lines[i-1].includes('</div>')) {
       lines.splice(i, 0, '        </div>');
       fixed = true;
    }
    break;
  }
}

if (fixed) {
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, lines.join('\n'), "utf8");
  console.log("âœ… Fix Successful: Missing </div> tag ko exact jagah par daal diya gaya hai.");
  console.log("ğŸ‘‰ Ab push karein:");
  console.log("   git add src/StaffApp.jsx && git commit -m \"Fixed build syntax error automatically\" && git push origin main --force");
} else {
  console.log("âš ï¸ File mein ModalShell nahi mila ya tag pehle se theek hai.");
}===== ./patch_staff2.py =====

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

// Code ke andar ka text search karne wala function
function findFileByContent(dir, searchString) {
    const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
    for (const file of files) {
        if (file === 'node_modules' || file === '.git' || file === 'dist' || file === 'build' || file === '.next') continue;
        const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);
        const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
        if (stat.isDirectory()) {
            const found = findFileByContent(fullPath, searchString);
            if (found) return found;
        } else if (file.endsWith('.jsx') || file.endsWith('.tsx') || file.endsWith('.js')) {
            const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
            if (content.includes(searchString)) {
                return fullPath;
            }
        }
    }
    return null;
}
